name: TubalTensor.transform_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transform_apply (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) (k : Fin n) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin p) :
    transform A k i j = td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (A i j))) k
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.invTransform_transform
statement:
theorem invTransform_transform (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) :
    invTransform (transform A) = A
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  show KM.ofFun (vecRe (td.applyMinv (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (A i j)))))) = A i j
  rw [td.applyMinv_applyM, vecRe_toComplex, KM.ofFun_toFun]

name: TubalTensor.transform_invTransform
statement:
theorem transform_invTransform
    (Ahat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (hreal : ∀ i j, IsRealVec (td.applyMinv (fun k => Ahat k i j))) :
    transform (invTransform Ahat : TubalMatrix m p n td) = Ahat
proof:
:= by
  funext k i j
  simp only [transform_apply, invTransform, KM.toFun_ofFun]
  rw [toComplex_vecRe _ (hreal i j), td.applyM_applyMinv]

name: TubalTensor.toComplex_sum
statement:
private theorem toComplex_sum {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → Fin n → ℝ) :
    toComplex (∑ s ∈ S, f s) = ∑ s ∈ S, toComplex (f s)
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => ext i; simp [toComplex_apply]
  | cons a S ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_cons]
    rw [toComplex_add, ih]

name: TubalTensor.applyM_sum
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
    exact Matrix.mulVec_zero _
  | cons a S ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_cons]
    rw [td.applyM_add, ih]

name: TubalTensor.applyM_toComplex_mul
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : toComplex (KM.toFun (a * b)) =
      starMC td (toComplex (KM.toFun a)) (toComplex (KM.toFun b)) := by
    change toComplex (starM td (KM.toFun a) (KM.toFun b)) = _
    exact starM_eq_starMC td (KM.toFun a) (KM.toFun b)
  rw [h1]
  show td.applyM (td.applyMinv (td.applyM _ ∘ₕ td.applyM _)) = _
  rw [td.applyM_applyMinv]

name: TubalTensor.transform_mul
statement:
private theorem transform_mul (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) (B : TubalMatrix p l n td) :
    transform (A * B) = transform A △ transform B
proof:
:= by
  funext k i j
  simp only [transform_apply, facewise_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
  
  change (td.applyM (toComplex (∑ s : Fin p, KM.toFun (A i s * B s j)))) k = _
  rw [toComplex_sum, applyM_sum]
  
  rw [Finset.sum_apply]
  
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
  have := congr_fun (applyM_toComplex_mul (A i s) (B s j)) k
  simpa [vecHadamard_apply] using this

name: TubalTensor.transform_injective
statement:
private theorem transform_injective :
    Function.Injective (transform : TubalMatrix m p n td → _)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective invTransform_transform

name: TubalTensor.tube_eq_zero_iff_transform
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h k
    simp only [transform_apply, h, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
    exact congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_zero td.M) k
  · intro h
    have hall : td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (A i j))) = 0 := funext h
    have hzero := congr_arg td.applyMinv hall
    simp only [td.applyMinv_applyM] at hzero
    rw [show td.applyMinv 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _] at hzero
    have hfun : KM.toFun (A i j) = 0 := by
      ext l; have := congr_fun hzero l
      simp only [toComplex, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    change KM.ofFun (KM.toFun (A i j)) = 0
    rw [hfun]; rfl

name: TubalTensor.transform_eq_facewise_iff
statement:
theorem transform_eq_facewise_iff
    (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) (B : TubalMatrix p l n td) (C : TubalMatrix m l n td) :
    C = A * B ↔ transform C = transform A △ transform B
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ transform_mul A B,
   fun h => transform_injective (h.trans (transform_mul A B).symm)⟩

name: TubalTensor.facewise_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem facewise_apply
    (A : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (B : Fin n → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin l) ℂ) (k : Fin n) :
    (A △ B) k = A k * B k
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.sum_normSq_unitary_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  set A : Matrix (Fin n') (Fin 1) ℂ := fun i _ => v i
  have hA : frobNormSq A = ∑ i, Complex.normSq (v i) := by
    unfold frobNormSq; congr 1; funext i
    exact Fin.sum_univ_one _
  have hWA : W * A = fun i (_ : Fin 1) => (W.mulVec v) i := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, mulVec, dotProduct]
    rfl
  have hWA_frob : frobNormSq (W * A) = ∑ i, Complex.normSq ((W.mulVec v) i) := by
    unfold frobNormSq; rw [hWA]; congr 1; funext i
    exact Fin.sum_univ_one _
  rw [← hWA_frob, frobNormSq_unitary_mul_left W A hW, hA]

name: TubalTensor.normSq_ofReal'
statement: private theorem normSq_ofReal' (r : ℝ) : Complex.normSq (r : ℂ) = r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.normSq_ofReal]; ring

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform (c : ℂ) (W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hW : IsUnitary W) (hM : td.M = c • W)
    (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) :
    Complex.normSq c * tubalFrobNormSq A =
    ∑ k : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform A k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobNormSq tubalFrobNormSq
  simp_rw [transform_apply]
  
  
  
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]; simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  
  
  
  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]; arg 2; ext i; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  congr 1; funext i; congr 1; funext j
  set a := KM.toFun (A i j)
  
  have hMv : td.applyM (toComplex a) = c • W.mulVec (toComplex a) := by
    show td.M.mulVec (toComplex a) = c • W.mulVec (toComplex a)
    rw [hM, Matrix.smul_mulVec]
  simp_rw [hMv, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
  
  
  
  conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  
  congr 1
  
  rw [sum_normSq_unitary_mulVec W hW]
  
  congr 1; funext k
  rw [toComplex_apply, normSq_ofReal']

name: TubalTensor.transform_slice_unitary_of_starMUnitary
statement:
theorem transform_slice_unitary_of_starMUnitary
    (U : TubalMatrix m m n td) (hU : IsStarMUnitary U) (k : Fin n) :
    IsUnitary (transform U k)
proof:
:= by
  show (transform U k)ᴴ * transform U k = 1
  have h1 : transform (Uᴴ * U) = fun k => (transform U k)ᴴ * transform U k := by
    have hfact := (transform_eq_facewise_iff Uᴴ U (Uᴴ * U)).mp rfl
    funext k'; have := congr_fun hfact k'
    simp only [facewise_apply] at this
    rw [this, congr_fun (transform_conjTranspose U) k']
  rw [← congr_fun h1 k, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, congr_fun transform_one k]

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_mul_left
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_mul_left
    (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td)
    (U : TubalMatrix m m n td) (B : TubalMatrix m p n td)
    (hU : IsStarMUnitary U) :
    tubalFrobNormSq (U * B) = tubalFrobNormSq B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, W, hc, hW, hM⟩ := hsc
  have hLHS := tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform c W hW hM (U * B)
  have hRHS := tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform c W hW hM B
  have heq : ∑ k : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform (U * B) k) =
             ∑ k : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform B k) := by
    congr 1; funext k
    have hfact := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff U B (U * B)).mp rfl) k
    simp only [facewise_apply] at hfact
    rw [hfact]
    exact frobNormSq_unitary_mul_left _ _ (transform_slice_unitary_of_starMUnitary U hU k)
  have hc_ne : (Complex.normSq c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hc)
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hc_ne (hLHS.trans (heq.trans hRHS.symm))

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_mul_right
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_mul_right
    (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td)
    (B : TubalMatrix m p n td) (V : TubalMatrix p p n td)
    (hV : IsStarMUnitary V) :
    tubalFrobNormSq (B * V) = tubalFrobNormSq B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, W, hc, hW, hM⟩ := hsc
  have hLHS := tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform c W hW hM (B * V)
  have hRHS := tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform c W hW hM B
  have heq : ∑ k : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform (B * V) k) =
             ∑ k : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform B k) := by
    congr 1; funext k
    have hfact := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff B V (B * V)).mp rfl) k
    simp only [facewise_apply] at hfact
    rw [hfact]
    exact frobNormSq_unitary_mul_right _ _ (transform_slice_unitary_of_starMUnitary V hV k)
  have hc_ne : (Complex.normSq c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hc)
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hc_ne (hLHS.trans (heq.trans hRHS.symm))

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_isometry
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_isometry (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td)
    (U : TubalMatrix m m n td) (hU : IsStarMUnitary U)
    (V : TubalMatrix p p n td) (hV : IsStarMUnitary V)
    (B : TubalMatrix m p n td) :
    tubalFrobNormSq (U * B) = tubalFrobNormSq B ∧
    tubalFrobNormSq (B * V) = tubalFrobNormSq B
proof:
:=
  ⟨tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_mul_left hsc U B hU,
   tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_mul_right hsc B V hV⟩

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_eq_tubalFrobNormSq_S
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_eq_tubalFrobNormSq_S
    (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td)
    {A : TubalMatrix m p n td} (svd : TSVD A) :
    tubalFrobNormSq A = tubalFrobNormSq svd.S
proof:
:= by
  have hVH_unitary : IsStarMUnitary svd.Vᴴ := by
    show svd.Vᴴᴴ * svd.Vᴴ = 1
    rw [conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
    exact svd.hV_unitary.mul_conjTranspose_self
  
  have h1 : tubalFrobNormSq A = tubalFrobNormSq (svd.U * svd.S * svd.Vᴴ) :=
    congrArg tubalFrobNormSq svd.hA_eq
  have h2 : tubalFrobNormSq (svd.U * svd.S * svd.Vᴴ) =
    tubalFrobNormSq (svd.U * (svd.S * svd.Vᴴ)) :=
    congrArg tubalFrobNormSq (Matrix.mul_assoc svd.U svd.S svd.Vᴴ)
  have h3 := tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_mul_left hsc svd.U (svd.S * svd.Vᴴ) svd.hU_unitary
  have h4 := tubalFrobNormSq_unitary_mul_right hsc svd.S svd.Vᴴ hVH_unitary
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans (h3.trans h4))

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_fdiag
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_fdiag {m' p' : ℕ} {S : TubalMatrix m' p' n td}
    (hS : IsFDiagonal S) :
    tubalFrobNormSq S = ∑ i : Fin m', ∑ j : Fin p',
      if (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then tubeFrobNormSq (S i j) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold tubalFrobNormSq tubeFrobNormSq
  congr 1; funext i; congr 1; funext j
  by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
  · rw [if_pos hij]
  · rw [if_neg hij]
    have := hS i j hij
    simp [this, KM.toFun_zero]

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_eq_sum_singular_tubes
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_eq_sum_singular_tubes
    (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td)
    {A : TubalMatrix m p n td} (svd : TSVD A) :
    tubalFrobNormSq A = ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin p,
      if (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then tubeFrobNormSq (svd.S i j) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tubalFrobNormSq_eq_tubalFrobNormSq_S hsc svd]
  exact tubalFrobNormSq_fdiag svd.hS_fdiag

name: TubalTensor.tubeFrobNormSq_eq_sum_normSq
statement:
private theorem tubeFrobNormSq_eq_sum_normSq (c : ℂ) (W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hW : IsUnitary W) (hM : td.M = c • W) (a : KM n td) :
    Complex.normSq c * tubeFrobNormSq a =
    ∑ k, Complex.normSq (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun a)) k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tubeFrobNormSq
  
  have hMv : td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun a)) = c • W.mulVec (toComplex (KM.toFun a)) := by
    show td.M.mulVec _ = _; rw [hM, Matrix.smul_mulVec]
  simp_rw [hMv, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [sum_normSq_unitary_mulVec W hW]
  congr 1; funext k; rw [toComplex_apply, normSq_ofReal']

name: TubalTensor.tubeFrobNormSq_singular_ordered
statement:
theorem tubeFrobNormSq_singular_ordered
    (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td)
    {A : TubalMatrix m p n td} (svd : TSVD A)
    (i₁ i₂ : Fin (min m p)) (hle : i₁ ≤ i₂) :
    tubeFrobNormSq (svd.S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₂)
                          (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₂)) ≤
    tubeFrobNormSq (svd.S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₁)
                          (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₁))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, W, hc, hW, hM⟩ := hsc
  set fi₁ := Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₁
  set fj₁ := Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₁
  set fi₂ := Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₂
  set fj₂ := Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₂
  have hc_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Complex.normSq c := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hc
  
  have hslice : ∀ k, Complex.normSq (transform svd.S k fi₂ fj₂) ≤
                      Complex.normSq (transform svd.S k fi₁ fj₁) := by
    intro k
    have hsvd_k := svd.hS_svdDiag k
    have hord_k := hsvd_k.2.2 fi₁ fi₂ fj₁ fj₂ rfl rfl hle
    have ⟨him₁, hre₁⟩ := hsvd_k.2.1 fi₁ fj₁ rfl
    have ⟨him₂, hre₂⟩ := hsvd_k.2.1 fi₂ fj₂ rfl
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, him₁, him₂, mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hord_k hre₂ |>.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hord_k (le_trans hre₂ hord_k))
  
  have hsum : ∑ k, Complex.normSq (transform svd.S k fi₂ fj₂) ≤
              ∑ k, Complex.normSq (transform svd.S k fi₁ fj₁) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => hslice k)
  
  have hP₁ := tubeFrobNormSq_eq_sum_normSq c W hW hM (svd.S fi₁ fj₁)
  have hP₂ := tubeFrobNormSq_eq_sum_normSq c W hW hM (svd.S fi₂ fj₂)
  
  simp only [transform_apply] at hsum
  
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hP₂.trans_le (hsum.trans hP₁.symm.le)) hc_pos

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_svd
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_svd (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td) {A : TubalMatrix m p n td} (svd : TSVD A) :
    tubalFrobNormSq A = tubalFrobNormSq svd.S ∧
    (tubalFrobNormSq A = ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin p,
      if (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then tubeFrobNormSq (svd.S i j) else 0) ∧
    (∀ i₁ i₂ : Fin (min m p), i₁ ≤ i₂ →
      tubeFrobNormSq (svd.S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₂)
                            (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₂)) ≤
      tubeFrobNormSq (svd.S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₁)
                            (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₁)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨tubalFrobNormSq_eq_tubalFrobNormSq_S hsc svd,
   tubalFrobNormSq_eq_sum_singular_tubes hsc svd,
   tubeFrobNormSq_singular_ordered hsc svd⟩

name: TubalTensor.transform_sub'
statement:
private theorem transform_sub' (A B : TubalMatrix m p n td) (k : Fin n) :
    transform (A - B) k = transform A k - transform B k
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp only [transform_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, TubalData.applyM]
  show (td.M *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun (A i j) - KM.toFun (B i j))) k = _
  rw [toComplex_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, Matrix.mulVec_add, Pi.add_apply,
    show (td.M *ᵥ (-toComplex (KM.toFun (B i j)))) k =
      -(td.M *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun (B i j))) k from
      congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_neg _ _) k, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: TubalTensor.isSVDDiag_realOfSVDDiagC
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun i j hij => by simp [realOfSVDDiagC, hS.1 i j hij],
   fun i j hij => (hS.2.1 i j hij).2,
   fun i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂ hle => hS.2.2 i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂ hle⟩

name: TubalTensor.toComplexMatrix_realOfSVDDiagC
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp only [toComplexMatrix, Matrix.map_apply, realOfSVDDiagC]
  by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
  · apply Complex.ext
    · exact Complex.ofReal_re _
    · rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact (hS.2.1 i j hij).1.symm
  · simp [hS.1 i j hij]

name: TubalTensor.transform_tubalTrunc
statement:
private theorem transform_tubalTrunc {S : TubalMatrix m p n td}
    (hS : IsFDiagonal S) (k : ℕ) (sl : Fin n) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin p) :
    transform (tubalTrunc S hS k) sl i j =
    if (i : ℕ) < k ∧ (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then transform S sl i j else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [transform_apply, tubalTrunc]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · simp [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]

name: TubalTensor.tsvd_eckart_young_rank
statement:
theorem tsvd_eckart_young_rank
    (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td)
    {A : TubalMatrix m p n td} (svd : TSVD A)
    (B : TubalMatrix m p n td) (k : ℕ)
    (hB : starMRank B ≤ k) :
    tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncApprox svd k) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, W, hc, hW, hM⟩ := hsc
  have hc_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Complex.normSq c := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hc
  have hL := tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform c W hW hM (A - tsvdTruncApprox svd k)
  have hR := tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform c W hW hM (A - B)
  suffices h : ∑ j : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform (A - tsvdTruncApprox svd k) j) ≤
               ∑ j : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform (A - B) j) by
    nlinarith [hL, hR, hc_pos]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j _
  
  have hBrank : (transform B j).rank ≤ k := by
    calc (transform B j).rank
        ≤ Finset.sup Finset.univ (fun j => (transform B j).rank) :=
          Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (transform B j).rank) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      _ = starMRank B := (starMRank_eq_sup_rank B).symm
      _ ≤ k := hB
  
  set Sj_real := realOfSVDDiagC (transform svd.S j)
  set hSj_real := isSVDDiag_realOfSVDDiagC (svd.hS_svdDiag j)
  have hSj_embed := toComplexMatrix_realOfSVDDiagC (svd.hS_svdDiag j)
  
  have hSlice_j : transform A j = transform svd.U j * toComplexMatrix Sj_real *
      (transform svd.V j)ᴴ := by
    rw [hSj_embed]; exact svd.hSlice j
  
  have hTrunc_j : transform (tsvdTruncApprox svd k) j =
      transform svd.U j * toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc Sj_real hSj_real k) *
      (transform svd.V j)ᴴ := by
    unfold tsvdTruncApprox
    have hmul1 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff (svd.U * tubalTrunc svd.S svd.hS_fdiag k)
      svd.Vᴴ _).mp rfl) j
    have hmul2 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff svd.U
      (tubalTrunc svd.S svd.hS_fdiag k) _).mp rfl) j
    simp only [facewise_apply] at hmul1 hmul2
    rw [hmul1, Matrix.mul_assoc, hmul2, congr_fun (transform_conjTranspose svd.V) j,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    congr 1; congr 1
    ext i' j'
    rw [transform_tubalTrunc]
    simp only [toComplexMatrix, Matrix.map_apply, svdTrunc]
    by_cases h : (i' : ℕ) < k ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ)
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
      have him := ((svd.hS_svdDiag j).2.1 i' j' h.2).1
      apply Complex.ext
      · rfl
      · rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact him
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]; simp
  
  rw [transform_sub', transform_sub', hTrunc_j]
  
  exact eckart_young
    ⟨transform svd.U j, Sj_real, transform svd.V j,
     svd.hU_slice j, svd.hV_slice j, hSj_real, hSlice_j⟩
    (transform B j) k hBrank

name: TubalTensor.tsvd_eckart_young_multirank
statement:
theorem tsvd_eckart_young_multirank
    (hsc : IsScaledUnitary td)
    {A : TubalMatrix m p n td} (svd : TSVD A)
    (B : TubalMatrix m p n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r)
    (hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r) :
    tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, W, hc, hW, hM⟩ := hsc
  have hc_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Complex.normSq c := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hc
  have hL := tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform c W hW hM (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr)
  have hR := tubalFrobNormSq_eq_transform c W hW hM (A - B)
  suffices h : ∑ j : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) j) ≤
               ∑ j : Fin n, frobNormSq (transform (A - B) j) by
    nlinarith [hL, hR, hc_pos]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j _
  
  have hBrank : (transform B j).rank ≤ r j := hB j
  
  set F : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ := fun k i' j' =>
    if (i' : ℕ) < r k ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then transform svd.S k i' j' else 0
  
  have hF_paired : ∀ (a : Fin m) (b : Fin p),
      HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => F k a b) := by
    intro a b
    have hS_ps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (svd.S a b))
    constructor
    · 
      intro k hreal
      show (if (a : ℕ) < r k ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ) then transform svd.S k a b else 0).im = 0
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hS_ps.1 k hreal
      · rfl
    · 
      intro k k' hne hconj
      show (if (a : ℕ) < r k' ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ) then transform svd.S k' a b else 0) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (if (a : ℕ) < r k ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ) then transform svd.S k a b else 0)
      have hrr : r k = r k' := hr k k' (Ne.symm hne) hconj
      by_cases h : (a : ℕ) < r k ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ)
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ⟨hrr ▸ h.1, h.2⟩]
        exact hS_ps.2 k k' hne hconj
      · have h' : ¬((a : ℕ) < r k' ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ)) := by rw [← hrr]; exact h
        rw [if_neg h, if_neg h', map_zero]
  
  have hF_rt : transform (invTransform F : TubalMatrix m p n td) = F :=
    transform_invTransform F
      (fun a b => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hF_paired a b))
  
  set Sj_real := realOfSVDDiagC (transform svd.S j)
  set hSj_real := isSVDDiag_realOfSVDDiagC (svd.hS_svdDiag j)
  have hSj_embed := toComplexMatrix_realOfSVDDiagC (svd.hS_svdDiag j)
  
  have hSlice_j : transform A j = transform svd.U j * toComplexMatrix Sj_real *
      (transform svd.V j)ᴴ := by
    rw [hSj_embed]; exact svd.hSlice j
  
  have hTrunc_j : transform (tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) j =
      transform svd.U j * toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc Sj_real hSj_real (r j)) *
      (transform svd.V j)ᴴ := by
    unfold tsvdTruncMulti
    have hmul1 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff
      (svd.U * tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr) svd.Vᴴ _).mp rfl) j
    have hmul2 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff svd.U
      (tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr) _).mp rfl) j
    simp only [facewise_apply] at hmul1 hmul2
    rw [hmul1, Matrix.mul_assoc, hmul2, congr_fun (transform_conjTranspose svd.V) j,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    congr 1; congr 1
    
    
    ext i' j'
    have hrt := congr_fun₂ (congr_fun hF_rt j) i' j'
    show transform (invTransform F : TubalMatrix m p n td) j i' j' = _
    rw [hrt]
    
    simp only [F, toComplexMatrix, Matrix.map_apply, svdTrunc]
    by_cases h : (i' : ℕ) < r j ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ)
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
      have him := ((svd.hS_svdDiag j).2.1 i' j' h.2).1
      apply Complex.ext
      · rfl
      · rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact him
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]; simp
  
  rw [transform_sub', transform_sub', hTrunc_j]
  
  exact eckart_young
    ⟨transform svd.U j, Sj_real, transform svd.V j,
     svd.hU_slice j, svd.hV_slice j, hSj_real, hSlice_j⟩
    (transform B j) (r j) hBrank

name: TubalTensor.tubeFrobNormSq_eq_weighted_normSq
statement:
private theorem tubeFrobNormSq_eq_weighted_normSq
    (D : Fin n → ℝ) (W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hD : ∀ i, D i ≠ 0) (hW : IsUnitary W)
    (hM : td.M = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (D i : ℂ)) * W) (a : KM n td) :
    tubeFrobNormSq a =
    ∑ k, (D k)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.normSq (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun a)) k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tubeFrobNormSq
  set Dc : Fin n → ℂ := fun i => (D i : ℂ)
  
  have hMv : ∀ k : Fin n,
      td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun a)) k =
      Dc k * (W *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun a)) k := by
    intro k
    show (td.M *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun a)) k = _
    rw [hM, show (diagonal Dc * W) *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun a) =
        diagonal Dc *ᵥ (W *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun a)) from
      by rw [← mulVec_mulVec], mulVec_diagonal]
  
  have rhs_eq : ∀ k,
      (D k)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.normSq (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun a)) k) =
      Complex.normSq ((W *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun a)) k) := by
    intro k
    rw [hMv k, map_mul, normSq_ofReal', ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ (hD k), one_pow, one_mul]
  simp_rw [rhs_eq]
  
  rw [sum_normSq_unitary_mulVec W hW]
  congr 1; funext k
  rw [toComplex_apply, normSq_ofReal']

name: TubalTensor.tubalFrobNormSq_eq_weighted_transform
statement:
theorem tubalFrobNormSq_eq_weighted_transform
    (D : Fin n → ℝ) (W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hD : ∀ i, D i ≠ 0) (hW : IsUnitary W)
    (hM : td.M = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (D i : ℂ)) * W)
    (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) :
    tubalFrobNormSq A = ∑ k : Fin n, (D k)⁻¹ ^ 2 * frobNormSq (transform A k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobNormSq tubalFrobNormSq
  simp_rw [transform_apply]
  
  conv_rhs =>
    arg 2; ext k; rw [Finset.mul_sum]; arg 2; ext i; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]; arg 2; ext i; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  congr 1; funext i; congr 1; funext j
  exact tubeFrobNormSq_eq_weighted_normSq D W hD hW hM (A i j)

name: TubalTensor.tsvd_eckart_young_multirank_diagUnitary
statement:
theorem tsvd_eckart_young_multirank_diagUnitary
    (hdu : IsDiagUnitary td)
    {A : TubalMatrix m p n td} (svd : TSVD A)
    (B : TubalMatrix m p n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r)
    (hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r) :
    tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, W, hD, hW, hM⟩ := hdu
  
  rw [tubalFrobNormSq_eq_weighted_transform D W hD hW hM,
      tubalFrobNormSq_eq_weighted_transform D W hD hW hM]
  
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j _
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg _)
  
  have hBrank : (transform B j).rank ≤ r j := hB j
  
  set F : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ := fun k i' j' =>
    if (i' : ℕ) < r k ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then transform svd.S k i' j' else 0
  
  have hF_paired : ∀ (a : Fin m) (b : Fin p),
      HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => F k a b) := by
    intro a b
    have hS_ps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (svd.S a b))
    constructor
    · intro k hreal
      show (if (a : ℕ) < r k ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ) then transform svd.S k a b else 0).im = 0
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hS_ps.1 k hreal
      · rfl
    · intro k k' hne hconj
      show (if (a : ℕ) < r k' ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ) then transform svd.S k' a b else 0) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (if (a : ℕ) < r k ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ) then transform svd.S k a b else 0)
      have hrr : r k = r k' := hr k k' (Ne.symm hne) hconj
      by_cases h : (a : ℕ) < r k ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ)
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ⟨hrr ▸ h.1, h.2⟩]
        exact hS_ps.2 k k' hne hconj
      · have h' : ¬((a : ℕ) < r k' ∧ (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ)) := by rw [← hrr]; exact h
        rw [if_neg h, if_neg h', map_zero]
  
  have hF_rt : transform (invTransform F : TubalMatrix m p n td) = F :=
    transform_invTransform F
      (fun a b => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hF_paired a b))
  
  set Sj_real := realOfSVDDiagC (transform svd.S j)
  set hSj_real := isSVDDiag_realOfSVDDiagC (svd.hS_svdDiag j)
  have hSj_embed := toComplexMatrix_realOfSVDDiagC (svd.hS_svdDiag j)
  
  have hSlice_j : transform A j = transform svd.U j * toComplexMatrix Sj_real *
      (transform svd.V j)ᴴ := by
    rw [hSj_embed]; exact svd.hSlice j
  
  have hTrunc_j : transform (tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) j =
      transform svd.U j * toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc Sj_real hSj_real (r j)) *
      (transform svd.V j)ᴴ := by
    unfold tsvdTruncMulti
    have hmul1 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff
      (svd.U * tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr) svd.Vᴴ _).mp rfl) j
    have hmul2 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff svd.U
      (tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr) _).mp rfl) j
    simp only [facewise_apply] at hmul1 hmul2
    rw [hmul1, Matrix.mul_assoc, hmul2, congr_fun (transform_conjTranspose svd.V) j,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    congr 1; congr 1
    ext i' j'
    have hrt := congr_fun₂ (congr_fun hF_rt j) i' j'
    show transform (invTransform F : TubalMatrix m p n td) j i' j' = _
    rw [hrt]
    simp only [F, toComplexMatrix, Matrix.map_apply, svdTrunc]
    by_cases h : (i' : ℕ) < r j ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ)
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
      have him := ((svd.hS_svdDiag j).2.1 i' j' h.2).1
      apply Complex.ext
      · rfl
      · rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact him
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]; simp
  
  rw [transform_sub', transform_sub', hTrunc_j]
  exact eckart_young
    ⟨transform svd.U j, Sj_real, transform svd.V j,
     svd.hU_slice j, svd.hV_slice j, hSj_real, hSlice_j⟩
    (transform B j) (r j) hBrank

name: TubalTensor.applyM_toComplex_star
proof:
:= by
  simp only [KM.toFun_star]
  rw [starConjM_eq_starConjC]
  show td.applyM (td.applyMinv (vecConj (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun a))))) = _
  rw [td.applyM_applyMinv]

name: TubalTensor.transform_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem transform_conjTranspose (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) :
    transform Aᴴ = fun k => (transform A k)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  funext k i j
  simp only [transform_apply, conjTranspose_apply]
  have h := congr_fun (applyM_toComplex_star (A j i)) k
  rw [h]
  rw [vecConj_apply]
  rfl

name: TubalTensor.transform_one
statement:
theorem transform_one :
    transform (1 : TubalMatrix m m n td) = fun _ => 1
proof:
:= by
  funext k i j
  simp only [transform_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    simp only [KM.toFun_one, toComplex_unitTube]
    exact congr_fun (td.applyM_applyMinv (allOnes n)) k
  · simp only [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
    exact congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_zero td.M) k

name: TubalTensor.transform_injective'
statement:
private theorem transform_injective' :
    Function.Injective (transform : TubalMatrix m p n td → _)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective invTransform_transform

name: TubalTensor.transform_mul'
statement:
private theorem transform_mul' (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) (B : TubalMatrix p l n td) :
    transform (A * B) = fun k => transform A k * transform B k
proof:
:= by
  have h := (transform_eq_facewise_iff A B (A * B)).mp rfl
  funext k; rw [h, facewise_apply]

name: TubalTensor.transform_tube_paired
statement:
private theorem transform_tube_paired (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin p) :
    HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => transform A k i j)
proof:
:=
  applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (A i j))

name: TubalTensor.transform_invTransform_of_paired
statement:
private theorem transform_invTransform_of_paired
    (Ahat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (hpaired : ∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Ahat k i j)) :
    transform (invTransform Ahat : TubalMatrix m p n td) = Ahat
proof:
:=
  transform_invTransform Ahat
    (fun i j => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hpaired i j))

name: TubalTensor.matConj_apply
statement:
private theorem matConj_apply {m p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin p) : matConj A i j = starRingEnd ℂ (A i j)
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.matConj_mul
statement:
private theorem matConj_mul {m p l : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin l) ℂ) : matConj (A * B) = matConj A * matConj B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [matConj_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, map_sum, map_mul]

name: TubalTensor.matConj_conjTranspose
statement:
private theorem matConj_conjTranspose {m p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ) :
    matConj Aᴴ = (matConj A)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [matConj_apply, conjTranspose_apply]

name: TubalTensor.matConj_one
statement: private theorem matConj_one {m : ℕ} : matConj (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp only [matConj_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: TubalTensor.isUnitary_matConj
statement:
private theorem isUnitary_matConj {m : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    (hA : IsUnitary A) : IsUnitary (matConj A)
proof:
:= by
  show (matConj A)ᴴ * matConj A = 1
  rw [← matConj_conjTranspose, ← matConj_mul, hA.conjTranspose_mul_self, matConj_one]

name: TubalTensor.isSVDDiag_matConj
statement:
private theorem isSVDDiag_matConj {m p : ℕ} {S : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ}
    (hS : IsSVDDiagC S) : IsSVDDiagC (matConj S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    simp [matConj_apply, hS.1 i j hij]
  · intro i j hij
    have ⟨him, hre⟩ := hS.2.1 i j hij
    constructor
    · rw [matConj_apply, starRingEnd_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im, neg_eq_zero]
      exact him
    · rw [matConj_apply, starRingEnd_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re]
      exact hre
  · intro i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂ hle
    show (matConj S i₂ j₂).re ≤ (matConj S i₁ j₁).re
    rw [matConj_apply, matConj_apply]
    have : ∀ z : ℂ, (starRingEnd ℂ z).re = z.re := fun z => Complex.conj_re z
    rw [this, this]
    exact hS.2.2 i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂ hle

name: TubalTensor.matConj_eq_self_of_isSVDDiag
statement:
private theorem matConj_eq_self_of_isSVDDiag {m p : ℕ} {S : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ}
    (hS : IsSVDDiagC S) : matConj S = S
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [matConj_apply]
  by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
  · rw [starRingEnd_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr (hS.2.1 i j hij).1]
  · rw [hS.1 i j hij, map_zero]

name: TubalTensor.svd_conj_decomp
proof:
:= by
  rw [hdecomp, matConj_mul, matConj_mul, matConj_conjTranspose,
      matConj_eq_self_of_isSVDDiag hS]

name: TubalTensor.isRealMatrix_of_pairedStructure_realRow
statement:
private theorem isRealMatrix_of_pairedStructure_realRow {m p : ℕ}
    (Ahat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (hpaired : ∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Ahat k i j))
    {k : Fin n} (hreal : IsRealRow td.M k) :
    IsRealMatrix (Ahat k)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  exact (hpaired i j).1 k hreal

name: TubalTensor.matrix_svd_paired
statement:
theorem matrix_svd_paired {n : ℕ} (td : TubalData n) (m p : ℕ)
    (Ahat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (hpaired : ∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Ahat k i j)) :
    ∃ (Uhat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
      (Shat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
      (Vhat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℂ),
      (∀ k, IsUnitary (Uhat k)) ∧
      (∀ k, IsUnitary (Vhat k)) ∧
      (∀ k, IsSVDDiagC (Shat k)) ∧
      (∀ k, Ahat k = Uhat k * Shat k * (Vhat k)ᴴ) ∧
      (∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Uhat k i j)) ∧
      (∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Shat k i j)) ∧
      (∀ i j, HasRealPairedStructure td (fun k => Vhat k i j))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

  
  have ahat_conj : ∀ i k, k ≠ i → IsConjRow td.M i k → Ahat k = matConj (Ahat i) := by
    intro i k hki hconj
    ext a b
    simp only [matConj_apply]
    exact (hpaired a b).2 i k hki hconj

  
  
  have svd_per_slice : ∀ k,
      ∃ (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (S : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
        (V : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℂ),
        IsUnitary U ∧ IsUnitary V ∧ IsSVDDiagC S ∧ Ahat k = U * S * Vᴴ ∧
        (IsRealRow td.M k → IsRealMatrix U ∧ IsRealMatrix V) := by
    intro k
    by_cases hreal : IsRealRow td.M k
    · 
      have hAk_real := isRealMatrix_of_pairedStructure_realRow Ahat hpaired hreal
      let Ak_real := realPartMatrix (Ahat k) hAk_real
      have hAk_eq : Ahat k = Ak_real.map Complex.ofReal := (realPartMatrix_map_eq _ hAk_real).symm
      let svd_r := matrix_svd m p Ak_real
      let svd := svd_r.toComplex
      have hsvd_eq : Ahat k = svd.U * toComplexMatrix svd.S * svd.Vᴴ := by
        rw [hAk_eq]; exact svd.hA_eq
      exact ⟨svd.U, toComplexMatrix svd.S, svd.V, svd.hU_unitary, svd.hV_unitary,
        svd.hS_svdDiag.toComplex, hsvd_eq,
        fun _ => ⟨svd_r.toComplex_isRealMatrix_U, svd_r.toComplex_isRealMatrix_V⟩⟩
    · let svd := matrix_svd m p (Ahat k)
      exact ⟨svd.U, toComplexMatrix svd.S, svd.V, svd.hU_unitary, svd.hV_unitary,
        svd.hS_svdDiag.toComplex, svd.hA_eq, fun h => absurd h hreal⟩
  choose U0 S0 V0 hU0u hV0u hS0d hSVD0 hreal0 using svd_per_slice

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

  
  
  have partner_exists : ∀ k, ¬IsRealRow td.M k →
      ∃ k', k' ≠ k ∧ IsConjRow td.M k k' ∧
        (∀ l, l ≠ k → IsConjRow td.M k l → l = k') := by
    intro k hk
    exact (td.hM_real k).resolve_left hk
  
  choose partner hpartner_ne hpartner_conj hpartner_unique using
    (fun k hk => partner_exists k hk)

  
  
  have partner_symm : ∀ k (hk : ¬IsRealRow td.M k),
      ¬IsRealRow td.M (partner k hk) ∧
      ∀ (hk' : ¬IsRealRow td.M (partner k hk)),
        partner (partner k hk) hk' = k := by
    intro k hk
    set k' := partner k hk
    have hne := hpartner_ne k hk  
    have hconj := hpartner_conj k hk  
    
    
    constructor
    · intro hreal_k'
      
      
      
      
      
      have hconj_sym : IsConjRow td.M k' k := isConjRow_symm hconj
      
      have hrows : ∀ j, td.M k j = td.M k' j := by
        intro j
        have h1 := hconj_sym j  
        have h2 := hreal_k' j   
        rw [h1, starRingEnd_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr h2]
      
      have h1 : (td.M * td.M_inv) k k = 1 := by
        rw [td.hM_right_inv, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
      have h2 : (td.M * td.M_inv) k' k = 0 := by
        rw [td.hM_right_inv, Matrix.one_apply_ne hne]
      have heq : (td.M * td.M_inv) k k = (td.M * td.M_inv) k' k := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]; congr 1; ext l; rw [hrows]
      exact one_ne_zero (h1.symm.trans (heq ▸ h2))
    · intro hk'
      
      
      have hconj_sym : IsConjRow td.M k' k := isConjRow_symm hconj
      exact (hpartner_unique (partner k hk) hk' k hne.symm hconj_sym).symm

  
  have real_no_partner : ∀ k k', k' ≠ k → IsConjRow td.M k k' →
      IsRealRow td.M k → False := by
    intro k k' hkk' hconj_row hreal
    have hrows : ∀ l, td.M k' l = td.M k l := by
      intro l; rw [hconj_row l, starRingEnd_apply, Complex.star_def,
        Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr (hreal l)]
    have h1 : (td.M * td.M_inv) k k = 1 := by rw [td.hM_right_inv, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    have h2 : (td.M * td.M_inv) k' k = 0 := by
      rw [td.hM_right_inv, Matrix.one_apply_ne hkk']
    have heq : (td.M * td.M_inv) k k = (td.M * td.M_inv) k' k := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]; congr 1; ext l; rw [hrows]
    exact one_ne_zero (h1.symm.trans (heq ▸ h2))

  

  
  let tpartner : Fin n → Fin n := fun k =>
    if hk : IsRealRow td.M k then k else partner k hk

  have tpartner_real : ∀ k, IsRealRow td.M k → tpartner k = k :=
    fun k hk => dif_pos hk

  have tpartner_nonreal : ∀ k (hk : ¬IsRealRow td.M k), tpartner k = partner k hk := by
    intro k hk; exact dif_neg hk

  have tpartner_not_real : ∀ k, ¬IsRealRow td.M k → ¬IsRealRow td.M (tpartner k) := by
    intro k hk; rw [tpartner_nonreal k hk]; exact (partner_symm k hk).1

  have tpartner_ne : ∀ k, ¬IsRealRow td.M k → tpartner k ≠ k := by
    intro k hk; rw [tpartner_nonreal k hk]; exact hpartner_ne k hk

  have tpartner_conj : ∀ k, ¬IsRealRow td.M k → IsConjRow td.M k (tpartner k) := by
    intro k hk; rw [tpartner_nonreal k hk]; exact hpartner_conj k hk

  have tpartner_invol : ∀ k, ¬IsRealRow td.M k → tpartner (tpartner k) = k := by
    intro k hk
    rw [tpartner_nonreal k hk, tpartner_nonreal _ (partner_symm k hk).1]
    exact (partner_symm k hk).2 (partner_symm k hk).1

  
  let is_canon : Fin n → Prop := fun k => k ≤ tpartner k

  have canon_real : ∀ k, IsRealRow td.M k → is_canon k := by
    intro k hk; show k ≤ tpartner k; rw [tpartner_real k hk]

  
  have canon_partner : ∀ k, ¬is_canon k → is_canon (tpartner k) := by
    intro k hk
    by_cases hr : IsRealRow td.M k
    · exact absurd (canon_real k hr) hk
    · show tpartner k ≤ tpartner (tpartner k)
      rw [tpartner_invol k hr]; exact le_of_lt (not_le.mp hk)

  
  have noncanon_partner : ∀ k, is_canon k → ¬IsRealRow td.M k → ¬is_canon (tpartner k) := by
    intro k hc hk h
    rw [show is_canon (tpartner k) ↔ tpartner k ≤ tpartner (tpartner k) from Iff.rfl] at h
    rw [tpartner_invol k hk] at h
    exact tpartner_ne k hk (le_antisymm h hc)

  
  let Uhat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ := fun k =>
    if is_canon k then U0 k else matConj (U0 (tpartner k))
  let Shat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ := fun k =>
    if is_canon k then S0 k else S0 (tpartner k)
  let Vhat : Fin n → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℂ := fun k =>
    if is_canon k then V0 k else matConj (V0 (tpartner k))

  
  have svd_diag_conj_self : ∀ k (i : Fin m) (j : Fin p),
      starRingEnd ℂ (S0 k i j) = S0 k i j := by
    intro k i j
    by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
    · rw [starRingEnd_apply, Complex.star_def,
        Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr ((hS0d k).2.1 i j hij).1]
    · rw [(hS0d k).1 i j hij, map_zero]

  refine ⟨Uhat, Shat, Vhat, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

  
  · intro k; show IsUnitary (if is_canon k then U0 k else matConj (U0 (tpartner k)))
    split_ifs
    · exact hU0u k
    · exact isUnitary_matConj (hU0u _)

  
  · intro k; show IsUnitary (if is_canon k then V0 k else matConj (V0 (tpartner k)))
    split_ifs
    · exact hV0u k
    · exact isUnitary_matConj (hV0u _)

  
  · intro k; show IsSVDDiagC (if is_canon k then S0 k else S0 (tpartner k))
    split_ifs
    · exact hS0d k
    · exact hS0d _

  
  · intro k
    show Ahat k = (if is_canon k then U0 k else matConj (U0 (tpartner k))) *
      (if is_canon k then S0 k else S0 (tpartner k)) *
      (if is_canon k then V0 k else matConj (V0 (tpartner k)))ᴴ
    split_ifs with hc
    · exact hSVD0 k
    · 
      have hk : ¬IsRealRow td.M k := fun hr => hc (canon_real k hr)
      rw [← matConj_conjTranspose, ahat_conj (tpartner k) k (tpartner_ne k hk).symm
        (isConjRow_symm (tpartner_conj k hk))]
      exact svd_conj_decomp (hS0d _) (hSVD0 _)

  
  
  
  

  
  · intro i j; constructor
    · intro k hreal
      show ((if is_canon k then U0 k else matConj (U0 (tpartner k))) i j).im = 0
      rw [if_pos (canon_real k hreal)]
      exact (hreal0 k hreal).1 i j
    · intro k k' hkk' hconj_row
      show (if is_canon k' then U0 k' else matConj (U0 (tpartner k'))) i j =
           starRingEnd ℂ ((if is_canon k then U0 k else matConj (U0 (tpartner k))) i j)
      have hk : ¬IsRealRow td.M k := fun h => real_no_partner k k' hkk' hconj_row h
      have hk' : ¬IsRealRow td.M k' := by
        intro h; exact real_no_partner k' k hkk'.symm (isConjRow_symm hconj_row) h
      
      have hk'_eq : k' = tpartner k := by
        rw [tpartner_nonreal k hk]; exact hpartner_unique k hk k' hkk' hconj_row
      by_cases hc : is_canon k
      · 
        rw [if_pos hc, if_neg (hk'_eq ▸ noncanon_partner k hc hk)]
        
        rw [show tpartner k' = k from by rw [hk'_eq, tpartner_invol k hk]]
        rfl
      · 
        
        rw [if_neg hc, if_pos (hk'_eq ▸ canon_partner k hc)]
        rw [hk'_eq]
        simp only [matConj_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_star]

  
  · intro i j; constructor
    · intro k hreal
      show ((if is_canon k then S0 k else S0 (tpartner k)) i j).im = 0
      rw [if_pos (canon_real k hreal)]
      by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
      · exact ((hS0d k).2.1 i j hij).1
      · rw [(hS0d k).1 i j hij]; rfl
    · intro k k' hkk' hconj_row
      show (if is_canon k' then S0 k' else S0 (tpartner k')) i j =
           starRingEnd ℂ ((if is_canon k then S0 k else S0 (tpartner k)) i j)
      have hk : ¬IsRealRow td.M k := fun h => real_no_partner k k' hkk' hconj_row h
      have hk' : ¬IsRealRow td.M k' := by
        intro h; exact real_no_partner k' k hkk'.symm (isConjRow_symm hconj_row) h
      have hk'_eq : k' = tpartner k := by
        rw [tpartner_nonreal k hk]; exact hpartner_unique k hk k' hkk' hconj_row
      by_cases hc : is_canon k
      · rw [if_pos hc, if_neg (hk'_eq ▸ noncanon_partner k hc hk)]
        rw [show tpartner k' = k from by rw [hk'_eq, tpartner_invol k hk]]
        exact (svd_diag_conj_self k i j).symm
      · rw [if_neg hc, if_pos (hk'_eq ▸ canon_partner k hc)]
        rw [hk'_eq]
        exact (svd_diag_conj_self _ i j).symm

  
  · intro i j; constructor
    · intro k hreal
      show ((if is_canon k then V0 k else matConj (V0 (tpartner k))) i j).im = 0
      rw [if_pos (canon_real k hreal)]
      exact (hreal0 k hreal).2 i j
    · intro k k' hkk' hconj_row
      show (if is_canon k' then V0 k' else matConj (V0 (tpartner k'))) i j =
           starRingEnd ℂ ((if is_canon k then V0 k else matConj (V0 (tpartner k))) i j)
      have hk : ¬IsRealRow td.M k := fun h => real_no_partner k k' hkk' hconj_row h
      have hk' : ¬IsRealRow td.M k' := by
        intro h; exact real_no_partner k' k hkk'.symm (isConjRow_symm hconj_row) h
      have hk'_eq : k' = tpartner k := by
        rw [tpartner_nonreal k hk]; exact hpartner_unique k hk k' hkk' hconj_row
      by_cases hc : is_canon k
      · rw [if_pos hc, if_neg (hk'_eq ▸ noncanon_partner k hc hk)]
        rw [show tpartner k' = k from by rw [hk'_eq, tpartner_invol k hk]]
        rfl
      · rw [if_neg hc, if_pos (hk'_eq ▸ canon_partner k hc)]
        rw [hk'_eq]
        simp only [matConj_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_star]

name: TubalTensor.KM_le_of_transform
proof:
:= by
  rw [KM.le_iff]
  
  have hlin : td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (S i₁ j₁) - KM.toFun (S i₂ j₂))) =
      fun k => transform S k i₁ j₁ - transform S k i₂ j₂ := by
    simp only [toComplex_sub]
    ext k; simp only [transform_apply]
    rw [show td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (S i₁ j₁)) - toComplex (KM.toFun (S i₂ j₂))) k =
        td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (S i₁ j₁))) k -
        td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (S i₂ j₂))) k from by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, td.applyM_add, Pi.add_apply,
        show td.applyM (-toComplex (KM.toFun (S i₂ j₂))) k =
          -(td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (S i₂ j₂))) k) from
          congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_neg _ _) k, ← sub_eq_add_neg]]
  simp only [hlin]; exact ⟨him, hre⟩

name: TubalTensor.rank_of_svdDiag
statement:
private theorem rank_of_svdDiag {m' p' : ℕ}
    (S : Matrix (Fin m') (Fin p') ℂ) (hS : IsSVDDiagC S)
    (U : Matrix (Fin m') (Fin m') ℂ) (V : Matrix (Fin p') (Fin p') ℂ)
    (hU : IsUnitary U) (hV : IsUnitary V) :
    (U * S * Vᴴ).rank =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m' p') =>
        S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m' p') i)
          (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m' p') i) ≠ 0)).card
proof:
:= by
  
  have hUdet : IsUnit U.det := isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hU.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hVHdet : IsUnit Vᴴ.det := by
    rw [det_conjTranspose]
    exact (isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hV.conjTranspose_mul_self).star
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det _ _ hUdet,
      rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det _ _ hVHdet]
  
  rw [← rank_conjTranspose_mul_self S]
  
  
  set w : Fin p' → ℂ := fun j =>
    if h : (j : ℕ) < m' then
      starRingEnd ℂ (S ⟨j, h⟩ j) * S ⟨j, h⟩ j
    else 0
  have hSHS_eq : Sᴴ * S = diagonal w := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, conjTranspose_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · 
      subst hij
      rw [diagonal_apply_eq]
      
      by_cases him : (i : ℕ) < m'
      · simp only [w, dif_pos him]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (⟨i, him⟩ : Fin m') (Finset.mem_univ _)]
        · rfl
        · 
          intro k _ hk
          have : (k : ℕ) ≠ (i : ℕ) := by
            intro heq; exact hk (Fin.ext (by omega))
          rw [hS.1 k i this, mul_zero]
      · simp only [w, dif_neg him]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro k _
        have : (k : ℕ) ≠ (i : ℕ) := by omega
        rw [hS.1 k i this, mul_zero]
    · 
      rw [diagonal_apply_ne _ hij]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k _
      by_cases hki : (k : ℕ) = (i : ℕ)
      · have hkj : (k : ℕ) ≠ (j : ℕ) := by
          intro h; exact hij (Fin.ext (hki.symm.trans h))
        rw [hS.1 k j hkj, mul_zero]
      · rw [hS.1 k i hki, star_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [hSHS_eq]
  have hrd : (diagonal w).rank = Fintype.card {i : Fin p' // w i ≠ 0} := rank_diagonal w
  rw [hrd, ← Fintype.card_subtype]
  
  
  
  apply Fintype.card_congr
  
  
  
  have hw_ne_zero_iff_lt : ∀ j : Fin p', w j ≠ 0 → (j : ℕ) < min m' p' := by
    intro j hne
    simp only [w] at hne
    split_ifs at hne with h
    · exact Nat.lt_min.mpr ⟨h, j.isLt⟩
    · exact absurd rfl hne
  have hw_ne_zero_iff_S : ∀ (j : Fin p') (hj : w j ≠ 0),
      S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m' p') ⟨j, hw_ne_zero_iff_lt j hj⟩)
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m' p') ⟨j, hw_ne_zero_iff_lt j hj⟩) ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hj heq
    apply hj
    simp only [w]
    have him : (j : ℕ) < m' := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hw_ne_zero_iff_lt j hj) (Nat.min_le_left m' p')
    rw [dif_pos him]
    simp only [Fin.castLE] at heq
    rw [heq, map_zero, zero_mul]
  have hS_ne_zero_iff_w : ∀ i : Fin (min m' p'),
      S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m' p') i)
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m' p') i) ≠ 0 →
      w (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m' p') i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hne
    simp only [w, Fin.castLE]
    have him : (i : ℕ) < m' := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (Nat.min_le_left m' p')
    rw [dif_pos him]
    intro heq
    apply hne
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp heq with h | h
    · rwa [map_eq_zero] at h
    · exact h
  exact {
    toFun := fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => ⟨⟨j, hw_ne_zero_iff_lt j hj⟩, hw_ne_zero_iff_S j hj⟩
    invFun := fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m' p') i, hS_ne_zero_iff_w i hi⟩
    left_inv := fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => by simp [Fin.castLE]
    right_inv := fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => by
      ext
      simp [Fin.castLE]
  }

name: TubalTensor.starMRank_eq_sup_rank
statement:
theorem starMRank_eq_sup_rank (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) :
    starMRank A = Finset.sup Finset.univ (fun k => (transform A k).rank)
proof:
:= by
  
  set svd := TSVD.of A
  set S := svd.S
  have hUu := svd.hU_slice
  have hVu := svd.hV_slice
  have hSd := svd.hS_svdDiag
  have hSlice := svd.hSlice
  
  have hrank_slice : ∀ k, (transform A k).rank =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m p) =>
        transform S k (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
                       (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0)).card := by
    intro k
    rw [hSlice k]
    exact rank_of_svdDiag _ (hSd k) _ _ (hUu k) (hVu k)
  
  have htube_iff : ∀ i : Fin (min m p),
      (S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
         (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0) ↔
      (∃ k, transform S k (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
                          (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0) := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro hne
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      exact hne ((tube_eq_zero_iff_transform
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i)).mpr hall)
    · intro ⟨k, hk⟩ heq
      exact hk ((tube_eq_zero_iff_transform
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i)).mp heq k)
  
  have hLHS : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m p) =>
      S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
         (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0)).card =
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m p) =>
      ∃ k, transform S k (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
                          (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0)).card := by
    have : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m p) =>
        S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
           (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m p) =>
        ∃ k, transform S k (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
                            (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0)) :=
      Finset.filter_congr (fun i _ => htube_iff i)
    exact congrArg Finset.card this
  
  show (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m p) =>
      S (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
         (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0)).card = _
  rw [hLHS]
  
  simp_rw [hrank_slice]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hdown : ∀ k (i₁ i₂ : Fin (min m p)),
      i₁ ≤ i₂ →
      transform S k (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₂)
                     (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₂) ≠ 0 →
      transform S k (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₁)
                     (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₁) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k i₁ i₂ hle hne
    have hsvd := hSd k
    
    have hord := hsvd.2.2
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₁)
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₂)
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₁)
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₂)
      rfl rfl hle
    
    
    have hreal := (hsvd.2.1
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₂)
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₂) rfl)
    have hre_pos : 0 < (transform S k
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₂)
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₂)).re := by
      have hre_nn := hreal.2
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hre_nn with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso; apply hne
        have him := hreal.1
        exact Complex.ext h.symm him
    
    intro heq
    have hreal1 := (hsvd.2.1
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₁)
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₁) rfl)
    have : (transform S k
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i₁)
        (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i₁)).re = 0 := by
      have him := hreal1.1; rw [heq]; rfl
    linarith [hord]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  set fU := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m p) =>
      ∃ k, transform S k (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
                          (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0)
  set fK := fun k => Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (min m p) =>
      transform S k (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_left m p) i)
                     (Fin.castLE (Nat.min_le_right m p) i) ≠ 0)
  
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    by_cases hne : fU.Nonempty
    · 
      set imax := fU.max' hne
      have himax_mem : imax ∈ fU := Finset.max'_mem fU hne
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at himax_mem
      obtain ⟨_, k₀, hk₀⟩ := himax_mem
      
      have hle_max : ∀ j ∈ fU, j ≤ imax := fun j hj => Finset.le_max' fU j hj
      
      
      have hsub : fU ⊆ fK k₀ := by
        intro j hj
        simp only [fU, fK, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hj ⊢
        exact hdown k₀ j imax (hle_max j (by simp only [fU, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]; exact hj)) hk₀
      calc fU.card ≤ (fK k₀).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        _ ≤ Finset.sup Finset.univ (fun k => (fK k).card) :=
            Finset.le_sup (f := fun k => (fK k).card) (Finset.mem_univ k₀)
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.card_empty]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
  · 
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro k _
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro j hj
    simp only [fU, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hj ⊢
    exact ⟨k, hj⟩

name: TubalTensor.rank_le_starMRank
statement:
theorem rank_le_starMRank (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) (k : Fin n) :
    (transform A k).rank ≤ starMRank A
proof:
:= by
  rw [starMRank_eq_sup_rank]
  exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun k => (transform A k).rank) (Finset.mem_univ k)

name: TubalTensor.starMMultirank_le_starMRank
statement:
theorem starMMultirank_le_starMRank (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) (k : Fin n) :
    starMMultirank A k ≤ starMRank A
proof:
:=
  rank_le_starMRank A k

name: TubalTensor.parseval_bilinear
statement:
private theorem parseval_bilinear {n' : ℕ}
    (W : Matrix (Fin n') (Fin n') ℂ) (hW : IsUnitary W) (f g : Fin n' → ℂ) :
    ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ ((W *ᵥ f) k) * ((W *ᵥ g) k) =
    ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (f k) * (g k)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hWHW : ∀ j l : Fin n',
      ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (W k j) * W k l = if j = l then 1 else 0 := by
    intro j l
    
    have h := congr_fun (congr_fun hW j) l
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
    
    
    
    exact h
  
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  
  
  simp_rw [map_sum, map_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  
  
  
  
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  congr 1; funext j
  
  
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  
  
  
  
  have step3 : ∀ l : Fin n',
    ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (W k j) * starRingEnd ℂ (f j) * (W k l * g l) =
    starRingEnd ℂ (f j) * g l * (∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (W k j) * W k l) := by
    intro l; rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; funext k; ring
  simp_rw [step3]
  simp_rw [hWHW]
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]

name: TubalTensor.hilbert_algebra_tube
statement:
theorem hilbert_algebra_tube (hDU : IsDiagUnitary td)
    (a x y : KM n td) :
    tubeFrobInner (a * x) y = tubeFrobInner x (star a * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, W, hDnz, hW, hM⟩ := hDU
  
  set a' := toComplex (KM.toFun a)
  set x' := toComplex (KM.toFun x)
  set y' := toComplex (KM.toFun y)
  
  set Dc : Fin n → ℂ := fun i => (D i : ℂ)
  
  have h_ax : toComplex (KM.toFun (a * x)) = starMC td a' x' := by
    change toComplex (starM td (KM.toFun a) (KM.toFun x)) = _
    exact starM_eq_starMC td _ _
  
  have h_say : toComplex (KM.toFun (star a * y)) =
      starMC td (starConjC td a') y' := by
    change toComplex (starM td (starConjM td (KM.toFun a)) (KM.toFun y)) = _
    rw [starM_eq_starMC, starConjM_eq_starConjC]
  
  
  
  
  have frob_eq_re : ∀ u v : KM n td,
      (tubeFrobInner u v : ℂ) =
      ∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ ((W *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun u)) k) *
        ((W *ᵥ toComplex (KM.toFun v)) k) := by
    intro u v
    unfold tubeFrobInner
    push_cast
    
    conv_lhs =>
      arg 2; ext k
      rw [show (KM.toFun u k : ℂ) = toComplex (KM.toFun u) k from by simp,
          show (KM.toFun v k : ℂ) = toComplex (KM.toFun v) k from by simp,
          show toComplex (KM.toFun u) k = starRingEnd ℂ (toComplex (KM.toFun u) k)
            from by simp [toComplex_apply, Complex.conj_ofReal]]
    exact (parseval_bilinear W hW _ _).symm
  
  suffices h : (tubeFrobInner (a * x) y : ℂ) = (tubeFrobInner x (star a * y) : ℂ) from
    Complex.ofReal_injective h
  rw [frob_eq_re, frob_eq_re]
  
  have hDW_Minv : diagonal Dc * (W * td.M_inv) = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hM]; exact td.hM_right_inv
  
  have hM_mulVec : ∀ v : Fin n → ℂ, ∀ k : Fin n,
      (td.M *ᵥ v) k = Dc k * (W *ᵥ v) k := by
    intro v k
    rw [hM, show (diagonal Dc * W) *ᵥ v = diagonal Dc *ᵥ (W *ᵥ v) from
      by rw [← mulVec_mulVec], mulVec_diagonal]
  
  have hW_applyMinv : ∀ v : Fin n → ℂ, ∀ k : Fin n,
      (W *ᵥ (td.M_inv *ᵥ v)) k = (Dc k)⁻¹ * v k := by
    intro v k
    have hDc_ne : Dc k ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hDnz k)
    have h1 : diagonal Dc *ᵥ ((W * td.M_inv) *ᵥ v) = v := by
      rw [mulVec_mulVec, hDW_Minv, one_mulVec]
    have h2 := congr_fun h1 k; rw [mulVec_diagonal] at h2
    rw [mulVec_mulVec, ← h2, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hDc_ne, one_mul]
  
  set α := W *ᵥ a'  
  set ξ := W *ᵥ x'  
  set η := W *ᵥ y'  
  
  
  congr 1; funext k
  
  
  rw [h_ax, h_say]
  
  
  
  have hW_ax : (W *ᵥ starMC td a' x') k = (Dc k)⁻¹ * (td.applyM a' k * td.applyM x' k) := by
    show (W *ᵥ (td.M_inv *ᵥ (td.applyM a' ∘ₕ td.applyM x'))) k = _
    rw [hW_applyMinv, vecHadamard_apply]
  
  
  
  have hW_say : (W *ᵥ starMC td (starConjC td a') y') k =
      (Dc k)⁻¹ * (starRingEnd ℂ (td.applyM a' k) * td.applyM y' k) := by
    
    
    
    have hsc : td.applyM (starConjC td a') = vecConj (td.applyM a') :=
      applyM_starConjC td a'
    show (W *ᵥ (td.M_inv *ᵥ (td.applyM (starConjC td a') ∘ₕ td.applyM y'))) k = _
    rw [hW_applyMinv, vecHadamard_apply, hsc, vecConj_apply]
  
  rw [hW_ax, hW_say]
  
  
  rw [show td.applyM a' k = Dc k * α k from hM_mulVec a' k,
      show td.applyM x' k = Dc k * ξ k from hM_mulVec x' k,
      show td.applyM y' k = Dc k * η k from hM_mulVec y' k]
  
  have hDc_conj : starRingEnd ℂ (Dc k) = Dc k := by
    simp [Dc, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hDc_ne : Dc k ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hDnz k)
  
  
  
  simp only [map_mul, hDc_conj, map_inv₀]
  
  
  ring

name: TubalTensor.tubeFrobInner_sum_left
statement:
private theorem tubeFrobInner_sum_left {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → KM n td) (b : KM n td) :
    tubeFrobInner (∑ i ∈ s, f i) b = ∑ i ∈ s, tubeFrobInner (f i) b
proof:
:= by
  unfold tubeFrobInner
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  congr 1; funext k
  rw [show KM.toFun (∑ i ∈ s, f i) k = ∑ i ∈ s, KM.toFun (f i) k from
    Finset.sum_apply k s (fun i => KM.toFun (f i))]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: TubalTensor.tubeFrobInner_sum_right
statement:
private theorem tubeFrobInner_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : KM n td) (f : ι → KM n td) :
    tubeFrobInner a (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, tubeFrobInner a (f i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tubeFrobInner
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  congr 1; funext k
  rw [show KM.toFun (∑ i ∈ s, f i) k = ∑ i ∈ s, KM.toFun (f i) k from
    Finset.sum_apply k s (fun i => KM.toFun (f i))]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: TubalTensor.hilbert_algebra_tensor
statement:
theorem hilbert_algebra_tensor (hDU : IsDiagUnitary td)
    (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) (X : Fin p → KM n td) (Y : Fin m → KM n td) :
    omFrobInner (A.mulVec X) Y = omFrobInner X (Aᴴ.mulVec Y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold omFrobInner
  
  simp only [mulVec, dotProduct]
  
  simp_rw [tubeFrobInner_sum_left]
  
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  simp_rw [hilbert_algebra_tube hDU]
  
  simp_rw [← tubeFrobInner_sum_right, conjTranspose_apply]

name: TubalTensor.IsStarMUnitary.conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem IsStarMUnitary.conjTranspose_mul_self {U : TubalMatrix m m n td}
    (h : IsStarMUnitary U) : Uᴴ * U = 1

name: TubalTensor.IsStarMUnitary.mul_conjTranspose_self
statement:
theorem IsStarMUnitary.mul_conjTranspose_self {U : TubalMatrix m m n td}
    (h : IsStarMUnitary U) : U * Uᴴ = 1
proof:
:=
  (mul_eq_one_comm_of_card_eq (Fin m) (Fin m) (KM n td) rfl).mp h

name: TubalTensor.linear_coeff_zero_of_quadratic_nonneg
statement:
private theorem linear_coeff_zero_of_quadratic_nonneg {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (h : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ A * t ^ 2 + B * t) : B = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hB
  have h1 := h (-B / (2 * A))
  have hcalc : A * (-B / (2 * A)) ^ 2 + B * (-B / (2 * A)) = -(B ^ 2 / (4 * A)) := by
    have : A ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA; field_simp; ring
  rw [hcalc] at h1
  linarith [div_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < B ^ 2) (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4 * A)]

name: TubalTensor.starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero
statement:
private theorem starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im = 0) :
    starRingEnd ℂ z = z
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · exact Complex.conj_re z
  · rw [Complex.conj_im]; linarith

name: TubalTensor.M_inv_real_of_M_real
statement:
private theorem M_inv_real_of_M_real (hM_real : ∀ i j : Fin n, (td.M i j).im = 0) :
    ∀ i j : Fin n, (td.M_inv i j).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hMconjMinv : td.M * (td.M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ)) = 1 := by
    ext i k
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [show ∑ j, td.M i j * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M_inv j k) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (∑ j, td.M i j * td.M_inv j k) from by
        rw [map_sum]; congr 1; funext j
        rw [map_mul, starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero (hM_real i j)]]
    rw [show ∑ j, td.M i j * td.M_inv j k = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) i k from by
      rw [← td.hM_right_inv]; rfl]
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have hMapEq : td.M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) = td.M_inv :=
    calc td.M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ)
        = 1 * td.M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := (one_mul _).symm
      _ = (td.M_inv * td.M) * td.M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by rw [td.hM_left_inv]
      _ = td.M_inv * (td.M * td.M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ)) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = td.M_inv * 1 := by rw [hMconjMinv]
      _ = td.M_inv := mul_one _
  intro i j
  have h := congr_fun₂ hMapEq i j
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply] at h
  
  have him := Complex.conj_im (td.M_inv i j)
  rw [h] at him 
  linarith

name: TubalTensor.eckart_young_multirank_necessity
statement:
theorem eckart_young_multirank_necessity
    (_hn : 0 < n)
    (hM_real : ∀ i j : Fin n, (td.M i j).im = 0)
    (hopt : ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (k : Fin n) (β : ℝ),
      ∑ i, (a i - ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) k).re *
            ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ i, (a i - β * ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re) ^ 2)
    : IsDiagUnitary td
proof:
:= by
  have hMinv_real := M_inv_real_of_M_real hM_real
  set c : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun k i =>
    ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re
  have hc_eq : ∀ k i : Fin n, c k i = (td.M_inv i k).re := by
    intro k i; simp [c, mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
      Finset.mem_univ, mul_one]
  
  have hC_pos : ∀ k : Fin n, 0 < ∑ i, c k i ^ 2 := by
    intro k
    by_contra h; push Not at h
    have h0 : ∀ i, c k i = 0 := fun i => sq_eq_zero_iff.mp
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (c k i)) |>.mp
        (le_antisymm h (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)) i (Finset.mem_univ i))
    have hcol_zero : ∀ i, td.M_inv i k = 0 := fun i =>
      Complex.ext (by rw [Complex.zero_re, ← hc_eq]; exact h0 i)
        (by rw [Complex.zero_im]; exact hMinv_real i k)
    have h1 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv k k
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_true] at h1
    rw [show ∑ j, td.M k j * td.M_inv j k = 0 from
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by rw [hcol_zero j, mul_zero])] at h1
    exact zero_ne_one h1
  
  have foc : ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (k : Fin n),
      ∑ i, a i * c k i = ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) k).re * ∑ i, c k i ^ 2 := by
    intro a k
    set α := ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) k).re
    set C := ∑ i, c k i ^ 2
    set S := ∑ i, (a i - α * c k i) * c k i
    have hquad : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ C * t ^ 2 + (-2 * S) * t := by
      intro t
      have h := hopt a k (α + t)
      have hterm : ∀ i : Fin n,
          (a i - (α + t) * c k i) ^ 2 =
          (a i - α * c k i) ^ 2 +
          (c k i ^ 2 * t ^ 2 + (-2) * ((a i - α * c k i) * c k i) * t) := by
        intro i; ring
      have hrhs : ∑ x, (a x - (α + t) * c k x) ^ 2 =
          ∑ x, (a x - α * c k x) ^ 2 +
          ((∑ x, c k x ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + (-2) * (∑ x, (a x - α * c k x) * c k x) * t) := by
        conv_lhs => arg 2; ext x; rw [hterm x]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]; congr 1
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]; congr 1
        · rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        · rw [show ∑ x, (-2) * ((a x - α * c k x) * c k x) * t =
            (∑ x, (-2) * ((a x - α * c k x) * c k x)) * t from by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]]
          congr 1; rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [hrhs] at h; linarith
    have hS_zero : S = 0 := by linarith [linear_coeff_zero_of_quadratic_nonneg (hC_pos k) hquad]
    show ∑ i, a i * c k i = α * C
    have hS_expand : S = ∑ i, a i * c k i - α * C := by
      simp only [S]; conv_lhs => arg 2; ext i; rw [show (a i - α * c k i) * c k i =
        a i * c k i - α * (c k i ^ 2) from by ring]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    linarith
  
  have hMinv_eq : ∀ j k : Fin n,
      (td.M_inv j k).re = (td.M k j).re * ∑ i, c k i ^ 2 := by
    intro j k
    have h := foc (Pi.single j 1) k
    rw [show ∑ i, (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℝ) i * c k i = c k j from by
      simp [Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]] at h
    
    have hα : ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℝ)) k).re = (td.M k j).re := by
      simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, toComplex, Pi.single_apply]
      simp only [apply_ite Complex.ofReal, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero]
      simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [hα, hc_eq] at h; exact h
  
  have hMMT_off_diag : ∀ i k : Fin n, i ≠ k →
      ∑ j, (td.M i j).re * (td.M k j).re = 0 := by
    intro i k hik
    have hMMinv := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv i k
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_neg hik] at hMMinv
    set Ck := ∑ l, c k l ^ 2
    
    have hreal_sum : ∑ j, (td.M i j).re * (td.M_inv j k).re = 0 := by
      have hterm : ∀ j, (td.M i j * td.M_inv j k).re = (td.M i j).re * (td.M_inv j k).re := by
        intro j; rw [Complex.mul_re]; simp [hM_real i j, hMinv_real j k, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      
      have hzero : (∑ j, td.M i j * td.M_inv j k) = 0 := hMMinv
      
      have : ∀ (f : Fin n → ℂ), (∑ j, f j).re = ∑ j, (f j).re := by
        intro f; simp only [Complex.re_sum]
      conv_lhs => rw [show ∑ j, (td.M i j).re * (td.M_inv j k).re =
        ∑ j, (td.M i j * td.M_inv j k).re from by congr 1; funext j; rw [hterm]]
      rw [← this]; rw [hzero]; simp
    simp_rw [hMinv_eq] at hreal_sum
    have : (∑ j, (td.M i j).re * (td.M k j).re) * Ck = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]; convert hreal_sum using 1; congr 1; funext j; ring
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right (ne_of_gt (hC_pos k))
  
  set rowNormSq : Fin n → ℝ := fun k => ∑ j, (td.M k j).re ^ 2
  have hRowPos : ∀ k, 0 < rowNormSq k := by
    intro k
    by_contra h; push Not at h
    have h0 : ∀ j, (td.M k j).re = 0 := fun j => sq_eq_zero_iff.mp
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) |>.mp
        (le_antisymm h (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)) j (Finset.mem_univ j))
    have hrow_zero : ∀ j, td.M k j = 0 := fun j =>
      Complex.ext (by simp [h0 j]) (by simp [hM_real k j])
    have h1 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv k k
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_true] at h1
    rw [show ∑ j, td.M k j * td.M_inv j k = 0 from
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by rw [hrow_zero j, zero_mul])] at h1
    exact zero_ne_one h1
  set D : Fin n → ℝ := fun k => Real.sqrt (rowNormSq k)
  have hD_ne : ∀ k, D k ≠ 0 := fun k => ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hRowPos k))
  have hD_sq : ∀ k, D k ^ 2 = rowNormSq k :=
    fun k => Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hRowPos k))
  set W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun k => ((D k : ℂ))⁻¹) * td.M
  have hM_eq : td.M = Matrix.diagonal (fun k => (↑(D k) : ℂ)) * W := by
    simp only [W, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    conv_lhs => rw [show td.M = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * td.M from (one_mul _).symm]
    congr 1
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    rw [show (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ => 1) from by
      ext i j; simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply]]
    congr 1; funext i
    exact (mul_inv_cancel₀ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hD_ne i))).symm
  
  have hW_unitary : IsUnitary W := by
    suffices h : W * Wᴴ = 1 from mul_eq_one_comm.mp h
    
    
    
    
    ext i j
    
    have hW_il : ∀ p l, W p l = ((D p : ℂ))⁻¹ * td.M p l := by
      intro p l; simp [W, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
        Finset.mem_univ]
    
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, conjTranspose_apply, star_def]
    simp_rw [hW_il, map_mul,
      starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero (by simp : ((↑(D j))⁻¹ : ℂ).im = 0)]
    simp_rw [show ∀ l, starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) = td.M j l from
      fun l => starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero (hM_real j l)]
    
    rw [show ∑ l, (↑(D i))⁻¹ * td.M i l * ((↑(D j))⁻¹ * td.M j l) =
      (↑(D i))⁻¹ * (↑(D j))⁻¹ * ∑ l, td.M i l * td.M j l from by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; funext l; ring]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · 
      subst hij; simp only [ite_true]
      
      have hsum : ∑ l, td.M i l * td.M i l = ↑(rowNormSq i) := by
        simp only [rowNormSq]; rw [Complex.ofReal_sum]; congr 1; funext l
        have him := hM_real i l
        rw [show td.M i l = ↑((td.M i l).re) from
          Complex.ext rfl (by simp [him])]
        simp [Complex.ofReal_re, sq]
      rw [hsum, ← hD_sq i, Complex.ofReal_pow]
      have hDi := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hD_ne i)
      field_simp
    · 
      rw [if_neg hij]
      have hsum : ∑ l, td.M i l * td.M j l = 0 := by
        
        rw [show ∑ l, td.M i l * td.M j l = ↑(∑ l, (td.M i l).re * (td.M j l).re) from by
          rw [Complex.ofReal_sum]; congr 1; funext l
          apply Complex.ext
          · simp [Complex.mul_re, hM_real i l, hM_real j l, mul_zero, sub_zero, Complex.ofReal_re]
          · simp [Complex.mul_im, hM_real i l, hM_real j l, mul_zero, add_zero, Complex.ofReal_im],
          hMMT_off_diag i j hij]; simp
      rw [hsum, mul_zero]
  exact ⟨D, W, hD_ne, hW_unitary, hM_eq⟩

name: TubalTensor.MMH_off_diag_complex_nonconj_partB
statement:
private theorem MMH_off_diag_complex_nonconj_partB
    (h j h' j' : Fin n) (_hhj : h ≠ j) (_hhh' : h' ≠ h) (_hjj' : j' ≠ j)
    (hconj_h : IsConjRow td.M h h') (hconj_j : IsConjRow td.M j j')
    (_hj'h : j' ≠ h) (_hh'j : h' ≠ j)
    (w : Fin n → ℂ) (α₁ : ℂ) (α₂ : ℝ) (hα₂_pos : 0 < α₂)
    (hw_decomp : ∀ l, w l = α₁ * td.M h l + ↑α₂ * td.M h' l)
    (hMw_jh : ∑ l, td.M j l * w l = 0)
    (hMw_j'h : ∑ l, td.M j' l * w l = 0)
    (hMw_hh : ∑ l, td.M h l * w l = 1)
    (hMw_h'h : ∑ l, td.M h' l * w l = 0) :
    ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j' l = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hconj_h_sym : ∀ l, td.M h' l = starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) := hconj_h
  
  
  
  have hI : α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j l +
      (↑α₂ : ℂ) * starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j' l) = 0 := by
    have hsub : ∑ l, td.M j l * w l =
        α₁ * ∑ l, td.M j l * td.M h l + ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M j l * td.M h' l := by
      conv_lhs => arg 2; ext l; rw [hw_decomp l]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1; funext l; ring
    rw [hMw_jh] at hsub
    rw [show ∑ l, td.M j l * td.M h l = ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j l from by
      congr 1; funext l; ring] at hsub
    rw [show ∑ l, td.M j l * td.M h' l = starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j' l) from by
      rw [map_sum]; congr 1; funext l; rw [hconj_h_sym l]
      rw [show starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l * td.M j' l) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j' l) from map_mul _ _ _]
      have : starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j' l) = td.M j l := by
        rw [hconj_j l, starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_conj]
      rw [this]; ring] at hsub
    exact hsub.symm
  
  have hII : α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j' l +
      (↑α₂ : ℂ) * starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j l) = 0 := by
    have hsub : ∑ l, td.M j' l * w l =
        α₁ * ∑ l, td.M j' l * td.M h l + ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M j' l * td.M h' l := by
      conv_lhs => arg 2; ext l; rw [hw_decomp l]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1; funext l; ring
    rw [hMw_j'h] at hsub
    rw [show ∑ l, td.M j' l * td.M h l = ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j' l from by
      congr 1; funext l; ring] at hsub
    rw [show ∑ l, td.M j' l * td.M h' l = starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j l) from by
      rw [map_sum]; congr 1; funext l
      rw [hconj_h_sym l, hconj_j l]
      rw [show starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l * td.M j l) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) from map_mul _ _ _]; ring] at hsub
    exact hsub.symm
  
  set S := ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j' l
  set T := ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j l
  have hII_conj : starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ S + ↑α₂ * T = 0 := by
    have := congr_arg (starRingEnd ℂ) hII
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_zero, starRingEnd_apply, star_star,
      show star (↑α₂ : ℂ) = ↑α₂ from by simp [Complex.conj_ofReal]] at this
    exact this
  
  have hα₂_ne : (↑α₂ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hα₂_pos)
  have hkey : (↑(α₂ ^ 2) - α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ α₁) * starRingEnd ℂ S = 0 := by
    have h1 : ↑α₂ * α₁ * T + ↑α₂ * ↑α₂ * starRingEnd ℂ S = 0 := by
      have := show ↑α₂ * (α₁ * T + ↑α₂ * starRingEnd ℂ S) = 0 from by rw [hI, mul_zero]
      linear_combination this
    have h2 : α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ S + α₁ * ↑α₂ * T = 0 := by
      have := show α₁ * (starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ S + ↑α₂ * T) = 0 from by rw [hII_conj, mul_zero]
      linear_combination this
    have : (↑α₂ * ↑α₂ - α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ α₁) * starRingEnd ℂ S = 0 := by
      linear_combination h1 - h2
    convert this using 2; push_cast; ring
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hkey with hdet | hcS
  · 
    have hIII : α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l + ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l = 1 := by
      have : ∑ l, td.M h l * w l = α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l +
          ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l := by
        conv_lhs => arg 2; ext l; rw [hw_decomp l]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; congr 1; funext l; ring
      rw [hMw_hh] at this; exact this.symm
    have hIV : α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l +
        ↑α₂ * starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l) = 0 := by
      have : ∑ l, td.M h' l * w l = α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h l +
          ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h' l := by
        conv_lhs => arg 2; ext l; rw [hw_decomp l]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; congr 1; funext l; ring
      rw [hMw_h'h] at this
      rw [show ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h l = ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l from by
        congr 1; funext l; ring] at this
      rw [show ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h' l = starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l) from by
        rw [map_sum]; congr 1; funext l; simp_rw [hconj_h_sym l]; exact (map_mul _ _ _).symm] at this
      exact this.symm
    set σ' := ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l
    set N' := ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l
    have hN'_real : (N' : ℂ).im = 0 := by
      simp only [N', Complex.im_sum]; apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro l _
      rw [hconj_h_sym l]; simp [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_im]
    have hIV_conj : starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * N' + ↑α₂ * σ' = 0 := by
      have := congr_arg (starRingEnd ℂ) hIV
      simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_zero, starRingEnd_apply, star_star,
        show star (↑α₂ : ℂ) = ↑α₂ from by simp [Complex.conj_ofReal],
        show star N' = N' from by rw [star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr hN'_real]] at this
      exact this
    have hdet' : α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ α₁ = ↑(α₂ ^ 2) := by
      exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hdet).symm
    have hmul : α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * (σ' * N') = -(↑α₂ * σ') * (1 - ↑α₂ * N') := by
      calc α₁ * starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * (σ' * N')
          = (starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * N') * (α₁ * σ') := by ring
        _ = (-(↑α₂ * σ')) * (1 - ↑α₂ * N') := by
            rw [show starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * N' = -(↑α₂ * σ') from by linear_combination hIV_conj,
              show α₁ * σ' = 1 - ↑α₂ * N' from by linear_combination hIII]
    rw [hdet'] at hmul
    have hασ : ↑α₂ * σ' = 0 := by
      
      have hα₂sq : (↑(α₂ ^ 2) : ℂ) = ↑α₂ * ↑α₂ := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hα₂sq] at hmul
      linear_combination hmul
    have hσ_zero : σ' = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hασ).resolve_left hα₂_ne
    have hα₂N : ↑α₂ * N' = 1 := by
      have : α₁ * σ' = 0 := by rw [hσ_zero, mul_zero]
      linear_combination hIII - this
    have hN_ne : N' ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hα₂N; exact zero_ne_one hα₂N
    have hα₁_eq : α₁ = 0 := by
      have : α₁ * N' = 0 := by
        have := hIV; rw [hσ_zero, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at this; exact this
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hN_ne
    rw [hα₁_eq, zero_mul] at hdet'
    exact absurd (Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hdet'.symm)
      (ne_of_gt (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < α₂ ^ 2))
  · 
    have : S = 0 := by
      have h := congr_arg (starRingEnd ℂ) hcS
      simp only [starRingEnd_apply, star_star, map_zero] at h; exact h
    exact this

name: TubalTensor.hC_pos_general
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h; push Not at h
  have h0 : ∀ i, ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro i
    exact le_antisymm
      (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) |>.mp
        (le_antisymm h (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)) i (Finset.mem_univ i)))
      (sq_nonneg _)
  
  have hcol_re_zero : ∀ i, (td.M_inv i k).re = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hi := h0 i
    have : ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re = (td.M_inv i k).re := by
      simp [mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]
    rw [this] at hi
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hi
  
  have hMinv_col_real : ∀ i, (td.M_inv i k).im = 0 := by
    intro i
    have := Minv_col_conj_of_row_conj td (isRealRow_self_conj hk_real) i
    exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp this.symm
  
  have hcol_zero : ∀ i, td.M_inv i k = 0 := by
    intro i
    exact Complex.ext (hcol_re_zero i) (hMinv_col_real i)
  
  have h1 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv k k
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at h1
  rw [show ∑ j, td.M k j * td.M_inv j k = 0 from
    Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by rw [hcol_zero j, mul_zero])] at h1
  exact zero_ne_one h1

name: TubalTensor.foc_general
statement:
private theorem foc_general (td : TubalData n) (k : Fin n) (hk_real : IsRealRow td.M k)
    (hopt_tube : ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (β : ℝ),
      ∑ i, (a i - ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) k).re *
            ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ i, (a i - β * ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re) ^ 2) :
    ∀ j : Fin n,
      (td.M_inv j k).re = (td.M k j).re * ∑ i, ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set c : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re
  have hc_eq : ∀ i : Fin n, c i = (td.M_inv i k).re := by
    intro i; simp [c, mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
      Finset.mem_univ, mul_one]
  have hC_pos := hC_pos_general td k hk_real
  
  intro j
  set α_fun := fun (a : Fin n → ℝ) => ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) k).re
  set C := ∑ i, c i ^ 2
  
  have h := hopt_tube (Pi.single j 1) ((α_fun (Pi.single j 1)))
  
  have foc_single : ∑ i, (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℝ) i * c i = α_fun (Pi.single j 1) * C := by
    set a : Fin n → ℝ := Pi.single j 1
    set α := α_fun a
    set S := ∑ i, (a i - α * c i) * c i
    have hquad : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ C * t ^ 2 + (-2 * S) * t := by
      intro t
      have h' := hopt_tube a (α + t)
      have hterm : ∀ i : Fin n,
          (a i - (α + t) * c i) ^ 2 =
          (a i - α * c i) ^ 2 +
          (c i ^ 2 * t ^ 2 + (-2) * ((a i - α * c i) * c i) * t) := by
