        intro i; ring
      have hrhs : ∑ x, (a x - (α + t) * c x) ^ 2 =
          ∑ x, (a x - α * c x) ^ 2 +
          ((∑ x, c x ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + (-2) * (∑ x, (a x - α * c x) * c x) * t) := by
        conv_lhs => arg 2; ext x; rw [hterm x]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]; congr 1
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]; congr 1
        · rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        · rw [show ∑ x, (-2) * ((a x - α * c x) * c x) * t =
            (∑ x, (-2) * ((a x - α * c x) * c x)) * t from by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]]
          congr 1; rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [hrhs] at h'; linarith
    have hS_zero : S = 0 := by
      linarith [linear_coeff_zero_of_quadratic_nonneg hC_pos hquad]
    show ∑ i, a i * c i = α * C
    have hS_expand : S = ∑ i, a i * c i - α * C := by
      simp only [S]; conv_lhs => arg 2; ext i; rw [show (a i - α * c i) * c i =
        a i * c i - α * (c i ^ 2) from by ring]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    linarith
  
  rw [show ∑ i, (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℝ) i * c i = c j from by
    simp [Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]] at foc_single
  
  have hα : α_fun (Pi.single j 1) = (td.M k j).re := by
    simp only [α_fun, mulVec, dotProduct, toComplex, Pi.single_apply]
    simp only [apply_ite Complex.ofReal, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero]
    simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  rw [hα, hc_eq] at foc_single
  exact foc_single

name: TubalTensor.derive_tube_opt_real
statement:
private theorem derive_tube_opt_real (td : TubalData n) (_hn : 0 < n) (k : Fin n)
    (hk_real : IsRealRow td.M k)
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B)) :
    ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (β : ℝ),
      ∑ i, (a i - ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) k).re *
            ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ i, (a i - β * ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro a β
  
  set c : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single k (1 : ℂ)) i).re
  set α := ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) k).re
  
  set A : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td := fun _ _ => KM.ofFun a
  
  set bvec : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => β * c i
  set B : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td := fun _ _ => KM.ofFun bvec
  
  set r : Fin n → ℕ := fun k' => if k' = k then 1 else 0
  
  
  have hr : RespectsConjPairing td r := by
    intro k₁ k₂ hk₁₂ hconj
    
    have aux : ∀ (a b : Fin n), a ≠ b → IsConjRow td.M a b → a = k → False := by
      intro a b hab hc hak
      rw [hak] at hc hab
      have hrows_eq : ∀ l, td.M b l = td.M k l := by
        intro l; rw [hc l, starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero (hk_real l)]
      have e1 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv k k
      have e2 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv b k
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at e1
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at e2
      rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hab)] at e2
      rw [show ∑ x, td.M b x * td.M_inv x k = ∑ x, td.M k x * td.M_inv x k from by
        congr 1; funext l; rw [hrows_eq l]] at e2
      exact absurd e1 (by rw [e2]; exact zero_ne_one)
    simp only [r]
    by_cases hk1 : k₁ = k
    · exact absurd (aux k₁ k₂ hk₁₂ hconj hk1) False.elim
    · by_cases hk2 : k₂ = k
      · exact absurd (aux k₂ k₁ (Ne.symm hk₁₂) (isConjRow_symm hconj) hk2) False.elim
      · simp [hk1, hk2]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hB_multirank : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r := by
    intro k'
    simp only [starMMultirank]
    
    by_cases hkk : k' = k
    · 
      rw [hkk]; simp only [r, ite_true]
      exact (transform B k).rank_le_card_height.trans (by simp)
    · 
      simp only [r, if_neg hkk]
      
      suffices transform B k' = 0 by rw [this]; simp
      ext i j
      simp only [transform_apply, B]
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      have hMinv_real : ∀ x, (td.M_inv x k).im = 0 := by
        intro x
        have := Minv_col_conj_of_row_conj td (isRealRow_self_conj hk_real) x
        exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp this.symm
      
      rw [KM.toFun_ofFun]
      show td.applyM (toComplex (fun i => β * c i)) k' = (0 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ) i j
      simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply, toComplex]
      
      
      simp_rw [show ∀ x, (↑(β * c x) : ℂ) = ↑β * ↑(c x) from fun x => by push_cast; ring]
      
      rw [show ∑ x, td.M k' x * (↑β * ↑(c x)) = ↑β * ∑ x, td.M k' x * ↑(c x) from by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; funext x; ring]
      
      have hc_eq_Minv : ∀ x, (↑(c x) : ℂ) = td.M_inv x k := by
        intro x
        have hc_val : c x = (td.M_inv x k).re := by
          simp [c, mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]
        rw [hc_val]
        symm
        exact Complex.ext (Complex.ofReal_re _) (by rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact hMinv_real x)
      simp_rw [hc_eq_Minv]
      
      have hmul := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv k' k
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_neg hkk] at hmul
      rw [hmul, mul_zero]; simp
  
  have svd := TSVD.of A
  have hopt' := hopt 1 1 A svd B r hr hB_multirank
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hRHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A - B) = ∑ i, (a i - β * c i) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_one]
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, A, B, KM.toFun_sub, KM.toFun_ofFun, bvec, Pi.sub_apply]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hLHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) =
      ∑ i, (a i - α * c i) ^ 2 := by
    
    set AP : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td := fun _ _ => KM.ofFun (fun i => α * c i)
    
    suffices htrunc_eq : tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr = AP by
      rw [htrunc_eq]
      simp only [tubalFrobNormSq]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.sum_univ_one]
      simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, A, AP, KM.toFun_sub, KM.toFun_ofFun, Pi.sub_apply]
    
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective invTransform_transform)
    
    funext sl i j
    
    have hi : i = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i
    have hj : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
    subst hi; subst hj
    
    have hAP_transform : ∀ sl', transform AP sl' 0 0 =
        td.applyM (toComplex (fun i => α * c i)) sl' := by
      intro sl'; simp only [transform_apply, AP, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    
    
    
    have hMinv_real : ∀ x, (td.M_inv x k).im = 0 := by
      intro x
      have := Minv_col_conj_of_row_conj td (isRealRow_self_conj hk_real) x
      exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp this.symm
    have hc_eq_Minv : ∀ x, (↑(c x) : ℂ) = td.M_inv x k := by
      intro x
      have hc_val : c x = (td.M_inv x k).re := by
        simp [c, mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]
      rw [hc_val]
      exact Complex.ext (Complex.ofReal_re _) (by rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact (hMinv_real x).symm)
    
    have hMc : td.applyM (toComplex c) = Pi.single k 1 := by
      ext sl'
      simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply, toComplex]
      simp_rw [hc_eq_Minv]
      have hmul := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv sl' k
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at hmul
      rw [hmul]
      simp [Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
    
    have hM_alphac : td.applyM (toComplex (fun i => α * c i)) = fun sl' =>
        if sl' = k then ↑α else 0 := by
      ext sl'
      simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply, toComplex]
      simp_rw [show ∀ x, (↑(α * c x) : ℂ) = ↑α * ↑(c x) from fun x => by push_cast; ring]
      rw [show ∑ x, td.M sl' x * (↑α * ↑(c x)) = ↑α * ∑ x, td.M sl' x * ↑(c x) from by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; funext x; ring]
      simp_rw [hc_eq_Minv]
      have hmul := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv sl' k
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at hmul
      rw [hmul]
      split_ifs with h
      · simp
      · simp
    
    have hAP_sl : ∀ sl', transform AP sl' 0 0 = if sl' = k then ↑α else 0 := by
      intro sl'; rw [hAP_transform, congr_fun hM_alphac sl']
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have htrunc_transform : ∀ sl', transform (tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) sl' =
        transform svd.U sl' * transform (tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr) sl' *
        (transform svd.V sl')ᴴ := by
      intro sl'
      unfold tsvdTruncMulti
      have hmul1 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff
        (svd.U * tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr) svd.Vᴴ _).mp rfl) sl'
      have hmul2 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff svd.U
        (tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr) _).mp rfl) sl'
      simp only [facewise_apply] at hmul1 hmul2
      rw [hmul1, Matrix.mul_assoc, hmul2, congr_fun (transform_conjTranspose svd.V) sl',
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    
    
    
    
    
    set F : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ := fun sl' i' j' =>
      if (i' : ℕ) < r sl' ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then transform svd.S sl' i' j' else 0
    have hF_paired : ∀ (a : Fin 1) (b : Fin 1),
        HasRealPairedStructure td (fun sl' => F sl' a b) := by
      intro a' b'
      have hS_ps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (svd.S a' b'))
      constructor
      · intro sl' hreal
        show (if (a' : ℕ) < r sl' ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd.S sl' a' b' else 0).im = 0
        split_ifs with h
        · exact hS_ps.1 sl' hreal
        · rfl
      · intro sl1 sl2 hne hconj
        show (if (a' : ℕ) < r sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd.S sl2 a' b' else 0) =
          starRingEnd ℂ (if (a' : ℕ) < r sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd.S sl1 a' b' else 0)
        have hrr : r sl1 = r sl2 := hr sl1 sl2 (Ne.symm hne) hconj
        by_cases h : (a' : ℕ) < r sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)
        · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ⟨hrr ▸ h.1, h.2⟩]
          exact hS_ps.2 sl1 sl2 hne hconj
        · have h' : ¬((a' : ℕ) < r sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)) := by rw [← hrr]; exact h
          rw [if_neg h, if_neg h', map_zero]
    have hF_rt : transform (invTransform F : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td) = F :=
      transform_invTransform F
        (fun a b => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hF_paired a b))
    
    have hTruncS_eq : tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr = invTransform F := rfl
    
    have hTruncS_transform : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd.S svd.hS_fdiag r hr) = F := by
      rw [hTruncS_eq]; exact hF_rt
    
    have hF_ne : ∀ sl', sl' ≠ k → F sl' 0 0 = 0 := by
      intro sl' hne
      simp only [F, r, if_neg hne]
      rw [if_neg]; push Not; intro h; exact absurd h (by omega)
    
    have hF_mat : ∀ sl', F sl' = if sl' = k then transform svd.S sl' else 0 := by
      intro sl'
      ext i' j'
      have hi' : i' = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i'
      have hj' : j' = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j'
      subst hi'; subst hj'
      show (if (0 : Fin 1).val < r sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 1).val = (0 : Fin 1).val
            then transform svd.S sl' 0 0 else 0) =
           (if sl' = k then transform svd.S sl' else 0 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ) 0 0
      by_cases hsl : sl' = k
      · 
        have hcond : (0 : Fin 1).val < r sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 1).val = (0 : Fin 1).val := by
          constructor
          · simp [r, hsl]
          · rfl
        rw [if_pos hcond, if_pos hsl]
      · 
        have hcond : ¬((0 : Fin 1).val < r sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 1).val = (0 : Fin 1).val) := by
          intro ⟨h1, _⟩
          simp [r, hsl] at h1
        rw [if_neg hcond, if_neg hsl]; simp
    
    by_cases hslk : sl = k
    · 
      subst hslk
      rw [hAP_sl, if_pos rfl, htrunc_transform, congr_fun hTruncS_transform sl]
      rw [hF_mat, if_pos rfl, ← svd.hSlice sl]
      
      simp only [transform_apply, A, KM.toFun_ofFun]
      
      have hMa_real : (td.applyM (toComplex a) sl).im = 0 := applyM_real_row hk_real
      
      show td.applyM (toComplex a) sl = ↑α
      simp only [α]
      symm
      exact Complex.ext (Complex.ofReal_re _) (by rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact hMa_real.symm)
    · 
      rw [hAP_sl, if_neg hslk, htrunc_transform, congr_fun hTruncS_transform sl]
      rw [hF_mat, if_neg hslk]
      simp
  linarith

name: TubalTensor.MMH_off_diag_both_real
statement:
private theorem MMH_off_diag_both_real (td : TubalData n)
    (h j : Fin n) (hhj : h ≠ j)
    (hh_real : IsRealRow td.M h) (hj_real : IsRealRow td.M j)
    (hMinv_eq : ∀ l : Fin n,
      (td.M_inv l h).re = (td.M h l).re * ∑ i, ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single h (1 : ℂ)) i).re ^ 2) :
    ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  set C_h := ∑ i, ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single h (1 : ℂ)) i).re ^ 2
  have hC_pos := hC_pos_general td h hh_real
  
  have hMMinv := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv j h
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hhj)] at hMMinv
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hreal_sum : ∑ l, (td.M j l).re * (td.M_inv l h).re = 0 := by
    have hzero : (∑ l, td.M j l * td.M_inv l h) = 0 := hMMinv
    have hterm : ∀ l, (td.M j l * td.M_inv l h).re = (td.M j l).re * (td.M_inv l h).re := by
      intro l
      rw [Complex.mul_re]
      have hjl : (td.M j l).im = 0 := hj_real l
      
      
      
      rw [hjl]; ring
    have : (∑ l, td.M j l * td.M_inv l h).re = ∑ l, (td.M j l * td.M_inv l h).re :=
      Complex.re_sum _ _
    rw [hzero, Complex.zero_re] at this
    rw [show ∑ l, (td.M j l).re * (td.M_inv l h).re =
      ∑ l, (td.M j l * td.M_inv l h).re from by congr 1; funext l; rw [hterm l]]
    linarith
  
  simp_rw [hMinv_eq] at hreal_sum
  have hprod_zero : (∑ l, (td.M j l).re * (td.M h l).re) * C_h = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]; convert hreal_sum using 1; congr 1; funext l; ring
  have hsum_zero : ∑ l, (td.M j l).re * (td.M h l).re = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod_zero).resolve_right (ne_of_gt hC_pos)
  
  rw [show ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) =
    ↑(∑ l, (td.M h l).re * (td.M j l).re) from by
      rw [Complex.ofReal_sum]; congr 1; funext l
      have hhl : (td.M h l).im = 0 := hh_real l
      have hjl : (td.M j l).im = 0 := hj_real l
      rw [starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero hjl]
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [Complex.mul_re, hhl, hjl, mul_zero, sub_zero, Complex.ofReal_re]
      · simp [Complex.mul_im, hhl, hjl, mul_zero, add_zero, Complex.ofReal_im]]
  rw [show ∑ l, (td.M h l).re * (td.M j l).re = ∑ l, (td.M j l).re * (td.M h l).re from by
    congr 1; funext l; ring]
  rw [hsum_zero]; simp

name: TubalTensor.conj_pair_transform_bvec
statement:
private theorem conj_pair_transform_bvec (td : TubalData n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (s t : ℝ) :
    td.applyM (toComplex (fun i => 2 * s * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * t * (td.M_inv i h).im)) =
      fun sl' => if sl' = h then ↑s + ↑t * Complex.I
                 else if sl' = h' then ↑s - ↑t * Complex.I
                 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hMinv_conj : ∀ l, td.M_inv l h' = starRingEnd ℂ (td.M_inv l h) :=
    Minv_col_conj_of_row_conj td hconj
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  ext sl'
  simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply, toComplex_apply]
  
  
  have hentry : ∀ x, (↑(2 * s * (td.M_inv x h).re - 2 * t * (td.M_inv x h).im) : ℂ) =
      ↑s * (td.M_inv x h + td.M_inv x h') +
      ↑t * Complex.I * (td.M_inv x h - td.M_inv x h') := by
    intro x
    rw [hMinv_conj x]
    set z := td.M_inv x h
    have hcz : starRingEnd ℂ z = ⟨z.re, -z.im⟩ :=
      Complex.ext (Complex.conj_re z) (by rw [Complex.conj_im])
    rw [hcz, show z = ⟨z.re, z.im⟩ from (Complex.eta z).symm]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp ; ring
  simp_rw [hentry]
  
  
  have hdist : ∑ x, td.M sl' x * (↑s * (td.M_inv x h + td.M_inv x h') +
      ↑t * Complex.I * (td.M_inv x h - td.M_inv x h')) =
    ↑s * ∑ x, td.M sl' x * td.M_inv x h + ↑s * ∑ x, td.M sl' x * td.M_inv x h' +
    ↑t * Complex.I * ∑ x, td.M sl' x * td.M_inv x h -
    ↑t * Complex.I * ∑ x, td.M sl' x * td.M_inv x h' := by
    trans (∑ x, (↑s * (td.M sl' x * td.M_inv x h) + ↑s * (td.M sl' x * td.M_inv x h') +
        ↑t * Complex.I * (td.M sl' x * td.M_inv x h) -
        ↑t * Complex.I * (td.M sl' x * td.M_inv x h')))
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro x _; ring
    · simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hdist]
  have hMMinv_h := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv sl' h
  have hMMinv_h' := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv sl' h'
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at hMMinv_h hMMinv_h'
  rw [hMMinv_h, hMMinv_h']
  by_cases hsl_h : sl' = h
  · rw [hsl_h]; simp only [ite_true, Ne.symm hh'_ne, ite_false]; ring
  · by_cases hsl_h' : sl' = h'
    · rw [hsl_h']; simp [hh'_ne]
    · have : ¬(sl' = h ∨ sl' = h') := fun ho => ho.elim hsl_h hsl_h'
      simp [hsl_h, hsl_h']

name: TubalTensor.conj_pair_multirank_valid
proof:
:= by
  
  have rows_eq_absurd : ∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → (∀ l, td.M a l = td.M b l) → False := by
    intro a b hab hrows
    have e1 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv b b
    have e2 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv a b
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at e1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_neg hab] at e2
    rw [show ∑ x, td.M a x * td.M_inv x b = ∑ x, td.M b x * td.M_inv x b from by
      congr 1; funext l; rw [hrows l]] at e2
    exact absurd e1 (by rw [e2]; exact zero_ne_one)
  intro k₁ k₂ hk₁₂ hconj_k
  show (if k₁ = h ∨ k₁ = h' then 1 else 0) = (if k₂ = h ∨ k₂ = h' then 1 else 0)
  by_cases hk1h : k₁ = h
  · 
    have hk2h' : k₂ = h' := by
      by_contra hne
      exact rows_eq_absurd k₂ h' hne (fun l => by rw [hk1h] at hconj_k; rw [hconj_k l, hconj l])
    rw [hk1h, hk2h']; simp
  · by_cases hk1h' : k₁ = h'
    · 
      have hk2h : k₂ = h := by
        by_contra hne
        exact rows_eq_absurd k₂ h hne (fun l => by
          rw [hk1h'] at hconj_k
          rw [hconj_k l, hconj l, starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_conj])
      rw [hk1h', hk2h]; simp
    · 
      have hk1_not : ¬(k₁ = h ∨ k₁ = h') := fun ho => ho.elim hk1h hk1h'
      rw [if_neg hk1_not]
      by_cases hk2h : k₂ = h
      · exfalso; exact hk1h' (by
          by_contra hne
          exact rows_eq_absurd k₁ h' hne (fun l => by
            rw [hk2h] at hconj_k; rw [(isConjRow_symm hconj_k) l, hconj l]))
      · by_cases hk2h' : k₂ = h'
        · exfalso; exact hk1h (by
            by_contra hne
            exact rows_eq_absurd k₁ h hne (fun l => by
              rw [hk2h'] at hconj_k
              rw [(isConjRow_symm hconj_k) l, hconj l, starRingEnd_apply, star_def,
                Complex.conj_conj]))
        · rw [if_neg (fun ho => ho.elim hk2h hk2h')]

name: TubalTensor.conj_pair_tube_multirank
statement:
private theorem conj_pair_tube_multirank (td : TubalData n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (s t : ℝ) :
    HasStarMMultirankAtMost
      (fun (_ : Fin 1) (_ : Fin 1) =>
        KM.ofFun (fun i => 2 * s * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * t * (td.M_inv i h).im) : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td)
      (fun sl => if sl = h ∨ sl = h' then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro k'
  simp only [starMMultirank]
  by_cases hkh : k' = h
  · 
    rw [hkh]; simp only []
    exact (transform _ h).rank_le_card_height.trans (by simp)
  · by_cases hkh' : k' = h'
    · 
      rw [hkh']; simp only []
      exact (transform _ h').rank_le_card_height.trans (by simp)
    · 
      simp only [show ¬(k' = h ∨ k' = h') from fun ho => ho.elim hkh hkh', ite_false]
      suffices transform (fun _ _ => KM.ofFun (fun i =>
        2 * s * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * t * (td.M_inv i h).im) : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td) k' = 0 by
        rw [this]; simp
      ext i j
      simp only [transform_apply, KM.toFun_ofFun]
      show td.applyM (toComplex (fun i =>
        2 * s * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * t * (td.M_inv i h).im)) k' =
        (0 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ) i j
      rw [congr_fun (conj_pair_transform_bvec td h h' hh'_ne hconj s t) k']
      simp [hkh, hkh']

name: TubalTensor.conj_pair_tsvd_trunc_eq
statement:
private theorem conj_pair_tsvd_trunc_eq (td : TubalData n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    tsvdTruncMulti (TSVD.of (fun (_ : Fin 1) (_ : Fin 1) => KM.ofFun a : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td))
      (fun sl => if sl = h ∨ sl = h' then 1 else 0)
      (conj_pair_multirank_valid td h h' hh'_ne hconj) =
    (fun (_ : Fin 1) (_ : Fin 1) =>
      KM.ofFun (fun i => 2 * ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re * (td.M_inv i h).re -
                          2 * ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im * (td.M_inv i h).im) : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td)
proof:
:= by
  
  apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective invTransform_transform)
  funext sl i j
  have hi : i = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i
  have hj : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
  subst hi; subst hj
  set s₀ := ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re
  set t₀ := ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im
  set r₀ : Fin n → ℕ := fun sl => if sl = h ∨ sl = h' then 1 else 0
  set hr₀ := conj_pair_multirank_valid td h h' hh'_ne hconj
  set A₀ : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td := fun _ _ => KM.ofFun a
  set svd₀ := TSVD.of A₀
  set AP : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td := fun _ _ =>
    KM.ofFun (fun i => 2 * s₀ * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * t₀ * (td.M_inv i h).im)
  
  have hAP_transform : ∀ sl', transform AP sl' 0 0 =
      td.applyM (toComplex (fun i => 2 * s₀ * (td.M_inv i h).re -
                                      2 * t₀ * (td.M_inv i h).im)) sl' := by
    intro sl'; simp only [transform_apply, AP, KM.toFun_ofFun]
  
  have hAP_sl : ∀ sl', transform AP sl' 0 0 =
      if sl' = h then ↑s₀ + ↑t₀ * Complex.I
      else if sl' = h' then ↑s₀ - ↑t₀ * Complex.I
      else 0 := by
    intro sl'
    rw [hAP_transform, congr_fun (conj_pair_transform_bvec td h h' hh'_ne hconj s₀ t₀) sl']
  
  have htrunc_transform : ∀ sl', transform (tsvdTruncMulti svd₀ r₀ hr₀) sl' =
      transform svd₀.U sl' * transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₀.S svd₀.hS_fdiag r₀ hr₀) sl' *
      (transform svd₀.V sl')ᴴ := by
    intro sl'
    unfold tsvdTruncMulti
    have hmul1 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff
      (svd₀.U * tubalTruncMulti svd₀.S svd₀.hS_fdiag r₀ hr₀) svd₀.Vᴴ _).mp rfl) sl'
    have hmul2 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff svd₀.U
      (tubalTruncMulti svd₀.S svd₀.hS_fdiag r₀ hr₀) _).mp rfl) sl'
    simp only [facewise_apply] at hmul1 hmul2
    rw [hmul1, Matrix.mul_assoc, hmul2, congr_fun (transform_conjTranspose svd₀.V) sl',
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  
  set F : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ := fun sl' i' j' =>
    if (i' : ℕ) < r₀ sl' ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then transform svd₀.S sl' i' j' else 0
  have hF_paired : ∀ (a' : Fin 1) (b' : Fin 1),
      HasRealPairedStructure td (fun sl' => F sl' a' b') := by
    intro a' b'
    have hS_ps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (svd₀.S a' b'))
    constructor
    · intro sl' hreal
      show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₀ sl' ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₀.S sl' a' b' else 0).im = 0
      split_ifs with hif
      · exact hS_ps.1 sl' hreal
      · rfl
    · intro sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
      show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₀ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₀.S sl2 a' b' else 0) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (if (a' : ℕ) < r₀ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₀.S sl1 a' b' else 0)
      have hrr : r₀ sl1 = r₀ sl2 := hr₀ sl1 sl2 (Ne.symm hne) hconj_sl
      by_cases hif : (a' : ℕ) < r₀ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)
      · rw [if_pos hif, if_pos ⟨hrr ▸ hif.1, hif.2⟩]
        exact hS_ps.2 sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
      · have hif' : ¬((a' : ℕ) < r₀ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)) := by rw [← hrr]; exact hif
        rw [if_neg hif, if_neg hif', map_zero]
  have hF_rt : transform (invTransform F : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td) = F :=
    transform_invTransform F
      (fun a' b' => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hF_paired a' b'))
  have hTruncS_eq : tubalTruncMulti svd₀.S svd₀.hS_fdiag r₀ hr₀ = invTransform F := rfl
  have hTruncS_transform : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₀.S svd₀.hS_fdiag r₀ hr₀) = F := by
    rw [hTruncS_eq]; exact hF_rt
  
  have hF_mat : ∀ sl', F sl' = if sl' = h ∨ sl' = h' then transform svd₀.S sl' else 0 := by
    intro sl'
    ext i' j'
    have hi' : i' = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i'
    have hj' : j' = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j'
    subst hi'; subst hj'
    show (if (0 : Fin 1).val < r₀ sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 1).val = (0 : Fin 1).val
          then transform svd₀.S sl' 0 0 else 0) =
         (if sl' = h ∨ sl' = h' then transform svd₀.S sl' else 0 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ) 0 0
    by_cases hsl : sl' = h ∨ sl' = h'
    · have hcond : (0 : Fin 1).val < r₀ sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 1).val = (0 : Fin 1).val := by
        constructor
        · simp [r₀, hsl]
        · rfl
      rw [if_pos hcond, if_pos hsl]
    · have hcond : ¬((0 : Fin 1).val < r₀ sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 1).val = (0 : Fin 1).val) := by
        intro ⟨h1, _⟩
        simp [r₀, hsl] at h1
      rw [if_neg hcond, if_neg hsl]; simp
  
  by_cases hslh : sl = h ∨ sl = h'
  · 
    rw [hAP_sl, htrunc_transform, congr_fun hTruncS_transform sl]
    rw [hF_mat, if_pos hslh, ← svd₀.hSlice sl]
    simp only [transform_apply, A₀, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    
    rcases hslh with hsl_eq | hsl_eq
    · 
      rw [hsl_eq, if_pos rfl]
      show td.applyM (toComplex a) h = ↑s₀ + ↑t₀ * Complex.I
      simp only [s₀, t₀]
      exact ((td.applyM (toComplex a) h).re_add_im).symm
    · 
      rw [hsl_eq, if_neg hh'_ne, if_pos rfl]
      
      
      
      rw [show td.applyM (toComplex a) h' = starRingEnd ℂ (td.applyM (toComplex a) h) from
        @applyM_conj_row _ td a h h' hconj]
      simp only [s₀, t₀]
      set w := (td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h
      show starRingEnd ℂ w = ↑w.re - ↑w.im * Complex.I
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp only [Complex.conj_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]; ring
      · simp only [Complex.conj_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]; ring
  · 
    rw [hAP_sl]
    push Not at hslh
    rw [if_neg hslh.1, if_neg hslh.2]
    rw [htrunc_transform, congr_fun hTruncS_transform sl]
    rw [hF_mat, if_neg (by push Not; exact hslh)]
    simp

name: TubalTensor.tube_ey_conj_pair_aux
statement:
private theorem tube_ey_conj_pair_aux (td : TubalData n) (_hn : 0 < n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) (s t : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, (a i - 2 * ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re * (td.M_inv i h).re +
                2 * ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im * (td.M_inv i h).im) ^ 2 ≤
    ∑ i, (a i - 2 * s * (td.M_inv i h).re + 2 * t * (td.M_inv i h).im) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  have hr₀ := conj_pair_multirank_valid td h h' hh'_ne hconj
  have hB_multirank := conj_pair_tube_multirank td h h' hh'_ne hconj s t
  set A₀ : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td := fun _ _ => KM.ofFun a
  set bvec : Fin n → ℝ := fun j =>
    (2 : ℝ) * s * (td.M_inv j h).re - (2 : ℝ) * t * (td.M_inv j h).im
  set B₀ : TubalMatrix 1 1 n td := fun _ _ => KM.ofFun bvec
  set svd₀ := TSVD.of A₀
  have hopt' := hopt 1 1 A₀ svd₀ B₀ _ hr₀ hB_multirank
  
  have hRHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A₀ - B₀) =
      ∑ i, (a i - 2 * s * (td.M_inv i h).re + 2 * t * (td.M_inv i h).im) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.sub_apply, A₀, B₀, KM.toFun_sub,
      KM.toFun_ofFun, bvec, Pi.sub_apply]
    congr 1; funext i; ring
  
  have htrunc_eq := conj_pair_tsvd_trunc_eq td h h' hh'_ne hconj a
  have hLHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A₀ - tsvdTruncMulti svd₀ _ hr₀) =
      ∑ i, (a i - 2 * ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re * (td.M_inv i h).re +
            2 * ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im * (td.M_inv i h).im) ^ 2 := by
    change tubalFrobNormSq (A₀ - tsvdTruncMulti (TSVD.of A₀) _ hr₀) = _
    rw [htrunc_eq]
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.sub_apply, A₀, KM.toFun_sub,
      KM.toFun_ofFun, Pi.sub_apply]
    congr 1; funext i; ring
  linarith

name: TubalTensor.tube_ey_conj_pair
statement:
private theorem tube_ey_conj_pair (td : TubalData n) (hn : 0 < n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B)) :
    let u := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).re
    let v := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).im
    ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (s t : ℝ),
      ∑ i, (a i - 2 * ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re * u i +
                  2 * ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im * v i) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ i, (a i - 2 * s * u i + 2 * t * v i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro u₁ v₁ a₁ s₁ t₁
  exact tube_ey_conj_pair_aux td hn h h' hh'_ne hconj hopt a₁ s₁ t₁

name: TubalTensor.foc_2d_decomp
statement:
private theorem foc_2d_decomp (td : TubalData n) (hn : 0 < n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B)) :
    ∃ (α₁ : ℂ) (α₂ : ℝ), 0 < α₂ ∧
      ∀ l, td.M_inv l h = α₁ * td.M h l + ↑α₂ * td.M h' l
proof:
:= by
  
  set u := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).re
  set v := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).im
  
  have hMinv_conj : ∀ l, td.M_inv l h' = starRingEnd ℂ (td.M_inv l h) :=
    Minv_col_conj_of_row_conj td hconj
  
  have hopt_tube := tube_ey_conj_pair td hn h h' hh'_ne hconj hopt
  
  set Cu := ∑ i, u i ^ 2
  set Cv := ∑ i, v i ^ 2
  set Cuv := ∑ i, u i * v i
  
  have hCu_nonneg : 0 ≤ Cu := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (u i))
  have hCv_nonneg : 0 ≤ Cv := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (v i))
  have hCuCv_pos : 0 < Cu + Cv := by
    by_contra h_neg; push Not at h_neg
    have h0 : Cu + Cv = 0 := le_antisymm h_neg (add_nonneg hCu_nonneg hCv_nonneg)
    have hCu0 : Cu = 0 := by linarith
    have hCv0 : Cv = 0 := by linarith
    have hu0 : ∀ i, u i = 0 := by
      intro i
      have := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (u j)) |>.mp
        (le_antisymm (by linarith) hCu_nonneg) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
    have hv0 : ∀ i, v i = 0 := by
      intro i
      have := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (v j)) |>.mp
        (le_antisymm (by linarith) hCv_nonneg) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
    
    have hcol_zero : ∀ i, td.M_inv i h = 0 := by
      intro i; exact Complex.ext (by rw [Complex.zero_re]; exact hu0 i) (by rw [Complex.zero_im]; exact hv0 i)
    
    have := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h h
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at this
    rw [show ∑ j, td.M h j * td.M_inv j h = 0 from
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by rw [hcol_zero j, mul_zero])] at this
    exact absurd this zero_ne_one
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have foc_u : Cu > 0 → ∀ l, u l = 2 * (td.M h l).re * Cu - 2 * (td.M h l).im * Cuv := by
    intro hCu_pos l
    
    set a : Fin n → ℝ := Pi.single l 1
    have hs₀ : ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re = (td.M h l).re := by
      simp only [a, mulVec, dotProduct, toComplex, Pi.single_apply]
      simp only [apply_ite Complex.ofReal, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero,
        mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    have ht₀ : ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im = (td.M h l).im := by
      simp only [a, mulVec, dotProduct, toComplex, Pi.single_apply]
      simp only [apply_ite Complex.ofReal, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero,
        mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    set s₀ := ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re
    set t₀ := ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im
    
    set r := fun i => a i - 2 * s₀ * u i + 2 * t₀ * v i
    
    have hquad : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ 4 * Cu * ε ^ 2 - 4 * (∑ i, r i * u i) * ε := by
      intro ε
      have h1 := hopt_tube a (s₀ + ε) t₀
      
      
      
      have hrhs : ∀ i, (a i - 2 * (s₀ + ε) * u i + 2 * t₀ * v i) =
          r i - 2 * ε * u i := by
        intro i; simp only [r]; ring
      rw [show ∑ i, (a i - 2 * (s₀ + ε) * u i + 2 * t₀ * v i) ^ 2 =
        ∑ i, (r i - 2 * ε * u i) ^ 2 from by congr 1; funext i; rw [hrhs i]] at h1
      have hexpand : ∀ i, (r i - 2 * ε * u i) ^ 2 =
          r i ^ 2 + (4 * u i ^ 2 * ε ^ 2 - 4 * (r i * u i) * ε) := by
        intro i; ring
      rw [show ∑ i, (r i - 2 * ε * u i) ^ 2 =
        ∑ i, r i ^ 2 + (4 * Cu * ε ^ 2 - 4 * (∑ i, r i * u i) * ε) from by
        conv_lhs => arg 2; ext i; rw [hexpand i]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        congr 1
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        congr 1
        · simp_rw [show ∀ x, 4 * u x ^ 2 * ε ^ 2 = (4 * ε ^ 2) * u x ^ 2 from fun x => by ring]
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; ring
        · simp_rw [show ∀ x, 4 * (r x * u x) * ε = (4 * ε) * (r x * u x) from fun x => by ring]
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; ring] at h1
      linarith
    
    have hSu_zero : ∑ i, r i * u i = 0 := by
      have hA_pos : 0 < 4 * Cu := by linarith
      have hquad' : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ (4 * Cu) * t ^ 2 + (-(4 * ∑ i, r i * u i)) * t := by
        intro t; have := hquad t; linarith
      have := linear_coeff_zero_of_quadratic_nonneg hA_pos hquad'
      linarith
    
    
    
    have hau : ∑ i, a i * u i = u l := by
      simp only [a, Pi.single_apply]
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]
    have hru_expand : ∑ i, r i * u i = u l - 2 * s₀ * Cu + 2 * t₀ * Cuv := by
      have : ∑ i, r i * u i = ∑ i, (a i * u i - 2 * s₀ * (u i ^ 2) + 2 * t₀ * (u i * v i)) := by
        congr 1; funext i; simp only [r]; ring
      rw [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hau]
    rw [hru_expand] at hSu_zero
    rw [hs₀, ht₀] at hSu_zero; linarith
  
  have foc_v : Cv > 0 → ∀ l, v l = 2 * (td.M h l).re * Cuv - 2 * (td.M h l).im * Cv := by
    intro hCv_pos l
    set a : Fin n → ℝ := Pi.single l 1
    have hs₀ : ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re = (td.M h l).re := by
      simp only [a, mulVec, dotProduct, toComplex, Pi.single_apply]
      simp only [apply_ite Complex.ofReal, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero,
        mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    have ht₀ : ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im = (td.M h l).im := by
      simp only [a, mulVec, dotProduct, toComplex, Pi.single_apply]
      simp only [apply_ite Complex.ofReal, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero,
        mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    set s₀ := ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).re
    set t₀ := ((td.M *ᵥ toComplex a) h).im
    set r := fun i => a i - 2 * s₀ * u i + 2 * t₀ * v i
    
    have hquad : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ 4 * Cv * ε ^ 2 + 4 * (∑ i, r i * v i) * ε := by
      intro ε
      have h1 := hopt_tube a s₀ (t₀ + ε)
      have hrhs : ∀ i, (a i - 2 * s₀ * u i + 2 * (t₀ + ε) * v i) =
          r i + 2 * ε * v i := by
        intro i; simp only [r]; ring
      rw [show ∑ i, (a i - 2 * s₀ * u i + 2 * (t₀ + ε) * v i) ^ 2 =
        ∑ i, (r i + 2 * ε * v i) ^ 2 from by congr 1; funext i; rw [hrhs i]] at h1
      have hexpand : ∀ i, (r i + 2 * ε * v i) ^ 2 =
          r i ^ 2 + (4 * v i ^ 2 * ε ^ 2 + 4 * (r i * v i) * ε) := by
        intro i; ring
      rw [show ∑ i, (r i + 2 * ε * v i) ^ 2 =
        ∑ i, r i ^ 2 + (4 * Cv * ε ^ 2 + 4 * (∑ i, r i * v i) * ε) from by
        conv_lhs => arg 2; ext i; rw [hexpand i]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        congr 1
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        congr 1
        · simp_rw [show ∀ x, 4 * v x ^ 2 * ε ^ 2 = (4 * ε ^ 2) * v x ^ 2 from fun x => by ring]
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; ring
        · simp_rw [show ∀ x, 4 * (r x * v x) * ε = (4 * ε) * (r x * v x) from fun x => by ring]
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; ring] at h1
      linarith
    have hSv_zero : ∑ i, r i * v i = 0 := by
      have hA_pos : 0 < 4 * Cv := by linarith
      have hquad' : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ (4 * Cv) * t ^ 2 + (4 * ∑ i, r i * v i) * t := by
        intro t; have := hquad t; linarith
      have := linear_coeff_zero_of_quadratic_nonneg hA_pos hquad'
      linarith
    have hav : ∑ i, a i * v i = v l := by
      simp only [a, Pi.single_apply]
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]
    
    have hrv_val : ∑ i, r i * v i = v l - 2 * s₀ * Cuv + 2 * t₀ * Cv := by
      have : ∑ i, r i * v i = ∑ i, (a i * v i - 2 * s₀ * (u i * v i) + 2 * t₀ * v i ^ 2) := by
        congr 1; funext i; simp only [r]; ring
      rw [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hav]
    rw [hrv_val] at hSv_zero
    rw [hs₀, ht₀] at hSv_zero; linarith
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hu_of_Cu_zero : Cu = 0 → ∀ i, u i = 0 := by
    intro hCu i
    have := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (u j)) |>.mp
      (le_antisymm (by linarith) hCu_nonneg) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
  have hv_of_Cv_zero : Cv = 0 → ∀ i, v i = 0 := by
    intro hCv i
    have := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (v j)) |>.mp
      (le_antisymm (by linarith) hCv_nonneg) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  refine ⟨⟨Cu - Cv, 2 * Cuv⟩, Cu + Cv, hCuCv_pos, ?_⟩
  intro l
  
  
  have hMh' : td.M h' l = starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) := hconj l
  
  set R := (td.M h l).re
  set I := (td.M h l).im
  
  have hMhl : td.M h l = ⟨R, I⟩ := Complex.eta (td.M h l)
  have hMh'l : td.M h' l = ⟨R, -I⟩ := by
    rw [hMh']; apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, R, I]
  
  have hLHS : td.M_inv l h = ⟨u l, v l⟩ := Complex.eta (td.M_inv l h)
  
  
  
  
  
  rw [hLHS, hMhl, hMh'l]
  apply Complex.ext
  · 
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    
    
    
    by_cases hCu : Cu = 0
    · 
      have hu0 := hu_of_Cu_zero hCu l
      have hCuv0 : Cuv = 0 := by
        have : ∀ i, u i = 0 := hu_of_Cu_zero hCu
        simp only [Cuv]; rw [show ∑ i, u i * v i = 0 from
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => by rw [this i, zero_mul])]
      simp [hu0, hCu, hCuv0]
    · 
      have hCu_pos : 0 < Cu := lt_of_le_of_ne hCu_nonneg (Ne.symm hCu)
      have := foc_u hCu_pos l
      
      simp; linarith
  · 
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    by_cases hCv : Cv = 0
    · 
      have hv0 := hv_of_Cv_zero hCv l
      have hCuv0 : Cuv = 0 := by
        have : ∀ i, v i = 0 := hv_of_Cv_zero hCv
        simp only [Cuv]; rw [show ∑ i, u i * v i = 0 from
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => by rw [this i, mul_zero])]
      simp [hv0, hCv, hCuv0]
    · 
      have hCv_pos : 0 < Cv := lt_of_le_of_ne hCv_nonneg (Ne.symm hCv)
      have := foc_v hCv_pos l
      
      simp; linarith

name: TubalTensor.svd_trunc_of_diag_2x2
statement:
private theorem svd_trunc_of_diag_2x2
    (a b : ℂ)
    (U S V : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hU : IsUnitary U) (hV : IsUnitary V) (hS : IsSVDDiagC S)
    (hSVD : U * S * Vᴴ = Matrix.diagonal ![a, b])
    (hab : Complex.normSq b < Complex.normSq a) :
    ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      (U * Matrix.diagonal (fun k : Fin 2 => if k = 0 then S 0 0 else 0) * Vᴴ) i j =
      Matrix.diagonal (![a, (0 : ℂ)]) i j
proof:
:= by
  
  have hS01 : S 0 1 = 0 := hS.1 0 1 (by decide)
  have hS10 : S 1 0 = 0 := hS.1 1 0 (by decide)
  have hS00_im : (S 0 0).im = 0 := (hS.2.1 0 0 rfl).1
  have hS00_nonneg : 0 ≤ (S 0 0).re := (hS.2.1 0 0 rfl).2
  have hS11_im : (S 1 1).im = 0 := (hS.2.1 1 1 rfl).1
  have hS11_nonneg : 0 ≤ (S 1 1).re := (hS.2.1 1 1 rfl).2
  have hS_ord : (S 1 1).re ≤ (S 0 0).re := hS.2.2 0 1 0 1 rfl rfl (by omega)
  
  
  have hSconj : Sᴴ = S := by
    ext p q; simp only [conjTranspose_apply]
    have hp : p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := by omega
    have hq : q = 0 ∨ q = 1 := by omega
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl
    · exact starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero hS00_im
    · simp [hS10, hS01]
    · simp [hS01, hS10]
    · exact starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero hS11_im
  
  
  have hVD_comm : V * (S * S) = ((Matrix.diagonal ![a, b])ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal ![a, b]) * V := by
    have hAHA_eq : V * (S * S) * Vᴴ = (Matrix.diagonal ![a, b])ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal ![a, b] := by
      have key : (U * S * Vᴴ)ᴴ * (U * S * Vᴴ) = V * (S * S) * Vᴴ := by
        have : (U * S * Vᴴ)ᴴ = V * Sᴴ * Uᴴ := by
          simp [conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [this, hSconj]
        rw [show V * S * Uᴴ * (U * S * Vᴴ) = V * S * (Uᴴ * U) * S * Vᴴ from by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]]
        rw [show Uᴴ * U = 1 from hU, Matrix.mul_one]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← key, hSVD]
    calc V * (S * S) = V * (S * S) * (Vᴴ * V) := by rw [hV, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = V * (S * S) * Vᴴ * V := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc (V * (S * S)) Vᴴ V]
      _ = _ := by rw [hAHA_eq]
  
  
  
  
  
  have hS_diag_eq : S = Matrix.diagonal ![S 0 0, S 1 1] := by
    ext p q
    have hp : p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := by omega
    have hq : q = 0 ∨ q = 1 := by omega
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [hS01, hS10,
        show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide]
  
  have hSS_eq : S * S =
      Matrix.diagonal ![S 0 0 * S 0 0, S 1 1 * S 1 1] := by
    rw [hS_diag_eq, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  
  have hDH_eq : (Matrix.diagonal ![a, b])ᴴ =
      Matrix.diagonal ![starRingEnd ℂ a, starRingEnd ℂ b] := by
    ext p q
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, starRingEnd_apply]
    by_cases hpq : p = q
    · subst hpq
      fin_cases p <;> simp
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hpq h.symm), if_neg hpq, star_zero]
  
  have hDHD_eq : (Matrix.diagonal ![a, b])ᴴ * Matrix.diagonal ![a, b] =
      Matrix.diagonal ![starRingEnd ℂ a * a, starRingEnd ℂ b * b] := by
    rw [hDH_eq, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  
  rw [hSS_eq, hDHD_eq] at hVD_comm
  
  
  have hentry_01 : V 0 1 * (S 1 1 * S 1 1) = starRingEnd ℂ a * a * V 0 1 := by
    have h := congr_fun₂ hVD_comm 0 1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, 
      show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, 
      if_true, if_false, 
      zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hentry_10 : V 1 0 * (S 0 0 * S 0 0) = starRingEnd ℂ b * b * V 1 0 := by
    have h := congr_fun₂ hVD_comm 1 0
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, 
      show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide,
      if_true, if_false, 
      zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hentry_00 : V 0 0 * (S 0 0 * S 0 0) = starRingEnd ℂ a * a * V 0 0 := by
    have h := congr_fun₂ hVD_comm 0 0
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, 
      show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide,
      if_true, if_false, 
      zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hentry_11 : V 1 1 * (S 1 1 * S 1 1) = starRingEnd ℂ b * b * V 1 1 := by
    have h := congr_fun₂ hVD_comm 1 1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, 
      show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide,
      if_true, if_false, 
      zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_add] at h
    exact h
  
  have hS00_cast : S 0 0 = ((S 0 0).re : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hS00_im]
  have hS11_cast : S 1 1 = ((S 1 1).re : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hS11_im]
  
  have hS00_sq : S 0 0 * S 0 0 = (((S 0 0).re * (S 0 0).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [Complex.mul_re, hS00_im]
    · simp [Complex.mul_im, hS00_im]
  have hS11_sq : S 1 1 * S 1 1 = (((S 1 1).re * (S 1 1).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [Complex.mul_re, hS11_im]
    · simp [Complex.mul_im, hS11_im]
  
  have hconj_a_sq : starRingEnd ℂ a * a = ((Complex.normSq a : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact Complex.mul_conj a
  have hconj_b_sq : starRingEnd ℂ b * b = ((Complex.normSq b : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact Complex.mul_conj b
  
  have hS_ord_sq : (S 1 1).re * (S 1 1).re ≤ (S 0 0).re * (S 0 0).re :=
    mul_self_le_mul_self hS11_nonneg hS_ord
  
  have hab_re : Complex.normSq b < Complex.normSq a := hab
  
  
  
  
  have hV01 : V 0 1 = 0 := by
    by_contra hV01_ne
    
    have h1 : S 1 1 * S 1 1 = starRingEnd ℂ a * a := by
      have : V 0 1 * (S 1 1 * S 1 1 - starRingEnd ℂ a * a) = 0 := by
        have := hentry_01
        linear_combination this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
      · exact absurd h hV01_ne
      · linear_combination h
    
    have h1_real : (S 1 1).re * (S 1 1).re = Complex.normSq a := by
      have := h1
      rw [hS11_sq, hconj_a_sq] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    
    have h2 : Complex.normSq b < (S 0 0).re * (S 0 0).re := by
      have h3 : Complex.normSq a ≤ (S 0 0).re * (S 0 0).re := by
        rw [← h1_real]; exact hS_ord_sq
      linarith
    
    have hS00_ne_b : S 0 0 * S 0 0 ≠ starRingEnd ℂ b * b := by
      intro heq
      rw [hS00_sq, hconj_b_sq] at heq
      have : (S 0 0).re * (S 0 0).re = Complex.normSq b := by exact_mod_cast heq
      linarith
    have hV10_zero : V 1 0 = 0 := by
      have hfact : V 1 0 * (S 0 0 * S 0 0 - starRingEnd ℂ b * b) = 0 := by
        have := hentry_10
        linear_combination this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfact with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso; apply hS00_ne_b; linear_combination h
    
    have hS11_ne_b : S 1 1 * S 1 1 ≠ starRingEnd ℂ b * b := by
      intro heq
      rw [hS11_sq, hconj_b_sq] at heq
      have : (S 1 1).re * (S 1 1).re = Complex.normSq b := by exact_mod_cast heq
      linarith [h1_real]
    have hV11_zero : V 1 1 = 0 := by
      have hfact : V 1 1 * (S 1 1 * S 1 1 - starRingEnd ℂ b * b) = 0 := by
        have := hentry_11
        linear_combination this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfact with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso; apply hS11_ne_b; linear_combination h
    
    have hVVH := hV.mul_conjTranspose_self
    have h11_VVH := congr_fun₂ hVVH 1 1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h11_VVH
    rw [hV10_zero, hV11_zero] at h11_VVH
    simp at h11_VVH
  
  
  
  have hV10 : V 1 0 = 0 := by
    by_contra hV10_ne
    have h1 : S 0 0 * S 0 0 = starRingEnd ℂ b * b := by
      have : V 1 0 * (S 0 0 * S 0 0 - starRingEnd ℂ b * b) = 0 := by
        have := hentry_10
        linear_combination this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
      · exact absurd h hV10_ne
      · linear_combination h
    have h1_real : (S 0 0).re * (S 0 0).re = Complex.normSq b := by
      have := h1
      rw [hS00_sq, hconj_b_sq] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    
    have h2 : (S 1 1).re * (S 1 1).re < Complex.normSq a := by
      have h3 : (S 1 1).re * (S 1 1).re ≤ Complex.normSq b := by
        rw [← h1_real]; exact hS_ord_sq
      linarith
    have hS11_ne_a : S 1 1 * S 1 1 ≠ starRingEnd ℂ a * a := by
      intro heq
      rw [hS11_sq, hconj_a_sq] at heq
      have : (S 1 1).re * (S 1 1).re = Complex.normSq a := by exact_mod_cast heq
      linarith
    have hV01_zero : V 0 1 = 0 := by
      have hfact : V 0 1 * (S 1 1 * S 1 1 - starRingEnd ℂ a * a) = 0 := by
        have := hentry_01
        linear_combination this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfact with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso; apply hS11_ne_a; linear_combination h
    have hS00_ne_a : S 0 0 * S 0 0 ≠ starRingEnd ℂ a * a := by
      intro heq
      rw [hS00_sq, hconj_a_sq] at heq
      have : (S 0 0).re * (S 0 0).re = Complex.normSq a := by exact_mod_cast heq
      linarith [h1_real]
    have hV00_zero : V 0 0 = 0 := by
      have hfact : V 0 0 * (S 0 0 * S 0 0 - starRingEnd ℂ a * a) = 0 := by
        have := hentry_00
        linear_combination this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfact with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso; apply hS00_ne_a; linear_combination h
    
    have hVVH := hV.mul_conjTranspose_self
    have h00_VVH := congr_fun₂ hVVH 0 0
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h00_VVH
    rw [hV00_zero, hV01_zero] at h00_VVH
    simp at h00_VVH
  
  
  
  
  have hS00_ne : S 0 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hS00_zero
    have hS00_re_zero : (S 0 0).re = 0 := by
      rw [hS00_zero]; rfl
    have hS11_re_zero : (S 1 1).re = 0 := le_antisymm
      (hS_ord.trans_eq hS00_re_zero) hS11_nonneg
    have hS_zero : S = 0 := by
      ext p q
      fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q
      · exact hS00_zero
      · exact hS01
      · exact hS10
      · apply Complex.ext
        · exact hS11_re_zero
        · exact hS11_im
    
    have hzero : (0 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal ![a, b] := by
      rw [← hSVD, hS_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]
    have ha_zero : a = 0 := by
      have := congr_fun₂ hzero 0 0
      simp at this
      exact this.symm
    
    have ha_normSq_pos : 0 < Complex.normSq a := by
      have hb_nn : 0 ≤ Complex.normSq b := Complex.normSq_nonneg b
      linarith
    rw [ha_zero] at ha_normSq_pos
    simp at ha_normSq_pos
  
  
  
  have hU10 : U 1 0 = 0 := by
    
    have hUS : U * S = Matrix.diagonal ![a, b] * V := by
      have h : U * S * Vᴴ * V = Matrix.diagonal ![a, b] * V := by rw [hSVD]
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc (U * S) Vᴴ V, hV.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one] at h
      exact h
    
    have hUS_10 : (U * S) 1 0 = U 1 0 * S 0 0 := by
      rw [hS_diag_eq]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, 
        show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide,
        if_true, if_false, mul_zero, add_zero]
    
    have hDV_10 : (Matrix.diagonal ![a, b] * V) 1 0 = 0 := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, 
        show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide,
        if_true, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
      rw [hV10, mul_zero]
    
    have h : U 1 0 * S 0 0 = 0 := by
      rw [← hUS_10, hUS, hDV_10]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hS00_ne
  
  intro i j
  have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
  have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hSVD_expand : ∀ i' j' : Fin 2,
      (U * S * Vᴴ) i' j' = (Matrix.diagonal ![a, b]) i' j' := congr_fun₂ hSVD
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hS_diag_eq : Matrix.diagonal (fun k : Fin 2 => if k = 0 then S 0 0 else 0) =
      S - Matrix.diagonal (fun k : Fin 2 => if k = 1 then S 1 1 else 0) := by
    ext p q
    have hp : p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := by omega
    have hq : q = 0 ∨ q = 1 := by omega
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.sub_apply]
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl
    · simp [show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide]
    · simp [show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, hS01]
    · simp [show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide, hS10]
    · simp [show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide]
  rw [hS_diag_eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
  
  
  
  rw [hSVD]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply]
  rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
  · 
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, if_true,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, conjTranspose_apply, 
      show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide,
      if_false]
    simp [hV01]
  · 
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, if_false,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, conjTranspose_apply, 
      show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide,
      if_true]
    
    simp [hV10]
    
    
    have h01 := congr_fun₂ hSVD 0 1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, conjTranspose_apply, 
      Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, 
      show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, if_false,
      hS01, hS10, hV10, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add,
      star_zero] at h01
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h01 with h1 | h1
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h2 | h2
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h2)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h2)
    · exact Or.inr (star_eq_zero.mp h1)
  · 
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide, if_false,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, conjTranspose_apply, 
      show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide,
      if_true]
    simp [hV01]
  · 
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.cons_val_one, if_true,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, conjTranspose_apply, 
      show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide,
      if_false]
    
    have h11 := congr_fun₂ hSVD 1 1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, conjTranspose_apply, 
      Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.cons_val_one, if_true,
      
      ] at h11
    simp only [hS01, hS10, hV10, hU10, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, star_zero] at h11 ⊢
    
    
    rw [h11, sub_self]

name: TubalTensor.lemma_B5_lt
statement:
private theorem lemma_B5_lt {n : ℕ} {td : TubalData n} (_hn : 0 < n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B))
    (Cu Cv : ℝ)
    (hCu : Cu = ∑ l : Fin n, (td.M_inv l h).re ^ 2)
    (hCv : Cv = ∑ l : Fin n, (td.M_inv l h).im ^ 2) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y < 1 → y ^ 2 * Cv ≤ Cu
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy_pos hy_lt
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  set u := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).re
  set v := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).im
  
  
  set bvec₁ : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => 2 * 1 * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * 0 * (td.M_inv i h).im
  set bvec₂ : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => 2 * 0 * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * y * (td.M_inv i h).im
  
  have hbvec₁_eq : ∀ k, bvec₁ k = 2 * u k := fun k => by
    simp only [bvec₁, u]; ring
  have hbvec₂_eq : ∀ k, bvec₂ k = -2 * y * v k := fun k => by
    simp only [bvec₂, v]; ring
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  set A₂ : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (0 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (0 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₁
    else if i = (1 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (1 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₂
    else 0
  
  have hA₂_00 : A₂ 0 0 = KM.ofFun bvec₁ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hA₂_01 : A₂ 0 1 = 0 := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have : ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    have : ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 1 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 1) := by decide
    simp [*]
  have hA₂_10 : A₂ 1 0 = 0 := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (0 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    have : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 1 ∧ (0 : Fin 2) = 1) := by decide
    simp [*]
  have hA₂_11 : A₂ 1 1 = KM.ofFun bvec₂ := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have h1 : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    rw [if_neg h1, if_pos ⟨trivial, trivial⟩]
  
  set Bc : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (1 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (1 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₂ else 0
  have hBc_00 : Bc 0 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBc_01 : Bc 0 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBc_10 : Bc 1 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBc_11 : Bc 1 1 = KM.ofFun bvec₂ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  
  set Bk0 : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (0 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (0 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₁ else 0
  have hBk0_00 : Bk0 0 0 = KM.ofFun bvec₁ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hBk0_01 : Bk0 0 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBk0_10 : Bk0 1 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBk0_11 : Bk0 1 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  
  set r₂ : Fin n → ℕ := fun sl => if sl = h ∨ sl = h' then 1 else 0
  have hr₂ : RespectsConjPairing td r₂ := conj_pair_multirank_valid td h h' hh'_ne hconj
  
  have hBc_mr : HasStarMMultirankAtMost Bc r₂ := by
    
    
    intro k'
    simp only [starMMultirank]
    
    
    
    have hBc_rank_le : ∀ k', (transform Bc k').rank ≤ 1 := by
      intro k'
      
      have hBc_eq : transform Bc k' = Matrix.vecMulVec
          (fun i => transform Bc k' i 1) (fun j => if j = (1 : Fin 2) then 1 else 0) := by
        ext i j
        simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec, Matrix.of_apply]
        have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
        rcases hj with rfl | rfl
        · 
          
          simp only [show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, ite_false, mul_zero]
          
          simp only [transform_apply]
          
          have : Bc i 0 = 0 := by
            have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
            rcases hi with rfl | rfl
            · exact hBc_00
            · exact hBc_10
          rw [this, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero,
            show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _, Pi.zero_apply]
        · 
          simp
      rw [hBc_eq]
      exact Matrix.rank_vecMulVec_le _ _
    by_cases hkh : k' = h
    · rw [hkh]
      have : r₂ h = 1 := if_pos (Or.inl rfl)
      rw [this]; exact hBc_rank_le h
    · by_cases hkh' : k' = h'
      · rw [hkh']
        have : r₂ h' = 1 := if_pos (Or.inr rfl)
        rw [this]; exact hBc_rank_le h'
      · 
        simp only [show ¬(k' = h ∨ k' = h') from fun ho => ho.elim hkh hkh', ite_false, r₂]
        suffices hzero : transform Bc k' = 0 by rw [hzero]; simp
        ext i j
        simp only [transform_apply]
        
        have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
        have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
        rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
        · 
          rw [show Bc 0 0 = (0 : KM n td) from hBc_00]
          rw [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero, show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _]
          simp
        ·

      have hS_trunc_zero : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) sl = 0 := by
        rw [congr_fun hTruncS_transform sl, hF₂_zero]

        · 
          rw [hBk0_transform_00, congr_fun hbvec₁_tr sl]
          simp [hslh.1, hslh.2]
        · exact hBk0_transform_other sl 0 1 (by decide)
        · exact hBk0_transform_other sl 1 0 (by decide)

  have hLHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A₂ - tsvdTruncMulti (TSVD.of A₂) r₂ hr₂) = 4 * y ^ 2 * Cv := by
    rw [htrunc_eq]
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq]

      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 0 - Bk0 0 0) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_00, hBk0_00, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h01 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 0 1) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 1 - Bk0 0 1) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_01, hBk0_01, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h10 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 1 0) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 0 - Bk0 1 0) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_10, hBk0_10, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h11 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 1 1) k = -2 * y * v k := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 1 - Bk0 1 1) k = -2 * y * v k

  have hRHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A₂ - Bc) = 4 * Cu := by
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq]
    have h00 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 0 0) k = 2 * u k := by

    show ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin n, (KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) i j) k) ^ 2 = 4 * Cu

    conv_lhs => arg 2; ext k; rw [show (2 * u k) ^ 2 = 4 * (u k) ^ 2 from by ring]

name: TubalTensor.lemma_B5_gt
statement:
private theorem lemma_B5_gt {n : ℕ} {td : TubalData n} (_hn : 0 < n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B))
    (Cu Cv : ℝ)
    (hCu : Cu = ∑ l : Fin n, (td.M_inv l h).re ^ 2)
    (hCv : Cv = ∑ l : Fin n, (td.M_inv l h).im ^ 2) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, 1 < y → Cu ≤ y ^ 2 * Cv
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy_gt
  have hy_pos : 0 < y := lt_trans zero_lt_one hy_gt
  
  
  set u := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).re
  set v := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).im
  set bvec₁ : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => 2 * 1 * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * 0 * (td.M_inv i h).im
  set bvec₂ : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => 2 * 0 * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * y * (td.M_inv i h).im
  have hbvec₁_eq : ∀ k, bvec₁ k = 2 * u k := fun k => by
    simp only [bvec₁, u]; ring
  have hbvec₂_eq : ∀ k, bvec₂ k = -2 * y * v k := fun k => by
    simp only [bvec₂, v]; ring
  
  
  set A₂ : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (0 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (0 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₂
    else if i = (1 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (1 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₁
    else 0
  have hA₂_00 : A₂ 0 0 = KM.ofFun bvec₂ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hA₂_01 : A₂ 0 1 = 0 := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have : ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    have : ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 1 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 1) := by decide
    simp [*]
  have hA₂_10 : A₂ 1 0 = 0 := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (0 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    have : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 1 ∧ (0 : Fin 2) = 1) := by decide
    simp [*]
  have hA₂_11 : A₂ 1 1 = KM.ofFun bvec₁ := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have h1 : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    rw [if_neg h1, if_pos ⟨trivial, trivial⟩]
  
  set Bc : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (1 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (1 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₁ else 0
  have hBc_00 : Bc 0 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBc_01 : Bc 0 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBc_10 : Bc 1 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBc_11 : Bc 1 1 = KM.ofFun bvec₁ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  
  set Bk0 : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (0 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (0 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₂ else 0
  have hBk0_00 : Bk0 0 0 = KM.ofFun bvec₂ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hBk0_01 : Bk0 0 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBk0_10 : Bk0 1 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBk0_11 : Bk0 1 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  set r₂ : Fin n → ℕ := fun sl => if sl = h ∨ sl = h' then 1 else 0
  have hr₂ : RespectsConjPairing td r₂ := conj_pair_multirank_valid td h h' hh'_ne hconj
  
  have hBc_mr : HasStarMMultirankAtMost Bc r₂ := by
    intro k'
    simp only [starMMultirank]
    have hBc_rank_le : ∀ k', (transform Bc k').rank ≤ 1 := by
      intro k'
      have hBc_eq : transform Bc k' = Matrix.vecMulVec
          (fun i => transform Bc k' i 1) (fun j => if j = (1 : Fin 2) then 1 else 0) := by
        ext i j
        simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec, Matrix.of_apply]
        have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
        rcases hj with rfl | rfl
        · simp only [show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, ite_false, mul_zero]
          simp only [transform_apply]
          have : Bc i 0 = 0 := by
            have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
            rcases hi with rfl | rfl
            · exact hBc_00
            · exact hBc_10
          rw [this, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero,
            show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _, Pi.zero_apply]
        · simp
      rw [hBc_eq]
      exact Matrix.rank_vecMulVec_le _ _
    by_cases hkh : k' = h
    · rw [hkh]
      have : r₂ h = 1 := if_pos (Or.inl rfl)
      rw [this]; exact hBc_rank_le h
    · by_cases hkh' : k' = h'
      · rw [hkh']
        have : r₂ h' = 1 := if_pos (Or.inr rfl)
        rw [this]; exact hBc_rank_le h'
      · simp only [show ¬(k' = h ∨ k' = h') from fun ho => ho.elim hkh hkh', ite_false, r₂]
        suffices hzero : transform Bc k' = 0 by rw [hzero]; simp
        ext i j
        simp only [transform_apply]
        have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
        have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
        rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
        · rw [show Bc 0 0 = (0 : KM n td) from hBc_00]
          rw [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero, show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _]
          simp
        · rw [show Bc 0 1 = (0 : KM n td) from hBc_01]
          rw [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero, show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _]
          simp
        · rw [show Bc 1 0 = (0 : KM n td) from hBc_10]
          rw [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero, show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _]
          simp
        · 
          rw [show Bc 1 1 = KM.ofFun bvec₁ from hBc_11, KM.toFun_ofFun]
          have := congr_fun (conj_pair_transform_bvec td h h' hh'_ne hconj 1 0) k'
          simp only [bvec₁] at this ⊢
          rw [this]; simp [hkh, hkh']
  
  have htrunc_eq : tsvdTruncMulti (TSVD.of A₂) r₂ hr₂ = Bk0 := by
    set svd₂ := TSVD.of A₂
    have hA₂_transform_00 : ∀ sl, transform A₂ sl 0 0 =
        td.applyM (toComplex bvec₂) sl := by
      intro sl; simp only [transform_apply, hA₂_00, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    have hA₂_transform_01 : ∀ sl, transform A₂ sl 0 1 = 0 := by
      intro sl; simp only [transform_apply, hA₂_01, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
      exact congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_zero _) sl
    have hA₂_transform_10 : ∀ sl, transform A₂ sl 1 0 = 0 := by
      intro sl; simp only [transform_apply, hA₂_10, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
      exact congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_zero _) sl
    have hA₂_transform_11 : ∀ sl, transform A₂ sl 1 1 =
        td.applyM (toComplex bvec₁) sl := by
      intro sl; simp only [transform_apply, hA₂_11, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    have hbvec₁_tr := conj_pair_transform_bvec td h h' hh'_ne hconj 1 0
    have hbvec₂_tr := conj_pair_transform_bvec td h h' hh'_ne hconj 0 y
    
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective invTransform_transform)
    funext sl i j
    have htrunc_transform : ∀ sl', transform (tsvdTruncMulti svd₂ r₂ hr₂) sl' =
        transform svd₂.U sl' * transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) sl' *
        (transform svd₂.V sl')ᴴ := by
      intro sl'
      unfold tsvdTruncMulti
      have hmul1 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff
        (svd₂.U * tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) svd₂.Vᴴ _).mp rfl) sl'
      have hmul2 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff svd₂.U
        (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) _).mp rfl) sl'
      simp only [facewise_apply] at hmul1 hmul2
      rw [hmul1, Matrix.mul_assoc, hmul2, congr_fun (transform_conjTranspose svd₂.V) sl',
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hBk0_transform_00 : ∀ sl', transform Bk0 sl' 0 0 =
        td.applyM (toComplex bvec₂) sl' := by
      intro sl'; simp only [transform_apply, hBk0_00, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    have hBk0_transform_other : ∀ sl' (i' j' : Fin 2), ¬(i' = 0 ∧ j' = 0) →
        transform Bk0 sl' i' j' = 0 := by
      intro sl' i' j' hne
      simp only [transform_apply]
      have : Bk0 i' j' = 0 := by
        have hi' : i' = 0 ∨ i' = 1 := by omega
        have hj' : j' = 0 ∨ j' = 1 := by omega
        rcases hi' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj' with rfl | rfl
        · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hne
        · exact hBk0_01
        · exact hBk0_10
        · exact hBk0_11
      rw [this, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
      exact congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_zero _) sl'
    by_cases hslh : sl = h ∨ sl = h'
    · 
      set F₂' : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun sl' i' j' =>
        if (i' : ℕ) < r₂ sl' ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl' i' j' else 0
      have hF₂'_paired : ∀ (a' : Fin 2) (b' : Fin 2),
          HasRealPairedStructure td (fun sl' => F₂' sl' a' b') := by
        intro a' b'
        have hS_ps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (svd₂.S a' b'))
        constructor
        · intro sl' hreal
          show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl' ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl' a' b' else 0).im = 0
          split_ifs with hif
          · exact hS_ps.1 sl' hreal
          · rfl
        · intro sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
          show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl2 a' b' else 0) =
            starRingEnd ℂ (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl1 a' b' else 0)
          have hrr : r₂ sl1 = r₂ sl2 := hr₂ sl1 sl2 (Ne.symm hne) hconj_sl
          by_cases hif : (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)
          · rw [if_pos hif, if_pos ⟨hrr ▸ hif.1, hif.2⟩]
            exact hS_ps.2 sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
          · have hif' : ¬((a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)) := by rw [← hrr]; exact hif
            rw [if_neg hif, if_neg hif', map_zero]
      have hF₂'_rt : transform (invTransform F₂' : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td) = F₂' :=
        transform_invTransform F₂'
          (fun a' b' => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hF₂'_paired a' b'))
      have hTruncS_transform' : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) = F₂' := by
        show transform (invTransform F₂' : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td) = F₂'
        exact hF₂'_rt
      have hF₂'_active : ∀ sl', sl' = h ∨ sl' = h' →
          F₂' sl' = Matrix.diagonal (fun (k : Fin 2) =>
            if k = 0 then transform svd₂.S sl' 0 0 else 0) := by
        intro sl' hsl'
        ext i' j'
        have hi' : i' = 0 ∨ i' = 1 := by omega
        have hj' : j' = 0 ∨ j' = 1 := by omega
        simp only [Matrix.diagonal]
        rcases hi' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj' with rfl | rfl
        · show (if (0 : Fin 2).val < r₂ sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 2).val = (0 : Fin 2).val then _ else 0) = _
          rw [if_pos ⟨by simp [r₂, hsl'], rfl⟩]
          simp [Matrix.of_apply]
        · show (if (0 : Fin 2).val < r₂ sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 2).val = (1 : Fin 2).val then _ else 0) = _
          rw [if_neg (fun ⟨_, h⟩ => absurd h (by decide))]
          simp [Matrix.of_apply, show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide]
        · show (if (1 : Fin 2).val < r₂ sl' ∧ (1 : Fin 2).val = (0 : Fin 2).val then _ else 0) = _
          rw [if_neg (fun ⟨_, h⟩ => absurd h (by decide))]
          simp [Matrix.of_apply, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide]
        · show (if (1 : Fin 2).val < r₂ sl' ∧ (1 : Fin 2).val = (1 : Fin 2).val then _ else 0) = _
          rw [if_neg (fun ⟨h1, _⟩ => by simp [r₂, hsl'] at h1)]
          simp [Matrix.of_apply]
      rw [congr_fun₂ (htrunc_transform sl) i j]
      rw [congr_fun hTruncS_transform' sl]
      rw [hF₂'_active sl hslh]
      set a_sl := transform A₂ sl 0 0
      set b_sl := transform A₂ sl 1 1
      have hA₂_diag : transform A₂ sl = Matrix.diagonal ![a_sl, b_sl] := by
        ext p q
        have hp : p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := by omega
        have hq : q = 0 ∨ q = 1 := by omega
        rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl <;>
          simp_all [Matrix.diagonal, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
            Matrix.cons_val_one, a_sl, b_sl,
            ]
      have hSVD_sl : transform svd₂.U sl * transform svd₂.S sl * (transform svd₂.V sl)ᴴ =
          Matrix.diagonal ![a_sl, b_sl] := by
        rw [← hA₂_diag]; exact (svd₂.hSlice sl).symm
      
      
      have hab_sl : Complex.normSq b_sl < Complex.normSq a_sl := by
        have ha_normSq : Complex.normSq a_sl = y ^ 2 := by
          show Complex.normSq (transform A₂ sl 0 0) = y ^ 2
          rw [hA₂_transform_00, congr_fun hbvec₂_tr sl]
          rcases hslh with rfl | rfl
          · rw [if_pos rfl]
            simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
              Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
            ring
          · rw [if_neg hh'_ne, if_pos rfl]
            simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
              Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
            ring
        have hb_eq : b_sl = 1 := by
          show transform A₂ sl 1 1 = 1
          rw [hA₂_transform_11, congr_fun hbvec₁_tr sl]
          rcases hslh with rfl | rfl
          · rw [if_pos rfl]; push_cast; ring
          · rw [if_neg hh'_ne, if_pos rfl]; push_cast; ring
        rw [ha_normSq, hb_eq, Complex.normSq_one]
        nlinarith [hy_gt, hy_pos]
      have h_trunc := svd_trunc_of_diag_2x2 a_sl b_sl
        (transform svd₂.U sl) (transform svd₂.S sl) (transform svd₂.V sl)
        (svd₂.hU_slice sl) (svd₂.hV_slice sl) (svd₂.hS_svdDiag sl)
        hSVD_sl hab_sl i j
      rw [h_trunc]
      have ha_sl_eq : a_sl = transform Bk0 sl 0 0 := by
        simp only [a_sl, hA₂_transform_00, hBk0_transform_00]
      have hBk0_eq_diag : transform Bk0 sl = Matrix.diagonal ![a_sl, 0] := by
        ext p q
        have hp : p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := by omega
        have hq : q = 0 ∨ q = 1 := by omega
        rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl <;>
          simp_all [Matrix.diagonal, 
            
            
            ]
      rw [← hBk0_eq_diag]
    · 
      push Not at hslh
      rw [congr_fun₂ (htrunc_transform sl) i j]
      have hr₂_sl : r₂ sl = 0 := if_neg (by push Not; exact hslh)
      set F₂ : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun sl' i' j' =>
        if (i' : ℕ) < r₂ sl' ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl' i' j' else 0
      have hF₂_paired : ∀ (a' : Fin 2) (b' : Fin 2),
          HasRealPairedStructure td (fun sl' => F₂ sl' a' b') := by
        intro a' b'
        have hS_ps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (svd₂.S a' b'))
        constructor
        · intro sl' hreal
          show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl' ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl' a' b' else 0).im = 0
          split_ifs with hif
          · exact hS_ps.1 sl' hreal
          · rfl
        · intro sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
          show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl2 a' b' else 0) =
            starRingEnd ℂ (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl1 a' b' else 0)
          have hrr : r₂ sl1 = r₂ sl2 := hr₂ sl1 sl2 (Ne.symm hne) hconj_sl
          by_cases hif : (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)
          · rw [if_pos hif, if_pos ⟨hrr ▸ hif.1, hif.2⟩]
            exact hS_ps.2 sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
          · have hif' : ¬((a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)) := by rw [← hrr]; exact hif
            rw [if_neg hif, if_neg hif', map_zero]
      have hF₂_rt : transform (invTransform F₂ : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td) = F₂ :=
        transform_invTransform F₂
          (fun a' b' => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hF₂_paired a' b'))
      have hTruncS_eq : tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂ = invTransform F₂ := rfl
      have hTruncS_transform : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) = F₂ := by
        rw [hTruncS_eq]; exact hF₂_rt
      have hF₂_zero : F₂ sl = 0 := by
        ext i' j'
        show (if (i' : ℕ) < r₂ sl ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then _ else 0) = 0
        rw [if_neg]; intro ⟨h1, _⟩; rw [hr₂_sl] at h1; exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ h1
      have hS_trunc_zero : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) sl = 0 := by
        rw [congr_fun hTruncS_transform sl, hF₂_zero]
      rw [hS_trunc_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]
      have hBk0_sl : transform Bk0 sl i j = 0 := by
        have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
        have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
        rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
        · 
          rw [hBk0_transform_00, congr_fun hbvec₂_tr sl]
          simp [hslh.1, hslh.2]
        · exact hBk0_transform_other sl 0 1 (by decide)
        · exact hBk0_transform_other sl 1 0 (by decide)
        · exact hBk0_transform_other sl 1 1 (by decide)
      rw [hBk0_sl]; simp [Matrix.zero_apply]
  
  have hLHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A₂ - tsvdTruncMulti (TSVD.of A₂) r₂ hr₂) = 4 * Cu := by
    rw [htrunc_eq]
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq]
    have h00 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 0 0) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 0 - Bk0 0 0) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_00, hBk0_00, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h01 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 0 1) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 1 - Bk0 0 1) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_01, hBk0_01, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h10 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 1 0) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 0 - Bk0 1 0) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_10, hBk0_10, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h11 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 1 1) k = 2 * u k := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 1 - Bk0 1 1) k = 2 * u k
      rw [hA₂_11, hBk0_11, sub_zero, KM.toFun_ofFun, hbvec₁_eq]
    show ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin n, (KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) i j) k) ^ 2 =
      4 * Cu
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, h00, h01, h10, h11]
    simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    conv_lhs => arg 2; ext k; rw [show (2 * u k) ^ 2 = 4 * (u k) ^ 2 from by ring]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hCu]
  
  have hRHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A₂ - Bc) = 4 * y ^ 2 * Cv := by
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq]
    have h00 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 0 0) k = -2 * y * v k := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 0 - Bc 0 0) k = -2 * y * v k
      rw [hA₂_00, hBc_00, sub_zero, KM.toFun_ofFun, hbvec₂_eq]
    have h01 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 0 1) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 1 - Bc 0 1) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_01, hBc_01, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h10 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 1 0) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 0 - Bc 1 0) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_10, hBc_10, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h11 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 1 1) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 1 - Bc 1 1) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_11, hBc_11, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    show ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin n, (KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) i j) k) ^ 2 = 4 * y ^ 2 * Cv
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, h00, h01, h10, h11]
    simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    conv_lhs => arg 2; ext k; rw [show (-2 * y * v k) ^ 2 = 4 * y ^ 2 * (v k) ^ 2 from by ring]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hCv]
  
  have hineq := hopt 2 2 A₂ (TSVD.of A₂) Bc r₂ hr₂ hBc_mr
  rw [hLHS, hRHS] at hineq
  linarith

name: TubalTensor.tube_ey_2x2_ineq
statement:
private theorem tube_ey_2x2_ineq {n : ℕ} {td : TubalData n} (_hn : 0 < n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B))
    (s₁ t₁ s₂ t₂ : ℝ)
    (hnorm : s₂ ^ 2 + t₂ ^ 2 < s₁ ^ 2 + t₁ ^ 2) :
    ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * s₂ * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * t₂ * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2 ≤
    ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * s₁ * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * t₁ * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  set bvec₁ : Fin n → ℝ :=
    fun i => 2 * s₁ * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * t₁ * (td.M_inv i h).im
  set bvec₂ : Fin n → ℝ :=
    fun i => 2 * s₂ * (td.M_inv i h).re - 2 * t₂ * (td.M_inv i h).im
  
  set A₂ : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (0 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (0 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₁
    else if i = (1 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (1 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₂
    else 0
  have hA₂_00 : A₂ 0 0 = KM.ofFun bvec₁ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hA₂_01 : A₂ 0 1 = 0 := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have : ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    have : ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 1 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 1) := by decide
    simp [*]
  have hA₂_10 : A₂ 1 0 = 0 := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (0 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    have : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 1 ∧ (0 : Fin 2) = 1) := by decide
    simp [*]
  have hA₂_11 : A₂ 1 1 = KM.ofFun bvec₂ := by
    simp only [A₂]
    have h1 : ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (1 : Fin 2) = 0) := by decide
    rw [if_neg h1, if_pos ⟨trivial, trivial⟩]
  
  set Bc : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (1 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (1 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₂ else 0
  have hBc_00 : Bc 0 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBc_01 : Bc 0 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBc_10 : Bc 1 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
