  have hBc_11 : Bc 1 1 = KM.ofFun bvec₂ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  
  set Bk0 : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td := fun i j =>
    if i = (0 : Fin 2) ∧ j = (0 : Fin 2) then KM.ofFun bvec₁ else 0
  have hBk0_00 : Bk0 0 0 = KM.ofFun bvec₁ := if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hBk0_01 : Bk0 0 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBk0_10 : Bk0 1 0 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have hBk0_11 : Bk0 1 1 = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  set r₂ : Fin n → ℕ := fun sl => if sl = h ∨ sl = h' then 1 else 0
  have hr₂ : RespectsConjPairing td r₂ := conj_pair_multirank_valid td h h' hh'_ne hconj
  have hBc_mr : HasStarMMultirankAtMost Bc r₂ := by
    intro k'
    simp only [starMMultirank]
    have hBc_rank_le : ∀ k', (transform Bc k').rank ≤ 1 := by
      intro k'
      have hBc_eq : transform Bc k' = Matrix.vecMulVec
          (fun i => transform Bc k' i 1) (fun j => if j = (1 : Fin 2) then 1 else 0) := by
        ext i j
        simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec, Matrix.of_apply]
        have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
        rcases hj with rfl | rfl
        · simp only [show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide, ite_false, mul_zero]
          simp only [transform_apply]
          have : Bc i 0 = 0 := by
            have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
            rcases hi with rfl | rfl
            · exact hBc_00
            · exact hBc_10
          rw [this, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero,
            show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _, Pi.zero_apply]
        · simp
      rw [hBc_eq]
      exact Matrix.rank_vecMulVec_le _ _
    by_cases hkh : k' = h
    · rw [hkh]
      have : r₂ h = 1 := if_pos (Or.inl rfl)
      rw [this]; exact hBc_rank_le h
    · by_cases hkh' : k' = h'
      · rw [hkh']
        have : r₂ h' = 1 := if_pos (Or.inr rfl)
        rw [this]; exact hBc_rank_le h'
      · simp only [show ¬(k' = h ∨ k' = h') from fun ho => ho.elim hkh hkh', ite_false, r₂]
        suffices hzero : transform Bc k' = 0 by rw [hzero]; simp
        ext i j
        simp only [transform_apply]
        have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
        have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
        rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
        · rw [show Bc 0 0 = (0 : KM n td) from hBc_00]
          rw [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero, show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _]
          simp
        · rw [show Bc 0 1 = (0 : KM n td) from hBc_01]
          rw [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero, show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _]
          simp
        · rw [show Bc 1 0 = (0 : KM n td) from hBc_10]
          rw [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero, show td.applyM 0 = 0 from Matrix.mulVec_zero _]
          simp
        · rw [show Bc 1 1 = KM.ofFun bvec₂ from hBc_11, KM.toFun_ofFun]
          have := congr_fun (conj_pair_transform_bvec td h h' hh'_ne hconj s₂ t₂) k'
          simp only [bvec₂] at this ⊢
          rw [this]; simp [hkh, hkh']
  have htrunc_eq : tsvdTruncMulti (TSVD.of A₂) r₂ hr₂ = Bk0 := by
    set svd₂ := TSVD.of A₂
    have hA₂_transform_00 : ∀ sl, transform A₂ sl 0 0 =
        td.applyM (toComplex bvec₁) sl := by
      intro sl; simp only [transform_apply, hA₂_00, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    have hA₂_transform_01 : ∀ sl, transform A₂ sl 0 1 = 0 := by
      intro sl; simp only [transform_apply, hA₂_01, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
      exact congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_zero _) sl
    have hA₂_transform_10 : ∀ sl, transform A₂ sl 1 0 = 0 := by
      intro sl; simp only [transform_apply, hA₂_10, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
      exact congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_zero _) sl
    have hA₂_transform_11 : ∀ sl, transform A₂ sl 1 1 =
        td.applyM (toComplex bvec₂) sl := by
      intro sl; simp only [transform_apply, hA₂_11, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    have hbvec₁_tr := conj_pair_transform_bvec td h h' hh'_ne hconj s₁ t₁
    have hbvec₂_tr := conj_pair_transform_bvec td h h' hh'_ne hconj s₂ t₂
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective invTransform_transform)
    funext sl i j
    have htrunc_transform : ∀ sl', transform (tsvdTruncMulti svd₂ r₂ hr₂) sl' =
        transform svd₂.U sl' * transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) sl' *
        (transform svd₂.V sl')ᴴ := by
      intro sl'
      unfold tsvdTruncMulti
      have hmul1 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff
        (svd₂.U * tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) svd₂.Vᴴ _).mp rfl) sl'
      have hmul2 := congr_fun ((transform_eq_facewise_iff svd₂.U
        (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) _).mp rfl) sl'
      simp only [facewise_apply] at hmul1 hmul2
      rw [hmul1, Matrix.mul_assoc, hmul2, congr_fun (transform_conjTranspose svd₂.V) sl',
        ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hBk0_transform_00 : ∀ sl', transform Bk0 sl' 0 0 =
        td.applyM (toComplex bvec₁) sl' := by
      intro sl'; simp only [transform_apply, hBk0_00, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    have hBk0_transform_other : ∀ sl' (i' j' : Fin 2), ¬(i' = 0 ∧ j' = 0) →
        transform Bk0 sl' i' j' = 0 := by
      intro sl' i' j' hne
      simp only [transform_apply]
      have : Bk0 i' j' = 0 := by
        have hi' : i' = 0 ∨ i' = 1 := by omega
        have hj' : j' = 0 ∨ j' = 1 := by omega
        rcases hi' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj' with rfl | rfl
        · exact absurd ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ hne
        · exact hBk0_01
        · exact hBk0_10
        · exact hBk0_11
      rw [this, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
      exact congr_fun (Matrix.mulVec_zero _) sl'
    by_cases hslh : sl = h ∨ sl = h'
    · set F₂' : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun sl' i' j' =>
        if (i' : ℕ) < r₂ sl' ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl' i' j' else 0
      have hF₂'_paired : ∀ (a' : Fin 2) (b' : Fin 2),
          HasRealPairedStructure td (fun sl' => F₂' sl' a' b') := by
        intro a' b'
        have hS_ps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (svd₂.S a' b'))
        constructor
        · intro sl' hreal
          show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl' ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl' a' b' else 0).im = 0
          split_ifs with hif
          · exact hS_ps.1 sl' hreal
          · rfl
        · intro sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
          show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl2 a' b' else 0) =
            starRingEnd ℂ (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl1 a' b' else 0)
          have hrr : r₂ sl1 = r₂ sl2 := hr₂ sl1 sl2 (Ne.symm hne) hconj_sl
          by_cases hif : (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)
          · rw [if_pos hif, if_pos ⟨hrr ▸ hif.1, hif.2⟩]
            exact hS_ps.2 sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
          · have hif' : ¬((a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)) := by rw [← hrr]; exact hif
            rw [if_neg hif, if_neg hif', map_zero]
      have hF₂'_rt : transform (invTransform F₂' : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td) = F₂' :=
        transform_invTransform F₂'
          (fun a' b' => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hF₂'_paired a' b'))
      have hTruncS_transform' : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) = F₂' := by
        show transform (invTransform F₂' : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td) = F₂'
        exact hF₂'_rt
      have hF₂'_active : ∀ sl', sl' = h ∨ sl' = h' →
          F₂' sl' = Matrix.diagonal (fun (k : Fin 2) =>
            if k = 0 then transform svd₂.S sl' 0 0 else 0) := by
        intro sl' hsl'
        ext i' j'
        have hi' : i' = 0 ∨ i' = 1 := by omega
        have hj' : j' = 0 ∨ j' = 1 := by omega
        simp only [Matrix.diagonal]
        rcases hi' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj' with rfl | rfl
        · show (if (0 : Fin 2).val < r₂ sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 2).val = (0 : Fin 2).val then _ else 0) = _
          rw [if_pos ⟨by simp [r₂, hsl'], rfl⟩]
          simp [Matrix.of_apply]
        · show (if (0 : Fin 2).val < r₂ sl' ∧ (0 : Fin 2).val = (1 : Fin 2).val then _ else 0) = _
          rw [if_neg (fun ⟨_, h⟩ => absurd h (by decide))]
          simp [Matrix.of_apply, show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 from by decide]
        · show (if (1 : Fin 2).val < r₂ sl' ∧ (1 : Fin 2).val = (0 : Fin 2).val then _ else 0) = _
          rw [if_neg (fun ⟨_, h⟩ => absurd h (by decide))]
          simp [Matrix.of_apply, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide]
        · show (if (1 : Fin 2).val < r₂ sl' ∧ (1 : Fin 2).val = (1 : Fin 2).val then _ else 0) = _
          rw [if_neg (fun ⟨h1, _⟩ => by simp [r₂, hsl'] at h1)]
          simp [Matrix.of_apply]
      rw [congr_fun₂ (htrunc_transform sl) i j]
      rw [congr_fun hTruncS_transform' sl]
      rw [hF₂'_active sl hslh]
      set a_sl := transform A₂ sl 0 0
      set b_sl := transform A₂ sl 1 1
      have hA₂_diag : transform A₂ sl = Matrix.diagonal ![a_sl, b_sl] := by
        ext p q
        have hp : p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := by omega
        have hq : q = 0 ∨ q = 1 := by omega
        rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl <;>
          simp_all [Matrix.diagonal, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
            Matrix.cons_val_one, a_sl, b_sl]
      have hSVD_sl : transform svd₂.U sl * transform svd₂.S sl * (transform svd₂.V sl)ᴴ =
          Matrix.diagonal ![a_sl, b_sl] := by
        rw [← hA₂_diag]; exact (svd₂.hSlice sl).symm
      
      have hab_sl : Complex.normSq b_sl < Complex.normSq a_sl := by
        have ha_normSq : Complex.normSq a_sl = s₁ ^ 2 + t₁ ^ 2 := by
          show Complex.normSq (transform A₂ sl 0 0) = s₁ ^ 2 + t₁ ^ 2
          rw [hA₂_transform_00, congr_fun hbvec₁_tr sl]
          rcases hslh with rfl | rfl
          · rw [if_pos rfl]
            simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
              Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
            ring
          · rw [if_neg hh'_ne, if_pos rfl]
            simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
              Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
            ring
        have hb_normSq : Complex.normSq b_sl = s₂ ^ 2 + t₂ ^ 2 := by
          show Complex.normSq (transform A₂ sl 1 1) = s₂ ^ 2 + t₂ ^ 2
          rw [hA₂_transform_11, congr_fun hbvec₂_tr sl]
          rcases hslh with rfl | rfl
          · rw [if_pos rfl]
            simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
              Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
            ring
          · rw [if_neg hh'_ne, if_pos rfl]
            simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
              Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
            ring
        rw [ha_normSq, hb_normSq]; exact hnorm
      have h_trunc := svd_trunc_of_diag_2x2 a_sl b_sl
        (transform svd₂.U sl) (transform svd₂.S sl) (transform svd₂.V sl)
        (svd₂.hU_slice sl) (svd₂.hV_slice sl) (svd₂.hS_svdDiag sl)
        hSVD_sl hab_sl i j
      rw [h_trunc]
      have ha_sl_eq : a_sl = transform Bk0 sl 0 0 := by
        simp only [a_sl, hA₂_transform_00, hBk0_transform_00]
      have hBk0_eq_diag : transform Bk0 sl = Matrix.diagonal ![a_sl, 0] := by
        ext p q
        have hp : p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := by omega
        have hq : q = 0 ∨ q = 1 := by omega
        rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hq with rfl | rfl <;>
          simp_all [Matrix.diagonal,
            
            
            ]
      rw [← hBk0_eq_diag]
    · push Not at hslh
      rw [congr_fun₂ (htrunc_transform sl) i j]
      have hr₂_sl : r₂ sl = 0 := if_neg (by push Not; exact hslh)
      set F₂ : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun sl' i' j' =>
        if (i' : ℕ) < r₂ sl' ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl' i' j' else 0
      have hF₂_paired : ∀ (a' : Fin 2) (b' : Fin 2),
          HasRealPairedStructure td (fun sl' => F₂ sl' a' b') := by
        intro a' b'
        have hS_ps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td (KM.toFun (svd₂.S a' b'))
        constructor
        · intro sl' hreal
          show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl' ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl' a' b' else 0).im = 0
          split_ifs with hif
          · exact hS_ps.1 sl' hreal
          · rfl
        · intro sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
          show (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl2 a' b' else 0) =
            starRingEnd ℂ (if (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ) then transform svd₂.S sl1 a' b' else 0)
          have hrr : r₂ sl1 = r₂ sl2 := hr₂ sl1 sl2 (Ne.symm hne) hconj_sl
          by_cases hif : (a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl1 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)
          · rw [if_pos hif, if_pos ⟨hrr ▸ hif.1, hif.2⟩]
            exact hS_ps.2 sl1 sl2 hne hconj_sl
          · have hif' : ¬((a' : ℕ) < r₂ sl2 ∧ (a' : ℕ) = (b' : ℕ)) := by rw [← hrr]; exact hif
            rw [if_neg hif, if_neg hif', map_zero]
      have hF₂_rt : transform (invTransform F₂ : TubalMatrix 2 2 n td) = F₂ :=
        transform_invTransform F₂
          (fun a' b' => applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (hF₂_paired a' b'))
      have hTruncS_eq : tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂ = invTransform F₂ := rfl
      have hTruncS_transform : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) = F₂ := by
        rw [hTruncS_eq]; exact hF₂_rt
      have hF₂_zero : F₂ sl = 0 := by
        ext i' j'
        show (if (i' : ℕ) < r₂ sl ∧ (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then _ else 0) = 0
        rw [if_neg]; intro ⟨h1, _⟩; rw [hr₂_sl] at h1; exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ h1
      have hS_trunc_zero : transform (tubalTruncMulti svd₂.S svd₂.hS_fdiag r₂ hr₂) sl = 0 := by
        rw [congr_fun hTruncS_transform sl, hF₂_zero]
      rw [hS_trunc_zero, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]
      have hBk0_sl : transform Bk0 sl i j = 0 := by
        have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
        have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by omega
        rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
        · rw [hBk0_transform_00, congr_fun hbvec₁_tr sl]
          simp [hslh.1, hslh.2]
        · exact hBk0_transform_other sl 0 1 (by decide)
        · exact hBk0_transform_other sl 1 0 (by decide)
        · exact hBk0_transform_other sl 1 1 (by decide)
      rw [hBk0_sl]; simp [Matrix.zero_apply]
  
  have hLHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A₂ - tsvdTruncMulti (TSVD.of A₂) r₂ hr₂) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * s₂ * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * t₂ * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2 := by
    rw [htrunc_eq]
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq]
    have h00 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 0 0) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 0 - Bk0 0 0) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_00, hBk0_00, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h01 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 0 1) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 1 - Bk0 0 1) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_01, hBk0_01, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h10 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 1 0) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 0 - Bk0 1 0) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_10, hBk0_10, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h11 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) 1 1) k = bvec₂ k := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 1 - Bk0 1 1) k = bvec₂ k
      rw [hA₂_11, hBk0_11, sub_zero, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    show ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin n, (KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bk0) i j) k) ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * s₂ * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * t₂ * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, h00, h01, h10, h11]
    simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  
  have hRHS : tubalFrobNormSq (A₂ - Bc) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * s₁ * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * t₁ * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [tubalFrobNormSq]
    have h00 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 0 0) k = bvec₁ k := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 0 - Bc 0 0) k = bvec₁ k
      rw [hA₂_00, hBc_00, sub_zero, KM.toFun_ofFun]
    have h01 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 0 1) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 0 1 - Bc 0 1) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_01, hBc_01, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h10 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 1 0) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 0 - Bc 1 0) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_10, hBc_10, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have h11 : ∀ k, KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) 1 1) k = 0 := by
      intro k; show KM.toFun (A₂ 1 1 - Bc 1 1) k = 0
      rw [hA₂_11, hBc_11, sub_self, KM.toFun_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    show ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin n, (KM.toFun ((A₂ - Bc) i j) k) ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * s₁ * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * t₁ * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, h00, h01, h10, h11]
    simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    rfl
  have hineq := hopt 2 2 A₂ (TSVD.of A₂) Bc r₂ hr₂ hBc_mr
  rw [hLHS, hRHS] at hineq
  exact hineq

name: TubalTensor.lemma_B6_cuv_zero
statement:
private theorem lemma_B6_cuv_zero {n : ℕ} {td : TubalData n} (hn : 0 < n)
    (h h' : Fin n) (hh'_ne : h' ≠ h) (hconj : IsConjRow td.M h h')
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B))
    (Cuv : ℝ)
    (hCuv : Cuv = ∑ l : Fin n, (td.M_inv l h).re * (td.M_inv l h).im) :
    Cuv = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  set u : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).re
  set v : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (td.M_inv i h).im
  set Cu : ℝ := ∑ i, u i ^ 2
  set Cv : ℝ := ∑ i, v i ^ 2
  have hCu_nn : 0 ≤ Cu := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hCv_nn : 0 ≤ Cv := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
  
  have hCuCv_pos : 0 < Cu + Cv := by
    by_contra hneg; push Not at hneg
    have h0 : Cu + Cv = 0 := le_antisymm hneg (add_nonneg hCu_nn hCv_nn)
    have hCu0 : Cu = 0 := by linarith
    have hCv0 : Cv = 0 := by linarith
    have hu0 : ∀ i, u i = 0 := fun i => by
      have := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (u j)) |>.mp
        (le_antisymm (hCu0 ▸ le_refl _) hCu_nn) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
    have hv0 : ∀ i, v i = 0 := fun i => by
      have := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (v j)) |>.mp
        (le_antisymm (hCv0 ▸ le_refl _) hCv_nn) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
    have hcol_zero : ∀ i, td.M_inv i h = 0 := fun i =>
      Complex.ext (by rw [Complex.zero_re]; exact hu0 i)
        (by rw [Complex.zero_im]; exact hv0 i)
    have hMMinv := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h h
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at hMMinv
    rw [show ∑ j, td.M h j * td.M_inv j h = 0 from
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by rw [hcol_zero j, mul_zero])] at hMMinv
    exact absurd hMMinv zero_ne_one
  
  have hCuv_sq_le : Cuv ^ 2 ≤ Cu * Cv := by
    have h_nn : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i, (r * u i - v i) ^ 2 :=
      fun _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have h_expand : ∀ r : ℝ, ∑ i, (r * u i - v i) ^ 2 =
        r ^ 2 * Cu - 2 * r * Cuv + Cv := by
      intro r
      have heq : ∀ i, (r * u i - v i) ^ 2 =
          r ^ 2 * u i ^ 2 - 2 * r * (u i * v i) + v i ^ 2 := fun i => by ring
      conv_lhs => arg 2; ext i; rw [heq i]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [show ∑ i, r ^ 2 * u i ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * Cu from by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]]
      rw [show ∑ i, 2 * r * (u i * v i) = 2 * r * Cuv from by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hCuv]]
    by_cases hCu_pos : 0 < Cu
    · 
      have h_at_min := h_nn (Cuv / Cu)
      rw [h_expand] at h_at_min
      have : (Cuv / Cu) ^ 2 * Cu - 2 * (Cuv / Cu) * Cuv + Cv =
          (Cv * Cu - Cuv ^ 2) / Cu := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [this] at h_at_min
      have : 0 ≤ Cv * Cu - Cuv ^ 2 := (div_nonneg_iff.mp h_at_min).elim
        (fun ⟨h1, _⟩ => h1) (fun ⟨_, h2⟩ => absurd hCu_pos (not_lt.mpr h2))
      linarith
    · push Not at hCu_pos
      have hCu0 : Cu = 0 := le_antisymm hCu_pos hCu_nn
      have hu0 : ∀ i, (td.M_inv i h).re = 0 := fun i => by
        have hsum_eq_zero : ∑ j, (td.M_inv j h).re ^ 2 = 0 := hCu0
        have := Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) |>.mp
          (le_antisymm (hsum_eq_zero ▸ le_refl _) hCu_nn) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
        exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
      have hCuv0 : Cuv = 0 := by
        rw [hCuv]; apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i _
        rw [hu0 i]; ring
      rw [hCuv0, hCu0]; simp
  have habs_le : 2 * |Cuv| ≤ Cu + Cv := by
    have h1 : 4 * Cuv ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (Cu * Cv) := by linarith
    have h2 : (2 * |Cuv|) ^ 2 ≤ (Cu + Cv) ^ 2 := by
      have heq : (2 * |Cuv|) ^ 2 = 4 * Cuv ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, sq_abs]; ring
      rw [heq]
      have hAM : 4 * (Cu * Cv) ≤ (Cu + Cv) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Cu - Cv), hCu_nn, hCv_nn]
      linarith
    have h3 : 0 ≤ 2 * |Cuv| := by positivity
    have h4 : 0 ≤ Cu + Cv := le_of_lt hCuCv_pos
    exact abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h2 h4 |>.2
  
  
  
  have hkey_lt : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 →
      a ^ 2 * ((Cu + Cv) + 2 * Cuv) ≤ (Cu + Cv) - 2 * Cuv := by
    intro a ha_pos ha_lt
    
    have hnorm : a ^ 2 + (-a) ^ 2 < 1 ^ 2 + 1 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hie := tube_ey_2x2_ineq hn h h' hh'_ne hconj hopt 1 1 a (-a) hnorm
    
    
    
    
    have hL_eq : ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * a * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * (-a) * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
        = 4 * a ^ 2 * (Cu + 2 * Cuv + Cv) := by
      have hsum : ∀ k : Fin n, (2 * a * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * (-a) * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
          = 4 * a ^ 2 * ((u k) ^ 2 + 2 * (u k * v k) + (v k) ^ 2) := fun k => by
        simp only [u, v]; ring
      conv_lhs => arg 2; ext k; rw [hsum k]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      show 4 * a ^ 2 * ∑ k, ((u k)^2 + 2 * (u k * v k) + (v k)^2) = 4 * a ^ 2 * (Cu + 2 * Cuv + Cv)
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      show (∑ k, (u k)^2) + (∑ k, 2 * (u k * v k)) + ∑ k, (v k)^2 = _
      rw [show ∑ k, 2 * (u k * v k) = 2 * ∑ k, u k * v k from by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]]
      show Cu + 2 * (∑ k, u k * v k) + Cv = Cu + 2 * Cuv + Cv
      rw [hCuv]
    have hR_eq : ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * 1 * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * 1 * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
        = 4 * (Cu - 2 * Cuv + Cv) := by
      have hsum : ∀ k : Fin n, (2 * 1 * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * 1 * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
          = 4 * ((u k) ^ 2 - 2 * (u k * v k) + (v k) ^ 2) := fun k => by
        simp only [u, v]; ring
      conv_lhs => arg 2; ext k; rw [hsum k]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      show 4 * ∑ k, ((u k)^2 - 2 * (u k * v k) + (v k)^2) = 4 * (Cu - 2 * Cuv + Cv)
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      show (∑ k, (u k)^2) - (∑ k, 2 * (u k * v k)) + ∑ k, (v k)^2 = _
      rw [show ∑ k, 2 * (u k * v k) = 2 * ∑ k, u k * v k from by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]]
      show Cu - 2 * (∑ k, u k * v k) + Cv = Cu - 2 * Cuv + Cv
      rw [hCuv]
    rw [hL_eq, hR_eq] at hie
    nlinarith [hie]
  have hkey_gt : ∀ a : ℝ, 1 < a →
      (Cu + Cv) - 2 * Cuv ≤ a ^ 2 * ((Cu + Cv) + 2 * Cuv) := by
    intro a ha_gt
    
    have hnorm : 1 ^ 2 + 1 ^ 2 < a ^ 2 + (-a) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hie := tube_ey_2x2_ineq hn h h' hh'_ne hconj hopt a (-a) 1 1 hnorm
    have hL_eq : ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * 1 * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * 1 * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
        = 4 * (Cu - 2 * Cuv + Cv) := by
      have hsum : ∀ k : Fin n, (2 * 1 * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * 1 * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
          = 4 * ((u k) ^ 2 - 2 * (u k * v k) + (v k) ^ 2) := fun k => by
        simp only [u, v]; ring
      conv_lhs => arg 2; ext k; rw [hsum k]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      show 4 * ∑ k, ((u k)^2 - 2 * (u k * v k) + (v k)^2) = 4 * (Cu - 2 * Cuv + Cv)
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      show (∑ k, (u k)^2) - (∑ k, 2 * (u k * v k)) + ∑ k, (v k)^2 = _
      rw [show ∑ k, 2 * (u k * v k) = 2 * ∑ k, u k * v k from by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]]
      show Cu - 2 * (∑ k, u k * v k) + Cv = Cu - 2 * Cuv + Cv
      rw [hCuv]
    have hR_eq : ∑ k : Fin n, (2 * a * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * (-a) * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
        = 4 * a ^ 2 * (Cu + 2 * Cuv + Cv) := by
      have hsum : ∀ k : Fin n, (2 * a * (td.M_inv k h).re - 2 * (-a) * (td.M_inv k h).im) ^ 2
          = 4 * a ^ 2 * ((u k) ^ 2 + 2 * (u k * v k) + (v k) ^ 2) := fun k => by
        simp only [u, v]; ring
      conv_lhs => arg 2; ext k; rw [hsum k]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      show 4 * a ^ 2 * ∑ k, ((u k)^2 + 2 * (u k * v k) + (v k)^2) = 4 * a ^ 2 * (Cu + 2 * Cuv + Cv)
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      show (∑ k, (u k)^2) + (∑ k, 2 * (u k * v k)) + ∑ k, (v k)^2 = _
      rw [show ∑ k, 2 * (u k * v k) = 2 * ∑ k, u k * v k from by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]]
      show Cu + 2 * (∑ k, u k * v k) + Cv = Cu + 2 * Cuv + Cv
      rw [hCuv]
    rw [hL_eq, hR_eq] at hie
    nlinarith [hie]
  
  set c : ℝ := Cu + Cv
  have hc_pos : 0 < c := hCuCv_pos
  have hc_pm_nn : 0 ≤ c - 2 * Cuv ∧ 0 ≤ c + 2 * Cuv := by
    constructor
    · 
      have := habs_le
      have hCuv_le : Cuv ≤ |Cuv| := le_abs_self _
      linarith
    · have := habs_le
      have hCuv_ge : -|Cuv| ≤ Cuv := neg_abs_le _
      linarith
  by_contra hCuv_ne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hCuv_ne with hCuv_neg | hCuv_pos
  · 
    by_cases hcp : c + 2 * Cuv = 0
    · 
      have h := hkey_gt 2 (by norm_num)
      rw [hcp, mul_zero] at h
      linarith
    · have hcp_pos : 0 < c + 2 * Cuv := lt_of_le_of_ne hc_pm_nn.2 (Ne.symm hcp)
      
      have hrat_gt : 1 < c / (c + 2 * Cuv) := by
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ hcp_pos]; linarith
      have hrat_pos : 0 < c / (c + 2 * Cuv) := by positivity
      set a₀ := Real.sqrt (c / (c + 2 * Cuv))
      have ha₀_gt : 1 < a₀ := by
        calc 1 = Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_one.symm
          _ < Real.sqrt (c / (c + 2 * Cuv)) :=
              Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) hrat_gt
      have ha₀_sq : a₀ ^ 2 = c / (c + 2 * Cuv) :=
        Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hrat_pos)
      have h := hkey_gt a₀ ha₀_gt
      rw [ha₀_sq] at h
      
      have h_simp : c / (c + 2 * Cuv) * (c + 2 * Cuv) = c := by
        field_simp
      rw [h_simp] at h
      
      linarith
  · 
    by_cases hcm : c - 2 * Cuv = 0
    · have h := hkey_lt (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      rw [hcm] at h
      have : (1/2 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (c + 2 * Cuv) ≤ 0 := h
      
      have : 0 < (1/2 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (c + 2 * Cuv) := by
        apply mul_pos (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      linarith
    · have hcm_pos : 0 < c - 2 * Cuv := lt_of_le_of_ne hc_pm_nn.1 (Ne.symm hcm)
      
      have hcp_pos : 0 < c + 2 * Cuv := by linarith
      have hrat_lt : c / (c + 2 * Cuv) < 1 := by
        rw [div_lt_one hcp_pos]; linarith
      have hrat_pos : 0 < c / (c + 2 * Cuv) := by positivity
      set a₀ := Real.sqrt (c / (c + 2 * Cuv))
      have ha₀_pos : 0 < a₀ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hrat_pos
      have ha₀_lt : a₀ < 1 := by
        calc a₀ < Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (le_of_lt hrat_pos) hrat_lt
          _ = 1 := Real.sqrt_one
      have ha₀_sq : a₀ ^ 2 = c / (c + 2 * Cuv) :=
        Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hrat_pos)
      have h := hkey_lt a₀ ha₀_pos ha₀_lt
      rw [ha₀_sq] at h
      have h_simp : c / (c + 2 * Cuv) * (c + 2 * Cuv) = c := by
        field_simp
      rw [h_simp] at h
      
      linarith

name: TubalTensor.MMH_off_diag_general
statement:
private theorem MMH_off_diag_general (td : TubalData n)
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B))
    (h j : Fin n) (hhj : h ≠ j) :
    ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases td.hM_real h with hh_real | ⟨h', hh'_ne, hconj_h, huniq_h⟩
  · 
    rcases td.hM_real j with hj_real | ⟨j', hj'_ne, hconj_j, huniq_j⟩
    · 
      have hopt_tube := derive_tube_opt_real td hn h hh_real hopt
      have hMinv_eq := foc_general td h hh_real hopt_tube
      exact MMH_off_diag_both_real td h j hhj hh_real hj_real hMinv_eq
    · 
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      have hopt_tube := derive_tube_opt_real td hn h hh_real hopt
      have hMinv_eq := foc_general td h hh_real hopt_tube
      have hC_pos := hC_pos_general td h hh_real
      
      have hMinv_h_real : ∀ l, (td.M_inv l h).im = 0 := by
        intro l
        have := Minv_col_conj_of_row_conj td (isRealRow_self_conj hh_real) l
        
        exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp this.symm
      
      have hj'h : j' ≠ h := by
        intro heq; subst heq
        
        
        have : IsRealRow td.M j := by
          intro l
          have := (isConjRow_symm hconj_j) l
          
          
          rw [this, starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero (hh_real l)]
          exact hh_real l  
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        have hrows_eq : ∀ l, td.M j' l = td.M j l := by
          intro l
          rw [hconj_j l, starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero (this l)]
        have h1 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv j j
        have h2 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv j' j
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at h1
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h2
        rw [if_neg hj'_ne] at h2
        rw [show ∑ x, td.M j' x * td.M_inv x j = ∑ x, td.M j x * td.M_inv x j from by
          congr 1; funext l; rw [hrows_eq l]] at h2
        exact absurd h1 (by rw [h2]; exact zero_ne_one)
      
      have hMMinv := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv j' h
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_neg hj'h] at hMMinv
      
      
      have hMinv_val : ∀ l, td.M_inv l h = ↑((td.M h l).re * ∑ i, ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single h (1 : ℂ)) i).re ^ 2) := by
        intro l
        apply Complex.ext
        · rw [Complex.ofReal_re]; exact hMinv_eq l
        · rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact hMinv_h_real l
      
      set C_h := ∑ i, ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single h (1 : ℂ)) i).re ^ 2
      
      have hsum_eq : C_h * ∑ l, td.M j' l * ↑((td.M h l).re) = 0 := by
        have : ∑ l, td.M j' l * td.M_inv l h = 0 := hMMinv
        rw [show ∑ l, td.M j' l * td.M_inv l h =
          C_h * ∑ l, td.M j' l * ↑((td.M h l).re) from by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            congr 1; funext l
            rw [hMinv_val l]; push_cast; ring] at this
        exact this
      have hinner_zero : ∑ l, td.M j' l * ↑((td.M h l).re) = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hsum_eq).resolve_left
          (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hC_pos))
      
      
      have : ∀ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) =
          td.M j' l * ↑((td.M h l).re) := by
        intro l
        rw [hconj_j l]
        have hhl : (td.M h l).im = 0 := hh_real l
        conv_lhs => rw [show td.M h l = ↑((td.M h l).re) from Complex.ext rfl (by simp [hhl])]
        rw [mul_comm]
      simp_rw [this]; exact hinner_zero
  · 
    rcases td.hM_real j with hj_real | ⟨j', hj'_ne, hconj_j, huniq_j⟩
    · 
      
      have hopt_tube_j := derive_tube_opt_real td hn j hj_real hopt
      have hMinv_eq_j := foc_general td j hj_real hopt_tube_j
      have hC_pos_j := hC_pos_general td j hj_real
      
      have hMinv_j_real : ∀ l, (td.M_inv l j).im = 0 := by
        intro l
        have := Minv_col_conj_of_row_conj td (isRealRow_self_conj hj_real) l
        exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp this.symm
      
      have hh'j : h' ≠ j := by
        intro heq; subst heq
        
        
        
        have hh_real' : IsRealRow td.M h := by
          intro l
          have := (isConjRow_symm hconj_h) l
          
          rw [this, starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero (hj_real l)]
          exact hj_real l
        
        have hrows_eq : ∀ l, td.M h' l = td.M h l := by
          intro l
          rw [hconj_h l, starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero (hh_real' l)]
        have e1 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h h
        have e2 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h' h
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at e1
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at e2
        rw [if_neg hh'_ne] at e2
        rw [show ∑ x, td.M h' x * td.M_inv x h = ∑ x, td.M h x * td.M_inv x h from by
          congr 1; funext l; rw [hrows_eq l]] at e2
        exact absurd e1 (by rw [e2]; exact zero_ne_one)
      
      have hMMinv := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h j
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_neg hhj] at hMMinv
      
      have hMinv_val : ∀ l, td.M_inv l j = ↑((td.M j l).re * ∑ i, ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single j (1 : ℂ)) i).re ^ 2) := by
        intro l
        apply Complex.ext
        · rw [Complex.ofReal_re]; exact hMinv_eq_j l
        · rw [Complex.ofReal_im]; exact hMinv_j_real l
      set C_j := ∑ i, ((td.M_inv *ᵥ Pi.single j (1 : ℂ)) i).re ^ 2
      
      have hsum_eq : C_j * ∑ l, td.M h l * ↑((td.M j l).re) = 0 := by
        have : ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M_inv l j = 0 := hMMinv
        rw [show ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M_inv l j =
          C_j * ∑ l, td.M h l * ↑((td.M j l).re) from by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            congr 1; funext l
            rw [hMinv_val l]; push_cast; ring] at this
        exact this
      have hinner_zero : ∑ l, td.M h l * ↑((td.M j l).re) = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hsum_eq).resolve_left
          (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hC_pos_j))
      
      
      convert hinner_zero using 1
      congr 1; funext l
      have hjl : (td.M j l).im = 0 := hj_real l
      rw [starRingEnd_eq_self_of_im_zero hjl]
      congr 1
      exact Complex.ext rfl (by simp [hjl])
    · 
      by_cases hnotconj : ¬IsConjRow td.M h j
      · 
        
        
        
        have hj'h : j' ≠ h := by
          intro heq; subst heq
          
          
          exact hnotconj (isConjRow_symm hconj_j)
        have hh'j : h' ≠ j := by
          intro heq; subst heq
          
          exact hnotconj hconj_h
        
        
        
        set w : Fin n → ℂ := fun l => td.M_inv l h
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        have hMw_hh : ∑ l, td.M h l * w l = 1 := by
          have := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h h
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at this
          exact this
        have hMw_h'h : ∑ l, td.M h' l * w l = 0 := by
          have := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h' h
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
          rwa [if_neg hh'_ne] at this
        have hMw_jh : ∑ l, td.M j l * w l = 0 := by
          have := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv j h
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
          rwa [if_neg (Ne.symm hhj)] at this
        have hMw_j'h : ∑ l, td.M j' l * w l = 0 := by
          have := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv j' h
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
          rwa [if_neg hj'h] at this
        
        suffices ∃ (α₁ : ℂ) (α₂ : ℝ), 0 < α₂ ∧ ∀ l, w l = α₁ * td.M h l + ↑α₂ * td.M h' l by
          obtain ⟨α₁, α₂, hα₂_pos, hw_decomp⟩ := this
          
          
          
          have hpartB := MMH_off_diag_complex_nonconj_partB h j h' j' hhj hh'_ne hj'_ne
            hconj_h hconj_j hj'h hh'j w α₁ α₂ hα₂_pos hw_decomp
            hMw_jh hMw_j'h hMw_hh hMw_h'h
          
          rw [show ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) =
            ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M j' l from by
              congr 1; funext l; rw [hconj_j l]]
          exact hpartB
        exact foc_2d_decomp td hn h h' hh'_ne hconj_h hopt
      · 
        push Not at hnotconj
        
        have hj_eq_h' : j = h' := huniq_h j (Ne.symm hhj) hnotconj
        
        rw [hj_eq_h']
        
        
        rw [show ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h' l) =
          ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l from by
          congr 1; funext l; rw [hconj_h l, starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_conj]]
        
        
        obtain ⟨α₁, α₂, hα₂_pos, hw_decomp⟩ := foc_2d_decomp td hn h h' hh'_ne hconj_h hopt
        have hα₂_ne : (↑α₂ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hα₂_pos)
        
        
        have hEqIV_conj : starRingEnd ℂ α₁ * (∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l)) +
            ↑α₂ * (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l) = 0 := by
          
          have hMMinv_h'h : ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M_inv l h = 0 := by
            have := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h' h
            simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
            rwa [if_neg hh'_ne] at this
          have hEqIV : α₁ * (∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l)) +
              ↑α₂ * starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l) = 0 := by
            have hsub : ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M_inv l h =
                α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h l + ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h' l := by
              conv_lhs => arg 2; ext l; rw [hw_decomp l]
              rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
              congr 1; funext l; ring
            rw [hMMinv_h'h] at hsub
            rw [show ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h l = ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) from by
              congr 1; funext l; rw [hconj_h l]; ring] at hsub
            rw [show ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h' l = starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l) from by
              rw [map_sum]; congr 1; funext l
              simp_rw [hconj_h l]; exact (map_mul _ _ _).symm] at hsub
            exact hsub.symm
          
          have hN_real : starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l)) =
              ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) := by
            rw [map_sum]; congr 1; funext l
            rw [Complex.mul_conj]
            simp [Complex.conj_ofReal]
          have hconj_eq := congr_arg (starRingEnd ℂ) hEqIV
          simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_zero] at hconj_eq
          rw [show starRingEnd ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l)) =
            ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l from by
            rw [starRingEnd_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_star]] at hconj_eq
          rw [show starRingEnd ℂ (↑α₂ : ℂ) = ↑α₂ from by
            rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]] at hconj_eq
          rw [hN_real] at hconj_eq
          exact hconj_eq
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        have hα₁_zero : α₁ = 0 := by
          
          
          
          set σ := ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l with hσ_def
          set N := ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) with hN_def
          have hEqI : α₁ * σ + ↑α₂ * N = 1 := by
            have hMMinv_hh : ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M_inv l h = 1 := by
              have := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h h
              simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ite_true] at this
              exact this
            have hsub : ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M_inv l h =
                α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l +
                ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l := by
              conv_lhs => arg 2; ext l; rw [hw_decomp l]
              rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
              congr 1; funext l; ring
            rw [hMMinv_hh] at hsub
            rw [show ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l =
              ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) from by
              congr 1; funext l; rw [hconj_h l]] at hsub
            exact hsub.symm
          have hEqIV : α₁ * N + ↑α₂ * starRingEnd ℂ σ = 0 := by
            have hMMinv_h'h : ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M_inv l h = 0 := by
              have := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv h' h
              simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
              rwa [if_neg hh'_ne] at this
            have hsub : ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M_inv l h =
                α₁ * ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h l +
                ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h' l := by
              conv_lhs => arg 2; ext l; rw [hw_decomp l]
              rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
              congr 1; funext l; ring
            rw [hMMinv_h'h] at hsub
            rw [show ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h l = N from by
              rw [hN_def]; congr 1; funext l; rw [hconj_h l]; ring] at hsub
            rw [show ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h' l = starRingEnd ℂ σ from by
              rw [hσ_def, map_sum]; congr 1; funext l
              simp_rw [hconj_h l]; exact (map_mul _ _ _).symm] at hsub
            exact hsub.symm
          
          have hN_real : starRingEnd ℂ N = N := by
            rw [hN_def, map_sum]; congr 1; funext l
            rw [Complex.mul_conj]; simp [Complex.conj_ofReal]
          
          
          
          
          have hα₁_eq_sum_sq : α₁ = ∑ l, (td.M_inv l h) ^ 2 := by
            have hexpand : ∑ l, (td.M_inv l h) ^ 2 =
                α₁ ^ 2 * σ + 2 * α₁ * ↑α₂ * N + ↑α₂ ^ 2 * starRingEnd ℂ σ := by
              conv_lhs => arg 2; ext l; rw [hw_decomp l]
              simp only [hσ_def, hN_def]
              rw [show ∑ l, (α₁ * td.M h l + ↑α₂ * td.M h' l) ^ 2 =
                α₁ ^ 2 * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l +
                2 * α₁ * ↑α₂ * ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l +
                ↑α₂ ^ 2 * ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h' l from by
                simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
                rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
                congr 1; funext l; ring]
              congr 1; congr 1
              · congr 1
                rw [show ∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h' l =
                  ∑ l, td.M h l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M h l) from by
                  congr 1; funext l; rw [hconj_h l]]
              · congr 1
                rw [show ∑ l, td.M h' l * td.M h' l =
                  starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l, td.M h l * td.M h l) from by
                  rw [map_sum]; congr 1; funext l
                  simp_rw [hconj_h l]; exact (map_mul _ _ _).symm]
            rw [hexpand]
            have : α₁ ^ 2 * σ + 2 * α₁ * ↑α₂ * N + ↑α₂ ^ 2 * starRingEnd ℂ σ =
                α₁ * (α₁ * σ + ↑α₂ * N) + ↑α₂ * (α₁ * N + ↑α₂ * starRingEnd ℂ σ) := by ring
            rw [this, hEqI, hEqIV, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero]
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          apply Complex.ext
          · 
            
            set Cu := ∑ l : Fin n, (td.M_inv l h).re ^ 2
            set Cv := ∑ l : Fin n, (td.M_inv l h).im ^ 2
            
            have hα₁_re : α₁.re = Cu - Cv := by
              rw [hα₁_eq_sum_sq]
              show (∑ l, (td.M_inv l h) ^ 2).re = Cu - Cv
              rw [Complex.re_sum]
              show ∑ l, ((td.M_inv l h) ^ 2).re = Cu - Cv
              have : ∀ l, ((td.M_inv l h) ^ 2).re =
                  (td.M_inv l h).re ^ 2 - (td.M_inv l h).im ^ 2 := by
                intro l; simp [sq, Complex.mul_re]
              simp_rw [this]; rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            rw [hα₁_re, Complex.zero_re]
            
            have hCu_nn : 0 ≤ Cu := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
            have hCv_nn : 0 ≤ Cv := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
            
            
            
            
            
            
            have hB5_lt : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y < 1 → y ^ 2 * Cv ≤ Cu :=
              lemma_B5_lt hn h h' hh'_ne hconj_h hopt Cu Cv rfl rfl
            have hB5_gt : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 < y → Cu ≤ y ^ 2 * Cv :=
              lemma_B5_gt hn h h' hh'_ne hconj_h hopt Cu Cv rfl rfl
            
            by_contra hne
            push Not at hne
            rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
            · 
              have hCv_pos : 0 < Cv := by linarith
              
              have hfrac_pos : 0 < (Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv) := by positivity
              have hfrac_lt : (Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv) < 1 := by
                rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]; linarith
              set y₀ := Real.sqrt ((Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv))
              have hy₀_pos : 0 < y₀ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hfrac_pos
              have hy₀_lt : y₀ < 1 := by
                calc y₀ < Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (le_of_lt hfrac_pos) hfrac_lt
                  _ = 1 := Real.sqrt_one
              have hy₀_sq : y₀ ^ 2 = (Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv) :=
                Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hfrac_pos)
              have h1 := hB5_lt y₀ hy₀_pos hy₀_lt
              rw [hy₀_sq] at h1
              
              have h2 : (Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv) * Cv = (Cu + Cv) / 2 := by
                field_simp
              linarith [h1.trans_eq (by linarith : Cu = Cu), h2 ▸ h1]
            · 
              by_cases hCv : Cv = 0
              · 
                have h1 := hB5_gt 2 (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2)
                simp [hCv] at h1; linarith
              · 
                have hCv_pos : 0 < Cv := lt_of_le_of_ne hCv_nn (Ne.symm hCv)
                have hfrac_pos : 0 < (Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv) := by positivity
                have hfrac_gt : 1 < (Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv) := by
                  rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
                set y₁ := Real.sqrt ((Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv))
                have hy₁_gt : 1 < y₁ := by
                  calc 1 = Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_one.symm
                    _ < Real.sqrt ((Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv)) :=
                        Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) hfrac_gt
                have hy₁_sq : y₁ ^ 2 = (Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv) :=
                  Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hfrac_pos)
                have h1 := hB5_gt y₁ hy₁_gt
                rw [hy₁_sq] at h1
                have h2 : (Cu + Cv) / (2 * Cv) * Cv = (Cu + Cv) / 2 := by
                  field_simp
                linarith [h2 ▸ h1]
          · 
            
            set Cuv := ∑ l : Fin n, (td.M_inv l h).re * (td.M_inv l h).im
            have hα₁_im : α₁.im = 2 * Cuv := by
              
              
              rw [hα₁_eq_sum_sq, Complex.im_sum]
              rw [show ∑ x, ((td.M_inv x h) ^ 2).im =
                  ∑ x, 2 * ((td.M_inv x h).re * (td.M_inv x h).im) from by
                congr 1; funext l; simp only [sq]; rw [Complex.mul_im]; ring]
              rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
            rw [hα₁_im, Complex.zero_im]
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            suffices Cuv = 0 by linarith
            exact lemma_B6_cuv_zero hn h h' hh'_ne hconj_h hopt Cuv rfl
        rw [hα₁_zero, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add] at hEqIV_conj
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hα₂_ne (hEqIV_conj.trans (mul_zero _).symm)

name: TubalTensor.eckart_young_multirank_necessity_general
statement:
theorem eckart_young_multirank_necessity_general
    (hn : 0 < n)
    (hopt : ∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B))
    : IsDiagUnitary td
proof:
:= by
  
  have hMMH_diag : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j →
      ∑ l, td.M i l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) = 0 :=
    fun i j hij => MMH_off_diag_general td hn hopt i j hij
  
  
  set rowNormSq : Fin n → ℝ := fun k =>
    (∑ l, td.M k l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M k l)).re
  have hRowNormSq_eq : ∀ k, rowNormSq k = ∑ l, Complex.normSq (td.M k l) := by
    intro k
    simp only [rowNormSq, Complex.re_sum]
    congr 1; funext l
    rw [Complex.mul_conj]; exact Complex.ofReal_re _
  have hRowPos : ∀ k, 0 < rowNormSq k := by
    intro k
    rw [hRowNormSq_eq]
    by_contra h; push Not at h
    have h0 : ∀ l, Complex.normSq (td.M k l) = 0 := fun l =>
      le_antisymm
        (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun l _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _) |>.mp
          (le_antisymm h (Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _)) l
          (Finset.mem_univ l)))
        (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)
    have hrow_zero : ∀ l, td.M k l = 0 := fun l =>
      Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp (h0 l)
    have h1 := congr_fun₂ td.hM_right_inv k k
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_true] at h1
    rw [show ∑ j, td.M k j * td.M_inv j k = 0 from
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by rw [hrow_zero j, zero_mul])] at h1
    exact zero_ne_one h1
  set D : Fin n → ℝ := fun k => Real.sqrt (rowNormSq k)
  have hD_ne : ∀ k, D k ≠ 0 := fun k => ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hRowPos k))
  have hD_sq : ∀ k, D k ^ 2 = rowNormSq k :=
    fun k => Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hRowPos k))
  set W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun k => ((D k : ℂ))⁻¹) * td.M
  have hM_eq : td.M = Matrix.diagonal (fun k => (↑(D k) : ℂ)) * W := by
    simp only [W, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    conv_lhs => rw [show td.M = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * td.M from (one_mul _).symm]
    congr 1
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    rw [show (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ => 1) from by
      ext i j; simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply]]
    congr 1; funext i
    exact (mul_inv_cancel₀ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hD_ne i))).symm
  
  have hW_unitary : IsUnitary W := by
    suffices h : W * Wᴴ = 1 from mul_eq_one_comm.mp h
    ext i j
    have hW_il : ∀ p l, W p l = ((D p : ℂ))⁻¹ * td.M p l := by
      intro p l; simp [W, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
        Finset.mem_univ]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, conjTranspose_apply, star_def]
    simp_rw [hW_il, map_mul,
      show ∀ q, starRingEnd ℂ ((↑(D q) : ℂ)⁻¹) = (↑(D q) : ℂ)⁻¹ from
        fun q => by simp]
    rw [show ∑ l, (↑(D i))⁻¹ * td.M i l * ((↑(D j))⁻¹ * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l)) =
      (↑(D i))⁻¹ * (↑(D j))⁻¹ * ∑ l, td.M i l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) from by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; funext l; ring]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · 
      subst hij; simp only [ite_true]
      have hsum : ∑ l, td.M i l * starRingEnd ℂ (td.M i l) = ↑(rowNormSq i) := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · rw [Complex.ofReal_re]
        · rw [Complex.ofReal_im]
          simp only [Complex.im_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro l _
          rw [Complex.mul_conj]; exact Complex.ofReal_im _
      rw [hsum, ← hD_sq i, Complex.ofReal_pow]
      have hDi := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hD_ne i)
      field_simp
    · 
      rw [if_neg hij, hMMH_diag i j hij, mul_zero]
  exact ⟨D, W, hD_ne, hW_unitary, hM_eq⟩

name: TubalTensor.eckart_young_multirank_iff
statement:
theorem eckart_young_multirank_iff (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∀ (m' p' : ℕ) (A : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (svd : TSVD A)
      (B : TubalMatrix m' p' n td) (r : Fin n → ℕ)
      (hr : RespectsConjPairing td r) (_hB : HasStarMMultirankAtMost B r),
      tubalFrobNormSq (A - tsvdTruncMulti svd r hr) ≤ tubalFrobNormSq (A - B))
    ↔ IsDiagUnitary td
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hopt => eckart_young_multirank_necessity_general hn hopt, ?_⟩
  intro hdu _ _ A svd B r hr hB
  exact tsvd_eckart_young_multirank_diagUnitary hdu svd B r hr hB

name: TubalTensor.IsFDiagonal.transform_diag
proof:
:= by
  simp [transform_apply, hA i j hij, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]

name: TubalTensor.isFDiagonal_of_transform
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  
  let A' : TubalMatrix m p n td := fun i' j' => if (i' : ℕ) = (j' : ℕ) then A i' j' else 0
  
  have htrans : transform A = transform A' := by
    funext k a b
    by_cases hab : (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ)
    · simp only [transform_apply, A', if_pos hab]
    · rw [h k a b hab]
      have hA0 : A' a b = 0 := if_neg hab
      simp [transform_apply, hA0, KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]
  
  have heq : A = A' :=
    (Function.LeftInverse.injective invTransform_transform) htrans
  
  exact congr_fun₂ heq i j ▸ if_neg hij

name: TubalTensor.commute_toLin'_of_commute_matrix
proof:
:= by
  have key : mapOfReal A * mapOfReal B = mapOfReal B * mapOfReal A := by
    have := congr_arg (Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix (m := Fin n)) h
    simp only [_root_.map_mul] at this
    exact this
  show (mapOfReal A).toLin' * (mapOfReal B).toLin' =
       (mapOfReal B).toLin' * (mapOfReal A).toLin'
  simp only [End.mul_eq_comp, ← Matrix.toLin'_mul]
  exact congr_arg Matrix.toLin' key

name: TubalTensor.aeval_apply_mem_eigenspace
proof:
:= by
  have hfv : f v = μ • v := End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hv
  have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, (f ^ k) v = μ ^ k • v := by
    intro k; induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, End.mul_apply, hfv, map_smul, ih, smul_smul]; ring_nf
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, Polynomial.eval_add, add_smul, hp, hq]
  | monomial k a =>
    simp only [Polynomial.aeval_monomial, Polynomial.eval_monomial]
    rw [End.mul_apply, hpow, Module.algebraMap_end_apply ℂ ℂ, smul_smul]

name: TubalTensor.isSemisimple_toLin'_diagonal
statement:
theorem isSemisimple_toLin'_diagonal {n : ℕ} (d : Fin n → ℂ) :
    End.IsSemisimple (diagonal d).toLin'
proof:
:= by
  
  set s := Finset.image d Finset.univ
  set p := ∏ μ ∈ s, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C μ) with hp_def
  
  have hp_sqf : Squarefree p :=
    (Polynomial.separable_prod_X_sub_C_iff'.mpr (fun _ _ _ _ h => h)).squarefree
  
  have hp_zero : Polynomial.aeval (diagonal d).toLin' p = 0 := by
    apply Basis.ext (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)); intro i
    simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply]
    rw [aeval_apply_mem_eigenspace (hasEigenvector_toLin'_diagonal d i).1]
    simp only [hp_def, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, rfl⟩) (sub_self _)]
    simp
  exact End.isSemisimple_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero hp_sqf hp_zero

name: TubalTensor.isSemisimple_toLin'_of_similar_diagonal
statement:
private lemma isSemisimple_toLin'_of_similar_diagonal {n : ℕ}
    (M S D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hS : IsUnit S) (hD : D.IsDiag)
    (hM : M = S * D * S⁻¹) : End.IsSemisimple M.toLin'
proof:
:= by
  
  have hdiag : ∃ d : Fin n → ℂ, D = diagonal d := by
    use fun i => D i i
    ext i j
    simp only [diagonal_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h; rfl
    · exact hD h
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hdiag
  have hDss := isSemisimple_toLin'_diagonal d
  
  have hdet : IsUnit S.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).mp hS
  
  let e : (Fin n → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ) :=
    LinearEquiv.ofLinear S.toLin' S⁻¹.toLin'
      (by simp only [← Matrix.toLin'_mul]; rw [mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet]; exact Matrix.toLin'_one)
      (by simp only [← Matrix.toLin'_mul]; rw [nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet]; exact Matrix.toLin'_one)
  
  have he : (e : (Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ)) ∘ₗ (diagonal d).toLin' = M.toLin' ∘ₗ e := by
    simp only [LinearMap.ext_iff]
    intro v
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, e, LinearEquiv.ofLinear_apply]
    rw [← Matrix.toLin'_mul_apply, ← Matrix.toLin'_mul_apply]
    congr 1
    
    rw [hM, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet, Matrix.mul_one]
  rwa [← e.isSemisimple_iff (diagonal d).toLin' M.toLin' he]

name: TubalTensor.isFinitelySemisimple_of_isMatDiag
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, D, hS, hD, hSDinv⟩ := hA
  exact (isSemisimple_toLin'_of_similar_diagonal _ S D hS hD hSDinv).isFinitelySemisimple

name: TubalTensor.matrix_eq_conj_diagonal_of_eigenbasis
statement:
private lemma matrix_eq_conj_diagonal_of_eigenbasis {n : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : Basis (Fin n) ℂ (Fin n → ℂ))
    (μ : Fin n → ℂ)
    (heig : ∀ i : Fin n, M.toLin' (b i) = μ i • b i) :
    let S := (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)).toMatrix b
    M = S * diagonal μ * S⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro S
  let e := Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)
  
  
  have hdiag : LinearMap.toMatrix b b M.toLin' = diagonal μ := by
    ext i j
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    
    have hj := heig j
    
    rw [hj, map_smul, Basis.repr_self, diagonal_apply]
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite,
               mul_one, mul_zero]
    
    by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, eq_comm]
  
  
  have hcob : S * (LinearMap.toMatrix b b M.toLin') * b.toMatrix e =
      LinearMap.toMatrix e e M.toLin' :=
    basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix
      (b := e) (c := e) (b' := b) (c' := b) (f := M.toLin')
  
  have hstd : LinearMap.toMatrix e e M.toLin' = M := by
    change LinearMap.toMatrix (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)) (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)) M.toLin' = M
    rw [show Matrix.toLin' = Matrix.toLin (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)) (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n))
        from rfl]
    exact LinearMap.toMatrix_toLin (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)) (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)) M
  
  have hSinv : S⁻¹ = b.toMatrix e := by
    exact Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv (e.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip b)
  rw [hdiag, hstd] at hcob
  rw [hSinv]
  exact hcob.symm

name: TubalTensor.jointly_diag_of_commuting
statement:
theorem jointly_diag_of_commuting {n : ℕ} (T : Set (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))
    (hdiag : ∀ A ∈ T, IsMatDiag A)
    (hcomm : ∀ A ∈ T, ∀ B ∈ T, A * B = B * A) :
    IsJointlyMatDiag T
proof:
:= by
  
  set f : T → End ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) := fun ⟨A, _⟩ => (mapOfReal A).toLin' with hf_def

  
  have hss : ∀ (A : T), (f A).IsFinitelySemisimple :=
    fun ⟨A, hA⟩ => isFinitelySemisimple_of_isMatDiag A (hdiag A hA)

  
  have hmge : ∀ (A : T) (μ : ℂ),
      (f A).maxGenEigenspace μ = (f A).eigenspace μ :=
    fun A μ => (hss A).maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace μ

  
  have hpw : Pairwise fun (i j : T) => Commute (f i) (f j) := by
    intro ⟨A, hA⟩ ⟨B, hB⟩ hne
    exact commute_toLin'_of_commute_matrix A B (hcomm A hA B hB)

  
  have hspan : ∀ (A : T), ⨆ μ, (f A).maxGenEigenspace μ = ⊤ :=
    fun A => End.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top (f A)

  
  have hjoint : ⨆ χ : T → ℂ, ⨅ (A : T), (f A).maxGenEigenspace (χ A) = ⊤ :=
    End.iSup_iInf_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_of_iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top_of_commute
      f hpw hspan

  
  have hjoint_eig : ⨆ χ : T → ℂ, ⨅ (A : T), (f A).eigenspace (χ A) = ⊤ := by
    simp_rw [← hmge] at hjoint ⊢
    exact hjoint

  
  have hU_top : ⊤ ≤ ⨆ (χ : T → ℂ), ⨅ (A : T), (f A).eigenspace (χ A) :=
    hjoint_eig ▸ le_refl _
  rw [Submodule.iSup_eq_span] at hU_top
  
  let b₀ := ofSpan hU_top
  letI := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex b₀
  
  have hfinrank : Module.finrank ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) = n := by
    simp
  
  have hcard := (finrank_eq_card_basis b₀).symm.trans hfinrank
  let b := b₀.reindex (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard)
  
  have hb_mem : ∀ j, ∃ χ : T → ℂ,
      b j ∈ (⨅ (A : T), (f A).eigenspace (χ A) : Submodule ℂ _) := by
    intro j
    have hj : b j ∈ Set.range (⇑b₀) := ⟨_, (Basis.reindex_apply b₀ _ j).symm⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mp (ofSpan_subset hU_top hj)
  choose χ hχ using hb_mem
  
  have hb_eig : ∀ (A : T) (j : Fin n), (f A) (b j) = χ j A • b j :=
    fun A j ↦ End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp ((Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp (hχ j) A)
  
  let e := Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)
  refine ⟨e.toMatrix b,
    IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one _ (e.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip b), ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  exact ⟨diagonal (fun j ↦ χ j ⟨A, hA⟩), isDiag_diagonal _,
    matrix_eq_conj_diagonal_of_eigenbasis (mapOfReal A) b _
      (fun j ↦ hb_eig ⟨A, hA⟩ j)⟩

name: TubalTensor.rank_conj_le
statement:
theorem rank_conj_le {m p : ℕ}
    (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (V : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (hU : IsUnitary U) (hV : IsUnitary V)
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hB : B.rank ≤ k) :
    (Uᴴ * B * V).rank ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  have hUHdet : IsUnit Uᴴ.det := by
    rw [det_conjTranspose]
    exact (isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hU.conjTranspose_mul_self).star
  have hVdet : IsUnit V.det :=
    isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hV.conjTranspose_mul_self
  calc (Uᴴ * B * V).rank
      = (Uᴴ * (B * V)).rank := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (B * V).rank := rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det _ _ hUHdet
    _ = B.rank := rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det _ _ hVdet
    _ ≤ k := hB

name: TubalTensor.frobNormSq_svdDiag_sub_trunc
statement:
theorem frobNormSq_svdDiag_sub_trunc {m p : ℕ} {S : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ}
    (hS : IsSVDDiag S) (k : ℕ) :
    frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc S hS k)) =
    ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin p,
      if ¬((i : ℕ) < k) ∧ (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then Complex.normSq (↑(S i j)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobNormSq]
  congr 1; funext i; congr 1; funext j
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, toComplexMatrix, Matrix.map_apply, svdTrunc]
  
  
  by_cases hik : (i : ℕ) < k
  · by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
    · 
      rw [if_pos ⟨hik, hij⟩, if_neg (by push Not; exact fun h => absurd hik (not_lt.mpr h))]
      simp [sub_self]
    · 
      rw [if_neg (not_and_of_not_right _ hij), if_neg (not_and_of_not_right _ hij)]
      simp [hS.1 i j hij]
  · by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
    · 
      rw [if_neg (not_and_of_not_left _ hik), if_pos ⟨hik, hij⟩]
      simp
    · 
      rw [if_neg (not_and_of_not_left _ hik), if_neg (not_and_of_not_right _ hij)]
      simp [hS.1 i j hij]

name: TubalTensor.weighted_sum_le_head
statement:
theorem weighted_sum_le_head {n : ℕ} (a w : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (ha_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (ha_mono : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≤ j → a j ≤ a i)
    (hw_range : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i ∧ w i ≤ 1)
    (hw_sum : ∑ i, w i ≤ k) :
    ∑ i, a i * w i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k), a i
proof:
:= by
  
  
  by_cases hkn : n ≤ k
  · have : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k) = Finset.univ := by
      ext i; simp; omega
    rw [this]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by nlinarith [(hw_range i).2, ha_nonneg i]
  · push Not at hkn
    
    
    
    
    
    
    set S_lo := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k)
    set S_hi := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ¬((i : ℕ) < k))
    have hunion : S_lo ∪ S_hi = Finset.univ := by
      ext i; simp [S_lo, S_hi]; omega
    have hdisj : Disjoint S_lo S_hi :=
      Finset.disjoint_filter.mpr fun _ _ h1 h2 => h2 h1
    
    have hsplit : ∑ i, a i * w i = ∑ i ∈ S_lo, a i * w i + ∑ i ∈ S_hi, a i * w i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_union hdisj, hunion]
    
    
    
    suffices hsuff : ∑ i ∈ S_hi, a i * w i ≤ ∑ i ∈ S_lo, a i * (1 - w i) by
      rw [hsplit]
      have key : ∑ i ∈ S_lo, a i * w i + ∑ i ∈ S_lo, a i * (1 - w i) = ∑ i ∈ S_lo, a i := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
      linarith
    
    
    set ak := a ⟨k, hkn⟩
    
    have hhi : ∀ j ∈ S_hi, a j ≤ ak := by
      intro j hj; simp [S_hi] at hj
      exact ha_mono ⟨k, hkn⟩ j (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)))
    
    have hlo : ∀ i ∈ S_lo, ak ≤ a i := by
      intro i hi; simp [S_lo] at hi
      exact ha_mono i ⟨k, hkn⟩ (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (Nat.le_of_lt hi))
    
    have h1 : ∑ j ∈ S_hi, a j * w j ≤ ak * ∑ j ∈ S_hi, w j := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => by nlinarith [hhi j hj, (hw_range j).1]
    
    have h2 : ak * ∑ i ∈ S_lo, (1 - w i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S_lo, a i * (1 - w i) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => by nlinarith [hlo i hi, (hw_range i).2]
    
    
    have hcard : (S_lo.card : ℝ) = k := by
      suffices h : S_lo.card = k by exact_mod_cast h
      change (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k)).card = k
      rw [show (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k)) =
        Finset.Iio (⟨k, hkn⟩ : Fin n) from by ext; simp [Fin.lt_def]]
      exact Fin.card_Iio _
    have h3 : ∑ j ∈ S_hi, w j ≤ ∑ i ∈ S_lo, (1 - w i) := by
      
      have heq : ∑ i ∈ S_lo, (1 - w i) = ↑S_lo.card - ∑ i ∈ S_lo, w i := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      
      have htotal : ∑ i ∈ S_lo, w i + ∑ i ∈ S_hi, w i = ∑ i, w i := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_union hdisj, hunion]
      linarith [hcard]
    
    have hak : 0 ≤ ak := ha_nonneg _
    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hak]

name: TubalTensor.bessel_row
statement:
private theorem bessel_row {p' r : ℕ} (x : Fin p' → ℂ)
    (V : Matrix (Fin p') (Fin r) ℂ) (hV : Vᴴ * V = 1) :
    ∑ j : Fin r, Complex.normSq (∑ l, x l * V l j) ≤
    ∑ l : Fin p', Complex.normSq (x l)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set w : Fin r → EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin p') :=
    fun j => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun l => star (V l j)) with hw_def
  set x' : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin p') := WithLp.toLp 2 x with hx'_def
  
  have hw : Orthonormal ℂ w := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    intro j₁ j₂
    
    
    
    simp only [hw_def, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply', starRingEnd_apply, star_star]
    
    
    have hstep : ∀ l, V l j₁ * star (V l j₂) = star (star (V l j₁) * V l j₂) := by
      intro l; rw [star_mul', star_star, mul_comm]
    simp_rw [hstep]
    rw [← star_sum]
    have hvv : ∑ l, star (V l j₁) * V l j₂ = (Vᴴ * V) j₁ j₂ := by
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    rw [hvv, hV, Matrix.one_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  
  have hB := hw.sum_inner_products_le x' (s := Finset.univ)
  
  have h_inner : ∀ j : Fin r, @inner ℂ _ _ (w j) x' = ∑ l, x l * V l j := by
    intro j
    simp only [hw_def, hx'_def, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply', starRingEnd_apply,
      star_star]
    congr 1; ext l; ring
  have h_norm_inner : ∀ j : Fin r,
      ‖@inner ℂ _ _ (w j) x'‖ ^ 2 = Complex.normSq (∑ l, x l * V l j) := by
    intro j; rw [h_inner, ← Complex.sq_norm]
  
  have h_norm_x : ‖x'‖ ^ 2 = ∑ l, Complex.normSq (x l) := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    congr 1; ext l
    simp only [hx'_def, PiLp.toLp_apply, ← Complex.sq_norm]
  
  rw [show ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ, ‖@inner ℂ _ _ (w j) x'‖ ^ 2 =
    ∑ j : Fin r, Complex.normSq (∑ l, x l * V l j) from by
    simp_rw [h_norm_inner]]  at hB
  rw [h_norm_x] at hB
  exact hB

name: TubalTensor.frobNormSq_mul_partialIsometry_le
statement:
private theorem frobNormSq_mul_partialIsometry_le {m' p' r : ℕ}
    (D : Matrix (Fin m') (Fin p') ℂ) (V : Matrix (Fin p') (Fin r) ℂ)
    (hV : Vᴴ * V = 1) :
    frobNormSq (D * V) ≤ frobNormSq D
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobNormSq
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
  have : ∀ j, (D * V) i j = ∑ l, D i l * V l j := fun j => by
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp_rw [this]
  exact bessel_row (D i) V hV

name: TubalTensor.weighted_sum_ge_tail
statement:
private theorem weighted_sum_ge_tail {n : ℕ} (a w : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (ha_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (ha_mono : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≤ j → a j ≤ a i)
    (hw_range : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i ∧ w i ≤ 1)
    (hw_sum : n - k ≤ ∑ i, w i) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ¬((i : ℕ) < k)), a i ≤
    ∑ i, a i * w i
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  have hw' : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (1 - w i) ∧ (1 - w i) ≤ 1 := by
    intro i; constructor <;> linarith [(hw_range i).1, (hw_range i).2]
  have hw'_sum : ∑ i, (1 - w) i ≤ k := by
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply]
    have : ∑ i : Fin n, ((1 : ℝ) - w i) = ∑ i, (1 : ℝ) - ∑ i, w i :=
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib (fun _ => 1) w
    rw [this, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    linarith
  have h := weighted_sum_le_head a (1 - w) k ha_nonneg ha_mono (fun i => hw' i) hw'_sum
  
  
  have hexpand : ∑ i, a i * (1 - w) i = ∑ i, a i - ∑ i, a i * w i := by
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply]
    rw [show ∑ i, a i * (1 - w i) = ∑ i, (a i - a i * w i) from by congr 1; ext i; ring]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hexpand] at h
  
  
  
  set S_lo := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k)
  set S_hi := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ¬((i : ℕ) < k))
  have hunion : S_lo ∪ S_hi = Finset.univ := by ext i; simp [S_lo, S_hi]; omega
  have hdisj : Disjoint S_lo S_hi :=
    Finset.disjoint_filter.mpr fun _ _ h1 h2 => h2 h1
  have hsplit : ∑ i, a i = ∑ i ∈ S_lo, a i + ∑ i ∈ S_hi, a i := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_union hdisj, hunion]
  linarith

name: TubalTensor.frobNormSq_conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobNormSq, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  congr 1; ext j; congr 1; ext i
  simp [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, mul_comm]

name: TubalTensor.frob_ge_tail_diag
statement:
private theorem frob_ge_tail_diag {m p : ℕ} {S : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ}
    (hS : IsSVDDiag S) (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hC : C.rank ≤ k) :
    ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin p,
      (if ¬((i : ℕ) < k) ∧ (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then Complex.normSq (↑(S i j)) else 0) ≤
    frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - C)
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases hkm : m ≤ k
  · have : ∀ i : Fin m, (i : ℕ) < k := fun i => by omega
    simp only [show ∀ i : Fin m, ¬¬((i : ℕ) < k) from fun i => not_not.mpr (this i),
      false_and, ite_false, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    exact frobNormSq_nonneg _
  · push Not at hkm 
    
    
    set fE : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin p) :=
      (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Fin p → ℂ)).symm.toLinearMap.comp
        (Cᴴ.mulVecLin.comp (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Fin m → ℂ)).toLinearMap)
    
    have hfE_apply : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m), fE v = WithLp.toLp 2 (Cᴴ *ᵥ v) := by
      intro v; simp [fE]
    
    have hrank_CT : Cᴴ.rank ≤ k := by rw [rank_conjTranspose]; exact hC
    haveI : FiniteDimensional ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) := inferInstance
    have hker_dim : m - k ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.ker fE) := by
      have hrn := fE.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
      simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at hrn
      
      have hrange : Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range fE) ≤ k := by
        
        have : LinearMap.range fE = (LinearMap.range Cᴴ.mulVecLin).map
            (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Fin p → ℂ)).symm.toLinearMap := by
          ext x; simp only [fE, LinearMap.mem_range, Submodule.mem_map, LinearMap.comp_apply,
            LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨Cᴴ.mulVecLin ((WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ _) v),
              ⟨(WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ _) v, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
          · rintro ⟨y, ⟨v, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨(WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ _).symm v, by
              simp⟩
        rw [this]
        rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]
        exact hrank_CT
      omega
    
    set K := LinearMap.ker fE
    haveI : FiniteDimensional ℂ K := Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le le_top
    set r := Module.finrank ℂ K
    set b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ K
    
    set W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin r) ℂ := fun i j => ((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) i
      with hW_def
    
    have hWortho : Wᴴ * W = 1 := by
      ext j₁ j₂
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hW_def]
      
      
      have hinner : ∑ i : Fin m, star (((b j₁ : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) i) *
          (((b j₂ : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) i) =
          @inner ℂ K _ (b j₁ : K) (b j₂ : K) := by
        rw [Submodule.coe_inner]
        simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply', starRingEnd_apply]
      rw [hinner, orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal j₁ j₂]
    
    have hCW : Cᴴ * W = 0 := by
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, hW_def]
      
      have hker : fE ((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) = 0 := by
        exact ((b j : K).prop : ((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) ∈ K)
      rw [hfE_apply] at hker
      
      have hzero : Cᴴ *ᵥ ((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)).ofLp = 0 := by
        have := congr_arg WithLp.ofLp hker
        simpa using this
      
      have : (Cᴴ *ᵥ ((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)).ofLp) i = (0 : Fin p → ℂ) i := by
        rw [hzero]
      simpa [mulVec, dotProduct] using this
    
    have hSCW : (toComplexMatrix S - C)ᴴ * W = (toComplexMatrix S)ᴴ * W := by
      rw [conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hCW, sub_zero]
    
    have hFrob_bound : frobNormSq ((toComplexMatrix S)ᴴ * W) ≤
        frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - C) := by
      calc frobNormSq ((toComplexMatrix S)ᴴ * W)
          = frobNormSq ((toComplexMatrix S - C)ᴴ * W) := by rw [hSCW]
        _ ≤ frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - C)ᴴ :=
          frobNormSq_mul_partialIsometry_le _ W hWortho
        _ = frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - C) :=
          frobNormSq_conjTranspose _
    
    
    set d : Fin m → ℝ := fun i => ∑ j : Fin r, Complex.normSq (W i j) with hd_def
    
    have hd_range : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i ∧ d i ≤ 1 := by
      intro i; constructor
      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _
      · 
        
        set ei : Fin m → ℂ := fun l => if l = i then 1 else 0
        have hei_norm : ∑ l : Fin m, Complex.normSq (ei l) = 1 := by
          simp only [ei]
          rw [show ∑ l : Fin m, Complex.normSq (if l = i then 1 else 0) =
            ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ, (if l = i then Complex.normSq 1 else Complex.normSq 0)
            from by congr 1; ext l; split_ifs <;> rfl]
          simp [Complex.normSq_one, Complex.normSq_zero]
        have hbessel := bessel_row ei W hWortho
        rw [hei_norm] at hbessel
        
        
        have hsimpl : ∀ j : Fin r, ∑ l, ei l * W l j = W i j := by
          intro j; simp only [ei, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']; simp
        simp_rw [hsimpl] at hbessel
        exact hbessel
    
    have hd_sum : (m : ℝ) - k ≤ ∑ i, d i := by
      
      have hd_eq : ∑ i, d i = ∑ j : Fin r, ∑ i : Fin m,
          Complex.normSq (((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) i) := by
        simp only [hd_def, hW_def]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      rw [hd_eq]
      
      have hcol_norm : ∀ j : Fin r, ∑ i : Fin m,
          Complex.normSq (((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) i) = 1 := by
        intro j
        rw [show ∑ i, Complex.normSq (((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)) i) =
          ‖((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m))‖ ^ 2 from by
          rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]; congr 1; ext l
          simp [← Complex.sq_norm]]
        rw [show ‖((b j : K) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m))‖ = ‖(b j : K)‖ from rfl]
        rw [show ‖(b j : K)‖ = 1 from b.orthonormal.1 j]
        norm_num
      simp_rw [hcol_norm, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin]
      have hkm' : k ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt hkm
      have h1 : (m - k : ℕ) ≤ r := hker_dim
      have h2 : ((m - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr h1
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hkm'] at h2
      linarith
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    set sigma2 : Fin m → ℝ := fun i =>
      ∑ j : Fin p, if (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then Complex.normSq (↑(S i j)) else 0
      with hsigma2_def
    
    have hLHS : ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin p,
        (if ¬((i : ℕ) < k) ∧ (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then Complex.normSq (↑(S i j)) else 0) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => ¬((i : ℕ) < k)), sigma2 i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      congr 1; funext i
      by_cases h : ¬((i : ℕ) < k)
      · 
        rw [if_pos h]
        congr 1; funext j
        simp only [h, not_false_eq_true, true_and]
      · 
        push Not at h; rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr h)]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _
        rw [if_neg]; push Not; intro habs; omega
    rw [hLHS]
    
    have hsig_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ sigma2 i := by
      intro i; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => by
        split_ifs <;> [exact Complex.normSq_nonneg _; exact le_refl 0]
    
    have hsig_eq : ∀ i : Fin m, sigma2 i =
        if h : (i : ℕ) < p then Complex.normSq (↑(S i ⟨(i : ℕ), h⟩)) else 0 := by
      intro i; simp only [hsigma2_def]
      split_ifs with hip
      · 
        have : ∀ j : Fin p, (if (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then Complex.normSq (↑(S i j)) else 0) =
            if j = ⟨(i : ℕ), hip⟩ then Complex.normSq (↑(S i j)) else 0 := by
          intro j; congr 1; exact propext ⟨fun h => Fin.ext h.symm,
            fun h => (Fin.ext_iff.mp h).symm⟩
        simp_rw [this]
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']; simp
      · 
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _
        rw [if_neg]; omega
    have hsig_mono : ∀ i₁ i₂ : Fin m, i₁ ≤ i₂ → sigma2 i₂ ≤ sigma2 i₁ := by
      intro i₁ i₂ hle
      rw [hsig_eq i₁, hsig_eq i₂]
      split_ifs with h₂ h₁
      · 
        simp only [Complex.normSq_ofReal]
        exact mul_self_le_mul_self (hS.2.1 i₂ ⟨(i₂ : ℕ), h₂⟩ rfl)
          (hS.2.2 i₁ i₂ ⟨(i₁ : ℕ), h₁⟩ ⟨(i₂ : ℕ), h₂⟩ rfl rfl hle)
      · 
        omega
      · simp only [Complex.normSq_ofReal]
        exact mul_self_nonneg _
      · exact le_refl 0
    
    have hweighted := weighted_sum_ge_tail sigma2 d k hsig_nonneg hsig_mono hd_range hd_sum
    
    
    have hFrob_eq : ∑ i : Fin m, sigma2 i * d i =
        frobNormSq ((toComplexMatrix S)ᴴ * W) := by
      
      
      set cv := ∑ j : Fin p, (if h : (j : ℕ) < m then
        Complex.normSq (↑(S ⟨(j : ℕ), h⟩ j) : ℂ) * d ⟨(j : ℕ), h⟩ else 0) with hcv_def
      
      have hLHS_cv : ∑ i : Fin m, sigma2 i * d i = cv := by
        have expand : ∀ i : Fin m, sigma2 i * d i =
            ∑ j : Fin p, if (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) then
              Complex.normSq (↑(S i j)) * d i else 0 := by
          intro i; simp only [hsigma2_def, Finset.sum_mul]
          congr 1; funext j; split_ifs <;> simp
        simp_rw [expand]; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        congr 1; funext j
        by_cases hjm : (j : ℕ) < m
        · rw [dif_pos hjm]
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨(j : ℕ), hjm⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
          · simp
          · intro i _ hi; rw [if_neg]; exact fun h => hi (Fin.ext h)
        · rw [dif_neg hjm]
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i _
          rw [if_neg]; exact fun h => hjm (h ▸ i.isLt)
      
      have hRHS_cv : frobNormSq ((toComplexMatrix S)ᴴ * W) = cv := by
        unfold frobNormSq
        congr 1; funext j
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
        split_ifs with hjm
        · 
          have hinner : ∀ l : Fin r,
              ∑ i : Fin m, star ((toComplexMatrix S) i j) * W i l =
              ↑(S ⟨(j : ℕ), hjm⟩ j) * W ⟨(j : ℕ), hjm⟩ l := by
            intro l
            rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨(j : ℕ), hjm⟩ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
            · simp [toComplexMatrix, Complex.conj_ofReal]
            · intro i _ hi
              have : (i : ℕ) ≠ (j : ℕ) := fun h => hi (Fin.ext h)
              simp [toComplexMatrix, hS.1 i j this]
          simp_rw [hinner, map_mul]
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        · 
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro l _
          apply Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mpr
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i _
          have hne : (i : ℕ) ≠ (j : ℕ) := fun h => hjm (h ▸ i.isLt)
          simp [toComplexMatrix, hS.1 i j hne]
      linarith [hLHS_cv, hRHS_cv]
    
    calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => ¬((i : ℕ) < k)), sigma2 i
        ≤ ∑ i, sigma2 i * d i := hweighted
      _ = frobNormSq ((toComplexMatrix S)ᴴ * W) := hFrob_eq
      _ ≤ frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - C) := hFrob_bound

name: TubalTensor.diagonal_eckart_young
statement:
theorem diagonal_eckart_young {m p : ℕ} {S : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ}
    (hS : IsSVDDiag S) (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hC : C.rank ≤ k) :
    frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc S hS k)) ≤
    frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix S - C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNormSq_svdDiag_sub_trunc hS k]
  exact frob_ge_tail_diag hS C k hC

name: TubalTensor.eckart_young
statement:
theorem eckart_young {m p : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ}
    (svd : MatrixSVD A)
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hB : B.rank ≤ k) :
    frobNormSq (A - svd.truncApprox k) ≤
    frobNormSq (A - B)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hA_eq' : A = svd.U * toComplexMatrix svd.S * svd.Vᴴ :=
    svd.hA_eq
  
  have hResid : A - svd.truncApprox k =
      svd.U * (toComplexMatrix svd.S - toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc svd.S svd.hS_svdDiag k)) * svd.Vᴴ := by
    simp only [hA_eq', MatrixSVD.truncApprox]
    rw [← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub]
  
  have hAB : A - B =
      svd.U * (toComplexMatrix svd.S - svd.Uᴴ * B * svd.V) * svd.Vᴴ := by
    have hUU : svd.U * svd.Uᴴ = 1 := svd.hU_unitary.mul_conjTranspose_self
    have hVV : svd.V * svd.Vᴴ = 1 := svd.hV_unitary.mul_conjTranspose_self
    have hB_factor : B = svd.U * (svd.Uᴴ * B * svd.V) * svd.Vᴴ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc svd.U (svd.Uᴴ * B * svd.V) svd.Vᴴ,
