        Matrix.mul_assoc (svd.Uᴴ * B) svd.V svd.Vᴴ,
        hVV, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc svd.U svd.Uᴴ B, hUU, Matrix.one_mul]
    conv_lhs => rw [hA_eq', hB_factor]
    rw [← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  
  rw [hResid,
    show frobNormSq (svd.U * (toComplexMatrix svd.S -
      toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc svd.S svd.hS_svdDiag k)) * svd.Vᴴ) =
      frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix svd.S -
        toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc svd.S svd.hS_svdDiag k)) from by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [frobNormSq_unitary_mul_left svd.U _ svd.hU_unitary]
      rw [frobNormSq_unitary_mul_right _ svd.Vᴴ svd.hV_unitary.conjTranspose]]
  rw [hAB,
    show frobNormSq (svd.U * (toComplexMatrix svd.S -
      svd.Uᴴ * B * svd.V) * svd.Vᴴ) =
      frobNormSq (toComplexMatrix svd.S - svd.Uᴴ * B * svd.V) from by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [frobNormSq_unitary_mul_left svd.U _ svd.hU_unitary]
      rw [frobNormSq_unitary_mul_right _ svd.Vᴴ svd.hV_unitary.conjTranspose]]
  
  exact diagonal_eckart_young svd.hS_svdDiag _ k
    (rank_conj_le svd.U svd.V svd.hU_unitary svd.hV_unitary B k hB)

name: TubalTensor.col_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext j i; simp [Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, hv]

name: TubalTensor.isMatDiag_of_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top
statement:
theorem isMatDiag_of_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (h_top : (⨆ μ, (complexEnd A).eigenspace μ) = ⊤) :
    IsMatDiag A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Ac := A.map toℂ with hAc_def
  set f := complexEnd A with hf_def
  
  have h_ind : iSupIndep f.eigenspace := f.eigenspaces_iSupIndep
  have h_int : DirectSum.IsInternal (fun μ : ℂ => f.eigenspace μ) :=
    DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top h_ind h_top
  
  haveI (μ : ℂ) : Module.Free ℂ ↥(f.eigenspace μ) :=
    @Module.Free.of_divisionRing ℂ ↥(f.eigenspace μ) _ _ _
  set bμ := fun μ : ℂ => Module.finBasis ℂ ↥(f.eigenspace μ)
  
  set cb := h_int.collectedBasis bμ with hcb_def
  
  haveI : Finite (Σ μ : ℂ, Fin (finrank ℂ ↥(f.eigenspace μ))) :=
    Module.Finite.finite_basis cb
  haveI : Fintype (Σ μ : ℂ, Fin (finrank ℂ ↥(f.eigenspace μ))) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have h_card : Fintype.card (Σ μ : ℂ, Fin (finrank ℂ ↥(f.eigenspace μ))) = n := by
    have h1 := finrank_eq_card_basis cb
    have h2 : finrank ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) = n := finrank_fin_fun ℂ
    linarith
  
  set e := (Fintype.equivFin _).trans (finCongr h_card)
  set b := cb.reindex e with hb_def
  
  set ev : Fin n → ℂ := fun j => (e.symm j).1
  
  have h_mem : ∀ j, (b j : Fin n → ℂ) ∈ f.eigenspace (ev j) := by
    intro j
    simp only [hb_def, Basis.reindex_apply, ev]
    rw [DirectSum.IsInternal.collectedBasis_coe]
    exact SetLike.coe_mem _
  have h_eig : ∀ j, f (b j) = ev j • (b j : Fin n → ℂ) := by
    intro j
    have hj := h_mem j
    rwa [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff] at hj
  
  set S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ := Matrix.of (fun i j => (b j : Fin n → ℂ) i) with hS_def
  set D := Matrix.diagonal ev
  
  have hS_col : S.col = (↑b : Fin n → Fin n → ℂ) :=
    col_of_eq S (↑b) (fun i j => by simp [hS_def, Matrix.of_apply])
  have hSu : IsUnit S :=
    linearIndependent_cols_iff_isUnit.mp (hS_col ▸ b.linearIndependent)
  
  have hDdiag : D.IsDiag := Matrix.isDiag_diagonal ev
  
  
  have hS_mulVec : ∀ j, S *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) = b j := by
    intro j; ext i
    simp [mulVec, dotProduct, hS_def, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  
  have hAS : Ac * S = S * D := by
    ext i j
    
    
    
    
    show ∑ k, Ac i k * S k j = ∑ k, S i k * D k j
    
    have hLHS : ∑ k, Ac i k * S k j = (Ac *ᵥ (b j : Fin n → ℂ)) i := by
      simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, hS_def, Matrix.of_apply]
    
    have hRHS : ∑ k, S i k * D k j = (b j : Fin n → ℂ) i * ev j := by
      simp only [hS_def, Matrix.of_apply, D, diagonal_apply, mul_ite, mul_zero,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [hLHS, hRHS]
    
    have h := congr_fun (h_eig j) i
    simp only [hf_def, complexEnd, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
    rw [h, mul_comm]
  
  have hSS : S * S⁻¹ = 1 :=
    mul_nonsing_inv S ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).mp hSu)
  refine ⟨S, D, hSu, hDdiag, ?_⟩
  calc Ac = Ac * 1 := (mul_one Ac).symm
    _ = Ac * (S * S⁻¹) := by rw [hSS]
    _ = Ac * S * S⁻¹ := (mul_assoc Ac S S⁻¹).symm
    _ = S * D * S⁻¹ := by rw [hAS]

name: TubalTensor.isMatDiag_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isMatDiag_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {p : ℂ[X]} (hp_sq : Squarefree p)
    (hp_ann : Polynomial.aeval (complexEnd A) p = 0) :
    IsMatDiag A
proof:
:= by
  set f := complexEnd A
  have h_ss : f.IsSemisimple :=
    Module.End.isSemisimple_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero hp_sq hp_ann
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsAlgClosed ℂ := Complex.isAlgClosed
  have h_fss := h_ss.isFinitelySemisimple (R := ℂ) (M := Fin n → ℂ)
  have h_eq : ∀ μ : ℂ, f.maxGenEigenspace μ = f.eigenspace μ :=
    fun μ => h_fss.maxGenEigenspace_eq_eigenspace μ
  have h_top_gen : (⨆ μ, f.maxGenEigenspace μ) = ⊤ :=
    Module.End.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top f
  have h_top : (⨆ μ, f.eigenspace μ) = ⊤ := by
    simp_rw [← h_eq]; exact h_top_gen
  exact isMatDiag_of_iSup_eigenspace_eq_top A h_top

name: TubalTensor.comm_frobenius
statement:
theorem comm_frobenius (F : Type*) [Field F] [Algebra ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] :
    finrank ℝ F ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := Field.exists_primitive_element ℝ F
  
  have hα_int : IsIntegral ℝ α := IsIntegral.of_finite ℝ α
  
  have hfr : finrank ℝ F = (minpoly ℝ α).natDegree := by
    have h1 := IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hα_int
    have h2 : finrank ℝ ↥(⊤ : IntermediateField ℝ F) = finrank ℝ F :=
      LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (IntermediateField.topEquiv).toLinearEquiv
    rw [hα] at h1; linarith
  
  rw [hfr]
  exact (minpoly.irreducible hα_int).natDegree_le_two

name: TubalTensor.frobNormSq_nonneg
statement:
theorem frobNormSq_nonneg {m p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ) :
    0 ≤ frobNormSq A
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _

name: TubalTensor.frobNormSq_eq_re_trace
statement:
theorem frobNormSq_eq_re_trace {m p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ) :
    frobNormSq A = (Matrix.trace (Aᴴ * A)).re
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobNormSq
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  have key : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.normSq z = (star z * z).re := by
    intro z; simp [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  simp_rw [key]
  simp only [Complex.re_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: TubalTensor.frobNormSq_unitary_mul_left
statement:
theorem frobNormSq_unitary_mul_left {m p : ℕ}
    (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (hU : IsUnitary U) :
    frobNormSq (U * X) = frobNormSq X
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNormSq_eq_re_trace, frobNormSq_eq_re_trace]
  congr 1
  rw [conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᴴ U X,
    hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]

name: TubalTensor.frobNormSq_unitary_mul_right
statement:
theorem frobNormSq_unitary_mul_right {m p : ℕ}
    (X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ) (V : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℂ)
    (hV : IsUnitary V) :
    frobNormSq (X * V) = frobNormSq X
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobNormSq_eq_re_trace, frobNormSq_eq_re_trace]
  congr 1
  rw [conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ Xᴴ (X * V),
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc Xᴴ X V,
    Matrix.trace_mul_cycle' Vᴴ (Xᴴ * X) V,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc V Vᴴ (Xᴴ * X),
    hV.mul_conjTranspose_self, Matrix.one_mul]

name: TubalTensor.IsUnitary.conjTranspose_mul_self
TubalTensor.IsUnitary.mul_conjTranspose_self
proof:
:=
  (mul_eq_one_comm_of_card_eq (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜 rfl).mp h

name: TubalTensor.IsUnitary.conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  show Aᴴᴴ * Aᴴ = 1
  rw [conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  exact h.mul_conjTranspose_self

name: TubalTensor.IsSVDDiag.toComplex

theorem IsSVDDiag.toComplex {m p : ℕ} {S : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ}

name: TubalTensor.svdEigval_antitone
statement:
private lemma svdEigval_antitone (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) 𝕜) :

proof:

  intro a b hab
  exact (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A).eigenvalues₀_antitone hab

name: TubalTensor.svdEigval_nonneg
statement:
private lemma svdEigval_nonneg (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) 𝕜) (j : Fin p) :
    0 ≤ svdEigval A j
proof:
:= by
  unfold svdEigval
  have hA := isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  
  have heq : ∀ k, hA.eigenvalues₀ k =
      hA.eigenvalues ((Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin p)) ≃ Fin p) k) := by
    intro k
    simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [heq]
  exact eigenvalues_conjTranspose_mul_self_nonneg A _

name: TubalTensor.mulVec_svdONB
statement:
private lemma mulVec_svdONB (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) 𝕜) (j : Fin p) :
    (Aᴴ * A) *ᵥ (svdONB A j).ofLp = (svdEigval A j : 𝕜) • (svdONB A j).ofLp
proof:
:= by
  set sym := isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.symm.1 (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A)
  set k := (finCongr (Fintype.card_fin p)).symm j
  
  have hv : (svdONB A j : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin p)) = sym.eigenvectorBasis finrank_euclideanSpace k := by
    simp only [svdONB, OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply]; congr 1
  
  have heval : svdEigval A j = sym.eigenvalues finrank_euclideanSpace k := by
    simp only [svdEigval, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀]; congr 1
  
  have heig := sym.apply_eigenvectorBasis finrank_euclideanSpace k
  
  
  have := congr_arg WithLp.ofLp heig
  simp only [toLpLin_apply, WithLp.ofLp_toLp, WithLp.ofLp_smul] at this
  rw [← hv, ← heval] at this
  exact this

name: TubalTensor.svdV_unitary
statement: private lemma svdV_unitary (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) 𝕜) : IsUnitary (svdV A)

name: TubalTensor.svdS_isSVDDiag
statement: private lemma svdS_isSVDDiag (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) 𝕜) : IsSVDDiag (svdS A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i j hij => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_, fun i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂ hle => ?_⟩
  · simp [svdS, hij]
  · simp only [svdS, hij, ite_true]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  · simp only [svdS, h₁, h₂, ite_true]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (svdEigval_antitone A (show j₁ ≤ j₂ by omega))

name: TubalTensor.svdPartialU_orthonormal
statement:
private lemma svdPartialU_orthonormal (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) 𝕜) :
    Orthonormal 𝕜 ((svdActiveSet A).restrict (svdPartialU A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ ⟨i₂, hi₂⟩
  set j₁ := Classical.choose hi₁
  set j₂ := Classical.choose hi₂
  have hj₁_val : (j₁ : ℕ) = (i₁ : ℕ) := (Classical.choose_spec hi₁).1
  have hj₁_ne : svdEigval A j₁ ≠ 0 := (Classical.choose_spec hi₁).2
  have hj₂_val : (j₂ : ℕ) = (i₂ : ℕ) := (Classical.choose_spec hi₂).1
  have hj₂_ne : svdEigval A j₂ ≠ 0 := (Classical.choose_spec hi₂).2
  have hu₁ : svdPartialU A i₁ = ((Real.sqrt (svdEigval A j₁))⁻¹ : 𝕜) •
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (svdONB A j₁).ofLp) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m)) :=
    dif_pos hi₁
  have hu₂ : svdPartialU A i₂ = ((Real.sqrt (svdEigval A j₂))⁻¹ : 𝕜) •
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (svdONB A j₂).ofLp) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m)) :=
    dif_pos hi₂
  simp only [Set.restrict, hu₁, hu₂]
  rw [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right]
  
  have inner_Av : @inner 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m)) _
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (svdONB A j₁).ofLp))
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (svdONB A j₂).ofLp)) =
      (svdEigval A j₂ : 𝕜) * @inner 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin p)) _
        (svdONB A j₁) (svdONB A j₂) := by
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    
    rw [star_mulVec, dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ _), dotProduct_mulVec, vecMul_vecMul,
        ← dotProduct_mulVec, mulVec_svdONB, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm]
  rw [inner_Av]
  have honb := (svdONB A).orthonormal
  simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq]
  by_cases h : i₁ = i₂
  · have hj_eq : j₁ = j₂ := Fin.ext (by omega)
    rw [if_pos h, hj_eq]
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite.mp honb j₂ j₂, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
    have hσ_ne : (Real.sqrt (svdEigval A j₂) : 𝕜) ≠ 0 :=
      RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
        (lt_of_le_of_ne (svdEigval_nonneg A j₂) (Ne.symm hj₂_ne))))
    have hsqeig : (svdEigval A j₂ : 𝕜) =
        (Real.sqrt (svdEigval A j₂) : 𝕜) * (Real.sqrt (svdEigval A j₂) : 𝕜) := by
      rw [← RCLike.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt (svdEigval_nonneg A j₂)]
    rw [hsqeig]
    simp only [map_inv₀, RCLike.conj_ofReal]
    field_simp
  · have hj_ne : j₁ ≠ j₂ := fun h' => h (Fin.ext (by omega))
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite.mp honb j₁ j₂, if_neg hj_ne, mul_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero, if_neg h]

name: TubalTensor.basis_toMatrix_onb_unitary
statement:

    IsUnitary ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin k) 𝕜).toBasis.toMatrix b.toBasis)
proof:

  have hmem := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin k) 𝕜).toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b
  rwa [Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'] at hmem

name: TubalTensor.svdUMatrix_unitary

private lemma svdUMatrix_unitary (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) 𝕜) :

name: TubalTensor.svdUONB_eq_partialU
proof:
:=
  ((svdPartialU_orthonormal A).exists_orthonormalBasis_extension_of_card_eq
    finrank_euclideanSpace).choose_spec i hi

name: TubalTensor.mulVec_svdONB_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have heig := mulVec_svdONB A j
  rw [hj, RCLike.ofReal_zero, zero_smul] at heig
  
  set v := (svdONB A j).ofLp
  set Av_lp : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m) := WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)
  have hinner : @inner 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m)) _ Av_lp Av_lp = 0 := by
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, Av_lp]
    
    have hstar : star (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = 0 := by
      rw [star_mulVec, ← dotProduct_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec, heig, dotProduct_zero]
    rw [← starRingEnd_self_apply (A *ᵥ v ⬝ᵥ star (A *ᵥ v))]
    simp only [dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ v) (star (A *ᵥ v)), hstar, map_zero]
  have hAv_zero : Av_lp = 0 := (inner_self_eq_zero (𝕜 := 𝕜)).mp hinner
  have : A *ᵥ v = WithLp.ofLp Av_lp := (WithLp.ofLp_toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)).symm
  rw [this, hAv_zero]; rfl

name: TubalTensor.svd_eq
statement:
private lemma svd_eq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) 𝕜) :
    A = svdUMatrix A * (svdS A).map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) * (svdV A)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices h : A * svdV A = svdUMatrix A * (svdS A).map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) by
    have hVu := svdV_unitary A
    calc A = A * (svdV A * (svdV A)ᴴ) := by rw [hVu.mul_conjTranspose_self, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = A * svdV A * (svdV A)ᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = svdUMatrix A * (svdS A).map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) * (svdV A)ᴴ := by rw [h]
  
  ext i j
  
  have hLHS : (A * svdV A) i j = (A *ᵥ (svdONB A j).ofLp) i := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, mulVec, dotProduct, svdV,
      Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr]
    rfl
  rw [hLHS]
  
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply, svdS]
  
  by_cases hev : svdEigval A j = 0
  · 
    have hAv := mulVec_svdONB_eq_zero A j hev
    simp only [hAv, Pi.zero_apply, hev, Real.sqrt_zero, map_zero, ite_self, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · 
    by_cases hjm : (j : ℕ) < m
    · 
      set k₀ : Fin m := ⟨j.val, hjm⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem k₀ (Finset.mem_univ _)]
      · 
        simp only [k₀, show (⟨j.val, hjm⟩ : Fin m).val = (j : ℕ) from rfl, ite_true]
        
        have hactive : k₀ ∈ svdActiveSet A := ⟨j, rfl, hev⟩
        have hueq := svdUONB_eq_partialU A k₀ hactive
        
        have hcc : Classical.choose hactive = j :=
          Fin.ext (Classical.choose_spec hactive).1
        
        have hpu : svdPartialU A k₀ = ((Real.sqrt (svdEigval A j))⁻¹ : 𝕜) •
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (svdONB A j).ofLp) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m)) := by
          show svdPartialU A k₀ = _
          unfold svdPartialU
          split
          · next h =>
            have hj_eq : Classical.choose h = j :=
              Fin.ext (Classical.choose_spec h).1
            simp only [hj_eq]
          · next h => exact absurd hactive h
        
        have hUik : svdUMatrix A i k₀ =
            ((Real.sqrt (svdEigval A j))⁻¹ : 𝕜) * (A *ᵥ (svdONB A j).ofLp) i := by
          
          
          
          
          
          have : svdUMatrix A i k₀ = (svdUONB A k₀ : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m)) i := by
            simp [svdUMatrix, Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr]
          rw [this, hueq, hpu]
          simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, WithLp.ofLp_toLp]
        rw [hUik]
        
        have hσ_ne : (Real.sqrt (svdEigval A j) : 𝕜) ≠ 0 :=
          RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
            (lt_of_le_of_ne (svdEigval_nonneg A j) (Ne.symm hev))))
        field_simp
      · 
        intro k _ hk
        have : ¬((k : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)) := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
        simp [this]
    · 
      
      
      exfalso
      have hev_all : ∀ k : Fin p, (k : ℕ) ≤ (j : ℕ) → svdEigval A k ≠ 0 := by
        intro k hk habs
        have h1 : svdEigval A j ≤ svdEigval A k := svdEigval_antitone A hk
        have h2 : 0 ≤ svdEigval A j := svdEigval_nonneg A j
        exact hev (le_antisymm (habs ▸ h1) h2)
      
      set f : Fin (m + 1) → EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m) := fun k =>
        let kp : Fin p := ⟨k.val, by omega⟩
        ((Real.sqrt (svdEigval A kp))⁻¹ : 𝕜) •
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (svdONB A kp).ofLp) : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m))
      have hf_on : Orthonormal 𝕜 f := by
        rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
        intro ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩
        simp only [f]
        set ka : Fin p := ⟨a, by omega⟩
        set kb : Fin p := ⟨b, by omega⟩
        rw [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right]
        have inner_Av : @inner 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m)) _
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (svdONB A ka).ofLp))
            (WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (svdONB A kb).ofLp)) =
            (svdEigval A kb : 𝕜) * @inner 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin p)) _
              (svdONB A ka) (svdONB A kb) := by
          simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
          rw [star_mulVec, dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ _), dotProduct_mulVec, vecMul_vecMul,
              ← dotProduct_mulVec, mulVec_svdONB, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm]
        rw [inner_Av]
        have honb := (svdONB A).orthonormal
        by_cases hab : a = b
        · subst hab
          have hka_ne := hev_all ka (show (ka : ℕ) ≤ (j : ℕ) by simp [ka]; omega)
          rw [show ka = kb from rfl, orthonormal_iff_ite.mp honb kb kb, if_pos rfl, mul_one,
              if_pos rfl]
          have hσ_ne : (Real.sqrt (svdEigval A kb) : 𝕜) ≠ 0 :=
            RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
              (lt_of_le_of_ne (svdEigval_nonneg A kb) (Ne.symm hka_ne))))
          rw [show (svdEigval A kb : 𝕜) =
              (Real.sqrt (svdEigval A kb) : 𝕜) * (Real.sqrt (svdEigval A kb) : 𝕜) from by
            rw [← RCLike.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt (svdEigval_nonneg A kb)]]
          simp only [map_inv₀, RCLike.conj_ofReal]
          field_simp
        · have hkab : ka ≠ kb := fun h => hab (by simp [ka, kb] at h; exact h)
          rw [orthonormal_iff_ite.mp honb ka kb, if_neg hkab, mul_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero,
              if_neg (fun h => hab (Fin.mk.inj h))]
      
      have := hf_on.linearIndependent.fintype_card_le_finrank
      simp [finrank_euclideanSpace] at this

lemma realPartMatrix_map_eq {m p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℂ)

name: TubalTensor.real_map_ofReal_unitary
statement:
private lemma real_map_ofReal_unitary {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hM : Mᴴ * M = 1) : IsUnitary (M.map Complex.ofReal)
proof:
:= by
  show (M.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ * M.map Complex.ofReal = 1
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.map_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  rw [show (∑ k, ↑(M k i) * ↑(M k j)) = (↑(∑ k, M k i * M k j) : ℂ) from by push_cast; ring]
  have := congr_fun₂ hM i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, Matrix.one_apply] at this
  rw [this]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: TubalTensor.isSVDDiag_svdTrunc
statement:
theorem isSVDDiag_svdTrunc {m p : ℕ} {S : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ}
    (hS : IsSVDDiag S) (k : ℕ) : IsSVDDiag (svdTrunc S hS k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro i j hij
    simp only [svdTrunc, if_neg (not_and_of_not_right _ hij)]
  · 
    intro i j hij
    simp only [svdTrunc]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hS.2.1 i j hij
    · rfl
  · 
    intro i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂ hle
    simp only [svdTrunc]
    
    by_cases hi₂ : (i₂ : ℕ) < k ∧ (i₂ : ℕ) = (j₂ : ℕ)
    · by_cases hi₁ : (i₁ : ℕ) < k ∧ (i₁ : ℕ) = (j₁ : ℕ)
      · rw [if_pos hi₂, if_pos hi₁]; exact hS.2.2 i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂ hle
      · 
        exfalso; apply hi₁; exact ⟨by omega, h₁⟩
    · by_cases hi₁ : (i₁ : ℕ) < k ∧ (i₁ : ℕ) = (j₁ : ℕ)
      · rw [if_neg hi₂, if_pos hi₁]; exact hS.2.1 i₁ j₁ h₁
      · rw [if_neg hi₂, if_neg hi₁]

name: TubalTensor.MatrixSVD.rank_truncApprox_le
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncApprox
  
  have hUdet : IsUnit svd.U.det :=
    isUnit_det_of_left_inverse svd.hU_unitary.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have hVHdet : IsUnit svd.Vᴴ.det := by
    rw [det_conjTranspose]
    exact (isUnit_det_of_left_inverse svd.hV_unitary.conjTranspose_mul_self).star
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,
    rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det _ _ hUdet,
    rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det _ _ hVHdet]
  
  
  set w : Fin m → ℂ := fun i => if (i : ℕ) < k then 1 else 0
  have hPSk : toComplexMatrix (svdTrunc svd.S svd.hS_svdDiag k) =
      diagonal w * toComplexMatrix svd.S := by
    ext i j
    simp only [toComplexMatrix, svdTrunc, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, w,
      diagonal_apply]
    by_cases h : (i : ℕ) < k
    · 
      by_cases hij : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ)
      · 
        rw [if_pos ⟨h, hij⟩]; symm
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_univ _)]
        · simp [if_pos h]
        · intro b _ hb; simp [show ¬(i = b) from fun h => hb h.symm]
      · 
        rw [if_neg (not_and_of_not_right _ hij)]; symm
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_univ _)]
        · simp [if_pos h, svd.hS_svdDiag.1 i j hij]
        · intro b _ hb; simp [show ¬(i = b) from fun h => hb h.symm]
    · 
      rw [if_neg (not_and_of_not_left _ h), Complex.ofReal_zero]; symm
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro b _
      simp only [ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
      split_ifs with hb <;> simp_all
  rw [hPSk]
  calc (diagonal w * toComplexMatrix svd.S).rank
      ≤ (diagonal w).rank := rank_mul_le_left _ _
    _ ≤ k := by
        have := rank_diagonal w
        rw [this]
        
        
        have hw : ∀ i : Fin m, w i ≠ 0 ↔ (i : ℕ) < k := by
          intro i; simp only [w]; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
        
        apply le_trans (Fintype.card_le_of_injective
          (fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => (⟨(i : ℕ), (hw i).mp hi⟩ : Fin k))
          (fun ⟨a, _⟩ ⟨b, _⟩ h => by
            have := Fin.mk.inj h
            exact Subtype.ext (Fin.ext this)))
        simp

name: TubalTensor.KM.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {a b : KM n td} (h : ∀ i, toFun a i = toFun b i) : a = b
proof:
:=
  funext h

name: TubalTensor.KM.starMC_assoc
statement:
private theorem starMC_assoc (td : TubalData n) (a b c : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starMC td (starMC td a b) c = starMC td a (starMC td b c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold starMC
  congr 1
  rw [td.applyM_applyMinv, td.applyM_applyMinv]
  exact vecHadamard_assoc _ _ _

name: TubalTensor.KM.starMC_comm
statement:
private theorem starMC_comm (td : TubalData n) (a b : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starMC td a b = starMC td b a
proof:
:= by
  unfold starMC
  congr 1
  exact vecHadamard_comm _ _

name: TubalTensor.KM.starMC_add_left
statement:
private theorem starMC_add_left (td : TubalData n) (a b c : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starMC td (a + b) c = starMC td a c + starMC td b c
proof:
:= by
  show td.applyMinv _ = td.applyMinv _ + td.applyMinv _
  rw [← td.applyMinv_add]
  congr 1
  show td.applyM (a + b) ∘ₕ td.applyM c =
    td.applyM a ∘ₕ td.applyM c + td.applyM b ∘ₕ td.applyM c
  rw [td.applyM_add, vecHadamard_right_distrib]

name: TubalTensor.KM.starMC_one_left

private theorem starMC_one_left (td : TubalData n) (a : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starMC td (td.applyMinv (allOnes n)) a = a
proof:
:= by
  unfold starMC
  rw [td.applyM_applyMinv, vecHadamard_allOnes_left]
  exact td.applyMinv_applyM a

name: TubalTensor.KM.starMC_zero_left
statement:
private theorem starMC_zero_left (td : TubalData n) (a : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starMC td 0 a = 0
proof:
:= by
  show td.applyMinv (td.applyM (0 : Fin n → ℂ) ∘ₕ td.applyM a) = 0
  have h1 : td.applyM (0 : Fin n → ℂ) = 0 := Matrix.mulVec_zero _
  rw [h1, vecHadamard_zero_left]
  show td.M_inv *ᵥ (0 : Fin n → ℂ) = 0
  exact Matrix.mulVec_zero _

name: TubalTensor.KM.starMC_neg_left
statement:
private theorem starMC_neg_left (td : TubalData n) (a b : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starMC td (-a) b = -starMC td a b
proof:
:= by
  show td.applyMinv (td.applyM (-a) ∘ₕ td.applyM b) =
    -td.applyMinv (td.applyM a ∘ₕ td.applyM b)
  rw [show td.applyM (-a) = -td.applyM a from Matrix.mulVec_neg _ _]
  rw [vecHadamard_neg_left]
  show td.M_inv *ᵥ -(td.applyM a ∘ₕ td.applyM b) =
    -(td.M_inv *ᵥ (td.applyM a ∘ₕ td.applyM b))
  exact Matrix.mulVec_neg _ td.M_inv

name: TubalTensor.KM.starM_neg_left

theorem starM_neg_left (td : TubalData n) (a b : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: TubalTensor.KM.smul_starM
statement:
private theorem smul_starM (td : TubalData n) (r : ℝ) (a b : Fin n → ℝ) :
    starM td (r • a) b = r • starM td a b
proof:
:= by
  apply toComplex_injective
  rw [toComplex_smul, starM_eq_starMC, starM_eq_starMC, toComplex_smul]
  show td.applyMinv (td.applyM ((r : ℂ) • toComplex a) ∘ₕ td.applyM (toComplex b)) =
    (r : ℂ) • td.applyMinv (td.applyM (toComplex a) ∘ₕ td.applyM (toComplex b))
  unfold TubalData.applyM TubalData.applyMinv
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, vecHadamard_smul_left, ← Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: TubalTensor.vecConj_applyM_hasPairedStructure
statement:
private theorem vecConj_applyM_hasPairedStructure (td : TubalData n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    HasRealPairedStructure td (vecConj (td.applyM (toComplex a)))
proof:
:= by
  have hps := applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td a
  constructor
  · intro i hreal
    simp only [vecConj_apply]
    have him := hps.1 i hreal
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_im, neg_eq_zero]
    exact him
  · intro i k hki hconj
    
    
    
    show starRingEnd ℂ (td.applyM (toComplex a) k) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ (td.applyM (toComplex a) i))
    congr 1; exact hps.2 i k hki hconj

name: TubalTensor.starConjC_involutive
statement:
private theorem starConjC_involutive (td : TubalData n) (a : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starConjC td (starConjC td a) = a
proof:
:= by
  unfold starConjC
  rw [td.applyM_applyMinv]
  
  
  have : vecConj (vecConj (td.applyM a)) = td.applyM a := by
    ext i
    show starRingEnd ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ (td.applyM a i)) = td.applyM a i
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_star]
  rw [this]
  exact td.applyMinv_applyM a

name: TubalTensor.starConjC_add
statement:
private theorem starConjC_add (td : TubalData n) (a b : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starConjC td (a + b) = starConjC td a + starConjC td b
proof:
:= by
  unfold starConjC
  rw [td.applyM_add]
  
  have : vecConj (td.applyM a + td.applyM b) = vecConj (td.applyM a) + vecConj (td.applyM b) := by
    ext i; simp [vecConj_apply, map_add]
  rw [this]
  exact td.applyMinv_add _ _

name: TubalTensor.starConjC_mul
statement:
private theorem starConjC_mul (td : TubalData n) (a b : Fin n → ℂ) :
    starConjC td (starMC td a b) = starMC td (starConjC td a) (starConjC td b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold starConjC starMC
  
  
  
  rw [td.applyM_applyMinv]
  
  
  rw [td.applyM_applyMinv, td.applyM_applyMinv]
  
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp [vecConj_apply, vecHadamard_apply, map_mul]

theorem starConjM_involutive (td : TubalData n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: TubalTensor.vecPseudoInv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vecPseudoInv_apply {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℂ) (i : Fin n) :
    vecPseudoInv v i = if v i = 0 then 0 else (v i)⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.vecPseudoInv_mp1
statement:
theorem vecPseudoInv_mp1 {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℂ) :
    v ∘ₕ vecPseudoInv v ∘ₕ v = v
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp only [vecHadamard_apply, vecPseudoInv_apply]
  by_cases h : v i = 0 <;> simp [h]

name: TubalTensor.vecPseudoInv_mp2
statement:
theorem vecPseudoInv_mp2 {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℂ) :
    vecPseudoInv v ∘ₕ v ∘ₕ vecPseudoInv v = vecPseudoInv v
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp only [vecHadamard_apply, vecPseudoInv_apply]
  by_cases h : v i = 0 <;> simp [h]

name: TubalTensor.vecPseudoInv_proj_real
statement:
theorem vecPseudoInv_proj_real {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℂ) (i : Fin n) :
    ((v ∘ₕ vecPseudoInv v) i).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vecHadamard_apply, vecPseudoInv_apply]
  by_cases h : v i = 0
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

name: TubalTensor.vecPseudoInv_proj_self_conj
statement:
theorem vecPseudoInv_proj_self_conj {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℂ) :
    vecConj (v ∘ₕ vecPseudoInv v) = v ∘ₕ vecPseudoInv v
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  show starRingEnd ℂ ((v ∘ₕ vecPseudoInv v) i) = (v ∘ₕ vecPseudoInv v) i
  rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr (vecPseudoInv_proj_real v i)]

name: TubalTensor.vecPseudoInv_comm
statement:
theorem vecPseudoInv_comm {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℂ) :
    vecPseudoInv v ∘ₕ v = v ∘ₕ vecPseudoInv v
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp only [vecHadamard_apply, vecPseudoInv_apply]
  by_cases h : v i = 0 <;> simp [h]

name: TubalTensor.vecConj_vecPseudoInv
statement:
theorem vecConj_vecPseudoInv {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℂ) :
    vecConj (vecPseudoInv v) = vecPseudoInv (vecConj v)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [vecConj_apply, vecPseudoInv_apply]
  by_cases h : v i = 0
  · simp [h]
  · have hc : starRingEnd ℂ (v i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro habs; apply h
      have := congr_arg (starRingEnd ℂ) habs
      rwa [map_zero, starRingEnd_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_star] at this
    simp [h, hc, map_inv₀]

name: TubalTensor.vecPseudoInv_hasPairedStructure
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i hreal
    simp only [vecPseudoInv_apply]
    split
    · simp
    · next h =>
      
      have him := hv.1 i hreal
      have hre_ne : (v i).re ≠ 0 := by
        intro habs
        apply h
        exact Complex.ext habs him
      rw [Complex.inv_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
      simp [him]
  · intro i k hki hconj
    simp only [vecPseudoInv_apply]
    have hvk := hv.2 i k hki hconj
    by_cases h : v i = 0
    · have hk : v k = 0 := by rw [hvk]; simp [h]
      simp [h, hk]
    · have hk : v k ≠ 0 := by
        intro habs; apply h
        have : starRingEnd ℂ (v k) = 0 := by rw [habs]; simp
        rw [hvk, starRingEnd_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_star] at this
        exact this
      simp [h, hvk, map_inv₀]

name: TubalTensor.weakInvM_mp4

theorem weakInvM_mp4 (td : TubalData n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: TubalTensor.weakInvC_unique
statement:
private theorem weakInvC_unique (td : TubalData n) (a y : Fin n → ℂ)
    (h1 : starMC td (starMC td a y) a = a)
    (h2 : starMC td (starMC td y a) y = y)
    (_h3 : starConjC td (starMC td a y) = starMC td a y)
    (_h4 : starConjC td (starMC td y a) = starMC td y a) :
    y = weakInvC td a
proof:
:= by
  
  apply td.applyM_injective
  rw [applyM_weakInvC]
  
  have hh1 : td.applyM a ∘ₕ td.applyM y ∘ₕ td.applyM a = td.applyM a := by
    have := congr_arg td.applyM h1; rwa [applyM_starMC, applyM_starMC] at this
  have hh2 : td.applyM y ∘ₕ td.applyM a ∘ₕ td.applyM y = td.applyM y := by
    have := congr_arg td.applyM h2; rwa [applyM_starMC, applyM_starMC] at this
  
  set u := td.applyM a
  set v := td.applyM y
  ext i
  simp only [vecPseudoInv_apply]
  
  by_cases hu : u i = 0
  · 
    have h2i := congr_fun hh2 i
    simp only [vecHadamard_apply, hu, mul_zero, zero_mul] at h2i
    simp [hu, h2i.symm]
  · 
    have h1i := congr_fun hh1 i
    simp only [vecHadamard_apply] at h1i
    
    have hvu : u i * v i = 1 := by
      have key : u i * v i * u i = 1 * u i := by rw [h1i, one_mul]
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ hu key
    
    simp [hu]
    calc v i = 1 * v i := (one_mul _).symm
    _ = (u i)⁻¹ * u i * v i := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hu]
    _ = (u i)⁻¹ * (u i * v i) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = (u i)⁻¹ * 1 := by rw [hvu]
    _ = (u i)⁻¹ := mul_one _

name: TubalTensor.weakInvM_unique
statement:
theorem weakInvM_unique (td : TubalData n) (a y : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h1 : starM td (starM td a y) a = a)
    (h2 : starM td (starM td y a) y = y)
    (h3 : starConjM td (starM td a y) = starM td a y)
    (h4 : starConjM td (starM td y a) = starM td y a) :
    y = weakInvM td a
proof:
:= by
  apply toComplex_injective
  rw [weakInvM_eq_weakInvC]
  apply weakInvC_unique
  · apply_fun toComplex at h1 using toComplex_injective
    rwa [starM_eq_starMC, starM_eq_starMC] at h1
  · apply_fun toComplex at h2 using toComplex_injective
    rwa [starM_eq_starMC, starM_eq_starMC] at h2
  · apply_fun toComplex at h3 using toComplex_injective
    rwa [starConjM_eq_starConjC, starM_eq_starMC] at h3
  · apply_fun toComplex at h4 using toComplex_injective
    rwa [starConjM_eq_starConjC, starM_eq_starMC] at h4

name: TubalTensor.weakInvM_moorePenrose
statement:
theorem weakInvM_moorePenrose (td : TubalData n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    starM td (starM td a (weakInvM td a)) a = a ∧
    starM td (starM td (weakInvM td a) a) (weakInvM td a) = weakInvM td a ∧
    starConjM td (starM td a (weakInvM td a)) = starM td a (weakInvM td a) ∧
    starConjM td (starM td (weakInvM td a) a) = starM td (weakInvM td a) a ∧
    (∀ y : Fin n → ℝ,
      starM td (starM td a y) a = a →
      starM td (starM td y a) y = y →
      starConjM td (starM td a y) = starM td a y →
      starConjM td (starM td y a) = starM td y a →
      y = weakInvM td a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨weakInvM_mp1 td a, weakInvM_mp2 td a, weakInvM_mp3 td a, weakInvM_mp4 td a,
   weakInvM_unique td a⟩

name: TubalTensor.KM.toFun_weakInv
statement:
@[simp] theorem toFun_weakInv (a : KM n td) :
    toFun (weakInv a) = weakInvM td (toFun a)
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.KM.weakInv_mp1
statement: theorem weakInv_mp1 (a : KM n td) : a * weakInv a * a = a
proof:
:= by
  show ofFun _ = _
  exact congr_arg ofFun (weakInvM_mp1 td _)

name: TubalTensor.mulVec_conj_real_row
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum]
  congr 1; ext j
  rw [map_mul]
  
  
  congr 1
  rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr (hreal j)]

name: TubalTensor.mulVec_conj_pair_row
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum]
  congr 1; ext j
  rw [map_mul]
  
  
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [show starRingEnd ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ (c j)) = c j from by
      rw [starRingEnd_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_star]]
  congr 1
  rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def]
  exact (hconj j).symm

name: TubalTensor.applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure
statement:
theorem applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure (td : TubalData n) (v : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hv : HasRealPairedStructure td v) :
    IsRealVec (td.applyMinv v)
proof:
:= by
  
  set c := td.applyMinv v with hc_def
  
  have hMc : td.applyM c = v := td.applyM_applyMinv v
  
  set w : Fin n → ℂ := fun j => starRingEnd ℂ (c j) with hw_def
  
  suffices hMw : td.applyM w = v by
    have heq := td.applyM_injective (hMw.trans hMc.symm)
    intro j
    have hj := congr_fun heq j
    
    show (c j).im = 0
    have : starRingEnd ℂ (c j) = c j := hj
    rwa [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im] at this
  
  ext i
  simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply, hw_def]
  
  rcases td.hM_real i with hreal | ⟨k, hki, hconj_row, _⟩
  · 
    
    rw [mulVec_conj_real_row td.M c i hreal]
    
    have hMci := congr_fun hMc i
    simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply] at hMci
    rw [hMci, starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr (hv.1 i hreal)]
  · 
    
    
    apply_fun starRingEnd ℂ using (starRingEnd ℂ).injective
    rw [mulVec_conj_pair_row td.M c i k hconj_row]
    
    
    have hMck := congr_fun hMc k
    simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply] at hMck
    rw [hMck, hv.2 i k hki hconj_row]

name: TubalTensor.identical_rows_absurd
statement:
private theorem identical_rows_absurd (td : TubalData n)
    {i j : Fin n} (hne : i ≠ j) (hrows : ∀ l, td.M i l = td.M j l) : False
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (td.M * td.M_inv) i i = 1 := by
    simp [td.hM_right_inv]
  have h2 : (td.M * td.M_inv) j i = 0 := by
    simp [td.hM_right_inv, Matrix.one_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hne)]
  have heq : (td.M * td.M_inv) i i = (td.M * td.M_inv) j i := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]; congr 1; ext l; rw [hrows]
  rw [heq] at h1; exact one_ne_zero (h1.symm ▸ h2)

name: TubalTensor.real_row_not_conj_partner
proof:
:= by
  exact identical_rows_absurd td hne (fun l => by
    
    
    
    
    have him : (starRingEnd ℂ (td.M i l)).im = 0 := by
      rw [← hconj l]; exact hj l
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_im, neg_eq_zero] at him
    have : starRingEnd ℂ (td.M i l) = td.M i l := by
      rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr him]
    rw [hconj l, this])

name: TubalTensor.Minv_col_eq_applyMinv_single
statement:
private theorem Minv_col_eq_applyMinv_single (td : TubalData n) (j i : Fin n) :
    td.M_inv i j = td.applyMinv (Pi.single j 1) i
proof:
:= by
  simp [TubalData.applyMinv_apply, Pi.single, Function.update,
    Finset.mem_univ, eq_comm]

name: TubalTensor.single_hasPairedStructure_of_realRow
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i _
    simp [Pi.single, Function.update]
    split <;> simp
  · intro i k hki hconj
    
    
    have hi_ne_j : i ≠ j := by
      intro h; subst h
      
      exact real_row_not_conj_partner td hj hki (isConjRow_symm hconj)
    have hk_ne_j : k ≠ j := by
      intro h; subst h
      
      exact real_row_not_conj_partner td hj hki.symm hconj
    simp [Pi.single, Function.update, hi_ne_j, hk_ne_j]

name: TubalTensor.Minv_col_real_of_realRow
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [Minv_col_eq_applyMinv_single]
  exact applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td _ (single_hasPairedStructure_of_realRow td hj) i

name: TubalTensor.applyM_Minv_col
statement:
private theorem applyM_Minv_col (td : TubalData n) (j : Fin n) :
    td.applyM (fun i => td.M_inv i j) = Pi.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply]
  
  have : ∑ l, td.M i l * td.M_inv l j = (td.M * td.M_inv) i j := by
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  rw [this, td.hM_right_inv, Matrix.one_apply]
  simp [Pi.single, Function.update, eq_comm]

name: TubalTensor.Minv_col_conj_of_conjRow
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set cj : Fin n → ℂ := fun i => td.M_inv i j
  set ck : Fin n → ℂ := fun i => td.M_inv i k
  set w : Fin n → ℂ := fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (cj i)
  have hMcj : td.applyM cj = Pi.single j 1 := applyM_Minv_col td j
  have hMck : td.applyM ck = Pi.single k 1 := applyM_Minv_col td k
  
  suffices hMw : td.applyM w = Pi.single k 1 by
    have heq := td.applyM_injective (hMw.trans hMck.symm)
    intro i
    have := congr_fun heq i
    
    exact this.symm
  
  funext i
  simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply, w]
  rcases td.hM_real i with hreal | ⟨i', hii', hconj_row, huniq⟩
  · 
    rw [mulVec_conj_real_row td.M cj i hreal]
    have hMcj_i := congr_fun hMcj i
    simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply] at hMcj_i
    rw [hMcj_i]
    
    have hi_ne_j : i ≠ j := by
      intro h; subst h
      
      
      
      exact real_row_not_conj_partner td hreal hjk.symm (isConjRow_symm hconj)
    have hi_ne_k : i ≠ k := by
      intro h; subst h
      
      
      exact real_row_not_conj_partner td hreal hjk hconj
    simp [Pi.single, Function.update, hi_ne_j, hi_ne_k]
  · 
    apply_fun starRingEnd ℂ using (starRingEnd ℂ).injective
    rw [mulVec_conj_pair_row td.M cj i i' hconj_row]
    have hMcj_i' := congr_fun hMcj i'
    simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply] at hMcj_i'
    rw [hMcj_i']
    
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · 
      subst hij
      have hi'k : i' = k := by
        by_contra h
        
        
        exact identical_rows_absurd td h (fun l => by
          rw [hconj_row l, hconj l])
      rw [hi'k]
      simp [Pi.single, Function.update, hjk, Ne.symm hjk]
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · 
        subst hik
        have hi'j : i' = j := by
          by_contra h
          
          
          
          exact identical_rows_absurd td h (fun l => by
            rw [hconj_row l, (isConjRow_symm hconj) l])
        rw [hi'j]
        simp [Pi.single, Function.update]
      · 
        have hi'_ne_j : i' ≠ j := by
          intro h; subst h
          
          
          
          exact identical_rows_absurd td hik (fun l => by
            have h1 := hconj_row l  
            have h2 := hconj l      
            rw [h2, h1, starRingEnd_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_star])
        have hi'_ne_k : i' ≠ k := by
          intro h; subst h
          
          
          
          exact identical_rows_absurd td hij (fun l => by
            have h1 := hconj_row l  
            have h2 := hconj l      
            have : starRingEnd ℂ (td.M i l) = starRingEnd ℂ (td.M j l) := by rw [← h1, ← h2]
            exact (starRingEnd ℂ).injective this)
        simp [Pi.single, Function.update, hik, hi'_ne_j]

name: TubalTensor.Minv_col_conj_of_row_conj
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · subst hjk
    
    have hreal : IsRealRow td.M j := by
      intro l
      have := h l  
      rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, eq_comm, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im] at this
      exact this
    intro i
    have him := Minv_col_real_of_realRow td hreal i
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr him]
  · exact Minv_col_conj_of_conjRow td hjk h

name: TubalTensor.conjCol_hasPairedStructure
statement:
private theorem conjCol_hasPairedStructure (td : TubalData n) (j : Fin n) :
    HasRealPairedStructure td (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (td.M i j))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i hreal
    
    show (starRingEnd ℂ (td.M i j)).im = 0
    have h := hreal j
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_im, neg_eq_zero]
    exact h
  · intro i k hki hconj
    
    
    
    
    show starRingEnd ℂ (td.M k j) = starRingEnd ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ (td.M i j))
    congr 1; exact hconj j

name: TubalTensor.Minv_mul_conjM_real
statement:
theorem Minv_mul_conjM_real (td : TubalData n) (i j : Fin n) :
    ((td.M_inv * td.M.map (starRingEnd ℂ)) i j).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply]
  
  exact applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure td
    (fun l => starRingEnd ℂ (td.M l j)) (conjCol_hasPairedStructure td j) i

name: TubalTensor.identical_rows_absurd_raw
statement:
private theorem identical_rows_absurd_raw
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hM_right : M * M_inv = 1)
    {i j : Fin n} (hne : i ≠ j) (hrows : ∀ l, M i l = M j l) : False
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (M * M_inv) i i = 1 := by
    rw [hM_right]; simp
  have h2 : (M * M_inv) j i = 0 := by
    rw [hM_right]; simp [Ne.symm hne]
  have heq : (M * M_inv) i i = (M * M_inv) j i := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]; congr 1; ext l; rw [hrows]
  rw [heq] at h1; exact one_ne_zero (h1.symm.trans h2)

name: TubalTensor.mulVec_toComplex_single
statement:
private theorem mulVec_toComplex_single
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    M *ᵥ toComplex (Pi.single j 1) = fun i => M i j
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp [toComplex_apply, Pi.single_eq_same]
  · intro l _ hlj; simp [toComplex_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hlj]
  · intro habs; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) habs

name: TubalTensor.Ra_entry_real
statement:
private theorem Ra_entry_real
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hpres : ∀ a b : Fin n → ℝ,
      IsRealVec (M_inv *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex a) ∘ₕ (M *ᵥ toComplex b))))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    ((M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (M *ᵥ toComplex a) * M) i j).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcol := hpres a (Pi.single j 1) i
  
  rw [mulVec_toComplex_single] at hcol
  
  
  
  
  
  suffices hsuff : (M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (M *ᵥ toComplex a) * M) i j =
      (M_inv *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex a) ∘ₕ fun l => M l j)) i by
    rw [hsuff]; exact hcol
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, vecHadamard_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro l _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single l]
  · simp; ring
  · intro m _ hml; simp [hml]
  · intro habs; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ l) habs

name: TubalTensor.Rk_eq_conj_Rk
statement:
private theorem Rk_eq_conj_Rk
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hRa : ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n),
      ((M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (M *ᵥ toComplex a) * M) i j).im = 0)
    (k : Fin n) :
    M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k) * M =
    M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => starRingEnd ℂ (M l k)) *
      M.map (starRingEnd ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'
  have h := hRa (Pi.single k 1) i' j'
  rw [mulVec_toComplex_single] at h
  
  have hself : starRingEnd ℂ ((M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k) * M) i' j') =
      (M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k) * M) i' j' := by
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr h]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  symm; rw [← hself]
  
  
  have : (M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k) * M).map (starRingEnd ℂ) =
      M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => starRingEnd ℂ (M l k)) *
        M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by
    rw [Matrix.map_mul (f := starRingEnd ℂ), Matrix.map_mul (f := starRingEnd ℂ)]
    congr 1; congr 1
    ext a b
    simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.map_apply, apply_ite (starRingEnd ℂ), map_zero]
  rw [← this, Matrix.map_apply]

name: TubalTensor.N_entry_identity
statement:
private theorem N_entry_identity
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (_hM_left : M_inv * M = 1) (hM_right : M * M_inv = 1)
    (hRa : ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n),
      ((M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (M *ᵥ toComplex a) * M) i j).im = 0)
    (i j k : Fin n) :
    (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j * M j k =
    starRingEnd ℂ (M i k) * (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j
proof:
:= by
  set N := M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv with hN_def
  have hconj_inv' : M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.map_mul (f := starRingEnd ℂ), hM_right,
      Matrix.map_one (starRingEnd ℂ) (map_zero _) (map_one _)]
  
  have hmat_eq := Rk_eq_conj_Rk hRa k
  
  have h1 : M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k) =
      M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => starRingEnd ℂ (M l k)) *
        M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv := by
    have step1 : M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k) =
        (M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k) * M) * M_inv := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, hM_right, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [step1, hmat_eq]
  
  have h2 : N * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun l => starRingEnd ℂ (M l k)) * N := by
    calc N * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k)
        = M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * (M_inv * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => M l k)) := by
          rw [hN_def, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * (M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) *
            Matrix.diagonal (fun l => starRingEnd ℂ (M l k)) *
            M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) := by rw [h1]
      _ = (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ)) *
            Matrix.diagonal (fun l => starRingEnd ℂ (M l k)) *
            (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.diagonal (fun l => starRingEnd ℂ (M l k)) * N := by
          rw [hconj_inv', Matrix.one_mul, hN_def]
  
  have h3 := congr_fun (congr_fun h2 i) j
  rwa [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul] at h3

name: TubalTensor.conjRow_of_N_nonzero
statement:
private theorem conjRow_of_N_nonzero
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    {i j : Fin n}
    (hN : ∀ k, (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j * M j k =
               starRingEnd ℂ (M i k) * (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j)
    (hne : (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j ≠ 0) :
    IsConjRow M i j
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  have h := hN k
  
  
  
  
  have h' : M j k * (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j =
      starRingEnd ℂ (M i k) * (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact h
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hne h'

name: TubalTensor.N_row_has_nonzero
statement:
private theorem N_row_has_nonzero
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hM_left : M_inv * M = 1) (hM_right : M * M_inv = 1)
    (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ j, (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  set N := M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv
  
  have hN_right : N * (M * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ)) = 1 := by
    show M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv * (M * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ)) = 1
    calc M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv * (M * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ))
        = M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * (M_inv * M) * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by
          rw [hM_left, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = 1 := by
          rw [← Matrix.map_mul (f := starRingEnd ℂ), hM_right,
            Matrix.map_one (starRingEnd ℂ) (map_zero _) (map_one _)]
  
  have h1 : (N * (M * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ))) i i = 1 := by
    rw [hN_right]; simp
  have h2 : (N * (M * M_inv.map (starRingEnd ℂ))) i i = 0 := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro l _
    rw [h l, zero_mul]
  exact one_ne_zero (h1.symm.trans h2)

name: TubalTensor.N_row_unique_nonzero
statement:
private theorem N_row_unique_nonzero
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hM_right : M * M_inv = 1)
    (hNid : ∀ i j k, (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j * M j k =
               starRingEnd ℂ (M i k) * (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j)
    {i j l : Fin n}
    (hj : (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i j ≠ 0)
    (hl : (M.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * M_inv) i l ≠ 0) :
    j = l
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hjl
  have hcj := conjRow_of_N_nonzero (hNid i j) hj
  have hcl := conjRow_of_N_nonzero (hNid i l) hl
  exact identical_rows_absurd_raw hM_right hjl (fun k => by rw [hcj k, hcl k])

name: TubalTensor.isRealPaired_of_starM_preserves_reals
statement:
theorem isRealPaired_of_starM_preserves_reals
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hM_left : M_inv * M = 1) (hM_right : M * M_inv = 1)
    (hpres : ∀ a b : Fin n → ℝ,
      IsRealVec (M_inv *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex a) ∘ₕ (M *ᵥ toComplex b)))) :
    IsRealPaired M
proof:
:= by
  have hRa := Ra_entry_real hpres
  have hNid := N_entry_identity hM_left hM_right hRa
  intro i
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := N_row_has_nonzero hM_left hM_right i
  have hconj_ij := conjRow_of_N_nonzero (hNid i j) hj
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · 
    subst hij; left; intro l
    have := hconj_ij l
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, eq_comm, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im] at this
    exact this
  · 
    right
    exact ⟨j, hij, hconj_ij, fun l _ hconj_il => by
      by_contra hjl
      exact identical_rows_absurd_raw hM_right hjl (fun k => by rw [hconj_ij k, hconj_il k])⟩

name: TubalTensor.starMC_real
statement:
theorem starMC_real (td : TubalData n) (a b : Fin n → ℝ) :
    IsRealVec (starMC td (toComplex a) (toComplex b))
proof:
:= by
  apply applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure
  exact vecHadamard_hasPairedStructure
    (applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td a)
    (applyM_toComplex_hasPairedStructure td b)

name: TubalTensor.starM_preserves_reals_iff_isRealPaired
statement:
theorem starM_preserves_reals_iff_isRealPaired
    {M M_inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hM_left : M_inv * M = 1) (hM_right : M * M_inv = 1) :
    (∀ a b : Fin n → ℝ,
      IsRealVec (M_inv *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex a) ∘ₕ (M *ᵥ toComplex b)))) ↔
    IsRealPaired M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact isRealPaired_of_starM_preserves_reals hM_left hM_right
  · intro hRP a b
    exact starMC_real ⟨M, M_inv, hM_left, hM_right, hRP⟩ a b

name: TubalTensor.starM_eq_starMC
statement:
theorem starM_eq_starMC (td : TubalData n) (a b : Fin n → ℝ) :
    toComplex (starM td a b) = starMC td (toComplex a) (toComplex b)
proof:
:= by
  apply toComplex_vecRe
  exact starMC_real td a b

name: TubalTensor.eM_isReal
statement:
theorem eM_isReal (td : TubalData n) :
    IsRealVec (td.applyMinv (allOnes n))
proof:
:= by
  apply applyMinv_real_of_pairedStructure
  constructor
  · intro _ _; simp
  · intro i k _ hconj
    simp only [allOnes_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_one]

name: TubalTensor.toComplex_unitTube
statement:
theorem toComplex_unitTube (td : TubalData n) :
    toComplex (unitTube td) = td.applyMinv (allOnes n)
proof:
:= by
  apply toComplex_vecRe
  exact eM_isReal td

name: TubalTensor.KM.not_isField
statement: theorem not_isField (hn : 3 ≤ n) : ¬ IsField (KM n td)
proof:
:= by
  intro hF
  have h2 : finrank ℝ (KM n td) ≤ 2 :=
    @comm_frobenius _ hF.toField instAlgebra instFiniteDimensional
  rw [finrank_eq] at h2
  omega

name: TubalTensor.KM.leM_refl
statement: private theorem leM_refl (a : KM n td) : leM a a
proof:
:= by
  unfold leM
  simp only [sub_self, toComplex_zero]
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩ <;> simp

name: TubalTensor.KM.leM_antisymm
statement: private theorem leM_antisymm {a b : KM n td} (hab : leM a b) (hba : leM b a) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  unfold leM at hab hba
  set v := td.applyM (toComplex (toFun b - toFun a)) with hv_def
  
  have hvneg : td.applyM (toComplex (toFun a - toFun b)) = -v := by
    rw [show toFun a - toFun b = -(toFun b - toFun a) from (neg_sub _ _).symm]
    rw [toComplex_neg]
    exact Matrix.mulVec_neg _ td.M
  
  have hle : ∀ i, (v i).re ≤ 0 := by
    intro i
    have h := hba.2 i; rw [hvneg] at h
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply, Complex.neg_re] at h; linarith
  
  have hv_zero : v = 0 := by
    ext i; exact Complex.ext (le_antisymm (hle i) (hab.2 i)) (hab.1 i)
  
  have h_diff : toComplex (toFun b - toFun a) = 0 := by
    apply td.applyM_injective
    change v = _; rw [hv_zero]; exact (Matrix.mulVec_zero _).symm
  ext i
  have hi := congr_fun (toComplex_injective (h_diff.trans toComplex_zero.symm)) i
  simp [Pi.sub_apply] at hi; linarith

name: TubalTensor.KM.leM_trans
statement: private theorem leM_trans {a b c : KM n td} (hab : leM a b) (hbc : leM b c) : leM a c
proof:
:= by
  unfold leM at *
  have hsum : td.applyM (toComplex (toFun c - toFun a)) =
      td.applyM (toComplex (toFun c - toFun b)) +
      td.applyM (toComplex (toFun b - toFun a)) := by
    rw [show toFun c - toFun a = (toFun c - toFun b) + (toFun b - toFun a) from by abel]
    rw [toComplex_add, td.applyM_add]
  constructor
  · intro i
    have := hbc.1 i; have := hab.1 i
    simp only [hsum, Pi.add_apply, Complex.add_im]; linarith
  · intro i
    have := hbc.2 i; have := hab.2 i
    simp only [hsum, Pi.add_apply, Complex.add_re]; linarith

name: TubalTensor.KM.le_iff
statement:
theorem le_iff (a b : KM n td) :
    a ≤ b ↔ (∀ i, (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun b - KM.toFun a)) i).im = 0) ∧
             (∀ i, 0 ≤ (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun b - KM.toFun a)) i).re)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TubalTensor.dotM_mulVec_expand
statement:
private theorem dotM_mulVec_expand (A : TubalMatrix m p n td)
    (X : OrientedMatrix p n td) (Y : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM (A.mulVec X) Y =
    ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ k : Fin p, star (A i k * X k) * Y i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotM_apply, mulVec, dotProduct, star_sum, Finset.sum_mul]

name: TubalTensor.dotM_conjTranspose_mulVec_expand
statement:
private theorem dotM_conjTranspose_mulVec_expand (A : TubalMatrix m p n td)
    (X : OrientedMatrix p n td) (Y : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM X (Aᴴ.mulVec Y) =
    ∑ k : Fin p, ∑ i : Fin m, star (X k) * (Aᴴ k i * Y i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotM_apply, mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]

name: TubalTensor.dotM_mulVec_left
statement:
theorem dotM_mulVec_left (A : TubalMatrix m p n td)
    (X : OrientedMatrix p n td) (Y : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM (A.mulVec X) Y = dotM X (Aᴴ.mulVec Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotM_mulVec_expand, dotM_conjTranspose_mulVec_expand]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [StarMul.star_mul, mul_assoc, conjTranspose_apply]

name: TubalTensor.isStarMAdjoint_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem isStarMAdjoint_conjTranspose (A : TubalMatrix m p n td) :
    IsStarMAdjoint A.toLinearMap (TubalMatrix.toLinearMap Aᴴ)
proof:
:=
  fun X Y => dotM_mulVec_left A X Y

name: TubalTensor.dotM_sub_right
statement:
private theorem dotM_sub_right (U V W : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM U (V - W) = dotM U V - dotM U W
proof:
:= by
  have h : (V - W : OrientedMatrix m n td) = V + (-1 : KM n td) • W := by
    rw [neg_one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [h, dotM_add_right, dotM_smul_right, neg_one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: TubalTensor.starMAdjoint_unique
statement:
theorem starMAdjoint_unique (T : StarMLinearMap p m n td)
    (S1 S2 : StarMLinearMap m p n td)
    (h1 : IsStarMAdjoint T S1) (h2 : IsStarMAdjoint T S2) :
    S1 = S2
proof:
:= by
  ext Y
  
  have key : ∀ X, dotM X (S1 Y - S2 Y) = 0 := by
    intro X
    rw [dotM_sub_right, sub_eq_zero]
    exact (h1 X Y).symm.trans (h2 X Y)
  
  
  have := (dotM_eq_zero_iff _).mp (key (S1 Y - S2 Y))
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

name: TubalTensor.TubalMatrix.toLinearMap_apply
statement:
theorem TubalMatrix.toLinearMap_apply (A : TubalMatrix m p n td)
    (X : OrientedMatrix p n td) :
    A.toLinearMap X = A.mulVec X
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.basis_decomp
statement:
private theorem basis_decomp (x : TubalCarrier n) :
    x = ∑ j : Fin n, x j • (Pi.single j 1 : TubalCarrier n)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repMatrix_apply (a : TubalCarrier n) (i j : Fin n) :
    repMatrix tr a i j = tr.mul a (Pi.single j 1) i
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem repMatrix_mulVec (a x : TubalCarrier n) :
    repMatrix tr a *ᵥ x = tr.mul a x
proof:
:= by
  
  have hdec : tr.mul a x = ∑ j : Fin n, x j • tr.mul a (Pi.single j 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [basis_decomp x]
    show (tr.mulLeftLinear a) (∑ j, x j • (Pi.single j 1 : TubalCarrier n)) = _
    rw [map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _; exact tr.mul_smul (x j) a (Pi.single j 1)
  ext i
  simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, repMatrix_apply, hdec,
    TubalCarrier.sum_apply, TubalCarrier.smul_apply]
  congr 1; ext j; ring

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_unique
statement:
theorem repMatrix_unique (a : TubalCarrier n) (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ x, R *ᵥ x = tr.mul a x) : R = repMatrix tr a
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have key : ∀ x, R *ᵥ x = repMatrix tr a *ᵥ x := by
    intro x; rw [hR, repMatrix_mulVec]
  ext i j
  have := congr_fun (key (Pi.single j 1)) i
  simpa [mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ] using this

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_zero
statement: theorem repMatrix_zero : repMatrix tr 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp only [repMatrix_apply, tr.zero_mul, Matrix.zero_apply,
    TubalCarrier.zero_apply]

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_neg
statement:
theorem repMatrix_neg (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    repMatrix tr (-a) = -repMatrix tr a
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp only [repMatrix_apply, tr.neg_mul, Matrix.neg_apply,
    TubalCarrier.neg_apply]

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_add
statement:
theorem repMatrix_add (a b : TubalCarrier n) :
    repMatrix tr (a + b) = repMatrix tr a + repMatrix tr b
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp only [repMatrix_apply, tr.right_distrib, Matrix.add_apply,
    TubalCarrier.add_apply]

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_smul
statement:
theorem repMatrix_smul (r : ℝ) (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    repMatrix tr (r • a) = r • repMatrix tr a
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact congr_fun (tr.smul_mul r a (Pi.single j 1)) i

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_one
statement: theorem repMatrix_one : repMatrix tr tr.one = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp only [repMatrix_apply, tr.one_mul, one_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem repMatrix_mul (a b : TubalCarrier n) :
    repMatrix tr (tr.mul a b) = repMatrix tr a * repMatrix tr b
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [repMatrix_apply, mul_apply]
  rw [tr.mul_assoc]
  exact (congr_fun (repMatrix_mulVec tr a (tr.mul b (Pi.single j 1))) i).symm

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_algHom_properties
statement:
theorem repMatrix_algHom_properties (a b : TubalCarrier n) (r : ℝ) :
    repMatrix tr (-a) = -repMatrix tr a ∧
    repMatrix tr (a + b) = repMatrix tr a + repMatrix tr b ∧
    repMatrix tr (r • a) = r • repMatrix tr a ∧
    repMatrix tr tr.one = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) ∧
    repMatrix tr (tr.mul a b) = repMatrix tr a * repMatrix tr b
proof:
:=
  ⟨repMatrix_neg tr a, repMatrix_add tr a b, repMatrix_smul tr r a,
   repMatrix_one tr, repMatrix_mul tr a b⟩

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_eq_zero_imp
statement: theorem repMatrix_eq_zero_imp {a : TubalCarrier n} (h : repMatrix tr a = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : repMatrix tr a *ᵥ tr.one = 0 := by simp [h]
  rw [repMatrix_mulVec, tr.mul_one] at h1
  exact h1

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_injective
statement: theorem repMatrix_injective : Function.Injective (repMatrix tr)
proof:
:= by
  intro (a : TubalCarrier n) (b : TubalCarrier n) hab
  have hsub : repMatrix tr (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [show a - b = a + (-b) from sub_eq_add_neg a b]
    rw [repMatrix_add, repMatrix_neg, hab, add_neg_cancel]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (repMatrix_eq_zero_imp tr hsub)

name: TubalTensor.repMatrix_comm
statement:
theorem repMatrix_comm (a b : TubalCarrier n) :
    repMatrix tr a * repMatrix tr b = repMatrix tr b * repMatrix tr a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← repMatrix_mul, ← repMatrix_mul, tr.mul_comm]

name: TubalTensor.IsIdempotent_iff_repMatrix
statement:
theorem IsIdempotent_iff_repMatrix (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    IsIdempotent tr a ↔ IsIdempotentElem (repMatrix tr a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsIdempotent IsIdempotentElem
  constructor
  · intro h
    show repMatrix tr a * repMatrix tr a = repMatrix tr a
    rw [← repMatrix_mul, h]
  · intro (h : repMatrix tr a * repMatrix tr a = repMatrix tr a)
    exact repMatrix_injective tr (repMatrix_mul tr a a ▸ h)

name: TubalTensor.nontrivial_idempotent_of_not_division
statement:
theorem nontrivial_idempotent_of_not_division (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    (hnd : ¬ IsDivisionRing tr V) :
    ∃ p, p ∈ V.carrier ∧ IsIdempotent tr p ∧ p ≠ 0 ∧ p ≠ V.unit
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsDivisionRing at hnd; push Not at hnd
  obtain ⟨a, ha_mem, ha_ne, ha_no_inv⟩ := hnd
  obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, haxa⟩ := V.vnr_mem a ha_mem
  refine ⟨tr.mul a x, V.mul_mem ha_mem hx_mem, tr.mul_idempotent_of_vnr haxa, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hp0
    have := haxa; rw [hp0, tr.zero_mul] at this; exact ha_ne this.symm
  · intro hp_eq; exact ha_no_inv x hx_mem hp_eq

name: TubalTensor.dim_one_is_subfield
statement:
theorem dim_one_is_subfield (V : TubalSubRing tr) (hdim : V.dim = 1) :
    IsTubalSubField tr V
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha ha_ne
  have hunit_ne : V.unit ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : V.toSubmodule = ⊥ := by
      ext x; simp only [Submodule.mem_bot]; constructor
      · intro hx; have := V.unit_mul x hx; rw [h, tr.zero_mul] at this; exact this.symm
      · intro hx; rw [hx]; exact V.toSubmodule.zero_mem
    unfold TubalSubRing.dim at hdim; rw [this] at hdim; simp at hdim
  have hv_sub : (⟨V.unit, V.unit_mem⟩ : V.toSubmodule) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; exact hunit_ne (congr_arg Subtype.val h)
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (@finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' ℝ V.toSubmodule inferInstance
    V.toSubmodule.addCommGroup V.toSubmodule.module
    ⟨V.unit, V.unit_mem⟩ hv_sub).mp hdim ⟨a, ha⟩
  have ha_eq : a = α • V.unit := by simpa using congr_arg Subtype.val hα.symm
  have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, zero_smul] at ha_eq; exact ha_ne ha_eq
  exact ⟨α⁻¹ • V.unit, V.smul_mem α⁻¹ V.unit_mem, by
    rw [ha_eq, tr.smul_mul, tr.mul_smul, V.unit_idempotent, smul_smul,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hα_ne, one_smul]⟩

name: TubalTensor.principalIdeal_union_spans
statement:
theorem principalIdeal_union_spans (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} :
    V.carrier ⊆ ↑(Submodule.span ℝ
      ((principalIdealSubRing tr p).carrier ∪
       (principalIdealSubRing tr (V.unit - p)).carrier))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [decompose_sum tr V hx (p := p)]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl (mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr p x)))
    (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr (mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr (V.unit - p) x)))

name: TubalTensor.finrank_comap_eq
statement:
private theorem finrank_comap_eq {W P : Submodule ℝ (TubalCarrier n)} (hPW : P ≤ W) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (P.comap W.subtype) = Module.finrank ℝ P
proof:
:=
  LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hPW)

name: TubalTensor.principalIdeal_dim_lt
statement:
theorem principalIdeal_dim_lt (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_mem : p ∈ V.carrier) (hp_idem : IsIdempotent tr p)
    (_hp_ne_zero : p ≠ 0) (hp_ne_unit : p ≠ V.unit) :
    (principalIdealSubRing tr p).dim < V.dim
proof:
:= by
  set P := (principalIdealSubmodule tr p).comap V.toSubmodule.subtype
  set Q := (principalIdealSubmodule tr (V.unit - p)).comap V.toSubmodule.subtype
  have hcompl := idempotent_decomposition tr V hp_mem hp_idem
  have hP_lt_top : P < ⊤ := by
    rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    intro hP_top
    have : Q ≤ P ⊓ Q := le_inf (hP_top ▸ le_top) le_rfl
    rw [hcompl.inf_eq_bot] at this
    have hq_zero : Q = ⊥ := eq_bot_iff.mpr this
    have : (⟨V.unit - p, V.sub_mem V.unit_mem hp_mem⟩ : V.toSubmodule) ∈ Q :=
      self_mem_principalIdeal tr (V.unit - p)
    rw [hq_zero, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact hp_ne_unit (eq_of_sub_eq_zero (congr_arg Subtype.val this)).symm
  have h := @Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt ℝ V.toSubmodule inferInstance
    V.toSubmodule.addCommGroup V.toSubmodule.module _ _ inferInstance hP_lt_top
  unfold TubalSubRing.dim
  show Module.finrank ℝ (principalIdealSubmodule tr p) < Module.finrank ℝ V.toSubmodule
  calc Module.finrank ℝ (principalIdealSubmodule tr p)
      = Module.finrank ℝ P :=
        (finrank_comap_eq (principalIdealSubmodule_le_of_mem tr V hp_mem)).symm
    _ < Module.finrank ℝ (⊤ : Submodule ℝ V.toSubmodule) := h
    _ = Module.finrank ℝ V.toSubmodule := finrank_top _ _

name: TubalTensor.complement_dim_lt
statement:
theorem complement_dim_lt (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_mem : p ∈ V.carrier) (hp_idem : IsIdempotent tr p)
    (hp_ne_zero : p ≠ 0) (_hp_ne_unit : p ≠ V.unit) :
    (principalIdealSubRing tr (V.unit - p)).dim < V.dim
proof:
:= by
  set P := (principalIdealSubmodule tr p).comap V.toSubmodule.subtype
  set Q := (principalIdealSubmodule tr (V.unit - p)).comap V.toSubmodule.subtype
  have hcompl := idempotent_decomposition tr V hp_mem hp_idem
  have hQ_lt_top : Q < ⊤ := by
    rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    intro hQ_top
    have : P ≤ Q ⊓ P := le_inf (hQ_top ▸ le_top) le_rfl
    rw [inf_comm, hcompl.inf_eq_bot] at this
    have hp_zero : P = ⊥ := eq_bot_iff.mpr this
    have : (⟨p, hp_mem⟩ : V.toSubmodule) ∈ P := self_mem_principalIdeal tr p
    rw [hp_zero, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact hp_ne_zero (congr_arg Subtype.val this)
  have h := @Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt ℝ V.toSubmodule inferInstance
    V.toSubmodule.addCommGroup V.toSubmodule.module _ _ inferInstance hQ_lt_top
  unfold TubalSubRing.dim
  show Module.finrank ℝ (principalIdealSubmodule tr (V.unit - p)) <
    Module.finrank ℝ V.toSubmodule
  calc Module.finrank ℝ (principalIdealSubmodule tr (V.unit - p))
      = Module.finrank ℝ Q :=
        (finrank_comap_eq
          (principalIdealSubmodule_le_of_mem tr V (V.sub_mem V.unit_mem hp_mem))).symm
    _ < Module.finrank ℝ (⊤ : Submodule ℝ V.toSubmodule) := h
    _ = Module.finrank ℝ V.toSubmodule := finrank_top _ _

name: TubalTensor.subring_decomp_subfields
statement:
theorem subring_decomp_subfields (V : TubalSubRing tr) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (Ws : Fin N → TubalSubRing tr),
      (∀ j, IsTubalSubField tr (Ws j)) ∧
      (∀ j, (Ws j).carrier ⊆ V.carrier) ∧
      V.carrier ⊆ ↑(Submodule.span ℝ (⋃ j, (Ws j).carrier))
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ W : TubalSubRing tr, W.dim ≤ d →
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (Ws : Fin N → TubalSubRing tr),
        (∀ j, IsTubalSubField tr (Ws j)) ∧
        (∀ j, (Ws j).carrier ⊆ W.carrier) ∧
        W.carrier ⊆ ↑(Submodule.span ℝ (⋃ j, (Ws j).carrier)) from
    h V.dim V (le_refl _)
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro W hW
    refine ⟨0, Fin.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hdim0 : W.dim = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hW
    have hbot : W.toSubmodule = ⊥ := by
      rwa [← Submodule.finrank_eq_zero, ← TubalSubRing.dim]
    have : x = 0 := by
      have : x ∈ W.toSubmodule := hx
      rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at this; exact this
    rw [this]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ d ih =>
    intro W hW
    by_cases hdiv : IsDivisionRing tr W
    · refine ⟨1, fun _ => W, fun _ => hdiv, fun _ => Set.Subset.refl _, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      simp only [Set.iUnion_const]
      exact hx
    · obtain ⟨p, hp_mem, hp_idem, hp_ne_zero, hp_ne_unit⟩ :=
        nontrivial_idempotent_of_not_division tr W hdiv
      have hlt_p := principalIdeal_dim_lt tr W hp_mem hp_idem hp_ne_zero hp_ne_unit
      have hlt_q := complement_dim_lt tr W hp_mem hp_idem hp_ne_zero hp_ne_unit
      obtain ⟨N₁, Ws₁, hfield₁, hsub₁, hspan₁⟩ :=
        ih (principalIdealSubRing tr p) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨N₂, Ws₂, hfield₂, hsub₂, hspan₂⟩ :=
        ih (principalIdealSubRing tr (W.unit - p)) (by omega)
      refine ⟨N₁ + N₂, Fin.addCases Ws₁ Ws₂, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j; exact Fin.addCases (fun i => by simp [Fin.addCases]; exact hfield₁ i)
                                     (fun i => by simp [Fin.addCases]; exact hfield₂ i) j
      · intro j
        refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
        · simp [Fin.addCases]
          exact Set.Subset.trans (hsub₁ i) (principalIdealSubmodule_le_of_mem tr W hp_mem)
        · simp [Fin.addCases]
          exact Set.Subset.trans (hsub₂ i)
            (principalIdealSubmodule_le_of_mem tr W (W.sub_mem W.unit_mem hp_mem))
      · intro x hx
        rw [decompose_sum tr W hx (p := p)]
        apply Submodule.add_mem
        · have hpx : tr.mul p x ∈ (principalIdealSubRing tr p).carrier :=
            mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr p x
          exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.iUnion_mono' fun i =>
            ⟨Fin.castAdd N₂ i, by simp [Fin.addCases]⟩) (hspan₁ hpx)
        · have hqx : tr.mul (W.unit - p) x ∈
              (principalIdealSubRing tr (W.unit - p)).carrier :=
            mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr (W.unit - p) x
          exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.iUnion_mono' fun i =>
            ⟨Fin.natAdd N₁ i, by simp [Fin.addCases]⟩) (hspan₂ hqx)

name: TubalTensor.isMatDiag_of_idempotent
statement:
theorem isMatDiag_of_idempotent {m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (hA : IsIdempotentElem A) : IsMatDiag A
proof:
:= by
  
  open Polynomial in
  set Ac := A.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
  set f : Module.End ℂ (Fin m → ℂ) := Ac.mulVecLin
  set p : ℂ[X] := X * (X - C 1) with hp_def
  have hp_sq : Squarefree p := by
    rw [hp_def, squarefree_mul_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, irreducible_X.squarefree, (irreducible_X_sub_C 1).squarefree⟩
    rw [irreducible_X.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd]
    intro ⟨q, hq⟩
    have := congr_arg (Polynomial.eval (0 : ℂ)) hq
    simp at this
  have hp_ann : Polynomial.aeval f p = 0 := by
    simp only [hp_def, map_mul, map_sub, Polynomial.aeval_X, map_one]
    have hAc_idem : Ac * Ac = Ac := by
      show Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix A * Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix A =
        Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix A
      rw [← map_mul, hA.eq]
    have hf_idem : f * f = f :=
      LinearMap.ext fun v => by
        change Ac.mulVec (Ac.mulVec v) = Ac.mulVec v
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAc_idem]
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hf_idem, sub_self]
  exact isMatDiag_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero A hp_sq hp_ann

name: TubalTensor.isMatDiag_smul
statement:
theorem isMatDiag_smul {m : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (hA : IsMatDiag A) : IsMatDiag (r • A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, D, hSu, hDdiag, hASD⟩ := hA
  refine ⟨S, (r : ℂ) • D, hSu, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij; simp [hDdiag hij]
  · have : (r • A).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = (r : ℂ) • A.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) := by
      ext i j; simp
    rw [this, hASD]
    simp

name: TubalTensor.exists_smul_of_dim_one
proof:
:= by
  have hv_sub : (⟨v, hv⟩ : W) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; exact hv_ne (congr_arg Subtype.val h)
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (@finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' ℝ W inferInstance
    W.addCommGroup W.module ⟨v, hv⟩ hv_sub).mp hdim ⟨a, ha⟩
  exact ⟨α, by simpa using congr_arg Subtype.val hα.symm⟩

name: TubalTensor.subfield_diag_dim1
statement:
theorem subfield_diag_dim1 (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    (hdim : V.dim = 1) :
    SetDiag tr V.carrier
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  rw [IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag]
  have hReV_diag : IsMatDiag (repMatrix tr V.unit) :=
    isMatDiag_of_idempotent _ ((IsIdempotent_iff_repMatrix tr V.unit).mp V.unit_idempotent)
  have hunit_ne : V.unit ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : V.toSubmodule = ⊥ := by
      ext x; simp only [Submodule.mem_bot]; constructor
      · intro hx; have := V.unit_mul x hx; rw [h, tr.zero_mul] at this; exact this.symm
      · intro hx; rw [hx]; exact V.toSubmodule.zero_mem
    unfold TubalSubRing.dim at hdim; rw [this] at hdim; simp at hdim
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := exists_smul_of_dim_one hdim V.unit_mem hunit_ne ha
  rw [hα, repMatrix_smul]
  exact isMatDiag_smul α _ hReV_diag

name: TubalTensor.subfield_diag_dim2
statement:
theorem subfield_diag_dim2 (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    (hdiv : IsDivisionRing tr V) (hdim : V.dim = 2) :
    SetDiag tr V.carrier
proof:
:= by
  
  open Polynomial in
  unfold TubalSubRing.dim at hdim
  
  have hunit_ne : V.unit ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; have hbot : V.toSubmodule = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff]; intro x hx
      have := V.unit_mul x hx; rw [h, tr.zero_mul] at this; rw [Submodule.mem_bot]; exact this.symm
    rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hdim; exact absurd hdim (by norm_num)
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha_mem, ha_nspan⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset
    (Submodule.lt_of_le_of_finrank_lt_finrank
      (Submodule.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr V.unit_mem))
      (by rw [finrank_span_singleton hunit_ne]; omega) :
      Submodule.span ℝ {V.unit} < V.toSubmodule)
  have ha_not_smul : ∀ r : ℝ, a ≠ r • V.unit := fun r hr =>
    ha_nspan (hr ▸ Submodule.smul_mem _ r (Submodule.subset_span rfl))
  
  have ha_sq_mem : tr.mul a a ∈ V.carrier := V.mul_mem ha_mem ha_mem
  
  set eV' : V.toSubmodule := ⟨V.unit, V.unit_mem⟩
  set a' : V.toSubmodule := ⟨a, ha_mem⟩
  set a2' : V.toSubmodule := ⟨tr.mul a a, ha_sq_mem⟩
  have hndep : ¬@LinearIndependent (Fin 3) ℝ V.toSubmodule ![eV', a', a2']
      inferInstance V.toSubmodule.addCommMonoid V.toSubmodule.module := by
    intro hli
    exact absurd (@LinearIndependent.fintype_card_le_finrank ℝ V.toSubmodule
      inferInstance V.toSubmodule.addCommMonoid V.toSubmodule.module
      inferInstance inferInstance (Fin 3) inferInstance
      (b := ![eV', a', a2']) hli) (by simp [hdim])
  obtain ⟨g, hsum, i₀, hi₀⟩ := (@Fintype.not_linearIndependent_iff (Fin 3) ℝ V.toSubmodule
    inferInstance V.toSubmodule.addCommGroup V.toSubmodule.module
    (v := ![eV', a', a2']) inferInstance).mp hndep
  
  have hg2 : g 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hg2_eq
    have h01 : g 0 • V.unit + g 1 • a = 0 := by
      have h := congr_arg Subtype.val hsum
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hg2_eq, zero_smul, add_zero, eV', a', a2',
        Submodule.coe_zero] at h
      exact h
    have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
      by_contra h0; by_cases h1 : g 1 = 0
      · rw [h1, zero_smul, add_zero] at h01
        exact hunit_ne (smul_eq_zero.mp h01 |>.resolve_left h0)
      · exact ha_not_smul (-g 0 / g 1) (by 
          have h2 : g 1 • a = -(g 0 • V.unit) :=
            add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp (by rwa [add_comm] at h01)
          calc a = (g 1)⁻¹ • (g 1 • a) := (inv_smul_smul₀ h1 a).symm
            _ = (g 1)⁻¹ • (-(g 0 • V.unit)) := by rw [h2]
            _ = (-g 0 / g 1) • V.unit := by
                rw [smul_neg, smul_smul, ← neg_smul]; congr 1; ring)
    have hg1 : g 1 = 0 := by
      rw [hg0, zero_smul, zero_add] at h01
      exact smul_eq_zero.mp h01 |>.resolve_right (fun h => ha_not_smul 0 (by simpa using h))
    exact hi₀ (by fin_cases i₀ <;> simp_all)
  
  set α := -g 0 / g 2
  set β := -g 1 / g 2
  have hsum_v : g 0 • V.unit + g 1 • a + g 2 • tr.mul a a = 0 := by
    have h := congr_arg Subtype.val hsum
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, eV', a', a2',
      Submodule.coe_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hquad : tr.mul a a = α • V.unit + β • a := by
    
    have h2 : g 2 • tr.mul a a = -(g 0 • V.unit + g 1 • a) := by
      have h3 : g 0 • V.unit + g 1 • a + g 2 • tr.mul a a = 0 := hsum_v
      have h4 : g 2 • tr.mul a a = -(g 0 • V.unit + g 1 • a) + 0 := by
        have := h3; rw [← this]; abel
      rwa [add_zero] at h4
    calc tr.mul a a
        = (g 2)⁻¹ • (g 2 • tr.mul a a) := (inv_smul_smul₀ hg2 _).symm
      _ = (g 2)⁻¹ • (-(g 0 • V.unit + g 1 • a)) := by rw [h2]
      _ = (g 2)⁻¹ • (-(g 0 • V.unit) + -(g 1 • a)) := by rw [neg_add]
      _ = (g 2)⁻¹ • (-(g 0 • V.unit)) + (g 2)⁻¹ • (-(g 1 • a)) := by rw [smul_add]
      _ = α • V.unit + β • a := by
          simp only [smul_smul, ← neg_smul]; congr 1 <;> (congr 1; ring)
  
  set j := a - (β / 2) • V.unit
  have hj_mem : j ∈ V.carrier := V.sub_mem ha_mem (V.smul_mem _ V.unit_mem)
  set γ := α + β ^ 2 / 4
  have hj_sq : tr.mul j j = γ • V.unit := by
    
    show tr.mul (a - (β / 2) • V.unit) (a - (β / 2) • V.unit) = γ • V.unit
    have hae : tr.mul a V.unit = a := V.mul_unit ha_mem
    have hea : tr.mul V.unit a = a := V.unit_mul a ha_mem
    have hee : tr.mul V.unit V.unit = V.unit := V.unit_idempotent
    rw [tr.sub_mul, tr.mul_sub, tr.mul_sub,
        tr.mul_smul, hae, tr.smul_mul, hea,
        tr.smul_mul, tr.mul_smul, hee, smul_smul, hquad]
    
    
    
    module
  
  have hγ_ne : γ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hγ; rw [hγ, zero_smul] at hj_sq
    have hj0 : j = 0 := by
      by_contra hj_ne
      obtain ⟨inv, _, hinv⟩ := hdiv j hj_mem hj_ne
      have h1 : j = tr.mul j V.unit := (V.mul_unit hj_mem).symm
      rw [← hinv, ← tr.mul_assoc, tr.mul_comm j j, hj_sq, tr.zero_mul] at h1; exact hj_ne h1
    exact ha_not_smul (β / 2) (by 
      have : a = j + (β / 2) • V.unit := by simp [j]
      rw [this, hj0, zero_add])
  
  have heV_diag : IsDiag tr V.unit := by
    rw [IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag]
    exact isMatDiag_of_idempotent _ ((IsIdempotent_iff_repMatrix tr V.unit).mp V.unit_idempotent)
  
  have hj_diag : IsDiag tr j := by
    rw [IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag]
    set R := repMatrix tr j
    have hR_sq : R * R = γ • repMatrix tr V.unit := by
      rw [← repMatrix_mul, ← repMatrix_smul]; exact congrArg _ hj_sq
    have hR_eV : R * repMatrix tr V.unit = R := by
      rw [← repMatrix_mul]; exact congrArg _ (V.mul_unit hj_mem)
    have hR_cube : R * R * R = γ • R := by
      rw [mul_assoc, hR_sq, mul_smul_comm, hR_eV]
    set Rc := R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
    set f : Module.End ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) := Rc.mulVecLin
    
    have hRc_cube : Rc * Rc * Rc = (↑γ : ℂ) • Rc := by
      
      set φ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ →+* Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
        Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix
      change φ R * φ R * φ R = (↑γ : ℂ) • φ R
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, hR_cube]
      ext i j; simp [φ, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.map_apply]
    have hf_cube : f * f * f = (↑γ : ℂ) • f := by
      apply LinearMap.ext; intro v
      show Rc.mulVec (Rc.mulVec (Rc.mulVec v)) = (↑γ : ℂ) • (Rc.mulVec v)
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hRc_cube, Matrix.smul_mulVec]
    have hp_ann : aeval f (X * (X ^ 2 - C (↑γ : ℂ))) = 0 := by
      have h1 : f * (f * f - (↑γ : ℂ) • 1) = 0 := by
        apply LinearMap.ext; intro v
        show Rc.mulVec (Rc.mulVec (Rc.mulVec v) - (↑γ : ℂ) • v) = 0
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
            Matrix.mulVec_smul, hRc_cube, Matrix.smul_mulVec, sub_self]
      rw [map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C, sq,
          Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
      exact h1
    
    have hp_sq : Squarefree (X * (X ^ 2 - C (↑γ : ℂ))) := by
