      have hγc_ne : (↑γ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hγ_ne
      have h2_ne : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := two_ne_zero
      have hsep : Separable (X ^ 2 - C (↑γ : ℂ)) :=
        separable_X_pow_sub_C (↑γ : ℂ) h2_ne hγc_ne
      rw [squarefree_mul_iff]
      refine ⟨?_, irreducible_X.squarefree, hsep.squarefree⟩
      rw [irreducible_X.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd]
      intro ⟨q, hq⟩
      have h_eval := congr_arg (Polynomial.eval (0 : ℂ)) hq
      simp at h_eval
      exact hγ_ne h_eval
    exact isMatDiag_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero R hp_sq hp_ann
  
  have hpair_diag : SetDiag tr ({V.unit, j} : Set (TubalCarrier n)) := by
    intro x hx; rcases hx with rfl | rfl; exact heV_diag; exact hj_diag
  have hj_not_smul : ∀ r : ℝ, j ≠ r • V.unit := by
    intro r hr; exact ha_not_smul (r + β / 2) (by
      have : a = j + (β / 2) • V.unit := by simp [j]
      rw [this, hr, add_smul])
  have hspan : V.carrier ⊆ ↑(Submodule.span ℝ ({V.unit, j} : Set (TubalCarrier n))) := by
    have hli : LinearIndependent ℝ (![V.unit, j] : Fin 2 → TubalCarrier n) := by
      rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
      intro c hc
      
      have hc' : c 0 • V.unit + c 1 • j = 0 := by
        have := hc; simp [Fin.sum_univ_two] at this; exact this
      have hc1 : c 1 = 0 := by
        by_contra h1
        have h2 : c 1 • j = -(c 0 • V.unit) :=
          add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp (by rwa [add_comm] at hc')
        have h3 : j = (c 1)⁻¹ • (-(c 0 • V.unit)) := by
          rw [← h2]; exact (inv_smul_smul₀ h1 j).symm
        have h4 : j = (-(c 0 / c 1)) • V.unit := by
          rw [h3, smul_neg, smul_smul, neg_smul]; congr 1; field_simp
        exact hj_not_smul _ h4
      have hc0 : c 0 = 0 := by
        rw [hc1, zero_smul, add_zero] at hc'
        exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hc').resolve_right hunit_ne
      intro i; fin_cases i <;> assumption
    have h_sub : {V.unit, j} ⊆ V.carrier :=
      Set.insert_subset V.unit_mem (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hj_mem)
    have h_le : Submodule.span ℝ ({V.unit, j} : Set (TubalCarrier n)) ≤ V.toSubmodule :=
      Submodule.span_le.mpr h_sub
    have h_rank : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ ({V.unit, j} : Set (TubalCarrier n))) = 2 := by
      rw [show ({V.unit, j} : Set (TubalCarrier n)) = Set.range ![V.unit, j] from by
        ext x; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_range]
        constructor
        · rintro (rfl | rfl); exact ⟨0, rfl⟩; exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; fin_cases i <;> simp]
      exact (finrank_span_eq_card hli).trans (by simp)
    exact (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le h_le (h_rank ▸ hdim ▸ le_refl _)).symm ▸ le_refl _
  intro x hx
  exact diag_span tr {V.unit, j} hpair_diag x (hspan hx)

name: TubalTensor.subfield_dim_le_two
statement:
private theorem subfield_dim_le_two (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    (hdiv : IsDivisionRing tr V) : V.dim ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hne : V.unit = 0
  · 
    have : V.toSubmodule = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff]; intro x hx
      have := V.unit_mul x hx; rw [hne, tr.zero_mul] at this
      rw [Submodule.mem_bot]; exact this.symm
    show Module.finrank ℝ ↥V.toSubmodule ≤ 2
    rw [this]; simp [finrank_bot]
  · 
    letI instMod : Module ℝ ↥V.toSubmodule := V.toSubmodule.module
    letI instCR : CommRing ↥V.toSubmodule := subfieldCommRing tr V
    letI instAlg : @Algebra ℝ ↥V.toSubmodule _ instCR.toSemiring :=
      @Algebra.ofModule ℝ ↥V.toSubmodule _ instCR.toSemiring instMod
        (fun r x y => by
          obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x; obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := y
          refine Subtype.ext ?_
          dsimp [subfieldCommRing, HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, HMul.hMul, Mul.mul]
          exact tr.smul_mul r x y)
        (fun r x y => by
          obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x; obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := y
          refine Subtype.ext ?_
          dsimp [subfieldCommRing, HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, HMul.hMul, Mul.mul]
          exact tr.mul_smul r x y)
    letI instField : @Field ↥V.toSubmodule := @IsField.toField _ instCR.toRing {
      exists_pair_ne := ⟨0, ⟨V.unit, V.unit_mem⟩, fun h => hne (congr_arg Subtype.val h).symm⟩
      mul_comm := fun ⟨a, _⟩ ⟨b, _⟩ => Subtype.ext (tr.mul_comm a b)
      mul_inv_cancel := fun {a} ha => by
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := hdiv a.1 a.2 (fun h => ha (Subtype.ext h))
        exact ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, Subtype.ext hab⟩ }
    haveI instFD : @FiniteDimensional ℝ ↥V.toSubmodule _ _ instMod :=
      FiniteDimensional.finiteDimensional_submodule V.toSubmodule
    exact @comm_frobenius _ instField instAlg instFD

name: TubalTensor.subfield_diag
statement:
theorem subfield_diag (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    (hfield : IsTubalSubField tr V) : SetDiag tr V.carrier
proof:
:= by
  have hdim_le : V.dim ≤ 2 := subfield_dim_le_two tr V hfield
  
  have : V.dim = 0 ∨ V.dim = 1 ∨ V.dim = 2 := by omega
  rcases this with h | h | h
  · 
    intro a ha
    have hbot : V.toSubmodule = ⊥ := by
      rw [← Submodule.finrank_eq_zero]; exact h
    have ha0 : a = 0 := by
      have : a ∈ V.toSubmodule := ha
      rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at this; exact this
    subst ha0
    rw [IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag, repMatrix_zero]
    exact ⟨1, 0, isUnit_one, fun _ _ _ => by simp, by simp⟩
  · 
    exact subfield_diag_dim1 tr V h
  · 
    exact subfield_diag_dim2 tr V hfield h

name: TubalTensor.mulComplex_toComplex
statement:
theorem mulComplex_toComplex (a x : TubalCarrier n) :
    mulComplex tr a (toComplex x) = toComplex (tr.mul a x)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [mulComplex, toComplex_apply, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  have : tr.mul a (fun _ => 0) i = 0 := by
    rw [show (fun _ : Fin n => (0 : ℝ)) = 0 from rfl]; exact congr_fun (tr.mul_zero a) i
  simp [this]

name: TubalTensor.mulComplex_eq_repMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem mulComplex_eq_repMatrix_mulVec (a : TubalCarrier n) (b : Fin n → ℂ) :
    mulComplex tr a b = (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [mulComplex, mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, repMatrix_apply]
  
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [show tr.mul a (fun j => (b j).re) =
          repMatrix tr a *ᵥ (fun j => (b j).re) from (repMatrix_mulVec tr a _).symm,
        show tr.mul a (fun j => (b j).im) =
          repMatrix tr a *ᵥ (fun j => (b j).im) from (repMatrix_mulVec tr a _).symm]
  simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, repMatrix_apply]
  
  
  push_cast
  rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1; ext j
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_add, Complex.re_add_im]

name: TubalTensor.IsEigenpair_iff_repMatrix
statement:
theorem IsEigenpair_iff_repMatrix (a : TubalCarrier n) (μ : ℂ) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    IsEigenpair tr a μ x ↔
      x ≠ 0 ∧ (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ x = μ • x
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsEigenpair
  rw [mulComplex_eq_repMatrix_mulVec]

name: TubalTensor.mulVec_single_eq_col
statement:
private theorem mulVec_single_eq_col {m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (j : Fin m) :
    A *ᵥ Pi.single j 1 = col A j
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [mulVec, dotProduct, col, Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']

name: TubalTensor.linearIndependent_cols_of_mul_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcol_eq : col B = fun j => B.mulVecLin (Pi.single j 1) := by
    ext j i; simp [col]
  rw [hcol_eq]
  
  have hInj : Function.Injective B.mulVecLin := by
    intro u v huv
    have : A.mulVecLin (B.mulVecLin u) = A.mulVecLin (B.mulVecLin v) := congr_arg _ huv
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, mulVec_mulVec, h, one_mulVec] at this
    exact this
  
  have hStd : LinearIndependent ℂ (fun i => Pi.single i (1 : ℂ) : Fin m → Fin m → ℂ) := by
    have := (Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin m)).linearIndependent
    rwa [show ⇑(Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin m)) = fun i => Pi.single i (1 : ℂ) from by
      ext i j; simp [Pi.basisFun_apply]] at this
  
  exact hStd.map' B.mulVecLin (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot_of_injective hInj)

name: TubalTensor.diagonal_mulVec_single'
statement:
private theorem diagonal_mulVec_single' {m : ℕ} (d : Fin m → ℂ) (j : Fin m) :
    Matrix.diagonal d *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1 : Fin m → ℂ) = d j • (Pi.single j 1 : Fin m → ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Pi.single_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  split <;> simp [*]

name: TubalTensor.IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag
statement:
theorem IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    IsDiag tr a ↔ IsMatDiag (repMatrix tr a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsDiag IsMatDiag
  constructor
  · 
    intro ⟨v, μ, hli, heig⟩
    
    set S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ := Matrix.of (fun i j => v j i) with hS_def
    
    set D := Matrix.diagonal μ with hD_def
    
    have heig' : ∀ j, (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ v j = μ j • v j := by
      intro j; rw [← mulComplex_eq_repMatrix_mulVec]; exact (heig j).2
    
    have hcol : S.col = v := by
      ext j i; simp [Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, S, Matrix.of_apply]
    
    have hSu : IsUnit S :=
      linearIndependent_cols_iff_isUnit.mp (hcol ▸ hli)
    have hSS : S * S⁻¹ = 1 :=
      mul_nonsing_inv S ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).mp hSu)
    
    have hAS_eq_SD : (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * S = S * D := by
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, hS_def, Matrix.of_apply, hD_def, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
      have : ∑ k, (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) i k * v j k =
          ((repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ v j) i := rfl
      rw [this, heig']
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq', mul_comm]
    
    exact ⟨S, D, hSu, Matrix.isDiag_diagonal μ, by
      calc (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
          = (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * (S * S⁻¹) := by rw [hSS, mul_one]
        _ = S * D * S⁻¹ := by rw [← mul_assoc, hAS_eq_SD]⟩
  · 
    intro ⟨S, D, hSu, hDdiag, hRSD⟩
    
    
    
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det] at hSu
    have hSS : S * S⁻¹ = 1 := mul_nonsing_inv S hSu
    have hSinv : S⁻¹ * S = 1 := nonsing_inv_mul S hSu
    refine ⟨col S, fun j => D j j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      exact linearIndependent_cols_of_mul_eq_one S⁻¹ S hSinv
    · 
      intro j
      constructor
      · 
        intro h
        have : (S⁻¹ * S) j j = 0 := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
          exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => by
            have := congr_fun h k; simp [col] at this; simp [this])
        rw [hSinv, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at this
        exact one_ne_zero this
      · 
        rw [mulComplex_eq_repMatrix_mulVec]
        
        set R := (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
        have hR_S : R * S = S * D := by
          rw [show R = S * D * S⁻¹ from hRSD, mul_assoc, hSinv, mul_one]
        show R *ᵥ col S j = D j j • col S j
        rw [← mulVec_single_eq_col S, mulVec_mulVec, hR_S]
        rw [← mulVec_mulVec]
        
        have hD_basis : D *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) =
            D j j • (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) := by
          ext i
          simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply,
            Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst hij; simp
          · simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
            rw [hDdiag hij]; simp [hij]
        rw [hD_basis, mulVec_smul, mulVec_single_eq_col]

name: TubalTensor.IsJointlyDiag_iff_isJointlyMatDiag
statement:
theorem IsJointlyDiag_iff_isJointlyMatDiag (S : Set (TubalCarrier n)) :
    IsJointlyDiag tr S ↔ IsJointlyMatDiag (repMatrix tr '' S)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsJointlyDiag IsJointlyMatDiag
  constructor
  · 
    intro ⟨v, hli, heig⟩
    set P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ := Matrix.of (fun i j => v j i)
    have hcol : P.col = v := by
      ext j i; simp [Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, P, Matrix.of_apply]
    have hPu : IsUnit P := linearIndependent_cols_iff_isUnit.mp (hcol ▸ hli)
    have hPdet : IsUnit P.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det P).mp hPu
    have hPP : P * P⁻¹ = 1 := mul_nonsing_inv P hPdet
    refine ⟨P, hPu, ?_⟩
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨a, haS, rfl⟩ := hA
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := heig a haS
    refine ⟨Matrix.diagonal μ, Matrix.isDiag_diagonal μ, ?_⟩
    have hAP : (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P = P * Matrix.diagonal μ := by
      ext i j'
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
      
      change ∑ k, (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) i k * v j' k =
        ∑ k, v k i * if k = j' then μ k else 0
      have : ∑ k, (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) i k * v j' k =
          ((repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ v j') i := rfl
      rw [this, ← mulComplex_eq_repMatrix_mulVec, (hμ j').2]
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq', mul_comm]
    calc (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
        = (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * (P * P⁻¹) := by rw [hPP, mul_one]
      _ = P * Matrix.diagonal μ * P⁻¹ := by rw [← mul_assoc, hAP]
  · 
    intro ⟨P, hPu, hdiag⟩
    have hPdet : IsUnit P.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det P).mp hPu
    have hPinv : P⁻¹ * P = 1 := nonsing_inv_mul P hPdet
    refine ⟨col P, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact linearIndependent_cols_of_mul_eq_one P⁻¹ P hPinv
    · intro a haS
      obtain ⟨D, hDdiag, hRD⟩ := hdiag (repMatrix tr a) ⟨a, haS, rfl⟩
      have hRP : (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P = P * D := by
        rw [hRD, mul_assoc, hPinv, mul_one]
      refine ⟨fun j => D j j, fun j => ?_⟩
      constructor
      · 
        intro h
        have : (P⁻¹ * P) j j = 0 := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
          exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => by
            have := congr_fun h k; simp [col] at this; simp [this])
        rw [hPinv, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at this
        exact one_ne_zero this
      · 
        rw [mulComplex_eq_repMatrix_mulVec]
        show (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ col P j = D j j • col P j
        rw [← mulVec_single_eq_col P, mulVec_mulVec, hRP, ← mulVec_mulVec]
        have hD_basis : D *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) =
            D j j • (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) := by
          ext i
          simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply,
            Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst hij; simp
          · simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
            rw [hDdiag hij]; simp [hij]
        rw [hD_basis, mulVec_smul, mulVec_single_eq_col]

name: TubalTensor.jointly_diag_of_diag
statement:
theorem jointly_diag_of_diag (S : Set (TubalCarrier n)) (hS : SetDiag tr S) :
    IsJointlyDiag tr S
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsJointlyDiag_iff_isJointlyMatDiag]
  apply jointly_diag_of_commuting
  · 
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨a, haS, rfl⟩ := hA
    exact (IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag tr a).mp (hS a haS)
  · 
    intro A hA B hB
    obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := hA
    obtain ⟨b, _, rfl⟩ := hB
    exact repMatrix_comm tr a b

name: TubalTensor.RingJointlyDiag_of_RingDiag
statement: theorem RingJointlyDiag_of_RingDiag (hd : RingDiag tr) : RingJointlyDiag tr
proof:
:= by
  apply jointly_diag_of_diag
  intro a _; exact hd a

name: TubalTensor.conj_map_add
statement:
private theorem conj_map_add {m : ℕ} (P P_inv : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    P * (A + B).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P_inv =
      P * A.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P_inv + P * B.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P_inv
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (A + B).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) =
      A.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) + B.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) := by ext i j; simp
  rw [hmap, mul_add, add_mul]

name: TubalTensor.conj_map_smul
statement:
private theorem conj_map_smul {m : ℕ} (P P_inv : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (r : ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    P * (r • A).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P_inv =
      (r : ℂ) • (P * A.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P_inv)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (r • A).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = (r : ℂ) • A.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) := by
    ext i j; simp
  rw [hmap, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]

name: TubalTensor.diag_span
statement:
theorem diag_span (S : Set (TubalCarrier n)) (hS : SetDiag tr S) :
    SetDiag tr (Submodule.span ℝ S : Set (TubalCarrier n))
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPu, hdiag⟩ :=
    (IsJointlyDiag_iff_isJointlyMatDiag tr S).mp (jointly_diag_of_diag tr S hS)
  have hPdet : IsUnit P.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det P).mp hPu
  have hPP : P * P⁻¹ = 1 := mul_nonsing_inv P hPdet
  have hPinv : P⁻¹ * P = 1 := nonsing_inv_mul P hPdet
  have hPinvu : IsUnit P⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]; exact Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_det P hPdet
  
  intro b hb
  rw [IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag]
  
  refine ⟨P, P⁻¹ * (repMatrix tr b).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P, hPu, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    induction hb using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem a ha =>
      obtain ⟨D, hDdiag, hRD⟩ := hdiag (repMatrix tr a) ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      
      have : P⁻¹ * (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P = D := by
        calc P⁻¹ * (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P
            = P⁻¹ * (P * D * P⁻¹) * P := by rw [hRD]
          _ = P⁻¹ * P * D * (P⁻¹ * P) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
          _ = 1 * D * 1 := by rw [hPinv]
          _ = D := by rw [one_mul, mul_one]
      rw [this]; exact hDdiag
    | zero =>
      simp only [repMatrix_zero]
      intro i j hij; simp
    | add a b _ _ iha ihb =>
      rw [repMatrix_add]
      have hmap : (repMatrix tr a + repMatrix tr b).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) =
          (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) + (repMatrix tr b).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) := by
        ext i j; simp
      rw [hmap, mul_add, add_mul]; exact iha.add ihb
    | smul r a _ iha =>
      rw [repMatrix_smul]
      have hmap : (r • repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) =
          (r : ℂ) • (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) := by ext i j; simp
      rw [hmap, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]; exact iha.smul _
  · 
    set R := (repMatrix tr b).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
    have : P * (P⁻¹ * R * P) * P⁻¹ = R := by
      have h1 : P * (P⁻¹ * R * P) = P * P⁻¹ * R * P := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      rw [h1, hPP, one_mul, mul_assoc, hPP, mul_one]
    exact this.symm

name: TubalTensor.diagonal_mulVec_eq_had
statement:
private theorem diagonal_mulVec_eq_had {m : ℕ} (v w : Fin m → ℂ) :
    Matrix.diagonal v *ᵥ w = v ∘ₕ w
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.diagonal_apply, vecHadamard_apply]

name: TubalTensor.toComplex_single
statement:
private theorem toComplex_single (j : Fin n) :
    toComplex (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ)) = (Pi.single j (1 : ℂ) : Fin n → ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [toComplex_apply, Pi.single_apply]; split <;> simp

name: TubalTensor.RingDiag_of_starMForm
statement: theorem RingDiag_of_starMForm (h : HasStarMForm tr) : RingDiag tr
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hMu, hmul⟩ := h
  have hMdet : IsUnit M.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det M).mp hMu
  have hMM : M * M⁻¹ = 1 := mul_nonsing_inv M hMdet
  have hMinv : M⁻¹ * M = 1 := nonsing_inv_mul M hMdet
  intro a
  rw [IsDiag_iff_isMatDiag]
  
  set Ma := M *ᵥ toComplex a
  refine ⟨M⁻¹, Matrix.diagonal Ma, ?_, Matrix.isDiag_diagonal Ma, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]
    exact Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_det M hMdet
  · 
    rw [nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv M hMdet]
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    suffices h : ∀ j, (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) =
        (M⁻¹ * Matrix.diagonal Ma * M) *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) by
      ext i j
      
      have hl := congr_fun (h j) i
      simpa [mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ] using hl
    intro j
    
    have hlhs : (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) =
        toComplex (tr.mul a (Pi.single j 1)) := by
      
      
      funext i
      simp [mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, toComplex_apply, repMatrix_apply,
        Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    have hrhs : (M⁻¹ * Matrix.diagonal Ma * M) *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℂ) =
        M⁻¹ *ᵥ (Ma ∘ₕ (M *ᵥ toComplex (Pi.single j 1))) := by
      
      
      
      
      rw [toComplex_single, mul_assoc]
      
      
      conv_lhs => rw [show (M⁻¹ * (Matrix.diagonal Ma * M)) *ᵥ Pi.single j 1 =
        M⁻¹ *ᵥ ((Matrix.diagonal Ma * M) *ᵥ Pi.single j 1) from by
          rw [mulVec_mulVec]]
      congr 1
      rw [show (Matrix.diagonal Ma * M) *ᵥ Pi.single j 1 =
        Matrix.diagonal Ma *ᵥ (M *ᵥ Pi.single j 1) from by rw [mulVec_mulVec]]
      exact diagonal_mulVec_eq_had Ma (M *ᵥ Pi.single j 1)
    rw [hlhs, hrhs]
    
    exact hmul a (Pi.single j 1)

name: TubalTensor.starMForm_of_RingDiag
statement: theorem starMForm_of_RingDiag (hd : RingDiag tr) : HasStarMForm tr
proof:
:= by
  
  have hjd := RingJointlyDiag_of_RingDiag tr hd
  obtain ⟨P, hPu, hdiag_all⟩ :=
    (IsJointlyDiag_iff_isJointlyMatDiag tr Set.univ).mp hjd
  have hPdet : IsUnit P.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det P).mp hPu
  have hPP : P * P⁻¹ = 1 := mul_nonsing_inv P hPdet
  have hPinv : P⁻¹ * P = 1 := nonsing_inv_mul P hPdet
  
  
  have hdiag : ∀ a : TubalCarrier n, ∃ D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ,
      D.IsDiag ∧ (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = P * D * P⁻¹ := by
    intro a; exact hdiag_all (repMatrix tr a) ⟨a, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  
  
  
  set getD : TubalCarrier n → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ := fun a => (hdiag a).choose
  have hgetD_diag : ∀ a, (getD a).IsDiag := fun a => (hdiag a).choose_spec.1
  have hgetD_eq : ∀ a, (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = P * getD a * P⁻¹ :=
    fun a => (hdiag a).choose_spec.2
  
  set d : TubalCarrier n → (Fin n → ℂ) := fun a i => getD a i i
  
  have hD_eq_diag : ∀ a, getD a = Matrix.diagonal (d a) := by
    intro a; ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, d]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [hgetD_diag a h, h]
  
  
  
  have hmul_basis : ∀ (a : TubalCarrier n) (v : TubalCarrier n),
      tr.mul a v = ∑ j : Fin n, a j • tr.mul (Pi.single j 1) v := by
    intro a v
    have ha : a = ∑ j : Fin n, a j • (Pi.single j 1 : TubalCarrier n) := by
      ext m; simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    calc tr.mul a v = tr.mul v a := tr.mul_comm a v
      _ = (tr.mulLeftLinear v) a := rfl
      _ = (tr.mulLeftLinear v) (∑ j, a j • (Pi.single j 1 : TubalCarrier n)) :=
          congr_arg _ ha
      _ = ∑ j, a j • tr.mul (Pi.single j 1) v := by
          rw [map_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
          
          rw [TubalRing.mulLeftLinear_apply]
          
          have := tr.smul_mul (a j) (Pi.single j 1 : TubalCarrier n) v
          rw [tr.mul_comm v]; exact this
  
  set M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
    Matrix.of (fun i j => d (Pi.single j 1) i) with hM_def
  
  have hMa : ∀ a : TubalCarrier n, M *ᵥ toComplex a = d a := by
    intro a; funext i
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, hM_def, Matrix.of_apply, toComplex_apply]
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have hd_can : ∀ b, d b i = (P⁻¹ * (repMatrix tr b).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P) i i := by
      intro b
      show getD b i i = _
      have key : P⁻¹ * (repMatrix tr b).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * P = getD b := by
        rw [hgetD_eq b]; simp only [mul_assoc]
        rw [hPinv, mul_one, ← mul_assoc P⁻¹ P, hPinv, one_mul]
      rw [key.symm]
    
    simp_rw [hd_can]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply, repMatrix_apply]
    
    
    simp_rw [hmul_basis a]
    simp only [TubalCarrier.sum_apply, TubalCarrier.smul_apply,
      Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    
    
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]          
    congr 1; ext k
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]          
    congr 1; ext l
    congr 1; ext x; ring
  
  have hR_diag : ∀ a : TubalCarrier n,
      (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = P * Matrix.diagonal (M *ᵥ toComplex a) * P⁻¹ := by
    intro a; rw [hMa, ← hD_eq_diag, hgetD_eq]
  
  have hR_action : ∀ a b : TubalCarrier n,
      (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ toComplex b =
        P *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex a) ∘ₕ (P⁻¹ *ᵥ toComplex b)) := by
    intro a b
    
    rw [hR_diag a, mul_assoc]
    
    simp only [← mulVec_mulVec]
    rw [diagonal_mulVec_eq_had]
  
  
  
  
  set β := P⁻¹ *ᵥ toComplex tr.one
  
  have map_mulVec_toComplex : ∀ (a b : TubalCarrier n),
      (repMatrix tr a).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ toComplex b = toComplex (tr.mul a b) := by
    intro a b
    
    
    funext i
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply, toComplex_apply, repMatrix_apply]
    
    
    have := congr_arg (fun v => (↑(v i) : ℂ)) (repMatrix_mulVec tr a b)
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, repMatrix_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum,
      Complex.ofReal_mul] at this
    exact this
  have hunit : ∀ x : TubalCarrier n,
      toComplex x = P *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex x) ∘ₕ β) := by
    intro x
    have h1 := hR_action x tr.one
    rw [map_mulVec_toComplex, tr.mul_one] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have hPinv_b : ∀ b : TubalCarrier n,
      P⁻¹ *ᵥ toComplex b = (M *ᵥ toComplex b) ∘ₕ β := by
    intro b
    have := hunit b
    
    calc P⁻¹ *ᵥ toComplex b
        = P⁻¹ *ᵥ (P *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex b) ∘ₕ β)) := by congr 1
      _ = (P⁻¹ * P) *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex b) ∘ₕ β) := by rw [mulVec_mulVec]
      _ = (M *ᵥ toComplex b) ∘ₕ β := by rw [hPinv, one_mulVec]
  
  have hformula : ∀ a b : TubalCarrier n,
      toComplex (tr.mul a b) = (P * Matrix.diagonal β) *ᵥ
        ((M *ᵥ toComplex a) ∘ₕ (M *ᵥ toComplex b)) := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := hR_action a b
    rw [map_mulVec_toComplex, hPinv_b] at h1
    
    rw [h1]
    
    
    rw [show (M *ᵥ toComplex a) ∘ₕ ((M *ᵥ toComplex b) ∘ₕ β) =
        β ∘ₕ ((M *ᵥ toComplex a) ∘ₕ (M *ᵥ toComplex b)) from by
      ext k; simp [vecHadamard_apply]; ring,
      ← diagonal_mulVec_eq_had, mulVec_mulVec]
  
  have hNM : (P * Matrix.diagonal β) * M = 1 := by
    ext i j
    
    
    have h := hunit (Pi.single j 1)
    
    rw [show P *ᵥ ((M *ᵥ toComplex (Pi.single j 1)) ∘ₕ β) =
        (P * Matrix.diagonal β) *ᵥ (M *ᵥ toComplex (Pi.single j 1)) from by
      rw [show (M *ᵥ toComplex (Pi.single j 1)) ∘ₕ β =
          β ∘ₕ (M *ᵥ toComplex (Pi.single j 1)) from vecHadamard_comm _ _]
      rw [← diagonal_mulVec_eq_had, mulVec_mulVec]] at h
    
    rw [mulVec_mulVec] at h
    
    have hi := congr_fun h i
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, toComplex_apply, Pi.single_apply,
      apply_ite ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ), Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero,
      mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true,
      Matrix.one_apply] at hi ⊢
    exact hi.symm
  
  have hMu : IsUnit M := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]; exact isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hNM
  
  have hMinv : M⁻¹ = P * Matrix.diagonal β := by
    have hMdet := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det M).mp hMu
    exact inv_eq_left_inv hNM
  
  exact ⟨M, hMu, fun a b => by rw [hMinv]; exact hformula a b⟩

name: TubalTensor.RingDiag_iff_starMForm
statement: theorem RingDiag_iff_starMForm : RingDiag tr ↔ HasStarMForm tr
proof:
:=
  ⟨starMForm_of_RingDiag tr, RingDiag_of_starMForm tr⟩

name: TubalTensor.fullTubalSubRing_carrier
statement:
theorem fullTubalSubRing_carrier :
    (fullTubalSubRing tr).carrier = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [TubalSubRing.carrier, fullTubalSubRing]

name: TubalTensor.main_theorem
statement: theorem main_theorem : HasStarMForm tr
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨N, Ws, hfield, hsub, hspan⟩ := subring_decomp_subfields tr (fullTubalSubRing tr)
  
  have hdiag : ∀ j, SetDiag tr (Ws j).carrier := fun j => subfield_diag tr (Ws j) (hfield j)
  
  have hunion_diag : SetDiag tr (⋃ j, (Ws j).carrier) := by
    intro a ha; rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at ha
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ha; exact hdiag j a hj
  
  have hspan_diag : SetDiag tr (Submodule.span ℝ (⋃ j, (Ws j).carrier) : Set (TubalCarrier n)) :=
    diag_span tr _ hunion_diag
  
  have hring_diag : RingDiag tr := by
    intro a
    have ha_mem : a ∈ (fullTubalSubRing tr).carrier := by
      simp [fullTubalSubRing, TubalSubRing.carrier]
    exact hspan_diag a (hspan ha_mem)
  
  exact (RingDiag_iff_starMForm tr).mp hring_diag

name: TubalTensor.TubalSubRing.mem_carrier
statement: theorem mem_carrier {x : TubalCarrier n} : x ∈ V.carrier ↔ x ∈ V.toSubmodule
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TubalTensor.TubalSubRing.zero_mem
statement: theorem zero_mem : (0 : TubalCarrier n) ∈ V.carrier
proof: := V.toSubmodule.zero_mem

name: TubalTensor.TubalSubRing.add_mem
statement:
theorem add_mem {x y : TubalCarrier n} (hx : x ∈ V.carrier) (hy : y ∈ V.carrier) :
    x + y ∈ V.carrier
proof: := V.toSubmodule.add_mem hx hy

name: TubalTensor.TubalSubRing.smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_mem (r : ℝ) {x : TubalCarrier n} (hx : x ∈ V.carrier) :
    r • x ∈ V.carrier
proof: := V.toSubmodule.smul_mem r hx

name: TubalTensor.TubalSubRing.unit_idempotent
statement: theorem unit_idempotent : tr.mul V.unit V.unit = V.unit
proof:
:=
  V.unit_mul V.unit V.unit_mem

name: TubalTensor.TubalSubRing.mul_unit
statement: theorem mul_unit {x : TubalCarrier n} (hx : x ∈ V.carrier) : tr.mul x V.unit = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tr.mul_comm]; exact V.unit_mul x hx

name: TubalTensor.TubalSubRing.neg_mem
statement: theorem neg_mem {x : TubalCarrier n} (hx : x ∈ V.carrier) : -x ∈ V.carrier
proof:
:= by
  have h : (-1 : ℝ) • x = -x := by ext i; simp
  rw [← h]; exact V.smul_mem (-1) hx

name: TubalTensor.TubalSubRing.sub_mem
statement:
theorem sub_mem {x y : TubalCarrier n} (hx : x ∈ V.carrier) (hy : y ∈ V.carrier) :
    x - y ∈ V.carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact V.add_mem hx (V.neg_mem hy)

name: TubalTensor.self_mem_principalIdeal
statement:
theorem self_mem_principalIdeal (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    a ∈ principalIdeal tr a
proof:
:=
  ⟨tr.one, tr.one_mul a⟩

name: TubalTensor.zero_mem_principalIdeal
statement:
theorem zero_mem_principalIdeal (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    (0 : TubalCarrier n) ∈ principalIdeal tr a
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, tr.zero_mul a⟩

name: TubalTensor.mul_right_mem_principalIdeal
statement:
theorem mul_right_mem_principalIdeal (a x : TubalCarrier n) :
    tr.mul x a ∈ principalIdeal tr a
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: TubalTensor.mul_left_mem_principalIdeal
statement:
theorem mul_left_mem_principalIdeal (a x : TubalCarrier n) :
    tr.mul a x ∈ principalIdeal tr a
proof:
:= by
  rw [tr.mul_comm]; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: TubalTensor.principalIdeal_add
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx; obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨x' + y', tr.right_distrib x' y' a⟩

name: TubalTensor.principalIdeal_smul
statement:
theorem principalIdeal_smul {a : TubalCarrier n} (r : ℝ) {x : TubalCarrier n}
    (hx : x ∈ principalIdeal tr a) : r • x ∈ principalIdeal tr a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx; exact ⟨r • x', tr.smul_mul r x' a⟩

name: TubalTensor.mem_principalIdealSubmodule
statement:
theorem mem_principalIdealSubmodule (a x : TubalCarrier n) :
    x ∈ principalIdealSubmodule tr a ↔ x ∈ principalIdeal tr a
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TubalTensor.principalIdeal_ideal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨tr.mul y x', by rw [tr.mul_assoc, tr.mul_comm x', ← tr.mul_assoc]⟩

name: TubalTensor.principalUnit_idempotent
statement:
theorem principalUnit_idempotent (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    tr.mul (principalUnit tr a) (principalUnit tr a) = principalUnit tr a
proof:
:= by
  unfold principalUnit; exact tr.mul_idempotent_of_vnr (tr.weakInv_mp1 a)

name: TubalTensor.principalUnit_mem
statement:
theorem principalUnit_mem (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    principalUnit tr a ∈ principalIdeal tr a
proof:
:= by
  unfold principalUnit
  exact mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr a (tr.weakInv a)

name: TubalTensor.principalUnit_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx
  unfold principalUnit
  calc tr.mul (tr.mul a (tr.weakInv a)) (tr.mul x' a)
      = tr.mul x' (tr.mul (tr.mul a (tr.weakInv a)) a) := by
        rw [tr.mul_comm, tr.mul_assoc, tr.mul_comm a, ← tr.mul_assoc]
    _ = tr.mul x' a := by rw [tr.weakInv_mp1]

name: TubalTensor.principalIdeal_weakInv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tr.weakInv_mp2 x, tr.mul_comm]
  exact principalIdeal_ideal tr (principalIdeal_ideal tr hx (tr.weakInv x)) (tr.weakInv x)

name: TubalTensor.tubalSubRing_eq_principalIdeal
statement:
theorem tubalSubRing_eq_principalIdeal (V : TubalSubRing tr) :
    V.carrier = principalIdeal tr V.unit
proof:
:= by
  ext x; constructor
  · intro hx; exact ⟨x, by rw [tr.mul_comm]; exact V.unit_mul x hx⟩
  · intro ⟨y, hy⟩; rw [← hy]; exact V.ideal y V.unit_mem

name: TubalTensor.tubalSubRing_unit_IsIdempotent
statement:
theorem tubalSubRing_unit_IsIdempotent (V : TubalSubRing tr) :
    IsIdempotent tr V.unit
proof: := V.unit_idempotent

name: TubalTensor.tubalSubRing_unit_unique
statement:
theorem tubalSubRing_unit_unique (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {e : TubalCarrier n} (he_mem : e ∈ V.carrier)
    (he_unit : ∀ x, x ∈ V.carrier → tr.mul e x = x) :
    e = V.unit
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := he_unit V.unit V.unit_mem
  have h2 := V.unit_mul e he_mem
  rw [tr.mul_comm] at h2; rw [← h1, h2]

name: TubalTensor.idempotent_is_unit_of_principalIdeal
statement:
theorem idempotent_is_unit_of_principalIdeal
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_idem : IsIdempotent tr p)
    {x : TubalCarrier n} (hx : x ∈ principalIdeal tr p) :
    tr.mul p x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [← tr.mul_assoc, tr.mul_comm p y, tr.mul_assoc, hp_idem]

name: TubalTensor.tubalSubRing_idempotent_unique
statement:
theorem tubalSubRing_idempotent_unique (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {e : TubalCarrier n} (he_idem : IsIdempotent tr e)
    (he_gen : V.carrier = principalIdeal tr e) :
    e = V.unit
proof:
:= by
  apply tubalSubRing_unit_unique tr V
  · rw [he_gen]; exact self_mem_principalIdeal tr e
  · intro x hx
    rw [he_gen] at hx
    exact idempotent_is_unit_of_principalIdeal tr he_idem hx

name: TubalTensor.exists_unique_idempotent_generator
statement:
theorem exists_unique_idempotent_generator (V : TubalSubRing tr) :
    ∃! e : TubalCarrier n, IsIdempotent tr e ∧ V.carrier = principalIdeal tr e
proof:
:=
  ⟨V.unit,
   ⟨tubalSubRing_unit_IsIdempotent tr V, tubalSubRing_eq_principalIdeal tr V⟩,
   fun _ ⟨he_idem, he_gen⟩ => tubalSubRing_idempotent_unique tr V he_idem he_gen⟩

name: TubalTensor.complement_idempotent
statement:
theorem complement_idempotent (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_mem : p ∈ V.carrier) (hp_idem : IsIdempotent tr p) :
    IsIdempotent tr (V.unit - p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsIdempotent at hp_idem ⊢
  have hep : tr.mul V.unit p = p := V.unit_mul p hp_mem
  have hpe : tr.mul p V.unit = p := V.mul_unit hp_mem
  calc tr.mul (V.unit - p) (V.unit - p)
      = tr.mul V.unit V.unit - tr.mul V.unit p -
        (tr.mul p V.unit - tr.mul p p) := by
        rw [tr.mul_sub, tr.sub_mul, tr.sub_mul]; abel
    _ = V.unit - p - (p - p) := by rw [V.unit_idempotent, hep, hpe, hp_idem]
    _ = V.unit - p := by rw [sub_self, sub_zero]

name: TubalTensor.orthogonal_complement
statement:
theorem orthogonal_complement (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_mem : p ∈ V.carrier) (hp_idem : IsIdempotent tr p) :
    tr.mul p (V.unit - p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tr.mul_sub, V.mul_unit hp_mem, hp_idem, sub_self]

name: TubalTensor.orthogonal_complement'
statement:
theorem orthogonal_complement' (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_mem : p ∈ V.carrier) (hp_idem : IsIdempotent tr p) :
    tr.mul (V.unit - p) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tr.mul_comm]; exact orthogonal_complement tr V hp_mem hp_idem

name: TubalTensor.principalIdeal_inter_zero
statement:
theorem principalIdeal_inter_zero (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_mem : p ∈ V.carrier) (hp_idem : IsIdempotent tr p)
    {x : TubalCarrier n}
    (hxp : x ∈ principalIdeal tr p)
    (hxq : x ∈ principalIdeal tr (V.unit - p)) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hxp
  have hpx : tr.mul p x = x := by
    rw [← hy, ← tr.mul_assoc, tr.mul_comm p y, tr.mul_assoc, hp_idem]
  have h0 : tr.mul (V.unit - p) x = 0 := by
    rw [← hy, ← tr.mul_assoc, tr.mul_comm (V.unit - p) y, tr.mul_assoc,
        orthogonal_complement' tr V hp_mem hp_idem, tr.mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hxq
  have hq_idem : tr.mul (V.unit - p) (V.unit - p) = V.unit - p :=
    complement_idempotent tr V hp_mem hp_idem
  have hqx : tr.mul (V.unit - p) x = x := by
    rw [← hz, ← tr.mul_assoc, tr.mul_comm (V.unit - p) z, tr.mul_assoc, hq_idem]
  rw [← hqx, h0]

name: TubalTensor.decompose_sum
statement:
theorem decompose_sum (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p x : TubalCarrier n} (hx : x ∈ V.carrier) :
    x = tr.mul p x + tr.mul (V.unit - p) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tr.right_distrib]; conv_rhs => rw [show p + (V.unit - p) = V.unit by abel]
  exact (V.unit_mul x hx).symm

name: TubalTensor.principalIdealSubmodule_le_of_mem
statement:
theorem principalIdealSubmodule_le_of_mem (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_mem : p ∈ V.carrier) :
    principalIdealSubmodule tr p ≤ V.toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  intro x ⟨y, hy⟩; rw [← hy]; exact V.ideal y hp_mem

name: TubalTensor.idempotent_decomposition
statement:
theorem idempotent_decomposition (V : TubalSubRing tr)
    {p : TubalCarrier n} (hp_mem : p ∈ V.carrier) (hp_idem : IsIdempotent tr p) :
    IsCompl
      ((principalIdealSubmodule tr p).comap V.toSubmodule.subtype)
      ((principalIdealSubmodule tr (V.unit - p)).comap V.toSubmodule.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    rw [disjoint_iff]
    ext ⟨x, hxV⟩
    simp only [Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.mem_bot]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hxp, hxq⟩
      exact Subtype.ext (principalIdeal_inter_zero tr V hp_mem hp_idem hxp hxq)
    · intro h
      have hx0 : x = 0 := congr_arg Subtype.val h
      subst hx0
      exact ⟨zero_mem_principalIdeal tr p, zero_mem_principalIdeal tr (V.unit - p)⟩
  · 
    rw [codisjoint_iff]
    ext ⟨x, hxV⟩
    simp only [Submodule.mem_sup, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.mem_top, iff_true]
    have hpx_mem := principalIdealSubmodule_le_of_mem tr V hp_mem
                      (mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr p x)
    have hqx_mem := principalIdealSubmodule_le_of_mem tr V (V.sub_mem V.unit_mem hp_mem)
                      (mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr (V.unit - p) x)
    exact ⟨⟨tr.mul p x, hpx_mem⟩, mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr p x,
           ⟨tr.mul (V.unit - p) x, hqx_mem⟩, mul_left_mem_principalIdeal tr (V.unit - p) x,
           Subtype.ext (decompose_sum tr V hxV).symm⟩

name: TubalTensor.squeeze_twist
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squeeze_twist (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    squeeze (twist M : OrientedMatrix m n td) = M
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.twist_squeeze
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_squeeze (U : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    twist (squeeze U) = U
proof:
:= by
  funext i; rfl

name: TubalTensor.tubalMatrix_one_eq
statement:
theorem tubalMatrix_one_eq :
    (1 : TubalMatrix m m n td) = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp [Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]

name: TubalTensor.dotM_apply
statement:
theorem dotM_apply (U V : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM U V = ∑ i : Fin m, star (U i) * V i
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.dotM_conj_symm
statement:
theorem dotM_conj_symm (U V : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM U V = star (dotM V U)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotM_apply, star_sum, star_mul, star_star, mul_comm]

name: TubalTensor.dotM_add_right
statement:
theorem dotM_add_right (U V W : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM U (V + W) = dotM U V + dotM U W
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotM_apply]
  simp only [show ∀ i, (V + W) i = V i + W i from fun i => rfl, mul_add,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: TubalTensor.dotM_smul_right
statement:
theorem dotM_smul_right (U : OrientedMatrix m n td) (r : KM n td)
    (V : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM U (r • V) = r * dotM U V
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotM_apply, show ∀ i, (r • V) i = r * V i from fun i => rfl]
  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1; ext i; rw [mul_left_comm]

name: TubalTensor.dotM_linear_right
statement:
theorem dotM_linear_right (U : OrientedMatrix m n td) (r s : KM n td)
    (V W : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM U (r • V + s • W) = r * dotM U V + s * dotM U W
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotM_add_right, dotM_smul_right, dotM_smul_right]

name: TubalTensor.applyM_starMC_self
proof:
:= by
  unfold starMC starConjC
  rw [td.applyM_applyMinv, td.applyM_applyMinv]

name: TubalTensor.applyM_star_mul_self
statement:
private theorem applyM_star_mul_self (td : TubalData n) (u : KM n td) :
    td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (star u * u))) =
    vecConj (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun u))) ∘ₕ
      td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun u))
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 : toComplex (KM.toFun (star u * u)) =
      starMC td (starConjC td (toComplex (KM.toFun u))) (toComplex (KM.toFun u)) := by
    change toComplex (starM td (starConjM td (KM.toFun u)) (KM.toFun u)) = _
    rw [starM_eq_starMC, starConjM_eq_starConjC]
  rw [h1]
  exact applyM_starMC_self td _

name: TubalTensor.conj_had_self_eq_normSq
statement:
private theorem conj_had_self_eq_normSq {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    (vecConj y ∘ₕ y) j = ↑(Complex.normSq (y j))
proof:
:= by
  show vecConj y j * y j = _
  rw [vecConj_apply, mul_comm, Complex.mul_conj]

name: TubalTensor.conj_had_self_real
statement:
private theorem conj_had_self_real {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    ((vecConj y ∘ₕ y) j).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [conj_had_self_eq_normSq, Complex.ofReal_im]

name: TubalTensor.conj_had_self_nonneg
statement:
private theorem conj_had_self_nonneg {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ ((vecConj y ∘ₕ y) j).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [conj_had_self_eq_normSq, Complex.ofReal_re]
  exact Complex.normSq_nonneg _

name: TubalTensor.KM.le_def
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TubalTensor.KM.star_mul_self_nonneg
statement:
theorem KM.star_mul_self_nonneg (u : KM n td) :
    (0 : KM n td) ≤ star u * u
proof:
:= by
  rw [KM.le_def]
  simp only [KM.toFun_zero, sub_zero]
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [applyM_star_mul_self]; exact conj_had_self_real _ i
  · rw [applyM_star_mul_self]; exact conj_had_self_nonneg _ i

name: TubalTensor.applyM_zero
statement:
private theorem applyM_zero (td : TubalData n) :
    td.applyM (0 : Fin n → ℂ) = 0
proof: := Matrix.mulVec_zero _

name: TubalTensor.applyM_toComplex_KM_zero
statement:
private theorem applyM_toComplex_KM_zero (td : TubalData n) :
    td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (0 : KM n td))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [KM.toFun_zero, toComplex_zero]; exact applyM_zero td

name: TubalTensor.KM.star_mul_self_eq_zero
statement: theorem KM.star_mul_self_eq_zero {u : KM n td} (h : star u * u = 0) : u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hMsq : vecConj (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun u))) ∘ₕ
      td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun u)) = 0 := by
    have harg : td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (star u * u))) = 0 := by
      rw [h]; exact applyM_toComplex_KM_zero td
    rwa [applyM_star_mul_self] at harg
  have hMu : td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun u)) = 0 := by
    ext j
    have hj := congr_fun hMsq j
    rw [conj_had_self_eq_normSq, Pi.zero_apply, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero] at hj
    exact Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp hj
  exact KM.ext (fun i => congr_fun (toComplex_injective
    (td.applyM_injective (hMu.trans (applyM_zero td).symm))) i)

name: TubalTensor.applyM_toComplex_sum
statement:
private theorem applyM_toComplex_sum (td : TubalData n) {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → KM n td) :
    td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (∑ i ∈ s, f i))) =
    ∑ i ∈ s, td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (f i)))
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
    exact applyM_toComplex_KM_zero td
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha,
      show KM.toFun (f a + ∑ x ∈ s, f x) = KM.toFun (f a) + KM.toFun (∑ x ∈ s, f x) from rfl,
      toComplex_add, td.applyM_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: TubalTensor.dotM_nonneg
statement:
theorem dotM_nonneg (U : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    (0 : KM n td) ≤ dotM U U
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotM_apply, KM.le_def]
  simp only [KM.toFun_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [applyM_toComplex_sum]
  refine ⟨fun j => ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
  · simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [Complex.im_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => by
      rw [applyM_star_mul_self]; exact conj_had_self_real _ j
  · simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [Complex.re_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by
      rw [applyM_star_mul_self]; exact conj_had_self_nonneg _ j

name: TubalTensor.dotM_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem dotM_eq_zero_iff (U : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM U U = 0 ↔ U = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [dotM_apply] at h
    
    have h0 : ∀ j, (∑ i : Fin m,
        td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (star (U i) * U i)))) j = 0 := by
      intro j
      have hval : td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (∑ i, star (U i) * U i))) = 0 := by
        rw [h]; exact applyM_toComplex_KM_zero td
      rw [applyM_toComplex_sum] at hval
      exact congr_fun hval j
    
    
    funext i
    apply KM.star_mul_self_eq_zero
    
    have hMi : td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (star (U i) * U i))) = 0 := by
      ext j; rw [Pi.zero_apply, applyM_star_mul_self, conj_had_self_eq_normSq]
      
      have hsum : ∑ k : Fin m,
          (Complex.normSq (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (U k))) j) : ℂ) = 0 := by
        have := h0 j
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply] at this
        convert this using 1; congr 1; ext k
        rw [applyM_star_mul_self, conj_had_self_eq_normSq]
      
      have hre : ∑ k : Fin m,
          Complex.normSq (td.applyM (toComplex (KM.toFun (U k))) j) = 0 := by
        have hre_cx := congr_arg Complex.re hsum
        simp only [Complex.zero_re] at hre_cx
        exact_mod_cast hre_cx
      have h_term := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun k _ =>
          Complex.normSq_nonneg _)).mp hre i (Finset.mem_univ _)
      simp only [h_term, Complex.ofReal_zero]
    exact KM.ext (fun k => congr_fun (toComplex_injective
      (td.applyM_injective (hMi.trans (applyM_zero td).symm))) k)
  · intro h; rw [h, dotM_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    show star ((0 : OrientedMatrix m n td) i) * (0 : OrientedMatrix m n td) i = 0
    simp [show (0 : OrientedMatrix m n td) i = (0 : KM n td) from rfl]

name: TubalTensor.dotM_properties
statement:
theorem dotM_properties (U V : OrientedMatrix m n td) (r s : KM n td)
    (W X : OrientedMatrix m n td) :
    dotM U V = star (dotM V U) ∧
    dotM U (r • W + s • X) = r * dotM U W + s * dotM U X ∧
    (0 : KM n td) ≤ dotM U U ∧
    (dotM U U = 0 ↔ U = 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨dotM_conj_symm U V, dotM_linear_right U r s W X, dotM_nonneg U, dotM_eq_zero_iff U⟩

name: TubalTensor.applyM_real_row
statement:
theorem applyM_real_row {td : TubalData n} {a : Fin n → ℝ} {i : Fin n}
    (hrow : IsRealRow td.M i) : (td.applyM (toComplex a) i).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply]
  rw [Complex.im_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  have hr : (td.M i j).im = 0 := hrow j
  simp only [toComplex_apply, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, hr, zero_mul, add_zero]

proof:
:= by
  simp only [TubalData.applyM_apply, map_sum, map_mul]
  congr 1
  ext j
  rw [hconj j]
  simp [toComplex_apply, Complex.conj_ofReal]

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ h => applyM_real_row h, fun _ _ _ h => applyM_conj_row h⟩

name: TubalTensor.vecHadamard_hasPairedStructure
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i hrow
    simp only [vecHadamard_apply]
    have hure : (u i).im = 0 := hu.1 i hrow
    have hvre : (v i).im = 0 := hv.1 i hrow
    simp only [Complex.mul_im, hure, hvre, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  · intro i k hki hconj
    simp only [vecHadamard_apply]
    rw [hu.2 i k hki hconj, hv.2 i k hki hconj]
    show starRingEnd ℂ (u i) * starRingEnd ℂ (v i) = starRingEnd ℂ (u i * v i)
    rw [map_mul]

name: TubalTensor.TubalRing.mul_idempotent_of_vnr
statement:
theorem mul_idempotent_of_vnr {a x : TubalCarrier n} (hx : tr.mul (tr.mul a x) a = a) :
    tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul a x) = tr.mul a x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tr.mul_assoc, hx]

name: TubalTensor.TubalRing.vnr_refined
statement:
theorem vnr_refined (a : TubalCarrier n) :
    ∃ x, tr.mul (tr.mul a x) a = a ∧ tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := tr.vnr a
  have hpa : tr.mul (tr.mul a x) a = a := hx
  have hpp : tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul a x) = tr.mul a x :=
    tr.mul_idempotent_of_vnr hx
  have hxa : tr.mul x a = tr.mul a x := tr.mul_comm x a
  have hap : tr.mul a (tr.mul a x) = a := by rw [tr.mul_comm]; exact hpa
  refine ⟨tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : tr.mul a (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x) = tr.mul a (tr.mul (tr.mul a x) x) := by
      rw [hxa]
    have h2 : tr.mul a (tr.mul (tr.mul a x) x) = tr.mul (tr.mul a (tr.mul a x)) x := by
      rw [← tr.mul_assoc]
    have h3 : tr.mul a (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x) = tr.mul a x := by
      rw [h1, h2, hap]
    calc tr.mul (tr.mul a (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x)) a
        = tr.mul (tr.mul a x) a := by rw [h3]
      _ = a := hpa
  · have h1 : tr.mul (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x) a = tr.mul (tr.mul (tr.mul a x) x) a := by
      rw [hxa]
    have h2 : tr.mul (tr.mul (tr.mul a x) x) a = tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul x a) := by
      rw [tr.mul_assoc]
    have h3 : tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul x a) = tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul a x) := by
      rw [hxa]
    have hya : tr.mul (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x) a = tr.mul a x := by
      rw [h1, h2, h3, hpp]
    have h4 : tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x) =
              tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul (tr.mul a x) x) := by rw [hxa]
    have h5 : tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul (tr.mul a x) x) =
              tr.mul (tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul a x)) x := by rw [← tr.mul_assoc]
    calc tr.mul (tr.mul (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x) a) (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x)
        = tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x) := by rw [hya]
      _ = tr.mul (tr.mul (tr.mul a x) (tr.mul a x)) x := by rw [h4, h5]
      _ = tr.mul (tr.mul a x) x := by rw [hpp]
      _ = tr.mul (tr.mul x a) x := by rw [hxa]

name: TubalTensor.inv_real_of_real
statement:
theorem inv_real_of_real {A Ainv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : ∀ i j, (A i j).im = 0)
    (hL : Ainv * A = 1) (hR : A * Ainv = 1) :
    ∀ i j, (Ainv i j).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hAconj : A.map (starRingEnd ℂ) = A := by
    ext i j; simp only [Matrix.map_apply]
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def]
    exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr (hA i j)
  
  have map_mul_conj : ∀ (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      (X * Y).map (starRingEnd ℂ) = X.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * Y.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by
    intro X Y; ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, map_sum, map_mul]
  
  have map_one_conj : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).map (starRingEnd ℂ) = 1 := by
    ext i j; rw [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp [map_one, map_zero]
  
  have hconjL : Ainv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * A = 1 := by
    calc Ainv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * A
        = Ainv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * A.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by rw [hAconj]
      _ = (Ainv * A).map (starRingEnd ℂ) := (map_mul_conj Ainv A).symm
      _ = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by rw [hL]
      _ = 1 := map_one_conj
  
  have heq : Ainv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) = Ainv :=
    calc Ainv.map (starRingEnd ℂ)
        = Ainv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ = Ainv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * (A * Ainv) := by rw [hR]
      _ = (Ainv.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * A) * Ainv := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = 1 * Ainv := by rw [hconjL]
      _ = Ainv := one_mul _
  
  intro i j
  have hij := congr_fun₂ heq i j
  rw [Matrix.map_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_def] at hij
  exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hij

name: TubalTensor.conjPairBlockInv_mul_conjPairBlock
statement:
theorem conjPairBlockInv_mul_conjPairBlock :
    conjPairBlockInv * conjPairBlock = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [conjPairBlockInv, conjPairBlock, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
    Matrix.one_apply]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all <;> apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.div_ofReal, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
      Real.mul_self_sqrt sqrt2_nonneg] <;>
    field_simp <;>
    nlinarith [Real.mul_self_sqrt sqrt2_nonneg]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalMinv_block_mul
statement:

proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalMinv_block canonicalM_block
  rw [fromBlocks_multiply, ← blockDiagonal_mul]
  simp [conjPairBlockInv_mul_conjPairBlock]
  show fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) 0 0

    (blockDiagonal (1 : Fin k → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) = 1

name: TubalTensor.conjPairBlock_conj_rows

    ∀ j : Fin 2, conjPairBlock 1 j = starRingEnd ℂ (conjPairBlock 0 j)
