name: TubalTensor.conjPairBlock_not_allReal
statement:
private theorem conjPairBlock_not_allReal (r : Fin 2) :
    (conjPairBlock r 1).im ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    inv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) > 0)))
  fin_cases r <;> simp [conjPairBlock, Complex.div_ofReal, Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_im,
    Complex.I_re]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalM_isRealPaired
statement:
theorem canonicalM_isRealPaired (n m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2) :
    IsRealPaired (canonicalM n m hm hpar)
proof:
:= by
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
  set e := canonicalEquiv m k hk
  
  have entry_eq : ∀ i j, canonicalM n m hm hpar i j =
      canonicalM_block m k (e.symm i) (e.symm j) := fun _ _ => rfl
  intro i
  rcases h : e.symm i with a | ⟨r, b⟩
  · 
    left; intro j
    rw [entry_eq, h]
    rcases h' : e.symm j with c | ⟨s, d⟩
    · simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₁, one_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    · simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₂, Matrix.zero_apply]
  · 
    right
    
    have hr_other : ∀ (r : Fin 2), ∃ r' : Fin 2, r' ≠ r ∧
        (∀ j, conjPairBlock r' j = starRingEnd ℂ (conjPairBlock r j)) := by
      intro r; fin_cases r
      · exact ⟨1, by decide, conjPairBlock_conj_rows⟩
      · exact ⟨0, by decide, conjPairBlock_conj_rows'⟩
    obtain ⟨r', hr'_ne, hr'_conj⟩ := hr_other r
    refine ⟨e (Sum.inr (r', b)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro heq
      have := congr_arg e.symm heq
      simp at this; rw [h] at this
      exact absurd (congr_arg Prod.fst (Sum.inr.inj this)) hr'_ne
    · 
      intro j
      rw [entry_eq, entry_eq, h]
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rcases h' : e.symm j with c | ⟨s, d⟩
      · simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₁]
      · simp only [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply]
        split
        · next hbd => subst hbd; exact hr'_conj _
        · simp [starRingEnd_apply]
    · 
      intro l hl hconj
      
      have h_entry_l : ∀ j, canonicalM n m hm hpar l j =
          canonicalM_block m k (e.symm l) (e.symm j) := fun _ => rfl
      
      
      set j₁ := e (Sum.inr (1, b))
      have hj₁ : e.symm j₁ = Sum.inr (1, b) := by simp [j₁]
      
      have hi_j₁ : canonicalM n m hm hpar i j₁ =
          conjPairBlock r 1 := by
        rw [entry_eq, h, hj₁]
        simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_eq]
      
      have hl_j₁ : canonicalM n m hm hpar l j₁ =
          starRingEnd ℂ (conjPairBlock r 1) := by
        rw [show canonicalM n m hm hpar l j₁ = starRingEnd ℂ (canonicalM n m hm hpar i j₁)
            from hconj j₁, hi_j₁]
      
      set j₀ := e (Sum.inr (0, b))
      have hj₀ : e.symm j₀ = Sum.inr (0, b) := by simp [j₀]
      have hi_j₀ : canonicalM n m hm hpar i j₀ = conjPairBlock r 0 := by
        rw [entry_eq, h, hj₀]
        simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_eq]
      have hl_j₀ : canonicalM n m hm hpar l j₀ =
          starRingEnd ℂ (conjPairBlock r 0) := by
        rw [show canonicalM n m hm hpar l j₀ = starRingEnd ℂ (canonicalM n m hm hpar i j₀)
            from hconj j₀, hi_j₀]
      
      rcases hl_eq : e.symm l with a' | ⟨r'', b'⟩
      · 
        exfalso
        have : canonicalM n m hm hpar l j₁ = 0 := by
          rw [h_entry_l, hl_eq, hj₁]
          simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₂]
        rw [this] at hl_j₁
        have : (starRingEnd ℂ (conjPairBlock r 1)).im ≠ 0 := by
          rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_im, neg_ne_zero]
          exact conjPairBlock_not_allReal r
        rw [← hl_j₁] at this; exact this (by simp)
      · 
        
        have hb'_eq : b' = b := by
          by_contra hne
          have : canonicalM n m hm hpar l j₀ = 0 := by
            rw [h_entry_l, hl_eq, hj₀]
            simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_ne _ _ _ hne]
          rw [this] at hl_j₀
          have hzero : conjPairBlock r 0 = 0 := by
            rwa [eq_comm, map_eq_zero_iff _ (starRingEnd ℂ).injective] at hl_j₀
          
          have : (1 : ℂ) / ↑(Real.sqrt 2) = 0 := by
            fin_cases r <;> simp [conjPairBlock] at hzero
          exact (div_ne_zero one_ne_zero sqrt2_cast_ne_zero) this
        
        have hl_j₁' : conjPairBlock r'' 1 = starRingEnd ℂ (conjPairBlock r 1) := by
          have : canonicalM n m hm hpar l j₁ = conjPairBlock r'' 1 := by
            rw [h_entry_l, hl_eq, hj₁]; rw [hb'_eq]
            simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_eq]
          rw [← this]; exact hl_j₁
        
        have hgoal : conjPairBlock r'' 1 = conjPairBlock r' 1 := by
          rw [hl_j₁', hr'_conj 1]
        
        have hr''_eq : r'' = r' := by
          by_contra h_ne
          have : conjPairBlock r'' 1 ≠ conjPairBlock r' 1 := by
            fin_cases r'' <;> fin_cases r' <;> (try exact absurd rfl h_ne) <;>
              intro heq <;> simp [conjPairBlock] at heq <;>
              have := congr_arg Complex.im heq <;>
              simp [Complex.I_im, Complex.neg_im] at this <;>
              linarith [Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos (show (2 : ℝ) > 0 by norm_num)]
          exact this hgoal
        
        calc l = e (e.symm l) := (Equiv.apply_symm_apply e l).symm
          _ = e (Sum.inr (r', b)) := by rw [hl_eq, hb'_eq, hr''_eq]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalMinv_mul_canonicalM
statement:
theorem canonicalMinv_mul_canonicalM (n m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2) :
    canonicalMinv n m hm hpar * canonicalM n m hm hpar = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalMinv, canonicalM]
  rw [submatrix_mul_equiv, canonicalMinv_block_mul, submatrix_one_equiv]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalM_mul_canonicalMinv
statement:
theorem canonicalM_mul_canonicalMinv (n m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2) :
    canonicalM n m hm hpar * canonicalMinv n m hm hpar = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalM, canonicalMinv]
  rw [submatrix_mul_equiv, canonicalM_block_mul_inv, submatrix_one_equiv]

name: TubalTensor.realness_canonicalTubalData
statement:
theorem realness_canonicalTubalData (n m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2) :
    realness (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) = m
proof:
:= by
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
  set e := canonicalEquiv m k hk
  
  have not_real_of_inr : ∀ (i : Fin n) (r : Fin 2) (b : Fin k),
      e.symm i = Sum.inr (r, b) → ¬∀ j, ((canonicalM n m hm hpar) i j).im = 0 := by
    intro i r b hi hreal
    have h1 : (canonicalM n m hm hpar i (e (Sum.inr (1, b)))).im = 0 := hreal _
    have h2 : canonicalM n m hm hpar i (e (Sum.inr (1, b))) = conjPairBlock r 1 := by
      show canonicalM_block m k (e.symm i) (e.symm (e (Sum.inr (1, b)))) = _
      simp [hi, canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_eq]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact conjPairBlock_not_allReal r h1
  have real_of_inl : ∀ (i : Fin n) (a : Fin m),
      e.symm i = Sum.inl a → ∀ j, ((canonicalM n m hm hpar) i j).im = 0 := by
    intro i a hi j
    show (canonicalM_block m k (e.symm i) (e.symm j)).im = 0
    rw [hi]
    rcases h' : e.symm j with c | ⟨s, d⟩
    · simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₁, one_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
    · simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₂, Matrix.zero_apply]
  
  suffices h : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n =>
      ∀ j, ((canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar).M i j).im = 0) =
      Finset.univ.image (fun a : Fin m => e (Sum.inl a)) by
    unfold realness; rw [h]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a₁ a₂ h => by
      have := e.injective h; exact Sum.inl_injective this)]
    exact Finset.card_fin m
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image,
    canonicalTubalData]
  constructor
  · intro hreal
    rcases hi : e.symm i with a | ⟨r, b⟩
    · exact ⟨a, by rw [← hi, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩
    · exact absurd hreal (not_real_of_inr i r b hi)
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    rw [← ha]
    exact real_of_inl _ a (by simp)

name: TubalTensor.realness_parity
statement: theorem realness_parity (td : TubalData n) : n % 2 = realness td % 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set T := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ¬∀ j, (td.M i j).im = 0)
  
  have hcount : realness td + T.card = n := by
    show (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ∀ j, (td.M i j).im = 0)).card +
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬∀ j, (td.M i j).im = 0)).card = n
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
      (Finset.disjoint_filter.mpr (fun _ _ hp hnp => absurd hp hnp)),
      Finset.filter_union_filter_not_eq, Finset.card_fin]
  suffices h : 2 ∣ T.card by omega
  
  have mem_T : ∀ i ∈ T, ¬IsRealRow td.M i := fun i hi =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  
  have partner_exists : ∀ i : Fin n, ¬IsRealRow td.M i →
      ∃ k : Fin n, k ≠ i ∧ ¬IsRealRow td.M k ∧ IsConjRow td.M i k ∧
        ∀ l, l ≠ i → IsConjRow td.M i l → l = k := by
    intro i hi
    rcases td.hM_real i with hri | ⟨k, hk_ne, hk_conj, huniq⟩
    · exact absurd hri hi
    · refine ⟨k, hk_ne, ?_, hk_conj, huniq⟩
      intro hk_real; exact hi (fun j => by
        have hc := hk_conj j; have hr := hk_real j
        rw [hc, starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_im] at hr; linarith)
  
  set σ : Fin n → Fin n := fun i =>
    if h : IsRealRow td.M i then i else (partner_exists i h).choose with σ_def
  have hσ_ne : ∀ i, ¬IsRealRow td.M i → σ i ≠ i := fun i hi => by
    simp only [σ_def, dif_neg hi]; exact (partner_exists i hi).choose_spec.1
  have hσ_nonreal : ∀ i, ¬IsRealRow td.M i → ¬IsRealRow td.M (σ i) := fun i hi => by
    simp only [σ_def, dif_neg hi]; exact (partner_exists i hi).choose_spec.2.1
  have hσ_conj : ∀ i, ¬IsRealRow td.M i → IsConjRow td.M i (σ i) := fun i hi => by
    simp only [σ_def, dif_neg hi]; exact (partner_exists i hi).choose_spec.2.2.1
  have hσ_uniq : ∀ i, ¬IsRealRow td.M i → ∀ l, l ≠ i → IsConjRow td.M i l → l = σ i :=
    fun i hi => by
      simp only [σ_def, dif_neg hi]; exact (partner_exists i hi).choose_spec.2.2.2
  
  have hσ_invol : ∀ i, σ (σ i) = i := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : IsRealRow td.M i
    · simp only [σ_def, dif_pos hi]
    · exact (hσ_uniq (σ i) (hσ_nonreal i hi) i (hσ_ne i hi).symm
        (isConjRow_symm (hσ_conj i hi))).symm
  
  have hσ_mem : ∀ i ∈ T, σ i ∈ T := by
    intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hσ_nonreal i (mem_T i hi)⟩
  have hσ_inj : Set.InjOn σ ↑T := by
    intro i _ j _ hij; have := congr_arg σ hij; rwa [hσ_invol, hσ_invol] at this
  have hσ_fpf : ∀ i ∈ T, σ i ≠ i := fun i hi => hσ_ne i (mem_T i hi)
  
  set L := T.filter (fun i => i.val < (σ i).val)
  set U := T.filter (fun i => (σ i).val < i.val)
  have hLU_disj : Disjoint L U :=
    Finset.disjoint_filter.mpr (fun _ _ h1 h2 => by omega)
  have hLU_cover : L ∪ U = T := by
    ext i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hi with hL | hU
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hL).1
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hU).1
    · intro hi
      have hne : i.val ≠ (σ i).val := fun h => hσ_fpf i hi (Fin.ext h.symm)
      rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
      · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, h⟩))
      · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, h⟩))
  
  have hσ_L_to_U : ∀ i ∈ L, σ i ∈ U := fun i hi => by
    have ⟨hiT, hlt⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hσ_mem i hiT, by rw [hσ_invol]; exact hlt⟩
  have hσ_U_to_L : ∀ i ∈ U, σ i ∈ L := fun i hi => by
    have ⟨hiT, hlt⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hσ_mem i hiT, by rw [hσ_invol]; exact hlt⟩
  have hcard_eq : L.card = U.card := le_antisymm
    (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn σ hσ_L_to_U
      (hσ_inj.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr (Finset.filter_subset _ T))))
    (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn σ hσ_U_to_L
      (hσ_inj.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr (Finset.filter_subset _ T))))
  
  rw [show T.card = L.card + U.card from by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hLU_disj, hLU_cover]]
  exact ⟨L.card, by omega⟩

name: TubalTensor.realness_permute
statement:
theorem realness_permute (td : TubalData n) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    realness (permuteTubalData td σ) = realness td
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realness, permuteTubalData, submatrix_apply]
  
  have h_col : ∀ i, (∀ j, (td.M (σ i) (σ j)).im = 0) ↔ (∀ j, (td.M (σ i) j).im = 0) :=
    fun i => ⟨fun h j => σ.apply_symm_apply j ▸ h (σ.symm j), fun h j => h (σ j)⟩
  simp_rw [h_col]
  
  rw [show Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ∀ j, (td.M (σ i) j).im = 0) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ∀ j, (td.M i j).im = 0)).map σ.symm.toEmbedding from by
    ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_map, Equiv.toEmbedding_apply]
    exact ⟨fun hi => ⟨σ i, hi, σ.symm_apply_apply i⟩,
           fun ⟨_, ha, hai⟩ => by subst hai; rwa [σ.apply_symm_apply]⟩]
  exact Finset.card_map _

name: TubalTensor.submatrix_mulVec_comp_perm
proof:
:= by
  have h : (v ∘ ⇑σ) ∘ ⇑σ.symm = v := by ext i; simp
  rw [submatrix_mulVec_equiv, h]

name: TubalTensor.vecHadamard_comp_perm
statement:
private theorem vecHadamard_comp_perm (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (u v : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (u ∘ ⇑σ) ∘ₕ (v ∘ ⇑σ) = (u ∘ₕ v) ∘ ⇑σ
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [vecHadamard_apply]

name: TubalTensor.starMC_comp_perm
proof:
:= by
  show (td.M_inv.submatrix σ σ) *ᵥ
    ((td.M.submatrix σ σ *ᵥ (a ∘ ⇑σ)) ∘ₕ (td.M.submatrix σ σ *ᵥ (b ∘ ⇑σ))) =
    (td.M_inv *ᵥ (td.M *ᵥ a ∘ₕ td.M *ᵥ b)) ∘ ⇑σ
  rw [submatrix_mulVec_comp_perm, submatrix_mulVec_comp_perm,
      vecHadamard_comp_perm, submatrix_mulVec_comp_perm]

name: TubalTensor.starM_comp_perm
proof:
:= by
  show vecRe (starMC (permuteTubalData td σ) ((toComplex a) ∘ ⇑σ) ((toComplex b) ∘ ⇑σ)) =
    (vecRe (starMC td (toComplex a) (toComplex b))) ∘ ⇑σ
  rw [starMC_comp_perm]; ext; rfl

name: TubalTensor.unitTube_comp_perm
statement:
private theorem unitTube_comp_perm (td : TubalData n) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    unitTube (permuteTubalData td σ) = (unitTube td) ∘ ⇑σ
proof:
:= by
  apply toComplex_injective
  rw [toComplex_unitTube]
  show (td.M_inv.submatrix σ σ) *ᵥ allOnes n = toComplex ((unitTube td) ∘ ⇑σ)
  conv_rhs => rw [show toComplex ((unitTube td) ∘ ⇑σ) =
    (toComplex (unitTube td)) ∘ ⇑σ from rfl, toComplex_unitTube]
  rw [show (allOnes n : Fin n → ℂ) = allOnes n ∘ ⇑σ from by ext; simp [allOnes]]
  exact submatrix_mulVec_comp_perm _ _ _

name: TubalTensor.realness_block_sum
statement:
private theorem realness_block_sum (td : TubalData n) :
    realness td + 2 * ((n - realness td) / 2) = n
proof:
:= by
  have := realness_parity td; have := realness_le td; omega

name: TubalTensor.exists_ordering_perm
statement:
theorem exists_ordering_perm (td : TubalData n) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
      (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < realness td → IsRealRow td.M (σ i)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, realness td ≤ i.val → ¬IsRealRow td.M (σ i)) ∧
      (∀ b : Fin ((n - realness td) / 2),
        let e := canonicalEquiv (realness td) _ (realness_block_sum td)
        IsConjRow td.M (σ (e (Sum.inr (0, b)))) (σ (e (Sum.inr (1, b)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m := realness td with m_def
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := realness_block_sum td
  set e := canonicalEquiv m k hk
  
  set isReal := fun i : Fin n => ∀ j, (td.M i j).im = 0 with isReal_def
  have partner_data : ∀ i, ¬isReal i →
      ∃ j, j ≠ i ∧ ¬isReal j ∧ IsConjRow td.M i j ∧
        (∀ l, l ≠ i → IsConjRow td.M i l → l = j) := by
    intro i hi
    rcases td.hM_real i with hri | ⟨j, hne, hconj, huniq⟩
    · exact absurd hri hi
    refine ⟨j, hne, ?_, hconj, huniq⟩
    intro hj; exact hi (fun c => by
      have hc := hconj c; have hr := hj c
      rw [hc, starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_im] at hr; linarith)
  set p : Fin n → Fin n := fun i =>
    if h : isReal i then i else (partner_data i h).choose
  have hp_ne : ∀ i, ¬isReal i → p i ≠ i := fun i hi => by
    simp only [p, dif_neg hi]; exact (partner_data i hi).choose_spec.1
  have hp_nonreal : ∀ i, ¬isReal i → ¬isReal (p i) := fun i hi => by
    simp only [p, dif_neg hi]; exact (partner_data i hi).choose_spec.2.1
  have hp_conj : ∀ i, ¬isReal i → IsConjRow td.M i (p i) := fun i hi => by
    simp only [p, dif_neg hi]; exact (partner_data i hi).choose_spec.2.2.1
  have hp_uniq : ∀ i, ¬isReal i → ∀ l, l ≠ i → IsConjRow td.M i l → l = p i := fun i hi => by
    simp only [p, dif_neg hi]; exact (partner_data i hi).choose_spec.2.2.2
  have hp_invol : ∀ i, p (p i) = i := by
    intro i; by_cases hi : isReal i
    · simp only [p, dif_pos hi]
    · exact (hp_uniq (p i) (hp_nonreal i hi) i (hp_ne i hi).symm
        (isConjRow_symm (hp_conj i hi))).symm
  
  set R := Finset.univ.filter isReal
  set L := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬isReal i ∧ i.val < (p i).val)
  have hR_card : R.card = m := rfl
  
  have hp_inj_global : Function.Injective p := fun i j hij => by
    have := congr_arg p hij; rwa [hp_invol, hp_invol] at this
  have hL_card : L.card = k := by
    
    set NR := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ¬isReal i)
    set U := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬isReal i ∧ (p i).val < i.val)
    have hNR_card : NR.card = n - m := by
      have h1 : R ∪ NR = Finset.univ := by
        ext i; constructor
        · intro _; exact Finset.mem_univ _
        · intro _; rw [Finset.mem_union]
          by_cases h : isReal i
          · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩)
          · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩)
      have h2 : Disjoint R NR :=
        Finset.disjoint_filter.mpr (fun _ _ h h' => h' h)
      have h3 := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint h2
      rw [h1, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h3; omega
    have hLU_disj : Disjoint L U :=
      Finset.disjoint_filter.mpr (fun _ _ h1 h2 => by have := h1.2; have := h2.2; omega)
    have hLU_cover : L ∪ U = NR := by
      ext i; constructor
      · intro hi
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hi with hL | hU
        · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hL).2.1⟩
        · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hU).2.1⟩
      · intro hi
        have hni := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        have hne : i.val ≠ (p i).val := fun h => hp_ne i hni (Fin.ext h.symm)
        rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
        · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl
            (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hni, h⟩))
        · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr
            (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hni, h⟩))
    have hσ_L_to_U : ∀ i ∈ L, p i ∈ U := fun i hi => by
      obtain ⟨_, hni, hlt⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hi
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        hp_nonreal i hni, by rw [hp_invol]; exact hlt⟩
    have hσ_U_to_L : ∀ i ∈ U, p i ∈ L := fun i hi => by
      obtain ⟨_, hni, hlt⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hi
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        hp_nonreal i hni, by rw [hp_invol]; exact hlt⟩
    have hcard_eq : L.card = U.card := le_antisymm
      (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn p hσ_L_to_U hp_inj_global.injOn)
      (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn p hσ_U_to_L hp_inj_global.injOn)
    have : NR.card = L.card + U.card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hLU_disj, hLU_cover]
    omega
  
  let r_enum := (R.equivFinOfCardEq hR_card).symm  
  let l_enum := (L.equivFinOfCardEq hL_card).symm  
  
  let g : Fin m ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin k) → Fin n := fun x =>
    match x with
    | Sum.inl a => (r_enum a).val
    | Sum.inr (r, b) =>
      if r = (0 : Fin 2) then (l_enum b).val else p (l_enum b).val
  
  have g_inj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro x y hxy
    match x, y with
    | Sum.inl a₁, Sum.inl a₂ =>
      exact congr_arg Sum.inl (r_enum.injective (Subtype.val_injective hxy))
    | Sum.inl a, Sum.inr (r, b) =>
      exfalso
      have ha := (r_enum a).property  
      have := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
      have hb : ¬isReal (g (Sum.inr (r, b))) := by
        simp only [g]; split_ifs with hr
        · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b).property).2.1
        · exact hp_nonreal _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b).property).2.1
      rw [← hxy] at hb; exact hb this.2
    | Sum.inr (r, b), Sum.inl a =>
      exfalso
      have ha := (r_enum a).property
      have := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
      have hb : ¬isReal (g (Sum.inr (r, b))) := by
        simp only [g]; split_ifs with hr
        · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b).property).2.1
        · exact hp_nonreal _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b).property).2.1
      rw [hxy] at hb; exact hb this.2
    | Sum.inr (r₁, b₁), Sum.inr (r₂, b₂) =>
      simp only [g] at hxy
      have hb₁_prop := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b₁).property).2
      have hb₂_prop := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b₂).property).2
      split_ifs at hxy with h₁ h₂
      · 
        have := l_enum.injective (Subtype.val_injective hxy)
        rw [h₁, h₂]; exact congr_arg₂ (fun r b => Sum.inr (r, b)) rfl this
      · 
        exfalso; have := hb₁_prop.2  
        rw [hxy] at this  
        rw [hp_invol] at this; exact Nat.lt_asymm this hb₂_prop.2
      · 
        exfalso; have := hb₂_prop.2
        rw [← hxy] at this; rw [hp_invol] at this; exact Nat.lt_asymm this hb₁_prop.2
      · 
        have hinj := congr_arg p hxy; rw [hp_invol, hp_invol] at hinj
        have hbeq := l_enum.injective (Subtype.val_injective hinj)
        have hreq : r₁ = r₂ := by omega
        exact congr_arg₂ (fun r b => Sum.inr (r, b)) hreq hbeq
  
  let σ_fun : Fin n → Fin n := g ∘ ⇑e.symm
  have σ_inj : Function.Injective σ_fun :=
    Function.Injective.comp g_inj e.symm.injective
  have σ_bij : Function.Bijective σ_fun :=
    Finite.injective_iff_bijective.mp σ_inj
  let σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) := Equiv.ofBijective σ_fun σ_bij
  
  have hσ_apply : ∀ i, σ i = g (e.symm i) := fun _ => rfl
  
  have he_inl_lt : ∀ a : Fin m, (e (Sum.inl a)).val < m := by
    intro a
    show (canonicalEquiv m k hk (Sum.inl a)).val < m
    unfold canonicalEquiv
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply,
      finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast]
    exact a.isLt
  
  have he_inr_ge : ∀ x : Fin 2 × Fin k, m ≤ (e (Sum.inr x)).val := by
    intro ⟨r, b⟩
    show m ≤ (canonicalEquiv m k hk (Sum.inr (r, b))).val
    unfold canonicalEquiv
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inr,
      finSumFinEquiv_apply_right, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Fin.val_natAdd]
    omega
  refine ⟨σ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro i hi
    rw [hσ_apply]
    have he : ∃ a : Fin m, e.symm i = Sum.inl a := by
      rcases h : e.symm i with a | ⟨r, b⟩
      · exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
      · exfalso
        have hi_eq : i = e (Sum.inr (r, b)) := by rw [← h, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        have := he_inr_ge (r, b)
        omega
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := he
    rw [ha]; show isReal (g (Sum.inl a))
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (r_enum a).property).2
  · 
    intro i hi
    rw [hσ_apply]
    have he : ∃ r b, e.symm i = Sum.inr (r, b) := by
      rcases h : e.symm i with a | ⟨r, b⟩
      · exfalso
        have hi_eq : i = e (Sum.inl a) := by rw [← h, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        have := he_inl_lt a
        exact Nat.not_lt.mpr hi (by omega)
      · exact ⟨r, b, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨r, b, hrb⟩ := he
    rw [hrb]; show ¬isReal (g (Sum.inr (r, b)))
    simp only [g]; split_ifs with hr
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b).property).2.1
    · exact hp_nonreal _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b).property).2.1
  · 
    intro b
    simp only [hσ_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    show IsConjRow td.M (g (Sum.inr (0, b))) (g (Sum.inr (1, b)))
    simp only [g, ite_true,
      show ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0) from by decide, ite_false]
    exact hp_conj _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp (l_enum b).property).2.1

name: TubalTensor.conjPairBlockInv_conj_real
statement:
private theorem conjPairBlockInv_conj_real (z : ℂ) (r : Fin 2) :
    (conjPairBlockInv r 0 * z + conjPairBlockInv r 1 * starRingEnd ℂ z).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hconj : starRingEnd ℂ z = ⟨z.re, -z.im⟩ := by
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  rw [hconj]
  fin_cases r
  · 
    show (1 / (↑(Real.sqrt 2) : ℂ) * z + 1 / ↑(Real.sqrt 2) * ⟨z.re, -z.im⟩).im = 0
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.div_ofReal, Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im]
    ring
  · 
    show (Complex.I / (↑(Real.sqrt 2) : ℂ) * z +
      -Complex.I / ↑(Real.sqrt 2) * ⟨z.re, -z.im⟩).im = 0
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.div_ofReal, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im]
    ring

name: TubalTensor.product_im_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem product_im_eq_zero (td : TubalData n)
    (h_real : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < realness td → IsRealRow td.M i)
    (h_paired : ∀ b : Fin ((n - realness td) / 2),
      let e := canonicalEquiv (realness td) ((n - realness td) / 2) (realness_block_sum td)
      IsConjRow td.M (e (Sum.inr (0, b))) (e (Sum.inr (1, b))))
    (i j : Fin n) :
    ((canonicalMinv n (realness td) (realness_le td) (realness_parity td) * td.M) i j).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  set m := realness td
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := realness_block_sum td
  set e := canonicalEquiv m k hk
  
  
  
  rcases h_block : e.symm i with a | ⟨r, b⟩
  · 
    have hi_eq : i = e (Sum.inl a) := by rw [← Equiv.apply_symm_apply e i, h_block]
    show ((canonicalMinv n m _ _ * td.M) i j).im = 0
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
    
    have hcMinv_entry : ∀ l, canonicalMinv n m (realness_le td) (realness_parity td) i l =
        canonicalMinv_block m k (Sum.inl a) (e.symm l) :=
      fun l => by show canonicalMinv_block m k (e.symm i) (e.symm l) = _; rw [h_block]
    simp_rw [hcMinv_entry]
    
    have hsum_val : ∑ l, canonicalMinv_block m k (Sum.inl a) (e.symm l) * td.M l j =
        td.M (e (Sum.inl a)) j := by
      rw [show ∑ l, canonicalMinv_block m k (Sum.inl a) (e.symm l) * td.M l j =
          ∑ x, canonicalMinv_block m k (Sum.inl a) x * td.M (e x) j from
        Fintype.sum_equiv e.symm _ _ (fun l => by simp [Equiv.apply_symm_apply])]
      rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      simp only [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₁, fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
        Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul,
        Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    rw [hsum_val]
    
    have ha_val : (e (Sum.inl a)).val < m := by
      show (canonicalEquiv m k hk (Sum.inl a)).val < m
      unfold canonicalEquiv
      simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply,
        finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast]
      exact a.isLt
    exact h_real _ (hi_eq ▸ ha_val) j
  · 
    show ((canonicalMinv n m _ _ * td.M) i j).im = 0
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
    have hcMinv_entry : ∀ l, canonicalMinv n m (realness_le td) (realness_parity td) i l =
        canonicalMinv_block m k (Sum.inr (r, b)) (e.symm l) :=
      fun l => by show canonicalMinv_block m k (e.symm i) (e.symm l) = _; rw [h_block]
    simp_rw [hcMinv_entry]
    
    have hsum_val : ∑ l, canonicalMinv_block m k (Sum.inr (r, b)) (e.symm l) * td.M l j =
        ∑ s : Fin 2, conjPairBlockInv r s * td.M (e (Sum.inr (s, b))) j := by
      rw [show ∑ l, canonicalMinv_block m k (Sum.inr (r, b)) (e.symm l) * td.M l j =
          ∑ x, canonicalMinv_block m k (Sum.inr (r, b)) x * td.M (e x) j from
        Fintype.sum_equiv e.symm _ _ (fun l => by simp [Equiv.apply_symm_apply])]
      rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      simp only [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₁, fromBlocks_apply₂₂,
        Matrix.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add,
        blockDiagonal_apply, ite_mul]
      rw [show ∑ x : Fin 2 × Fin k,
          (if b = x.2 then conjPairBlockInv r x.1 * td.M (e (Sum.inr x)) j else 0) =
        ∑ s : Fin 2, conjPairBlockInv r s * td.M (e (Sum.inr (s, b))) j from by
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        congr 1; ext s; rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]]
    rw [hsum_val, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    
    have hconj : td.M (e (Sum.inr (1, b))) j =
        starRingEnd ℂ (td.M (e (Sum.inr (0, b))) j) := h_paired ⟨b.val, b.isLt⟩ j
    rw [hconj]
    exact conjPairBlockInv_conj_real _ r

name: TubalTensor.ordered_canonical_transition
statement:
theorem ordered_canonical_transition (td : TubalData n)
    (h_real : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < realness td → IsRealRow td.M i)
    (h_paired : ∀ b : Fin ((n - realness td) / 2),
      let e := canonicalEquiv (realness td) ((n - realness td) / 2) (realness_block_sum td)
      IsConjRow td.M (e (Sum.inr (0, b))) (e (Sum.inr (1, b)))) :
    ∃ (R S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
      S * R = 1 ∧ R * S = 1 ∧
      td.M = (canonicalM n (realness td) (realness_le td) (realness_parity td)) *
        R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  set cMinv := canonicalMinv n (realness td) (realness_le td) (realness_parity td)
  set cM := canonicalM n (realness td) (realness_le td) (realness_parity td)
  set P := cMinv * td.M
  
  have hP_real : ∀ i j, (P i j).im = 0 := product_im_eq_zero td h_real h_paired
  
  set R := P.map Complex.re
  
  have hR_cast : R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = P := by
    ext i j; simp only [R, Matrix.map_apply]
    exact Complex.ext (by rfl) (by simp [hP_real i j])
  
  set Q := td.M_inv * cM
  have hQ_real : ∀ i j, (Q i j).im = 0 := by
    intro i j
    
    have hQP : Q * P = 1 := by
      show td.M_inv * cM * (cMinv * td.M) = 1
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc cM cMinv,
        canonicalM_mul_canonicalMinv, Matrix.one_mul, td.hM_left_inv]
    have hPQ : P * Q = 1 := by
      show cMinv * td.M * (td.M_inv * cM) = 1
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc td.M td.M_inv,
        td.hM_right_inv, Matrix.one_mul, canonicalMinv_mul_canonicalM]
    have hQR : Q * R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = 1 := hR_cast ▸ hQP
    have hRQ : R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * Q = 1 := hR_cast ▸ hPQ
    
    have hconjQ_R : Q.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = 1 := by
      have hR_conj : R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = (R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)).map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by
        ext a b; simp only [Matrix.map_apply]; rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
      conv_lhs => rw [hR_conj]
      rw [← Matrix.map_mul (f := starRingEnd ℂ), hQR]
      ext a b; simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
      split_ifs with h
      · subst h; rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def]; simp
      · rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def]; simp
    
    have hQ_eq_conj : Q i j = (starRingEnd ℂ) (Q i j) := by
      have h1 : Q = Q.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := by
        calc Q = Q * 1 := (Matrix.mul_one _).symm
          _ = Q * (R.map (↑) * Q) := by rw [hRQ]
          _ = (Q * R.map (↑)) * Q := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
          _ = 1 * Q := by rw [hQR]
          _ = (Q.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * R.map (↑)) * Q := by rw [hconjQ_R]
          _ = Q.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * (R.map (↑) * Q) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ = Q.map (starRingEnd ℂ) * 1 := by rw [hRQ]
          _ = Q.map (starRingEnd ℂ) := Matrix.mul_one _
      exact congr_fun (congr_fun h1 i) j
    rw [starRingEnd_apply, star_def] at hQ_eq_conj
    rwa [eq_comm, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im] at hQ_eq_conj
  set S := Q.map Complex.re
  have hS_cast : S.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = Q := by
    ext i j; simp only [S, Matrix.map_apply]
    exact Complex.ext (by rfl) (by simp [hQ_real i j])
  
  have map_mul_cast (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
      (A * B).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = A.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * B.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) := by
    ext i j; simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  
  have cast_inj (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : A.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = B.map (↑)) :
      A = B := by ext i j; exact Complex.ofReal_injective (congr_fun (congr_fun h i) j)
  refine ⟨R, S, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    apply cast_inj
    rw [map_mul_cast, hS_cast, hR_cast, Matrix.map_one ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) Complex.ofReal_zero Complex.ofReal_one]
    show td.M_inv * cM * (cMinv * td.M) = 1
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc cM cMinv,
      canonicalM_mul_canonicalMinv, Matrix.one_mul, td.hM_left_inv]
  · 
    apply cast_inj
    rw [map_mul_cast, hR_cast, hS_cast, Matrix.map_one ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) Complex.ofReal_zero Complex.ofReal_one]
    show cMinv * td.M * (td.M_inv * cM) = 1
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc td.M td.M_inv,
      td.hM_right_inv, Matrix.one_mul, canonicalMinv_mul_canonicalM]
  · 
    calc td.M = 1 * td.M := (Matrix.one_mul _).symm
      _ = (cM * cMinv) * td.M := by rw [canonicalM_mul_canonicalMinv]
      _ = cM * (cMinv * td.M) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = cM * R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) := by rw [hR_cast]

name: TubalTensor.KM_algEquiv_canonical
statement:
theorem KM_algEquiv_canonical (td : TubalData n) :
    Nonempty (KM n td ≃ₐ[ℝ] KM n (canonicalTubalData n (realness td)
      (realness_le td) (realness_parity td)))
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨σ, h_real_σ, _, h_paired_σ⟩ := exists_ordering_perm td
  
  have iso₁ := permuteAlgEquiv td σ
  
  
  have hrp : realness (permuteTubalData td σ) = realness td := realness_permute td σ
  have h_real_perm : ∀ i, i.val < realness (permuteTubalData td σ) →
      IsRealRow (permuteTubalData td σ).M i := by
    rw [hrp]; intro i hi j; exact h_real_σ i hi (σ j)
  have h_paired_perm : ∀ b : Fin ((n - realness (permuteTubalData td σ)) / 2),
      let e := canonicalEquiv (realness (permuteTubalData td σ)) _
        (realness_block_sum (permuteTubalData td σ))
      IsConjRow (permuteTubalData td σ).M (e (Sum.inr (0, b))) (e (Sum.inr (1, b))) := by
    intro b e j
    
    set b' : Fin ((n - realness td) / 2) := ⟨b.val, by rw [← hrp]; exact b.isLt⟩
    
    suffices hce : ∀ s, e (Sum.inr (s, b)) =
        canonicalEquiv (realness td) _ (realness_block_sum td) (Sum.inr (s, b')) by
      
      rw [hce 1, hce 0]
      
      
      exact h_paired_σ b' (σ j)
    intro s; apply Fin.ext
    
    simp only [e, b', canonicalEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply,
      Sum.map_inr, finSumFinEquiv_apply_right, Fin.val_natAdd,
      finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, finProdFinEquiv, hrp]
    rfl
  
  obtain ⟨R, S, hSR, hRS, hM⟩ := ordered_canonical_transition _ h_real_perm h_paired_perm
  
  have hctd_eq : canonicalTubalData n (realness (permuteTubalData td σ))
      (realness_le _) (realness_parity _) =
      canonicalTubalData n (realness td) (realness_le td) (realness_parity td) := by
    suffices ∀ (a b : ℕ) (hab : a = b) (ha : a ≤ n) (hb : b ≤ n)
        (hpa : n % 2 = a % 2) (hpb : n % 2 = b % 2),
        canonicalTubalData n a ha hpa = canonicalTubalData n b hb hpb from
      this _ _ hrp _ _ _ _
    intro a b hab; subst hab; intros; rfl
  
  exact ⟨iso₁.trans (hctd_eq ▸ transportAlgEquiv _ _ R S hSR hRS hM)⟩

name: TubalTensor.realness_le
statement: theorem realness_le (td : TubalData n) : realness td ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold realness
  calc _ ≤ Finset.card Finset.univ := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
    _ = n := Finset.card_fin n

name: TubalTensor.canonicalEquiv_inl_val
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [canonicalEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl,
    finSumFinEquiv_apply_left, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Fin.val_castAdd,
    Equiv.refl_apply]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalEquiv_symm_lt
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun canonicalEquiv m k hk using (canonicalEquiv m k hk).injective
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, canonicalEquiv_inl_val hk i hi]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalM_mulVec_coord
proof:
:= by
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [show ∑ j, canonicalM n m hm hpar i j * v j =
      ∑ x, canonicalM_block m k ((canonicalEquiv m k hk).symm i) x *
        v (canonicalEquiv m k hk x) from
    Fintype.sum_equiv (canonicalEquiv m k hk).symm _ _ (fun j => by
      simp only [canonicalM, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]; rfl)]
  rw [canonicalEquiv_symm_lt hk i hi, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₁, fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
    Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  exact congr_arg v (canonicalEquiv_inl_val hk i hi)

name: TubalTensor.canonicalMinv_mulVec_coord
proof:
:= by
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [show ∑ j, canonicalMinv n m hm hpar i j * v j =
      ∑ x, canonicalMinv_block m k ((canonicalEquiv m k hk).symm i) x *
        v (canonicalEquiv m k hk x) from
    Fintype.sum_equiv (canonicalEquiv m k hk).symm _ _ (fun j => by
      simp only [canonicalMinv, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]; rfl)]
  rw [canonicalEquiv_symm_lt hk i hi, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₁, fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
    Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.zero_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  exact congr_arg v (canonicalEquiv_inl_val hk i hi)

name: TubalTensor.canonical_starM_coord
statement:
theorem canonical_starM_coord (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m) :
    starM (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) a b i = a i * b i
proof:
:= by
  show ((canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar).applyMinv
    ((canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar).applyM (toComplex a) ∘ₕ
     (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar).applyM (toComplex b)) i).re = _
  simp only [TubalData.applyMinv, TubalData.applyM, canonicalTubalData]
  rw [canonicalMinv_mulVec_coord m hm hpar _ i hi, vecHadamard_apply,
      canonicalM_mulVec_coord m hm hpar (toComplex a) i hi,
      canonicalM_mulVec_coord m hm hpar (toComplex b) i hi,
      toComplex_apply, toComplex_apply, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: TubalTensor.canonical_unitTube_coord
statement:
theorem canonical_unitTube_coord (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m) :
    unitTube (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) i = 1
proof:
:= by
  show ((canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar).applyMinv (allOnes n) i).re = 1
  simp only [TubalData.applyMinv, canonicalTubalData]
  rw [canonicalMinv_mulVec_coord m hm hpar _ i hi, allOnes_apply, Complex.one_re]

name: TubalTensor.coordProj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordProj_apply (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m) (a : KM n (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar)) :
    coordProj m hm hpar i hi a = KM.toFun a i
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.coordProj_injective
statement:
theorem coordProj_injective (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (i j : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m) (hj : j.val < m)
    (h : coordProj m hm hpar i hi = coordProj m hm hpar j hj) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hij
  have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun h (KM.ofFun (fun k => if k = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
  simp only [coordProj_apply, KM.toFun_ofFun, if_neg (Ne.symm hij)] at h1
  exact one_ne_zero h1

name: TubalTensor.canonicalEquiv_symm_ge
proof:
:= by
  rcases h : (canonicalEquiv m k hk).symm i with a | ⟨r, b⟩
  · exfalso
    have h1 : canonicalEquiv m k hk (Sum.inl a) = i := by
      rw [← h, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have h2 := congr_arg Fin.val h1
    simp only [canonicalEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl,
      finSumFinEquiv_apply_left, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Fin.val_castAdd,
      Equiv.refl_apply] at h2
    omega
  · exact ⟨r, b, rfl⟩

name: TubalTensor.canonicalM_pair_real_zero
proof:
:= by
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
  obtain ⟨r, b, hrb⟩ := canonicalEquiv_symm_ge hk j hj
  show canonicalM_block m k _ _ = 0
  rw [hrb, canonicalEquiv_symm_lt hk i hi]
  simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₁]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalM_real_pair_zero
proof:
:= by
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
  obtain ⟨r, b, hrb⟩ := canonicalEquiv_symm_ge hk j hj
  show canonicalM_block m k _ _ = 0
  rw [canonicalEquiv_symm_lt hk i hi, hrb]
  simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₂]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalMinv_pair_real_zero
proof:
:= by
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
  obtain ⟨r, b, hrb⟩ := canonicalEquiv_symm_ge hk j hj
  show canonicalMinv_block m k _ _ = 0
  rw [hrb, canonicalEquiv_symm_lt hk i hi]
  simp [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₁]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalMinv_real_pair_zero
proof:
:= by
  set k := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
  obtain ⟨r, b, hrb⟩ := canonicalEquiv_symm_ge hk j hj
  show canonicalMinv_block m k _ _ = 0
  rw [canonicalEquiv_symm_lt hk i hi, hrb]
  simp [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₁₂]

name: TubalTensor.stdBasis_mul_canonical
statement:
theorem stdBasis_mul_canonical (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    starM (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) (fun k => if k = i then 1 else 0) a =
    fun j => a i * (if j = i then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  set td := canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar
  set ei := fun k => if k = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0
  
  have hMe : ∀ k : Fin n, k.val ≥ m →
      (canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ toComplex ei) k = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro l _
    by_cases hl : l.val < m
    · rw [canonicalM_pair_real_zero m hm hpar k l hk hl, zero_mul]
    · push Not at hl
      have : toComplex ei l = 0 := by
        simp [ei, toComplex_apply, show ¬(l = i) from fun h => by omega]
      rw [this, mul_zero]
  
  have hHad : ∀ k : Fin n, k.val ≥ m →
      ((canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ toComplex ei) ∘ₕ
       (canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ toComplex a)) k = 0 := by
    intro k hk; rw [vecHadamard_apply, hMe k hk, zero_mul]
  ext j
  by_cases hj : j.val < m
  · rw [canonical_starM_coord m hm hpar _ a j hj]
    simp only [ei, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
    by_cases hij : j = i <;> simp [hij]
  · push Not at hj
    
    show ((canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar).applyMinv
      ((canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar).applyM (toComplex ei) ∘ₕ
       (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar).applyM (toComplex a)) j).re = _
    simp only [TubalData.applyMinv, TubalData.applyM, canonicalTubalData]
    
    
    have hMinv : (canonicalMinv n m hm hpar *ᵥ
      ((canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ toComplex ei) ∘ₕ
       (canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ toComplex a))) j = 0 := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k _
      by_cases hk : k.val < m
      · rw [canonicalMinv_pair_real_zero m hm hpar j k hj hk, zero_mul]
      · push Not at hk
        rw [hHad k hk, mul_zero]
    rw [hMinv, Complex.zero_re]
    
    simp [show ¬(j = i) from fun h => by omega]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalM_pair_same
statement:
private theorem canonicalM_pair_same (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (r s : Fin 2) (b : Fin ((n - m) / 2)) :
    canonicalM n m hm hpar
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (r, b)))
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (s, b))) =
    conjPairBlock r s
proof:
:= by
  show canonicalM_block m _ _ _ = _
  simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_eq]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalMinv_pair_same
statement:
private theorem canonicalMinv_pair_same (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (r s : Fin 2) (b : Fin ((n - m) / 2)) :
    canonicalMinv n m hm hpar
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (r, b)))
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (s, b))) =
    conjPairBlockInv r s
proof:
:= by
  show canonicalMinv_block m _ _ _ = _
  simp [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_eq]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalM_pair_diff
statement:
private theorem canonicalM_pair_diff (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (r s : Fin 2) (b b' : Fin ((n - m) / 2)) (hbb : b ≠ b') :
    canonicalM n m hm hpar
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (r, b)))
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (s, b'))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show canonicalM_block m _ _ _ = _
  simp [canonicalM_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_ne _ _ _ hbb]

name: TubalTensor.canonicalMinv_pair_diff
statement:
private theorem canonicalMinv_pair_diff (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (r s : Fin 2) (b b' : Fin ((n - m) / 2)) (hbb : b ≠ b') :
    canonicalMinv n m hm hpar
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (r, b)))
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (s, b'))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show canonicalMinv_block m _ _ _ = _
  simp [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_ne _ _ _ hbb]

name: TubalTensor.pair_sq_sum_re
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, conjPairBlockInv, conjPairBlock, sq]
  fin_cases s <;> fin_cases r <;> simp_all <;> {
    have hsq2 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (show (2:ℝ) ≥ 0 by norm_num)
    have hsq_ne : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by norm_num)
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hsq2] }

name: TubalTensor.canonicalEquiv_inr_ge
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h; push Not at h
  have := canonicalEquiv_symm_lt hk (canonicalEquiv m k hk (Sum.inr (r, b))) h
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
  exact absurd this (by nofun)

name: TubalTensor.canonicalMinv_mulVec_pair_coord
statement:
private theorem canonicalMinv_mulVec_pair_coord (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (v : Fin n → ℂ) (s : Fin 2) (b : Fin ((n - m) / 2)) :
    (canonicalMinv n m hm hpar *ᵥ v)
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (s, b))) =
    ∑ t : Fin 2, conjPairBlockInv s t *
      v (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) (by omega) (Sum.inr (t, b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : m + 2 * ((n - m) / 2) = n := by omega
  
  show ∑ j, canonicalMinv n m hm hpar
    (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) hk (Sum.inr (s, b))) j * v j = _
  
  rw [show ∑ j, canonicalMinv n m hm hpar
      (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) hk (Sum.inr (s, b))) j * v j =
    ∑ x, canonicalMinv_block m ((n - m) / 2) (Sum.inr (s, b)) x *
      v (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) hk x) from
    Fintype.sum_equiv (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) hk).symm _ _ (fun j => by
      simp only [canonicalMinv, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply])]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  
  have hreal : ∑ a : Fin m,
      canonicalMinv_block m ((n - m) / 2) (Sum.inr (s, b)) (Sum.inl a) *
      v (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) hk (Sum.inl a)) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro a _
    simp [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₁]
  rw [hreal, zero_add]
  
  rw [show ∑ x : Fin 2 × Fin ((n - m) / 2),
      canonicalMinv_block m ((n - m) / 2) (Sum.inr (s, b)) (Sum.inr x) *
      v (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) hk (Sum.inr x)) =
    ∑ t : Fin 2, ∑ b' : Fin ((n - m) / 2),
      canonicalMinv_block m ((n - m) / 2) (Sum.inr (s, b)) (Sum.inr (t, b')) *
      v (canonicalEquiv m ((n - m) / 2) hk (Sum.inr (t, b'))) from
    Fintype.sum_prod_type _]
  congr 1; ext t
  
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
  · 
    simp only [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂, blockDiagonal_apply_eq]
  · intro b' _ hb'
    simp only [canonicalMinv_block, fromBlocks_apply₂₂]
    rw [blockDiagonal_apply_ne _ s t hb'.symm, zero_mul]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: TubalTensor.pair_basis_sq
statement:
private theorem pair_basis_sq (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (b : Fin ((n - m) / 2)) (r : Fin 2) :
    let k := (n - m) / 2
    let hk : m + 2 * k = n := by omega
    let jr := canonicalEquiv m k hk (Sum.inr (r, b))
    let j0 := canonicalEquiv m k hk (Sum.inr ((0 : Fin 2), b))
    let td := canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar
    (KM.ofFun (fun l => if l = jr then (1 : ℝ) else 0) : KM n td) *
    (KM.ofFun (fun l => if l = jr then (1 : ℝ) else 0) : KM n td) =
    (if r = 0 then 1 / Real.sqrt 2 else -(1 / Real.sqrt 2)) •
    (KM.ofFun (fun l => if l = j0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) : KM n td)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : m + 2 * ((n - m) / 2) = n := by omega
  have hjr_ge : (canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr (r, b))).val ≥ m :=
    canonicalEquiv_inr_ge hk r b
  
  have htoC : ∀ jr : Fin n, toComplex (fun l => if l = jr then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      fun l => if l = jr then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro jr; ext l; simp only [toComplex_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
  
  have hMcol : ∀ (jr : Fin n) (k : Fin n),
      (canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ (fun l => if l = jr then (1 : ℂ) else 0)) k =
      canonicalM n m hm hpar k jr := by
    intro jr k; simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single jr (fun j _ h => by simp [h]) (by simp)]; simp
  
  have hHad_eq : ∀ (jr : Fin n) (k : Fin n),
      ((canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ (fun l => if l = jr then (1:ℂ) else 0)) ∘ₕ
       (canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ (fun l => if l = jr then (1:ℂ) else 0))) k =
      (canonicalM n m hm hpar k jr) ^ 2 := by
    intro jr k; simp only [vecHadamard_apply, hMcol, sq]
  
  set jr := canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr (r, b))
  set j0 := canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr ((0 : Fin 2), b))
  
  ext l
  
  show starM (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar)
    (fun l => if l = jr then 1 else 0) (fun l => if l = jr then 1 else 0) l =
    (if r = 0 then 1 / Real.sqrt 2 else -(1 / Real.sqrt 2)) *
    (if l = j0 then 1 else 0)
  by_cases hl : l.val < m
  · 
    rw [canonical_starM_coord m hm hpar _ _ l hl]
    have hlr : ¬(l = jr) := fun h => by omega
    have hl0 : ¬(l = j0) := fun h => by
      have := canonicalEquiv_inr_ge hk 0 b; omega
    simp [if_neg hlr, if_neg hl0]
  · 
    push Not at hl
    
    show (starMC (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar)
      (toComplex (fun l => if l = jr then (1:ℝ) else 0))
      (toComplex (fun l => if l = jr then (1:ℝ) else 0)) l).re = _
    simp only [starMC, TubalData.applyMinv, TubalData.applyM, canonicalTubalData, htoC]
    
    have hHad_diff : ∀ (t : Fin 2) (b' : Fin ((n-m)/2)), b' ≠ b →
        ((canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ (fun l => if l = jr then (1:ℂ) else 0)) ∘ₕ
         (canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ (fun l => if l = jr then (1:ℂ) else 0)))
          (canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr (t, b'))) = 0 := by
      intro t b' hbb; rw [hHad_eq, canonicalM_pair_diff m hm hpar t r b' b hbb,
        zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0)]
    
    obtain ⟨s, b', hrb'⟩ := canonicalEquiv_symm_ge hk l hl
    have hl_eq : l = canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr (s, b')) := by
      have := (canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk).apply_symm_apply l
      rw [hrb'] at this; exact this.symm
    
    rw [hl_eq, canonicalMinv_mulVec_pair_coord m hm hpar _ s b']
    by_cases hbb : b' = b
    · 
      rw [hbb]
      
      have hHP : ∀ t : Fin 2,
          ((canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ (fun l => if l = jr then (1:ℂ) else 0)) ∘ₕ
           (canonicalM n m hm hpar *ᵥ (fun l => if l = jr then (1:ℂ) else 0)))
            (canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr (t, b))) =
          (conjPairBlock t r) ^ 2 := by
        intro t; rw [hHad_eq]; congr 1; exact canonicalM_pair_same m hm hpar t r b
      simp_rw [hHP]
      rw [show (∑ t, conjPairBlockInv s t * (conjPairBlock t r) ^ 2).re =
        if s = 0 then (if r = 0 then 1 / Real.sqrt 2 else -(1 / Real.sqrt 2)) else 0
        from pair_sq_sum_re r s]
      
      by_cases hs : s = 0
      · subst hs
        have : canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr ((0 : Fin 2), b)) = j0 := rfl
        simp [if_pos this]
      · have hs1 : s = 1 := by fin_cases s <;> simp_all
        subst hs1
        simp only [show ¬((1 : Fin 2) = (0 : Fin 2)) from by decide, ite_false]
        have : canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr ((1:Fin 2), b)) ≠ j0 := by
          intro h; have := (canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk).injective h; simp at this
        simp only [if_neg this, mul_zero]
    · 
      simp_rw [hHad_diff _ b' hbb, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, Complex.zero_re]
      have : canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk (Sum.inr (s, b')) ≠ j0 := by
        intro h; have := (canonicalEquiv m ((n-m)/2) hk).injective h
        simp at this; exact hbb this.2
      simp [if_neg this]

name: TubalTensor.algHom_pair_basis_zero
statement:
private theorem algHom_pair_basis_zero (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (φ : KM n (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) →ₐ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val ≥ m) :
    φ (KM.ofFun (fun l => if l = j then 1 else 0)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let td := canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar
  set kk := (n - m) / 2
  have hk : m + 2 * kk = n := by omega
  obtain ⟨r, b, hrb⟩ := canonicalEquiv_symm_ge hk j hj
  have hj_eq : j = canonicalEquiv m kk hk (Sum.inr (r, b)) := by
    have := (canonicalEquiv m kk hk).apply_symm_apply j
    rw [hrb] at this; exact this.symm
  
  let e_ : Fin 2 → KM n td := fun s =>
    KM.ofFun (fun l => if l = canonicalEquiv m kk hk (Sum.inr (s, b)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  
  have hsq0 : e_ 0 * e_ 0 = (1 / Real.sqrt 2) • e_ 0 := pair_basis_sq m hm hpar b 0
  have hsq1 : e_ 1 * e_ 1 = (-(1 / Real.sqrt 2)) • e_ 0 := pair_basis_sq m hm hpar b 1
  
  have hφsq0 : φ (e_ 0) ^ 2 = (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * φ (e_ 0) := by
    have h := map_mul φ (e_ 0) (e_ 0); rw [hsq0, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
    linarith [sq (φ (e_ 0))]
  have hφsq1 : φ (e_ 1) ^ 2 = (-(1 / Real.sqrt 2)) * φ (e_ 0) := by
    have h := map_mul φ (e_ 1) (e_ 1); rw [hsq1, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
    linarith [sq (φ (e_ 1))]
  have hφ0 : φ (e_ 0) = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hval : φ (e_ 0) = 1 / Real.sqrt 2 := by
      have h : φ (e_ 0) * (φ (e_ 0) - 1 / Real.sqrt 2) = 0 := by nlinarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · exact absurd h hne
      · linarith
    rw [hval] at hφsq1
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (φ (e_ 1)), (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / Real.sqrt 2 from by positivity)]
  have hφ1 : φ (e_ 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hφ0, mul_zero] at hφsq1
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0) |>.mp (by linarith [sq_nonneg (φ (e_ 1))])
  
  have : φ (e_ r) = 0 := by fin_cases r <;> assumption
  convert this using 2; ext l; simp only [KM.ofFun, e_]; rw [hj_eq]

name: TubalTensor.algHom_canonical_eq_coordProj
statement:
theorem algHom_canonical_eq_coordProj (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (hpar : n % 2 = m % 2)
    (φ : KM n (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) →ₐ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m), φ = coordProj m hm hpar i hi
proof:
:= by
  
  let e_ : Fin n → KM n (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar) :=
    fun i => KM.ofFun (fun l => if l = i then 1 else 0)
  
  have hprod : ∀ (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m)
      (a : KM n (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar)),
      e_ i * a = KM.toFun a i • e_ i := by
    intro i hi a; ext l
    exact congr_fun (stdBasis_mul_canonical m hm hpar i hi (KM.toFun a)) l
  
  have hkey : ∀ (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m)
      (a : KM n (canonicalTubalData n m hm hpar)),
      φ (e_ i) * φ a = KM.toFun a i * φ (e_ i) := by
    intro i hi a
    have h := map_mul φ (e_ i) a
    rw [hprod i hi a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h; linarith
  
  by_cases hex : ∃ (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m), φ (e_ i) ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, hne⟩ := hex
    refine ⟨i₀, hi₀, AlgHom.ext (fun a => ?_)⟩
    rw [coordProj_apply]
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne ((hkey i₀ hi₀ a).trans (mul_comm _ _))
  · 
    push Not at hex; exfalso
    have hall : ∀ i : Fin n, φ (e_ i) = 0 := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i.val < m
      · exact hex i hi
      · exact algHom_pair_basis_zero m hm hpar φ i (by omega)
    
    have hφ_zero : φ.toLinearMap = 0 := by
      apply (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)).ext; intro i
      show φ (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n) i) = 0
      have : Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n) i = e_ i := by
        ext l; simp [Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.single_apply, e_, KM.ofFun, eq_comm]
      rw [this]; exact hall i
    have : φ 1 = 0 := by
      have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hφ_zero 1
      simp [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply] at h
    linarith [map_one φ]

name: TubalTensor.realness_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem realness_of_algEquiv (td₁ td₂ : TubalData n)
    (h : Nonempty (KM n td₁ ≃ₐ[ℝ] KM n td₂)) :
    realness td₁ = realness td₂
proof:
:= by
  set m₁ := realness td₁
  set m₂ := realness td₂
  
  obtain ⟨iso₁⟩ := KM_algEquiv_canonical td₁
  obtain ⟨iso₂⟩ := KM_algEquiv_canonical td₂
  obtain ⟨ψ⟩ := h
  
  set ctd₁ := canonicalTubalData n m₁ (realness_le td₁) (realness_parity td₁)
  set ctd₂ := canonicalTubalData n m₂ (realness_le td₂) (realness_parity td₂)
  set ψ' : KM n ctd₁ ≃ₐ[ℝ] KM n ctd₂ := iso₁.symm.trans (ψ.trans iso₂)
  
  
  have hinj : ∀ (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val < m₂),
      ∃ (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < m₁),
        (coordProj m₂ (realness_le td₂) (realness_parity td₂) i hi).comp ψ'.toAlgHom =
        coordProj m₁ (realness_le td₁) (realness_parity td₁) j hj := by
    intro i hi
    exact algHom_canonical_eq_coordProj m₁ (realness_le td₁) (realness_parity td₁) _
  
  
  suffices key : ∀ (m_s m_t : ℕ) (hms : m_s ≤ n) (hps : n % 2 = m_s % 2)
      (hmt : m_t ≤ n) (hpt : n % 2 = m_t % 2),
      Nonempty (KM n (canonicalTubalData n m_s hms hps) ≃ₐ[ℝ]
       KM n (canonicalTubalData n m_t hmt hpt)) → m_t ≤ m_s by
    exact le_antisymm (key _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨ψ'.symm⟩) (key _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨ψ'⟩)
  intro m_s m_t hms hps hmt hpt ⟨φ⟩
  by_contra h_lt; push Not at h_lt
  
  
  have hf : ∀ (i : Fin m_t),
      ∃ (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < m_s),
        (coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ i.isLt).comp φ.toAlgHom =
        coordProj m_s hms hps j hj :=
    fun i => algHom_canonical_eq_coordProj m_s hms hps
      ((coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ i.isLt).comp φ.toAlgHom)
  choose f hf_lt hf_eq using hf
  
  set g : Fin m_t → Fin m_s := fun i => ⟨(f i).val, hf_lt i⟩
  
  have g_inj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro a b hab
    have hv : (g a).val = (g b).val := congr_arg Fin.val hab
    have hfab : f a = f b := Fin.ext hv
    
    have hcp : coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨a.val, by omega⟩ a.isLt =
               coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨b.val, by omega⟩ b.isLt := by
      apply AlgHom.ext; intro y; obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := φ.surjective y
      have ha := AlgHom.congr_fun (hf_eq a) x
      have hb := AlgHom.congr_fun (hf_eq b) x
      change ((coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨a.val, _⟩ a.isLt).comp φ.toAlgHom) x =
             ((coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨b.val, _⟩ b.isLt).comp φ.toAlgHom) x
      rw [ha, hb]; simp only [coordProj_apply]; rw [hfab]
    have h := coordProj_injective m_t hmt hpt _ _ a.isLt b.isLt hcp
    have hv2 := congr_arg Fin.val h
    exact Fin.ext hv2
  
  exact absurd (Fintype.card_le_of_injective g g_inj) (by simp; omega)

name: TubalTensor.KM_algEquiv_of_realness_eq
statement:
theorem KM_algEquiv_of_realness_eq (td₁ td₂ : TubalData n) (h : realness td₁ = realness td₂) :
    Nonempty (KM n td₁ ≃ₐ[ℝ] KM n td₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨iso₁⟩ := KM_algEquiv_canonical td₁
  obtain ⟨iso₂⟩ := KM_algEquiv_canonical td₂
  
  have hctd : canonicalTubalData n (realness td₁) (realness_le td₁) (realness_parity td₁) =
    canonicalTubalData n (realness td₂) (realness_le td₂) (realness_parity td₂) := by
    
    suffices ∀ (a b : ℕ) (hab : a = b) (ha : a ≤ n) (hb : b ≤ n)
        (hpa : n % 2 = a % 2) (hpb : n % 2 = b % 2),
        canonicalTubalData n a ha hpa = canonicalTubalData n b hb hpb from
      this _ _ h _ _ _ _
    intro a b hab; subst hab; intros; rfl
  rw [hctd] at iso₁
  exact ⟨iso₁.trans iso₂.symm⟩

name: TubalTensor.KM_algEquiv_iff_realness_eq
statement:
theorem KM_algEquiv_iff_realness_eq (td₁ td₂ : TubalData n) :
    Nonempty (KM n td₁ ≃ₐ[ℝ] KM n td₂) ↔ realness td₁ = realness td₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨realness_of_algEquiv td₁ td₂, KM_algEquiv_of_realness_eq td₁ td₂⟩

name: TubalTensor.KM_ringEquiv_canonical
statement:
theorem KM_ringEquiv_canonical (td : TubalData n) :
    Nonempty (KM n td ≃+* KM n (canonicalTubalData n (realness td)
      (realness_le td) (realness_parity td)))
proof:
:=
  (KM_algEquiv_canonical td).map AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv

name: TubalTensor.KM_ringEquiv_of_realness_eq
statement:
theorem KM_ringEquiv_of_realness_eq (td₁ td₂ : TubalData n)
    (h : realness td₁ = realness td₂) :
    Nonempty (KM n td₁ ≃+* KM n td₂)
proof:
:=
  (KM_algEquiv_of_realness_eq td₁ td₂ h).map AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv

name: TubalTensor.ringHom_toAlgHom_apply
proof: := rfl

name: TubalTensor.realness_of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem realness_of_ringEquiv (td₁ td₂ : TubalData n)
    (h : Nonempty (KM n td₁ ≃+* KM n td₂)) :
    realness td₁ = realness td₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := h
  set m₁ := realness td₁; set m₂ := realness td₂
  obtain ⟨iso₁⟩ := KM_algEquiv_canonical td₁
  obtain ⟨iso₂⟩ := KM_algEquiv_canonical td₂
  set ψ' : KM n (canonicalTubalData n m₁ (realness_le td₁) (realness_parity td₁)) ≃+*
            KM n (canonicalTubalData n m₂ (realness_le td₂) (realness_parity td₂)) :=
    iso₁.symm.toRingEquiv.trans (f.trans iso₂.toRingEquiv)
  suffices key : ∀ (m_s m_t : ℕ) (hms : m_s ≤ n) (hps : n % 2 = m_s % 2)
      (hmt : m_t ≤ n) (hpt : n % 2 = m_t % 2),
      Nonempty (KM n (canonicalTubalData n m_s hms hps) ≃+*
       KM n (canonicalTubalData n m_t hmt hpt)) → m_t ≤ m_s by
    exact le_antisymm (key _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨ψ'.symm⟩) (key _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨ψ'⟩)
  intro m_s m_t hms hps hmt hpt ⟨φ⟩
  by_contra h_lt; push Not at h_lt
  
  
  
  let mkAlgHom (i : Fin m_t) : KM n (canonicalTubalData n m_s hms hps) →ₐ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    ringHom_toAlgHom _
      ((coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ i.isLt).toRingHom.comp φ.toRingHom)
  have hf : ∀ (i : Fin m_t),
      ∃ (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < m_s), mkAlgHom i = coordProj m_s hms hps j hj :=
    fun i => algHom_canonical_eq_coordProj m_s hms hps (mkAlgHom i)
  choose f' hf_lt hf_eq using hf
  set g : Fin m_t → Fin m_s := fun i => ⟨(f' i).val, hf_lt i⟩
  have g_inj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro a b hab
    have hv : (g a).val = (g b).val := congr_arg Fin.val hab
    have hfab : f' a = f' b := Fin.ext hv
    have hcp : coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨a.val, by omega⟩ a.isLt =
               coordProj m_t hmt hpt ⟨b.val, by omega⟩ b.isLt := by
      apply AlgHom.ext; intro y; obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := φ.surjective y
      show mkAlgHom a x = mkAlgHom b x
      rw [AlgHom.congr_fun (hf_eq a) x, AlgHom.congr_fun (hf_eq b) x]
      simp only [coordProj_apply, hfab]
    have h := congr_arg Fin.val (coordProj_injective m_t hmt hpt _ _ a.isLt b.isLt hcp)
    exact Fin.ext h
  exact absurd (Fintype.card_le_of_injective g g_inj) (by simp; omega)

name: TubalTensor.KM_ringEquiv_iff_realness_eq
statement:
theorem KM_ringEquiv_iff_realness_eq (td₁ td₂ : TubalData n) :
    Nonempty (KM n td₁ ≃+* KM n td₂) ↔ realness td₁ = realness td₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨realness_of_ringEquiv td₁ td₂, fun h => KM_ringEquiv_of_realness_eq td₁ td₂ h⟩
